Beichen embeds weight management into 10 chronic-disease centers and 14 diabetes clinics, with 98% family-doctor coverage among key groups and Tianjin's first Level-4A health-information interoperability rating.
  • 守护"夕阳红"：银龄智健行项目启动，构建老年慢病全周期防控体系
    Protecting the golden years: 'Silver Age Smart Health' initiative builds a full-cycle prevention system for chronic disease in the elderly
    新华社报道老年慢病防控新生态：国家慢性病综合防控示范区已达578个，"三减三健"覆盖2800多个县区。"银龄智健行"项目启动，构建"筛查—干预—管理—支持"全周期体系；专家提出干预从通用化向精准化、个性化转变，上海中医药大学展示中西医结合应对老年肌少症与脂肪肝共病的实践。
    Xinhua reports on China's evolving elderly chronic-disease control: 578 national demonstration zones and the "Three Reductions, Three Healths" campaign now cover over 2,800 counties. The newly launched "Silver Age" self-health and Smart Health initiatives aim to build a full-cycle screening-intervention-management-support system, with experts urging a shift from generic to precision, personalized intervention; Shanghai University of TCM showcased integrated approaches to sarcopenia-fatty liver comorbidity in the elderly.
  • "儿童肠菌移植技术联盟"在深圳成立，儿童精准营养与肠道微生态临床研究提速
    Pediatric FMT technology alliance founded in Shenzhen to accelerate child gut-microbiota clinical research and precision nutrition
    儿童肠菌移植技术联盟成立暨学术论坛10月19日在深圳市儿童医院龙华院区举行，肠道微生态诊疗与临床研究中心同步挂牌，推动珠三角儿童肠菌移植规范化与多中心研究。专家梳理儿童益生菌科学选菌三原则：功效精确到株、足量与活性有保障、按年龄段安全合规，并强调本土循证证据是儿童精准营养的关键。
    A pediatric fecal microbiota transplantation technology alliance was founded on October 19 at Shenzhen Children's Hospital Longgang campus, alongside a gut-microecology clinical research center, to standardize pediatric FMT and drive multicenter studies in the Greater Bay Area. Experts outlined three principles for strain-specific probiotic selection in children — evidence tied to named strains, guaranteed potency and viability, and age-appropriate safety compliance — stressing local-population evidence as key to pediatric precision nutrition.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-20
item.description: 2026-10-20 简报，共 20 条：上海交大贾伟团队Cell发文：女性富集肠道菌产生isoUDCA胆汁酸，解释慢性肝病的性别保护差异；梅奥诊所：脂肪肝其实是五种不同疾病，Nature Communications 揭示MASLD生物学亚型；哥伦比亚大学揭示APOE ε4携带者逃逸阿尔茨海默病的机制：FN1罕见突变护血管；热心肠日报：婴儿肠道炎症与特定致病菌让口服轮状病毒疫苗大打折扣；罗氏最高11.6亿美元引进大睿生物ALK7 RNAi肥胖药物，直击脂肪细胞保瘦体重；华中科大：16+8限时进食重塑肠菌产乙酸，延缓血管衰老并护心；西奈山发现年轻蛋白TIMP2：回补可让衰老大脑免疫细胞重返年轻；线粒体靶向药物递送系统应对年龄相关疾病：机制、策略与转化瓶颈综述；中国农科院召开精准营养与个性化食品创新科学会议，多学科夯实理论根基；膳食多糖作为SCFA直接底物：Frontiers综述提出精准益生元双轨干预框架；剑桥大学测试39种甜味剂：多数影响肠道菌，与药物联用效应被放大；可3D打印的三文鱼：双蛋白仿生食品为吞咽障碍老人定制营养；欧盟启动新平台，加速欧盟与英国新型食品审批；孕前叶酸：认知度高但实际补充率低，研究呼吁关口前移；韩国Dongkoo Bio&Pharma瞄准听力健康补剂，打造增长新引擎；Vivify收购AuNutra原料平台，补剂行业并购聚焦上游成分资产；新华网起底抗衰产品：NAD+抗衰针乱象与二甲双胍直播话术均无循证支撑；每天3000步即可减缓阿尔茨海默病tau蛋白积累，5000-7500步效果最佳；UC Berkeley揭开深睡-生长激素双向环路：睡眠增肌燃脂健脑的机制；襄阳中医医院体重管理与2型糖尿病逆转中心提质升级，中西医协同全周期管理
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 上海交大贾伟团队Cell发文：女性富集肠道菌产生isoUDCA胆汁酸，解释慢性肝病的性别保护差异
    SJTU Jia Wei Team Publishes in Cell: Female-Enriched Gut Microbiota Produces isoUDCA Bile Acid, Explaining Women's Protection Against Chronic Liver Disease
    上海交大六院贾伟团队10月19日在Cell发表研究：基于9254人胆汁酸谱首次鉴定女性富集胆汁酸isoUDCA，其水平女性较高、慢性肝病患者较低，可解释约19.57%的性别与肝病关联；研究锁定6种女性富集菌组合，揭示isoUDCA促进肝胆固醇与胆汁酸代谢、减轻肝损伤，为慢性肝病干预提供新靶点。
    On Oct 19, a team led by Jia Wei at Shanghai Jiao Tong University published in Cell: analyzing bile acid profiles of 9,254 subjects, they identified the female-enriched bile acid isoUDCA, higher in women and lower in chronic liver disease patients, explaining about 19.57% of the sex-disease association. They pinpointed a six-species female-enriched bacterial combination (FPBC) and showed isoUDCA promotes hepatic cholesterol and bile acid metabolism via SREBP2-STARD4-CYP7B1, easing liver injury — a new target for chronic liver disease.
  • 梅奥诊所：脂肪肝其实是五种不同疾病，Nature Communications 揭示MASLD生物学亚型
    Fatty Liver Disease Is Actually Five Different Conditions, Scientists Discover
    梅奥诊所团队10月18日在Nature Communications发文：整合4600余名MASLD患者基因组与临床数据，发现脂肪肝实为五种生物学亚型——部分与肥胖糖尿病相关，部分由遗传驱动且更易进展为晚期肝损伤；并首次发现亚型与抑郁、睡眠呼吸暂停、偏头痛相关，为分层筛查与按机制匹配治疗奠定基础。
    Mayo Clinic and Virginia Tech reported in Nature Communications (Oct 18): integrating genomic and clinical data from over 4,600 MASLD patients, they identified five biologically distinct fatty liver subtypes — some tightly linked to obesity and diabetes, others genetically driven and more prone to advanced liver damage — and first-time associations with depression, sleep apnea and migraine, laying groundwork for stratified screening and biology-matched treatment including GLP-1 response differences.
  • 哥伦比亚大学揭示APOE ε4携带者逃逸阿尔茨海默病的机制：FN1罕见突变护血管
    Why Some People Escape Alzheimer's Despite Carrying a High-risk Gene
    哥伦比亚大学团队10月19日在Nature Aging发文：APOE ε4促使纤连蛋白在脑血管周围过度堆积、削弱血脑屏障，而FN1基因罕见突变可限制该堆积，解释部分高危携带者80多岁仍认知敏锐；星形胶质细胞过表达纤连蛋白足以令屏障渗漏，减少则恢复功能，为模拟天然防御的抗AD疗法提出路径。
    Columbia University reported in Nature Aging (Oct 19): APOE ε4 drives excess fibronectin accumulation around brain vessels, weakening the blood-brain barrier via integrin-FAK signaling that disrupts the VEGF/HBEGF/IGF1 network; a rare FN1 mutation limits this buildup, explaining why some high-risk carriers stay sharp into their 80s. Overexpressing fibronectin in astrocytes sufficed to make the barrier leaky, while reducing it restored function — pointing to ways to mimic this natural defense.
  • 热心肠日报：婴儿肠道炎症与特定致病菌让口服轮状病毒疫苗大打折扣
    Infant Gut Inflammation and Specific Pathobionts Undermine Oral Rotavirus Vaccine Efficacy
    热心肠日报10月19日报道Nature Communications研究：婴儿肠道炎症与克雷伯菌等致病共生菌会削弱口服轮状病毒疫苗效力；团队提出以特定噬菌体提早靶向清除致病菌、重塑肠道免疫稳态，并将干预窗口前移至新生儿期，为低收入国家提升疫苗应答提供菌群靶点。
    China-Gut Daily reported on Oct 19 a Nature Communications study: infant gut inflammation and specific pathobionts such as Klebsiella markedly weaken oral rotavirus vaccine efficacy. Rather than adding conventional probiotics alone, the team proposes using targeted phages to clear pathobionts early and reshape gut immune homeostasis, moving intervention to the neonatal window — offering a defined microbiome target to improve vaccine response in low-income countries.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 罗氏最高11.6亿美元引进大睿生物ALK7 RNAi肥胖药物，直击脂肪细胞保瘦体重
    Roche Licenses Rona Therapeutics' ALK7 RNAi Obesity Drug in Deal Worth Up to $1.16 Billion
    大睿生物10月13日宣布与罗氏达成全球独家授权：靶向ALK7、基于肝外递送平台的RNAi候选药授权罗氏开发肥胖与代谢病，首付及近期里程碑最高1亿美元、总额最高11.6亿美元。ALK7直击脂肪细胞，有望选择性减少内脏脂肪、保留瘦体重，与GLP-1机制互补，为年内第二笔超10亿美元同类交易。
    Rona Therapeutics announced on Oct 13 an exclusive worldwide license with Roche for its ALK7-targeted RNAi candidate built on a proprietary extrahepatic delivery platform for obesity and metabolic disease — up to $100M upfront and near-term milestones, up to $1.16B in total. ALK7 targets adipocyte biology directly, potentially reducing visceral fat while preserving lean mass and complementing incretin-based therapies; it is the second $1B+ ALK7 RNAi deal this year.
  • 华中科大：16+8限时进食重塑肠菌产乙酸，延缓血管衰老并护心
    16:8 Time-Restricted Feeding Delays Vascular Aging via Gut Microbiota-Derived Acetate, HUST Study Finds
    华中科技大学团队在Aging Cell发表研究（10月19日报道）：16+8限时进食不影响体重血糖，经重塑肠道菌群富集产乙酸菌、升高乙酸，显著延缓小鼠血管衰老并护心；肠菌移植或补乙酸均可重现保护，清除菌群后消失，为饮食干预延缓心血管衰老提供机制依据。
    A Huazhong University of Science and Technology team reported in Aging Cell (covered Oct 19): 16:8 time-restricted feeding, without changing weight or glucose, remodels gut microbiota to enrich acetate-producing bacteria and raise acetate levels, significantly lowering hypertension and vascular stiffness in mice while improving heart health; fecal microbiota transfer or acetate supplementation reproduced the benefit, which vanished after antibiotics — a mechanistic basis for dietary intervention against cardiovascular aging.
  • 西奈山发现年轻蛋白TIMP2：回补可让衰老大脑免疫细胞重返年轻
    Scientists Find a Youth Protein (TIMP2) That Helps Aging Brain Immune Cells Act Young Again
    西奈山伊坎医学院团队10月17日在Nature Communications发文：年轻相关蛋白TIMP2缺失会使小胶质细胞呈衰老样状态、清除碎片能力下降；对老年小鼠回补TIMP2可恢复清除功能并降低炎症特征，提示回输年轻相关因子或可延缓脑免疫衰老，为阿尔茨海默病干预提供新方向。
    Mount Sinai researchers reported in Nature Communications (Oct 17): loss of the youth-associated protein TIMP2 drives microglia toward aged-like states with impaired debris clearance and elevated inflammatory signatures; restoring circulating TIMP2 in older mice revived their clearance function and dampened inflammatory markers — suggesting that youthful blood-borne factors may rejuvenate the brain's immune system and informing future strategies against Alzheimer's and related disorders.
  • 线粒体靶向药物递送系统应对年龄相关疾病：机制、策略与转化瓶颈综述
    Mitochondria-Targeted Drug Delivery Systems for Aging-Related Diseases: Mechanisms, Strategies and Advances
    生物通10月18日报道Journal of Controlled Release综述：梳理线粒体靶向药物递送在神经退行病、心血管病、肌少症等年龄相关疾病中的机制与策略，涵盖被动/主动靶向、刺激响应与仿生平台，及NAD+补充、线粒体移植等新兴干预；并指出靶向不稳、长期安全性与标准化缺失等转化瓶颈。
    ebiotrade reported on Oct 18 a Journal of Controlled Release review: mitochondrial dysfunction underlies neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, sarcopenia and osteoarthritis; the review surveys passive, stimuli-responsive, active and biomimetic mitochondrial-targeted delivery platforms, plus emerging interventions including NAD+ supplementation, mitochondrial gene delivery, EV-mediated transfer and mitochondrial transplantation, while flagging instability under pathological conditions, long-term safety and lack of standardized evaluation as key translational bottlenecks.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 中国农科院召开精准营养与个性化食品创新科学会议，多学科夯实理论根基
    CAAS Convenes Science Meeting on Precision Nutrition and Personalized Food Innovation
    中国农科院10月16日在京召开第七期科学会议，主题为精准营养与个性化食品创新，北大、清华等十余位专家围绕营养暗物质智能挖掘、膳食健康效应解析，从表观遗传、肠道菌群、AI建模、功能食品创制等维度研讨；专家呼吁多学科交叉融合，夯实精准营养理论根基、保障全生命周期健康。
    The Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences convened its seventh Fundamental Science Center meeting in Beijing on Oct 16 under the theme of precision nutrition and personalized food innovation. A dozen experts from Peking University, Tsinghua and PUTH discussed intelligent mining of nutritional dark matter and dietary health effects across epigenetic regulation, gut microbiota, AI modeling, nutritional epidemiology and functional food creation, urging deeper interdisciplinary integration to strengthen the theoretical foundation of precision nutrition for whole-of-life health.
  • 膳食多糖作为SCFA直接底物：Frontiers综述提出精准益生元双轨干预框架
    Dietary Polysaccharides as Direct Substrates for SCFA Production: A Dual-Track Precision Prebiotic Framework
    Frontiers in Microbiology 10月16日接收的综述提出精准益生元双轨框架：膳食多糖的单糖组成、糖苷键与分支结构决定哪些产短链脂肪酸菌可利用它们；据此可按结构匹配目标菌群，并结合个体基线菌群与疾病缺陷个性化选择，推动益生元从经验走向机制驱动的精准营养工具。
    A Frontiers in Microbiology review (accepted Oct 16) proposes a dual-track precision prebiotic framework: the monosaccharide composition, glycosidic linkages, molecular weight and branching of dietary polysaccharides determine which SCFA-producing taxa can access them, governed by CAZyme repertoires and cross-feeding networks. Structure-guided matching to target SCFA producers, combined with individualized selection based on baseline microbiota and disease-specific deficits, could advance prebiotics from empirical use to mechanism-driven precision nutrition tools (pending human validation).
  • 剑桥大学测试39种甜味剂：多数影响肠道菌，与药物联用效应被放大
    Scientists Tested 39 Sweeteners and Uncovered Surprising Gut Effects
    剑桥大学团队10月17日在Molecular Systems Biology发文：体外测试39种甜味剂与25种肠道菌，约四分之三甜味剂改变至少一种菌生长；异甜菊醇与抗抑郁药度洛西汀联用强烈抑制罗斯氏菌等关键菌并降低菌群多样性，提示甜味剂并非代谢惰性，与药物同服的互作值得警惕。
    University of Cambridge MRC Toxicology Unit reported in Molecular Systems Biology (Oct 17): testing 39 sweeteners against 25 gut bacterial species in vitro, roughly three-quarters altered the growth of at least one species; the sweetener isosteviol combined with the antidepressant duloxetine strongly suppressed key bacteria including Roseburia intestinalis and reduced diversity in a simulated community. Over 100 combination interactions suggest sweeteners are not metabolically inert — co-exposure with drugs and additives warrants attention, pending human studies.
  • 可3D打印的三文鱼：双蛋白仿生食品为吞咽障碍老人定制营养
    3D-Printed 'Salmon' Delivers Personalized Nutrition for Elderly with Swallowing Difficulties
    人民日报海外版10月19日报道，中国农科院加工所团队以核桃蛋白与蛋清蛋白双蛋白体系为墨水3D打印仿生三文鱼：蛋白含量22%、补充效率较传统提高200%，可按国际标准定制IDDSI 4-6级软膳，为吞咽障碍老人提供安全营养美味的个性化膳食。
    People's Daily Overseas Edition reported on Oct 19: a CAAS Institute of Food Science team used walnut-protein and egg-white dual-protein emulsion gels as ink for dual-feed 3D printing, recreating salmon's texture into a high-protein, easy-to-swallow food — 22% protein, 200% higher protein-replenishment efficiency than conventional products, with baking precisely tuned to cover IDDSI levels 4–6 for graded, personalized nutrition for elderly people with dysphagia.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 欧盟启动新平台，加速欧盟与英国新型食品审批
    EU Platform Launched to Accelerate Novel Food Approvals in EU and UK
    NutraIngredients 10月15日报道，旨在加速欧盟与英国新型食品审批的新平台上线，试图缩短创新成分从申报到上市的周期。对补剂与功能食品行业而言，审批提速意味着益生菌、植物提取物等新原料进入欧洲市场路径更可预期，或改变企业新品规划与区域上市策略。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 15 that a new platform has launched to speed up novel food approvals in the EU and UK, aiming to shorten the path from dossier to market. For the supplement and functional food industry, faster approvals make the route to market for ingredients such as probiotics and botanical extracts more predictable, potentially reshaping launch planning and regional go-to-market strategies.
  • 孕前叶酸：认知度高但实际补充率低，研究呼吁关口前移
    Folic Acid Before Pregnancy: Study Finds Low Adherence Despite High Awareness
    NutraIngredients 10月19日报道新研究：女性叶酸认知度虽高，孕前实际补充率却明显不足，意识与行为落差显著。研究者呼吁将干预前移至孕前，以更清晰的公共健康引导与更易得的产品形式提升覆盖率，降低神经管缺陷风险，也为孕产营养品牌指明教育型营销方向。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 19 a new study: despite high awareness of folic acid among women, pre-pregnancy supplementation rates remain low, revealing a clear knowledge-behavior gap. Researchers call for moving intervention earlier — clearer public-health guidance, more accessible formats and better-targeted education — to raise preconception coverage, reduce neural tube defect risk and point supplement brands toward education-led strategies.
  • 韩国Dongkoo Bio&Pharma瞄准听力健康补剂，打造增长新引擎
    Dongkoo Bio&Pharma Targets Underserved Hearing Care Category as Growth Engine
    NutraIngredients 10月19日报道，韩国Dongkoo Bio&Pharma将听力健康定位为下一个增长引擎，布局这一长期被忽视的补剂品类。随着老龄化与听力损失人群扩大，听力营养正成为差异化新赛道，为老年健康营养干预提供新商业样本，或带动更多厂商跟进。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 19 that South Korea's Dongkoo Bio&Pharma is positioning hearing care as its next growth engine, building supplement offerings in this long-underserved category. With global aging and a growing hearing-loss population, hearing nutrition is emerging as a differentiated new track, offering a commercial template for nutritional interventions in ENT and geriatric health and likely drawing more manufacturers into the gap.
  • Vivify收购AuNutra原料平台，补剂行业并购聚焦上游成分资产
    Vivify Acquires AuNutra Industries Ingredient Platform
    NutraIngredients 10月19日报道，Vivify收购AuNutra Industries原料平台，整合成分资产以强化产品矩阵与供应链掌控力。补剂行业并购活跃，品牌方正通过掌控特色原料构筑壁垒，原料平台所有权或成下一阶段竞争关键变量。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 19 that Vivify has acquired AuNutra Industries' ingredient platform, folding in its component assets to strengthen its product matrix and supply-chain control. M&A across the supplement sector remains active as brands build differentiation through ownership of signature ingredients — ingredient platform ownership may become a decisive competitive variable, opening integration and revaluation opportunities for upstream suppliers.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 新华网起底抗衰产品：NAD+抗衰针乱象与二甲双胍直播话术均无循证支撑
    The Science Behind Anti-Aging Products: Xinhua Investigates NAD+ Drips and Metformin Hype
    新华网10月20日刊发调查：医美机构将药品级NAD+注射剂包装为抗衰营养针推销给健康人群，存在超适应症、超剂量、改给药途径等乱象，2026版专家共识仅面向特定临床人群；二甲双胍抗衰延寿人体尚无定论、擅自服用风险大，专家提醒勿把基础研究等同于临床获益。
    Xinhua published an investigation on Oct 20: medical-aesthetic institutions market pharmaceutical-grade NAD+ injections to healthy people as anti-aging nutrient drips, off-label and at altered doses and routes — the 2026 expert consensus covers only specific elderly clinical populations. Metformin's anti-aging benefit in humans remains unproven, live-stream claims are unfounded, and unsupervised long-term use of this prescription drug is risky. Experts warn against equating basic research with clinical benefit.
  • 每天3000步即可减缓阿尔茨海默病tau蛋白积累，5000-7500步效果最佳
    Just 3,000 Steps a Day May Help Slow Alzheimer's, Scientists Find
    The Conversation 10月19日文章：一项追踪近300名已有阿尔茨海默病早期脑征象老人9-11年的计步研究发现，运动未减少淀粉样斑块，但显著减缓tau蛋白积累、认知与功能衰退近乎减半；获益自每天3000步出现、5000-7500步最佳，万步目标并非必需。
    The Conversation (Oct 19): a pedometer study tracking nearly 300 older adults with early Alzheimer's brain signs for 9–11 years found that physical activity did not reduce amyloid plaques but markedly slowed misfolded tau accumulation in key brain regions, nearly halving cognitive and functional decline. Benefits appeared at 3,000 steps (about 30 minutes of brisk walking), peaked at 5,000–7,500 and plateaued — suggesting the 10,000-step goal is unnecessary for real protection.
  • UC Berkeley揭开深睡-生长激素双向环路：睡眠增肌燃脂健脑的机制
    How Deep Sleep Builds Muscle, Burns Fat and Boosts the Brain: A Brain Circuit Revealed
    加州大学伯克利分校团队10月17日在Cell发文：绘制深度睡眠调控生长激素释放的下丘脑神经环路，并发现生长激素反馈作用于蓝斑促进觉醒，形成双向稳态环路；该机制解释睡眠不足如何干扰生长、肌骨修复与脂糖代谢，或为代谢病与神经退行病相关睡眠障碍提供新靶点。
    UC Berkeley researchers reported in Cell (Oct 17): recording neural activity in mice, they mapped the hypothalamic GHRH and somatostatin circuitry governing growth hormone release during deep sleep and discovered that accumulated growth hormone feeds back to the locus coeruleus to promote waking — a bidirectional homeostatic loop. The mechanism explains how poor sleep disrupts growth, muscle-bone repair and fat-glucose metabolism, and may inspire treatments for sleep disorders tied to metabolic and neurodegenerative disease.
  • 襄阳中医医院体重管理与2型糖尿病逆转中心提质升级，中西医协同全周期管理
    Xiangyang TCM Hospital Upgrades Weight Management and Type 2 Diabetes Reversal Centers
    襄阳市卫健委10月19日消息，襄阳市中医医院体重管理与2型糖尿病逆转中心提质升级：以人体成分、内脏脂肪与运动心肺测试精准界定干预边界，结合四色肥胖中医辨证分型施治，从单一治病转向全周期健康管理，响应国家体重管理年行动。
    Xiangyang Municipal Health Commission announced on Oct 19: the city's TCM hospital has upgraded its integrated weight management and type 2 diabetes reversal centers, with assessment, functional testing and TCM treatment zones and 20 inpatient beds. Using body composition, visceral fat and cardiopulmonary exercise testing to define intervention boundaries, combined with four-pattern TCM obesity syndrome differentiation for stratified individualized care, the centers shift from single-visit treatment toward whole-cycle health management in line with the national Weight Management Year initiative.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-19
item.description: 2026-10-19 简报，共 20 条：近9万人研究：红肉中一种罕见糖分与2型糖尿病风险升高63%相关；新药通过修复肠道逆转严重脂肪肝，肠-肝轴再获关键证据；高脂饮食可将肝脏再生区室持久重编程为衰老样状态，MitoQ部分恢复；源自大豆的天然化合物LPC70或可保护大脑免受高盐伤害；骨髓巨噬细胞STING信号成骨骼衰老枢纽：消耗NMN、抑制成骨；NAD+补剂真能带来健康衰老吗？现有人体证据全景盘点；4周尿石素A补充未改善中年肥胖者血管内皮功能，脑血流反应却升高；1.8万人队列：血液代谢组学年龄与慢病及死亡风险相关；FGA功能基因组分析平台亮相深圳HNC健康营养展，聚焦精准抗衰新路径；世界食品日：CIC bioGUNE解析精准营养的分子、免疫与昼夜节律维度；吹口气就能判断膳食质量？呼气挥发组或成精准营养无创监测新范式；肠道细菌可能正在改变你实际吸收的卡路里数量；Elysium发布更年期支持补剂Balance：NAD+科学叠加S-equol与麦角硫因；第115届全国糖酒会：中粮营养健康科技携悦活U格益生菌全系亮相；每天吃蓝莓连续三个月：老年参与者抑郁症状减轻，肠道菌群同步变化；B族维生素新知：从能量辅因子到肠-脑-免疫调节者；广东省二医糖胖病逆转中心深圳分中心揭牌，慢病管理转向主动健康；'不难瘦才享受'健康减重科普全国巡展成都站举行：科学减重无需硬扛；吃得不多却瘦不下来？可能是胰岛素抵抗在作怪；VTN未来健康峰会发布'1+N'抗炎营养与长寿健康解决方案
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 近9万人研究：红肉中一种罕见糖分与2型糖尿病风险升高63%相关
    Study of Nearly 90,000 Adults Links a Little-Known Sugar in Red Meat to a 63% Higher Risk of Type 2 Diabetes
    一项纳入近9万名成人的新研究发现，摄入红肉中一种鲜为人知的糖分（Neu5Gc）最多的人群，患2型糖尿病的风险高出63%。科学家怀疑这种糖可能引发慢性炎症，为红肉摄入与代谢性疾病之间的关联提供了新的机制解释。
    A new study of nearly 90,000 adults found that people with the highest intake of a little-known sugar in red meat (Neu5Gc) had a 63% higher risk of type 2 diabetes. Scientists suspect the sugar may trigger chronic inflammation, offering a new mechanistic explanation for the link between red meat consumption and metabolic disease.
  • 新药通过修复肠道逆转严重脂肪肝，肠-肝轴再获关键证据
    Experimental Drug Reverses Severe Fatty Liver Disease by Repairing the Gut
    科学家发现一种潜在新药，可在动物模型中通过恢复肠道健康、阻止有害物质抵达肝脏，从而逆转严重脂肪肝疾病。研究再次印证肠道屏障与肠道菌群是代谢性肝病的关键干预入口，这一突破或为脂肪性肝炎等疾病的新疗法铺平道路。
    Scientists have identified a potential new drug that reverses severe fatty liver disease in animal models by restoring gut health and blocking harmful substances from reaching the liver. The findings reinforce the gut barrier and microbiome as key intervention points for metabolic liver disease and may pave the way for new therapies such as steatohepatitis treatment.
  • 高脂饮食可将肝脏再生区室持久重编程为衰老样状态，MitoQ部分恢复
    High-Fat Diet Persistently Reprograms Liver Regenerative Compartments into a Senescence-Like State; MitoQ Partially Restores Function
    肝类器官研究显示，高脂饮食诱导的代谢应激会将肝脏再生区室持久重编程为衰老样状态，且离开原始代谢环境后异常仍持续传代；线粒体靶向抗氧化剂MitoQ可降低ROS与炎症因子并部分恢复类器官形成效率，提示线粒体功能障碍是再生缺陷的关键功能组分。
    Using liver organoids, researchers showed that metabolic stress from a high-fat diet persistently reprograms liver regenerative compartments into a senescence-like state, with abnormalities carried through successive passages even after leaving the original environment. The mitochondria-targeted antioxidant MitoQ lowered ROS and inflammatory markers and partially restored organoid-forming efficiency, pointing to mitochondrial dysfunction as a key functional component of the regenerative defect.
  • 源自大豆的天然化合物LPC70或可保护大脑免受高盐伤害
    Soy-Derived Compound LPC70 May Protect the Brain from Excess Salt
    日本研究人员的一项新研究显示，摄入过多盐分不仅可能升高血压，还可能损害记忆和社交行为；而一种源自大豆的天然化合物LPC70能够保护大脑免受过多盐分的伤害。这为高盐饮食人群的神经保护提供了源于日常膳食的潜在干预新思路。
    A new study by Japanese researchers suggests that excess salt intake may not only raise blood pressure but also impair memory and social behavior, while LPC70, a natural soy-derived compound, can protect the brain from salt-induced damage. The finding points to a diet-based strategy for protecting the nervous system in people with high-salt diets.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 骨髓巨噬细胞STING信号成骨骼衰老枢纽：消耗NMN、抑制成骨
    Bone Marrow Macrophage STING Signaling Emerges as a Hub of Skeletal Aging, Depleting NMN and Impairing Bone Formation
    《Advanced Science》刊载的研究显示，衰老骨髓中巨噬细胞STING信号随龄激活，上调CD38并以其胞外NAD酶活性消耗微环境中的NMN，阻断骨髓间充质干细胞的NAD+补救合成与成骨分化；STING抑制剂H-151联合NMN补充可减轻小鼠骨丢失，为衰老骨髓微环境干预提供新靶点。
    A study in Advanced Science shows that STING signaling in aged bone marrow macrophages is activated with age, upregulating CD38 whose ecto-NADase activity depletes NMN from the niche, blocking NAD+ salvage and osteogenic differentiation in bone marrow stromal cells. Combining the STING inhibitor H-151 with NMN supplementation reduced bone loss in mice, suggesting a new target for intervening in the aging marrow microenvironment.
  • NAD+补剂真能带来健康衰老吗？现有人体证据全景盘点
    Can NAD+ Supplements Really Support Healthy Aging? A Roundup of the Human Evidence
    科普文章系统盘点NAD+补剂证据：NR与NMN确能显著升高血液NAD+水平，脂质体NAD+在小样本试验中使细胞内NAD+升高逾64%；但33项人体研究的系统综述显示其对体能、代谢等健康老龄化终点效果不一致，专家强调多样饮食、压力管理与规律运动仍是当前证据最强的健康衰老策略。
    A science review of NAD+ supplements finds that NR and NMN reliably raise blood NAD+ levels, and liposomal NAD+ raised intracellular NAD+ by more than 64% in a small trial; however, a systematic review of 33 human studies shows inconsistent effects on physical function and metabolism. Experts stress that a varied diet, stress management and regular exercise remain the best-evidenced strategies for healthy aging.
  • 4周尿石素A补充未改善中年肥胖者血管内皮功能，脑血流反应却升高
    Four Weeks of Urolithin A Failed to Improve Vascular Endothelial Function in Middle-Aged Adults with Obesity, but Brain Blood Flow Reactivity Rose
    俄克拉荷马大学50人随机双盲试验显示，BMI≥30的中年人每日补充1000毫克尿石素A四周后，主要终点肱动脉血流介导舒张未见改善，但工作记忆任务中大脑皮层血流反应显著升高，任务成绩未变。提示尿石素A的作用可能存在组织特异性，其促线粒体自噬机制对脑血管的获益值得进一步研究。
    In a 50-person randomized, double-blind trial at the University of Oklahoma, middle-aged adults with BMI over 30 took 1,000 mg of urolithin A daily for four weeks. The primary endpoint, brachial artery flow-mediated dilation, did not improve, yet cerebral cortical blood flow reactivity during a working-memory task rose significantly without gains in performance. The results hint at tissue-specific effects and warrant further study of mitophagy-driven cerebrovascular benefits.
  • 1.8万人队列：血液代谢组学年龄与慢病及死亡风险相关
    Cohort of 18,476 People Links Blood Metabolomic Age to Chronic Disease and Mortality Risk
    发表于《科学·转化医学》的研究基于上海浦东队列18476名1至96岁参与者的血浆代谢谱构建代谢组学年龄模型：代谢年龄加速者更易发生糖尿病、高血压与脂肪肝，全因死亡风险也更高；但增量预测价值有限，属观察性结果，尚不能作为临床常规检测使用。
    A study in Science Translational Medicine built a metabolomic age model from plasma metabolite profiles of 18,476 participants aged 1 to 96 in the Shanghai Pudong Cohort. Those with accelerated metabolomic age were more likely to develop diabetes, hypertension and fatty liver disease and faced higher all-cause mortality risk, though the added predictive value was modest and the observational measures are not ready for routine clinical use.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • FGA功能基因组分析平台亮相深圳HNC健康营养展，聚焦精准抗衰新路径
    FGA Functional Genomics Platform Debuts at HNC Health Nutrition Expo in Shenzhen, Targeting Precision Anti-Aging
    10月14日，鲍勃米勒医生FGA平台携功能基因组分析体系与PN方案亮相深圳HNC健康营养展。李淼医生在专题报告中提出，衰老是甲基化、炎症衰老、自噬清除与线粒体能量四大系统网络失衡，精准抗衰应先识别个体瓶颈再定制干预，依托26万SNP基因底图实现分层管理。
    On October 14, the Dr. Bob Miller FGA platform presented its functional genomics analysis system and PN protocols at the HNC Health Nutrition Expo in Shenzhen. In her keynote, Dr. Li Miao argued that aging reflects network imbalance across methylation, inflammaging, autophagy clearance and mitochondrial energy, and that precision anti-aging should identify individual bottlenecks before tailored intervention, using a 260,000-SNP genomic base map for stratified management.
  • 世界食品日：CIC bioGUNE解析精准营养的分子、免疫与昼夜节律维度
    World Food Day: CIC bioGUNE Highlights Precision Nutrition Across Molecular, Immune and Circadian Dimensions
    西班牙CIC bioGUNE研究中心在世界食品日强调，饮食在分子、免疫与昼夜节律层面深度影响健康：CoDiet国际项目结合AI与代谢组学推进个性化营养推荐以防控糖尿病与心血管病，LIVER-MOON项目研究夜班与昼夜节律紊乱对代谢和肝脏健康的影响，并探索时间营养学干预策略。
    Marking World Food Day, Spain's CIC bioGUNE highlighted how diet shapes health at the molecular, immunological and circadian levels: the international CoDiet project combines AI and metabolomics to deliver personalized dietary recommendations against diabetes and cardiovascular disease, while LIVER-MOON investigates how shift work and circadian disruption affect metabolic and liver health and tests chrononutrition interventions.
  • 吹口气就能判断膳食质量？呼气挥发组或成精准营养无创监测新范式
    One Breath Away from Assessing Diet Quality: Exhaled Volatilomics as a Non-Invasive Precision Nutrition Tool
    鲁汶大学团队发表于Gut Microbes的交叉对照试验显示，呼气挥发物谱可清晰区分平衡膳食与不平衡膳食，并捕捉特定肠道菌的代谢痕迹：高纤维平衡餐后乙酸与甲醇持续升高数小时，而不平衡餐后该反应完全缺失，且呼气乙酸、甲醇分别与阿克曼菌属等7个菌属丰度相关，为无创监测饮食-菌群-宿主互作确立新范式。
    A crossover trial from KU Leuven published in Gut Microbes shows that exhaled volatile compound profiles can clearly distinguish balanced from unbalanced diets and trace the metabolic fingerprints of specific gut microbes: after a high-fiber balanced lunch, acetate and methanol rose for hours, a response entirely absent after the unbalanced meal, correlating with seven taxa including Akkermansia — establishing a non-invasive paradigm for monitoring diet-microbiome-host interactions.
  • 肠道细菌可能正在改变你实际吸收的卡路里数量
    Your Gut Bacteria May Be Changing How Many Calories You Actually Absorb
    一项对照研究建立的模型显示，肠道细菌在人体实际吸收多少卡路里中发挥着惊人作用：高纤维饮食者实际吸收的热量与食品标签标注值存在明显差异。研究者认为，食品标签可能无法反映真实能量摄入，肠道菌群构成应被纳入个体化营养与能量评估的考量。
    A model built from a controlled study suggests gut bacteria play a surprising role in how many calories humans actually absorb: people on high-fiber diets absorbed calories notably different from food-label values. The researchers argue that standard food labels may not reflect true energy intake, and microbiome composition should be factored into individualized nutrition and energy assessment.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • Elysium发布更年期支持补剂Balance：NAD+科学叠加S-equol与麦角硫因
    Elysium Health Launches Balance, a Menopause Support Supplement Grounded in NAD+ Science
    长寿科学公司Elysium Health于10月15日发布围绝经期与更年期支持配方Balance，整合其临床验证的NAD+补剂Basis（烟酰胺核糖+紫檀芪）、S-equol与麦角硫因。新发表的开放标签试点研究显示，Basis可显著改善潮热、睡眠与腹胀，并使雌二醇/雌酮比值向有利方向偏移。
    Longevity science company Elysium Health launched Balance on October 15, a perimenopause and menopause support formula combining its clinically studied NAD+ supplement Basis (nicotinamide riboside plus pterostilbene) with S-equol and ergothioneine. A newly published open-label pilot study showed Basis significantly improved hot flashes, poor sleep and bloating and shifted the estradiol-to-estrone ratio toward a more favorable balance.
  • 第115届全国糖酒会：中粮营养健康科技携悦活U格益生菌全系亮相
    China Sugar & Wine Fair: COFCO Nutrition & Health Technology Showcases Full Yuehuo-U Probiotics Line
    10月15-17日，中粮营养健康科技亮相南京第115届全国糖酒会，展出悦享态、悦享平、悦享形等六款悦活U格益生菌产品，覆盖办公、差旅、运动等多元场景；配方以自研菌株CCNH185叠加后生元CP2305，并计划2026年推出药食同源新系列，从'粮'向'养'延伸营养健康布局。
    From October 15 to 17, COFCO Nutrition & Health Technology presented its six-product Yuehuo-U probiotics line at the 115th China Sugar & Wine Fair in Nanjing, covering work, travel and sports scenarios. Formulas pair the proprietary strain CCNH185 with postbiotic CP2305, and a new medicine-food homology series is planned for 2026 as the company extends from grain into nutrition and health.
  • 每天吃蓝莓连续三个月：老年参与者抑郁症状减轻，肠道菌群同步变化
    Daily Blueberries for Three Months: Fewer Depressive Symptoms and Gut Microbiome Shifts in Older Adults
    一项小型研究发现，连续三个月每天食用蓝莓的老年参与者抑郁症状减轻更明显，同时检测到肠道菌群方面的变化。研究为膳食多酚经肠道菌群影响情绪的肠脑轴路径提供了新证据，蓝莓或成为老年人情绪健康的低成本膳食干预选项。
    A small study found that older adults who ate blueberries daily for three months showed greater reductions in depressive symptoms, alongside detectable changes in the gut microbiome. The findings add evidence for a gut-brain axis pathway in which dietary polyphenols act via the microbiome, positioning blueberries as a low-cost dietary option for emotional health in later life.
  • B族维生素新知：从能量辅因子到肠-脑-免疫调节者
    New Insights into B Vitamins: From Energy Cofactors to Gut-Brain-Immune Regulators
    最新科普梳理显示，B族维生素正被重新认识：临床前研究提示B2、B3可经重塑肠道菌群与屏障间接发挥神经保护潜力；VITACOG试验结合代谢组学分析提示，补充B族可重塑三羧酸与谷氨酰胺-谷氨酸循环，延缓轻度认知损害人群的脑萎缩；B1、B6、B12联用协同促进轴突再生的效果优于单用。
    A new science roundup shows B vitamins are being recast as more than energy cofactors: preclinical studies suggest B2 and B3 may confer neuroprotection indirectly by reshaping the gut microbiome and barrier; the VITACOG trial plus metabolomics indicates B-vitamin supplementation remodels the TCA and glutamine-glutamate cycles and may slow brain atrophy in mild cognitive impairment; and combining B1, B6 and B12 synergistically promotes axon regeneration better than single vitamins.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 广东省二医糖胖病逆转中心深圳分中心揭牌，慢病管理转向主动健康
    Guangdong Second Provincial General Hospital Opens Shenzhen Branch of Its Diabetes-Obesity Reversal Center
    10月18日，广东省第二人民医院糖胖病逆转中心深圳分中心在罗湖区人民医院揭牌。中心采用'2+N溯源系统法'，以中西医并重叠加精准营养、科学运动、心理疏导等综合干预，已服务患者超万人次，帮助早期糖胖病患者实现血糖长期平稳甚至临床逆转，推动慢病管理关口前移。
    On October 18, the Shenzhen branch of Guangdong Second Provincial General Hospital's diabetes-obesity reversal center opened at Luohu People's Hospital. Using a '2+N' integrative model that pairs Chinese and Western medicine with precision nutrition, exercise and psychological support, the center has served over 10,000 patients and aims to help early-stage patients achieve sustained glycemic control and even clinical remission, shifting chronic disease management upstream.
  • '不难瘦才享受'健康减重科普全国巡展成都站举行：科学减重无需硬扛
    National Healthy Weight-Loss Roadshow Stops in Chengdu: Science-Based Weight Management Without Suffering
    巡展成都站通过腰围测试、体脂检测与AI互动体验，引导公众按'认识疾病—识别风险—了解身体—看见改变'路径科学减重。专家强调我国18-79岁成人超重肥胖率已达53.1%，减重应兼顾腰围、代谢与生活方式，吃动睡一起管，医学干预须由医生评估，不建议自行跟风用药。
    At its Chengdu stop, the national healthy weight-loss roadshow used waist measurement, body-fat testing and interactive AI experiences to guide the public through 'recognize the disease, identify risks, understand your body, see the change.' Experts noted overweight and obesity now affect 53.1% of Chinese adults aged 18-79, urged attention to waist circumference, metabolism and lifestyle alongside diet, exercise and sleep, and cautioned that medical intervention should be physician-guided rather than self-prescribed.
  • 吃得不多却瘦不下来？可能是胰岛素抵抗在作怪
    Eating Little but Still Can't Lose Weight? Insulin Resistance May Be to Blame
    长沙晚报刊文提示，部分人群减肥屡屡失败可能与胰岛素抵抗相关。专家建议居家做好体重管理：少甜食油炸、三餐规律多杂粮蔬菜、适度运动如快走与八段锦、早睡调情绪；过度节食会进一步降低代谢并加重反弹，疑有胰岛素抵抗应及时就医评估，在医生指导下科学管理体重与代谢。
    Changsha Evening News reports that repeated weight-loss failure in some people may stem from insulin resistance. Experts recommend home-based weight management: limiting sweets and fried foods, regular meals with whole grains and vegetables, moderate exercise such as brisk walking, and earlier bedtimes — warning that crash dieting further lowers metabolism and worsens rebound, and that suspected insulin resistance warrants medical evaluation.
  • VTN未来健康峰会发布'1+N'抗炎营养与长寿健康解决方案
    VTN Future Health Summit Unveils '1+N' Anti-Inflammatory Nutrition and Longevity Solution
    10月11日VTN未来健康峰会举办，发布以抗炎营养餐为基础'1'、个性化长寿功能方案为'N'的主动健康解决方案，并联合SRW、TheroNomic、MitoQ等品牌科学家成立V健康研究院，规划培养10万名专业健康服务人员，构建'产品+方案+服务'的健康生态闭环。
    At the VTN Future Health Summit on October 11, the company launched an active-health solution built on an anti-inflammatory nutrition meal as the universal base ('1') plus personalized longevity programs ('N'), founded the V Health Research Institute with scientists from brands including SRW, TheroNomic and MitoQ, and announced plans to train 100,000 health service professionals in a 'product + solution + service' ecosystem.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-18
item.description: 2026-10-18 简报，共 20 条：西农刘学波团队：植物乳杆菌A736经色氨酸代谢物与肠神经“对话”，改善结肠炎；吉林大学团队：AKK菌代谢物酪醇经“肠-子宫轴”抑制子宫内膜炎；iMeta高分综述：肠-X轴全景图——肠道菌群与九大靶器官的双向对话；吉林农大携手善恩康共建AKK菌联合研究院，推进下一代益生菌转化；Cell Stem Cell临床研究：单次输注干细胞显著改善老年衰弱者行走能力；上海交大联合仙乐健康：人参皂苷Rg3经溶酶体调控促进健康衰老；酸奶发酵菌再立功：嗜热链球菌经NHR-49通路重塑脂肪代谢，延长线虫健康寿命；联合早报实况：长寿医学在新加坡兴起，生理年龄检测与“抗衰补剂”热潮并存；Frontiers in Microbiomes综述：饮食、睡眠、运动与抗生素如何塑造你的肠道菌群；25项RCT荟萃分析：四种饮食模式都能降糖减重，但没有唯一赢家；20项RCT网络荟萃：乳清蛋白+维生素D+亮氨酸领跑肌少症营养配方；金丝桃苷多维改善2型糖尿病：促脂肪产热、白色脂肪棕色化并重塑肠道菌群；FDA重申GRAS改革：拟以强制通报取代自愿制度，12月9日前公开征求意见；欧洲新平台上线：加速欧盟与英国新型食品审批；8周随机双盲试验：每日6克L-精氨酸显著减轻持续疲劳，3克剂量无效；Food Science & Nutrition综述：后生元从发酵副产物走向免疫、肠脑轴与代谢调控；13部门联合印发《儿童青少年“五健”促进行动计划（2026-2030年）》；华为WATCH D3亮相长城会：AI+可穿戴把心血管慢病管理从院内延伸到日常；重阳节来临：雅培捐赠百万医学营养品，全国义诊点亮银龄健康；重阳登高有“方”：中疾控手册支招“三高一疹”联防，慢病出行十六字口诀
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 西农刘学波团队：植物乳杆菌A736经色氨酸代谢物与肠神经“对话”，改善结肠炎
    NWAFU Team: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum A736 Talks to Enteric Neurons via Tryptophan Metabolite to Ease Colitis
    西北农林科技大学刘学波团队揭示益生菌护肠的神经机制：植物乳杆菌A736将膳食色氨酸转化为吲哚-3-乳酸，恢复结肠炎中减少的胆碱能神经元，重建乙酰胆碱介导的免疫抑制信号并重新平衡Th17/Treg应答；活体基因消融实验证实胆碱能神经元是必经之路，低色氨酸饮食会废除保护作用，提示菌株干预需配合膳食底物。
    A team at Northwest A&F University revealed how probiotics guard the gut via nerves: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum A736 converts dietary tryptophan into indole-3-lactate, restoring cholinergic neurons lost in colitis and rebalancing Th17/Treg immunity. Ablation experiments confirm cholinergic neurons are the required pathway, and tryptophan-poor diets abolish the protection.
  • 吉林大学团队：AKK菌代谢物酪醇经“肠-子宫轴”抑制子宫内膜炎
    Jilin University Team: AKK Microbe's Tyrosol Suppresses Endometritis via a Gut-Uterus Axis
    吉林大学曹永国、屈琳凯团队发表于Cell Host & Microbe：AKK菌经乙醇脱氢酶催化生成酪醇，酪醇入血富集于子宫，激活SIRT1/PI3K/AKT通路、抑制NF-κB炎症信号，显著缓解子宫内膜炎；阻断菌源酶保护消失，补回酪醇即恢复。研究确立了全新的“肠-子宫轴”代谢调控机制，为子宫内膜炎的抗生素耐药难题提供非抗生素干预思路。
    A Jilin University team reports in Cell Host & Microbe that Akkermansia muciniphila produces tyrosol via alcohol dehydrogenases; tyrosol reaches the uterus through blood and activates SIRT1/PI3K/AKT signaling to curb NF-κB inflammation, easing endometritis. Blocking the bacterial enzyme removes the benefit, which returns with tyrosol supplementation — a new gut-uterus axis and a non-antibiotic strategy.
  • iMeta高分综述：肠-X轴全景图——肠道菌群与九大靶器官的双向对话
    iMeta Review: The Gut-X Axis — Bidirectional Crosstalk Between the Gut Microbiome and Nine Target Organs
    iMeta期刊新综述系统绘制肠道微生物组与肝、肾、脑、肺等九大靶器官的双向互作图谱：梳理胆汁酸肠肝循环、门静脉通道、免疫细胞迁移与神经通路四大连接元件，覆盖短链脂肪酸、尿毒症毒素等关键代谢物，并整合高纤维饮食、益生菌与靶向药物三类干预策略，为基于肠-X轴的精准营养与慢病管理提供全景式参考。
    A new iMeta review maps bidirectional crosstalk between the gut microbiome and nine target organs including liver, kidney, brain and lung. It outlines four connecting elements — bile acid enterohepatic circulation, portal vein, immune-cell migration and neural routes — covers key metabolites such as SCFAs and uremic toxins, and integrates high-fiber diets, probiotics and targeted drugs as intervention strategies.
  • 吉林农大携手善恩康共建AKK菌联合研究院，推进下一代益生菌转化
    Jilin Agricultural University and ShinEcon Launch Joint AKK Research Institute for Next-Gen Probiotics
    10月15日，吉林农业大学与善恩康生物科技签约共建AKK菌联合研究院：依托任大勇教授团队的科研积累与企业的研发产业化能力，围绕嗜黏蛋白阿克曼菌开展安全性评估、功能评价与作用机制研究，推动下一代益生菌从论文走向产品。双方将打造科研与产业衔接平台，助力国产菌株提升全球竞争力。
    On October 15, Jilin Agricultural University and ShinEcon Biotech signed an agreement to build a joint AKK research institute. Combining Prof. Ren Dayong's research with the company's industrialization capability, the institute will run safety assessment, function evaluation and mechanism studies on Akkermansia muciniphila, pushing next-generation probiotics from papers to products.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • Cell Stem Cell临床研究：单次输注干细胞显著改善老年衰弱者行走能力
    Cell Stem Cell Trial: Single Stem-Cell Infusion Improves Walking Capacity in Frail Older Adults
    发表于Cell Stem Cell的随机对照研究为衰老衰弱干预带来突破：148位70-85岁轻中度衰弱老人单次输注不同剂量的Laromestrocel间充质干细胞，随访一年呈明确剂量-效应关系——2亿细胞组9个月时6分钟步行距离比安慰剂组多63.4米（p=0.0077），老人主观改善与步行提升显著相关。炎性衰老与干细胞储备下降被认为是衰弱的核心机制。
    A randomized trial published in Cell Stem Cell offers a breakthrough for aging-related frailty: 148 frail adults aged 70-85 received a single infusion of laromestrocel at varying doses. Over one year a clear dose-response emerged — the 200-million-cell group walked 63.4 meters farther than placebo at nine months (p=0.0077), with subjective improvement tracking the walking gains.
  • 上海交大联合仙乐健康：人参皂苷Rg3经溶酶体调控促进健康衰老
    SJTU with SIRLOIN Lab: Ginsenoside Rg3 Promotes Healthy Aging via Lysosomal Regulation
    上海交大郑凌君团队联合仙乐健康在Aging Cell发表研究：20(S)-人参皂苷Rg3延长线虫寿命并维持运动、进食等生理功能，减少随龄神经元蛋白聚集与多巴胺能神经元退变。机制上，Rg3重塑磷脂酰肌醇信号、抑制TORC1并激活HLH-30/TFEB，恢复受损的自噬-溶酶体通量。现有证据来自线虫模型，哺乳动物与人体效应仍待验证。
    Zheng Lingjun's team at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, with SIRLOIN-linked partner, published in Aging Cell: ginsenoside Rg3 extends nematode lifespan, preserves locomotion and feeding, and reduces age-related neuronal protein aggregation. Mechanistically Rg3 reshapes phosphoinositide signaling, suppresses TORC1, activates HLH-30/TFEB and restores autophagy-lysosomal flux; mammalian validation is still pending.
  • 酸奶发酵菌再立功：嗜热链球菌经NHR-49通路重塑脂肪代谢，延长线虫健康寿命
    Yogurt Starter Streptococcus thermophilus Extends Healthspan in Worms by Reprogramming Fat Metabolism
    遵义医科大学团队10月15日发表于GeroScience：常用酸奶发酵菌嗜热链球菌显著延长线虫健康span——运动更持久、脂褐素沉积减少。机制上，该菌激活PPARα同源核受体NHR-49，上调Δ9去饱和酶fat-5/6/7，把饱和脂肪酸转化为单不饱和脂肪酸、改善膜流动性。研究把脂代谢而非抗氧化置于益生菌抗衰机制的核心。
    A Zunyi Medical University team reported in GeroScience on October 15 that the yogurt starter Streptococcus thermophilus extends healthspan in C. elegans — better motility and less lipofuscin. The microbe activates the PPARα ortholog NHR-49, upregulates delta-9 desaturases fat-5/6/7, converts saturated fats to monounsaturated fatty acids and improves membrane fluidity, placing lipid metabolism at the core of probiotic anti-aging.
  • 联合早报实况：长寿医学在新加坡兴起，生理年龄检测与“抗衰补剂”热潮并存
    Zaobao Report: Longevity Medicine Rises in Singapore as Biological-Age Testing and Anti-Aging Supplements Boom
    联合早报实地报道新加坡长寿医学升温：本地首个基于新加坡人数据的生理年龄检测AgeQ累计检测已超1000次，每天收到60至100项咨询；NAD+补剂、干细胞与肽类疗法也被商家包装成“灵丹妙药”。Andrea Maier等专家提醒，小鼠延寿证据不能直接外推人类，越宽泛的“逆转衰老”宣称越需要有力临床证据，做好基础健康管理本身就是长寿干预。
    Lianhe Zaobao reports that longevity medicine is heating up in Singapore: AgeQ, the first biological-age test built on Singaporean data, has surpassed 1,000 tests with 60-100 inquiries daily, while NAD+ supplements, stem cells and peptide therapies are marketed as miracle cures. Experts caution that mouse evidence cannot be extrapolated to humans and that basic preventive care is itself a longevity intervention.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Frontiers in Microbiomes综述：饮食、睡眠、运动与抗生素如何塑造你的肠道菌群
    Frontiers in Microbiomes Review: How Diet, Sleep, Exercise and Antibiotics Shape Your Gut Microbes
    发表于Frontiers in Microbiomes的综述整合饮食与生活方式对菌群-宿主互作的决定性影响，指出个体应答差异才是核心特征：仅部分人能把大豆异黄酮转化为马雌酚，尿石素生成同样依赖特定菌群——由此形成按代谢能力分类的“代谢表型”。文章主张以可重复的功能特征而非单一“最优菌群”为目标，前瞻验证与标准化方法是个性化营养落地的前提。
    A review in Frontiers in Microbiomes synthesizes how diet and lifestyle determine microbiota-host interactions, stressing inter-individual variability: only some people convert soy isoflavones to equol, and urolithin production depends on specific communities, defining metabotypes. The authors argue personalized nutrition should target reproducible functional signatures, validated prospectively with standardized methods.
  • 25项RCT荟萃分析：四种饮食模式都能降糖减重，但没有唯一赢家
    Meta-Analysis of 25 RCTs: Four Dietary Patterns Lower Glucose and Weight, but No Clear Winner
    发表于Frontiers in Nutrition、纳入25项随机对照试验的荟萃分析比较2型糖尿病四种饮食模式：地中海、间歇性禁食、能量限制与生酮饮食均使体重下降约3公斤、空腹血糖与HbA1c改善，但预测区间跨越无效线，作者不支持排出名次。地中海模式对空腹血糖最一致，生酮的副作用报告更多——个体化选择比寻找“最佳饮食”更重要。
    A meta-analysis of 25 randomized trials in Frontiers in Nutrition compared Mediterranean, intermittent fasting, energy restriction and ketogenic diets in type 2 diabetes: all lowered weight by about 3 kg and improved fasting glucose and HbA1c, but prediction intervals crossed no effect and no pattern ranked first. Mediterranean was most consistent for glucose; ketogenic diets had more reported side effects.
  • 20项RCT网络荟萃：乳清蛋白+维生素D+亮氨酸领跑肌少症营养配方
    Network Meta-Analysis: Whey Plus Vitamin D and Leucine Leads Sarcopenia Nutrition Formulas
    发表于Nutrients、覆盖20项试验2160名老年人的网络荟萃显示：营养补充整体可改善肌肉量指数、握力与步速，其中乳清蛋白+维生素D+亮氨酸组合同时改善肌肉量指数（SMD 0.29）、握力（0.82）与坐站时间（-1.41），是唯一多项指标齐动的配方；另两种配方各靠单一试验支撑。证据确定性偏低，效应量应审慎解读。
    A network meta-analysis in Nutrients covering 20 trials and 2,160 older adults found nutritional supplements improve muscle-mass index, grip strength and gait speed. Whey protein plus vitamin D and leucine moved several measures at once (SMD 0.29 muscle mass, 0.82 grip, -1.41 sit-to-stand), while competing formulas rest on single trials. Certainty was low to very low.
  • 金丝桃苷多维改善2型糖尿病：促脂肪产热、白色脂肪棕色化并重塑肠道菌群
    Flavonoid Hyperoside Improves Type 2 Diabetes via Thermogenesis, Fat Browning and Gut Microbiota Remodeling
    10月8日在线发表于Phytotherapy Research的动物研究显示：广泛存在于果蔬中的黄酮金丝桃苷（槲皮素-3-O-半乳糖苷）可增强棕色脂肪产热与白色脂肪棕色化、减轻组织炎症，并重塑肠道菌群——提高拟杆菌门/厚壁菌门比值、恢复Muribaculaceae等有益菌丰度，多维度改善高脂饮食诱导的2型糖尿病代谢损伤，为天然活性物干预代谢病提供候选。
    An animal study published online October 8 in Phytotherapy Research shows hyperoside, a flavonoid common in fruits and vegetables, enhances brown adipose thermogenesis and white-fat browning, eases tissue inflammation and remodels the gut microbiome — raising the Bacteroidetes/Firmicutes ratio and restoring beneficial taxa — ameliorating high-fat diet-induced type 2 diabetes on multiple fronts.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • FDA重申GRAS改革：拟以强制通报取代自愿制度，12月9日前公开征求意见
    FDA Pushes Mandatory GRAS Notifications, with Comments Open Through December 9
    NutraIngredients报道，FDA官员在网络研讨会上重申GRAS（公认为安全）规则改革要点：8月提出的新规将把现行自愿通报制度改为覆盖人用与动物用食品物质的强制程序，公众意见征询至12月9日截止。改革旨在让监管者与公众更清楚哪些物质正进入食品供应，同时保留符合条件的GRAS用途豁免食品添加剂上市前审批的法定框架。
    FDA officials reiterated in a webinar the key points of the proposed GRAS rule reform: floated in August, the new rule would replace the voluntary notification system with a mandatory program covering human and animal food substances, with comments open through December 9 — giving regulators and the public a clearer picture of substances entering the food supply.
  • 欧洲新平台上线：加速欧盟与英国新型食品审批
    New European Platform Launched to Speed Up EU and UK Novel Food Approvals
    NutraIngredients报道，一个旨在加速欧盟与英国新型食品（novel food）审批的平台于10月15日宣布成立。新型食品审批周期长、资料要求高，长期被视为创新成分入场的最大瓶颈；新平台将统筹申报路径与监管沟通，为补剂原料、替代蛋白等功能成分进入欧洲市场提供更快通道，行业正关注其对创新提速的实际效果。
    NutraIngredients reports that a new platform dedicated to accelerating EU and UK novel food approvals was announced on October 15. Long review cycles and heavy documentation have been the biggest bottleneck for innovative ingredients; the platform will coordinate application pathways and regulator dialogue, offering faster market entry for supplement ingredients and alternative proteins.
  • 8周随机双盲试验：每日6克L-精氨酸显著减轻持续疲劳，3克剂量无效
    8-Week Double-Blind RCT: 6 g/day L-Arginine Reduces Persistent Fatigue, 3 g/day Falls Short
    发表于Nutrients的随机双盲试验纳入120名持续疲劳的在职成年人：每日6克口服L-精氨酸8周使疲劳严重度量表得分改善6.41分，显著优于安慰剂组的2.23分，而每日3克与安慰剂无差异。次要疲劳指标经多重比较校正后说服力减弱；试验由企业资助，疲劳有改善但未完全缓解，剂量与证据边界需留意。
    A double-blind randomized trial in Nutrients enrolled 120 working adults with persistent fatigue: 8 weeks of 6 g/day oral L-arginine improved Fatigue Severity Scale scores by 6.41 points versus 2.23 for placebo, while 3 g/day showed no benefit. Secondary outcomes weakened after multiplicity adjustment; the trial was industry-funded and fatigue improved but did not fully resolve.
  • Food Science & Nutrition综述：后生元从发酵副产物走向免疫、肠脑轴与代谢调控
    Review: Postbiotics Move from Fermentation Byproducts to Immune, Gut-Brain and Metabolic Modulation
    生物通报道发表于Food Science & Nutrition的综述：后生元作为非活菌及其代谢产物的制剂，含短链脂肪酸、肽类、多糖与维生素等活性成分，临床前与临床证据显示其可改善胰岛素敏感性、调节细胞因子信号、增强上皮屏障完整性，并对肥胖、2型糖尿病与抑郁具有保护潜力，还表现出抗肌少症作用；稳定性高、无需冷链是产业优势，但标准化与监管一致性仍待解决。
    A review in Food Science & Nutrition covered by Ebiotrade frames postbiotics — preparations of inactivated microbes and their metabolites rich in SCFAs, peptides, polysaccharides and vitamins — as modulators of immunity, the gut-brain axis and metabolism, with evidence for improved insulin sensitivity, barrier integrity and protection against obesity, type 2 diabetes and depression; standardization and regulatory alignment remain open issues.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 13部门联合印发《儿童青少年“五健”促进行动计划（2026-2030年）》
    13 Chinese Agencies Issue the 2026-2030 Action Plan for Children's “Five Healths”
    国家卫生健康委等13部门联合制定《儿童青少年“五健”促进行动计划（2026—2030年）》，聚焦健康体重、视力、心理、骨骼与口腔五大领域，倡导“6个1”健康生活方式并推行三级分层干预、多病共防。湖南省已全面启动免费筛查，1765家医疗机构依托“健康副校长”入校服务，累计筛查156.42万名儿童青少年，实现早发现、早预警、早干预。
    Thirteen agencies led by China's National Health Commission jointly issued the 2026-2030 Action Plan for children's “five healths” — weight, vision, mental health, bones and oral health — promoting the “6x1” healthy lifestyle and three-tiered interventions. Hunan has launched free screening in 1,765 medical institutions, reaching 1.5642 million children and adolescents so far.
  • 华为WATCH D3亮相长城会：AI+可穿戴把心血管慢病管理从院内延伸到日常
    Huawei WATCH D3 Debuts at Great Wall Congress: AI and Wearables Extend Cardiovascular Care Beyond Hospitals
    10月16日第37届长城心脏病学大会上，华为运动健康专题会展示AI+可穿戴的慢病管理新路径：唐熠达团队初步验证穿戴设备无感估算最大摄氧量的可行性，称其有望成为心血管风险预警核心指标；陈韵岱基于20余万穿戴用户数据探索AI随访血压管理，瑞金医院王继光介绍轻触式动态血压监测研究。专家共识：心血管防治关口应从诊室前移到日常生活。
    At the 37th Great Wall International Congress of Cardiology on October 16, Huawei's health session showcased AI-plus-wearable chronic disease management: Tang Yida's team validated cuffless VO2max estimation as a potential risk-warning indicator, Chen Yundai explored AI follow-up for blood pressure using data from over 200,000 wearable users, and Wang Jiguang presented light-touch ambulatory BP monitoring.
  • 重阳节来临：雅培捐赠百万医学营养品，全国义诊点亮银龄健康
    Abbott Donates Medical Nutrition Worth Millions as China Marks Double Ninth Elderly Health Campaign
    重阳节前夕，雅培连续第四年联合上海市慈善基金会开展“孝亲敬老”公益行动，捐赠价值百万元的全安素、益力佳等医学营养品，并支持覆盖全国20余省市的老年医学科重阳义诊与科普。临床营养专家强调优质蛋白对维持老年肌肉健康的基础作用，疾病康复或特殊营养需求人群可在医生或临床营养师指导下合理选用医学营养品。
    Ahead of the Double Ninth Festival, Abbott ran its fourth consecutive charity campaign with the Shanghai Charity Foundation, donating millions of yuan of medical nutrition products and supporting geriatric screenings and education across more than 20 provinces. Clinical nutrition experts underscored quality protein for muscle health in older adults and guided use of medical nutrition under professional supervision.
  • 重阳登高有“方”：中疾控手册支招“三高一疹”联防，慢病出行十六字口诀
    China CDC-Backed Handbook: “Three Highs Plus Shingles” Tips and a 16-Character Mantra for Safe Autumn Outings
    针对重阳出行高峰，中国疾控中心指导下发布的秋季出行健康手册提出“药带齐，苗早问；慢病不停药，行程不硬扛”十六字口诀。武汉协和医院专家提醒：糖尿病患者带状疱疹风险最高可高出60%，心血管患者高出39%；出行前应做好健康评估、规律饮食、带齐监测设备，带状疱疹出疹后72小时内启动抗病毒治疗效果最佳。
    For the Double Ninth travel peak, a handbook issued under China CDC guidance distills autumn travel tips into a 16-character mantra covering medications, vaccines and steady treatment. Wuhan Union Hospital experts note diabetes raises shingles risk by up to 60% and cardiovascular disease by 39%; travelers should assess their health beforehand, and antiviral therapy works best within 72 hours of rash onset.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-17
item.description: 2026-10-17 简报，共 20 条：俄研究团队：口腔与肠道乳酸菌构成可作消化道健康“晴雨表”；南科大刘小敏团队：基因组结构变异塑造肠道菌群与血代谢，肠菌或驱动高尿酸；肠道菌群借道迷走神经“调谐”大脑：冲动行为或源于菌群特征；单菌分辨率看糖尿病：单细胞测序揭示肠道菌群“功能工种”失衡；乔治·丘奇团队发现“返老还童”基因SRSF1：老年小鼠寿命延长14%、衰弱进展放缓44%；中国医科院李隽团队：NAD+激活脂肪因子Serpina3n，跨器官守护骨骼肌；Cell重磅：热量限制减少全基因组体细胞突变，基因组稳定性成可干预的衰老维度；衰老的“控制论”框架出炉：用数学定义干预安全边界与最小安全代价；扬州大学团队：大豆膳食纤维肠源代谢物harmaline破解耐药沙门菌定殖；Frontiers in Nutrition综述：饮食干预经菌群代谢物改写结直肠癌风险；康普茶或可安抚情绪：小鼠实验显示焦虑抑郁样行为减少、肠脑轴重塑；MIHC 2026绍兴落幕：70余位全球前2%科学家共议微生态，原研益生菌联合宣言发布；GLP-1药物正在重塑补剂需求：营养补剂行业必须读懂的五个变化；CRN Convergence 2026：女性健康补剂研究面临更严苛的科学审视；精密发酵对决植物细胞培养：补剂原料的绿色科技路线之争；爱昕集团发布五款日养新品：把营养补剂嵌入“每天都做得到”的场景；Nature Medicine：司美格鲁肽联合疗法减重22%，减掉的体重92%是脂肪；讯飞医疗携手瑞慈医疗：AI大模型进体检场景，探索商业化健康管理闭环；辉瑞健康减重科普展走进成都春熙路：体测、互动与“减重搭子”齐上阵；上海宝山“体重管理+肾脏病”专场收官：心血管-肾脏-代谢共管思维下沉社区
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 俄研究团队：口腔与肠道乳酸菌构成可作消化道健康“晴雨表”
    Oral and Gut Lactobacilli Composition Can Serve as a Barometer of Digestive Health
    俄罗斯秋明国立医科大学团队在《感染与免疫》发表新方法：通过口腔与肠道乳酸菌的物种构成即可判断消化道健康状态。研究发现副干酪乳杆菌是肠道稳态的“秩序守护者”，而发酵乳杆菌占主导则提示微生物群落失衡与隐性炎症。该方法无创、低成本，可用于消化内科与牙科的辅助诊断、疗效评估及疾病前早期预警。
    Researchers at Tyumen State Medical University report in Infection and Immunity a new method to gauge digestive health from the species composition of oral and gut Lactobacilli. Lactobacillus paracasei acts as an order-keeper of a healthy gut, while dominance of L. fermentus signals microbial imbalance and hidden inflammation. The approach is non-invasive and low-cost, supporting auxiliary diagnosis and early warning in gastroenterology and dentistry.
  • 南科大刘小敏团队：基因组结构变异塑造肠道菌群与血代谢，肠菌或驱动高尿酸
    Genomic Structural Variants Shape Gut Microbiome and Blood Metabolites, with Gut Bacteria Linked to Hyperuricemia
    南方科技大学刘小敏团队与华大张涛团队合作在Advanced Science发表成果：基于2002名中国人高深度全基因组与宏基因组数据，绘制出13.9万个结构变异图谱（44.3%为数据库未收录的“暗物质”），证实结构变异可独立于SNP调控菌群组成与血液代谢。孟德尔随机化分析提示潜伏肠杆菌可能升高血尿酸，维生素K1、羟脯氨酸等代谢物对特定菌株的定向调控获体外验证。
    A team led by Liu Xiaomin (SUSTech) with Zhang Tao (BGI) reports in Advanced Science on 2,002 deeply sequenced Chinese genomes and metagenomes, mapping 138,859 structural variants (44.3% absent from public databases) that independently of SNPs shape gut microbiome composition and blood metabolites. Mendelian randomization implicates Clostridium ramosum in elevated serum uric acid, with directionality of metabolites such as vitamin K1 toward specific strains validated in vitro.
  • 肠道菌群借道迷走神经“调谐”大脑：冲动行为或源于菌群特征
    Gut Microbiota Tunes the Brain via the Vagus Nerve: Impulsive Behavior May Originate in Microbiome Signatures
    热心肠日报报道的一项新研究显示，在病理症状出现之前，由基因变异塑造的肠道微生态即可通过迷走神经持续调谐特定脑区的突触连接强度，为情绪障碍与冲动外化行为埋下伏笔。小鼠在行为异常显现前10周龄时菌群差异已存在，而神经递质变化尚未发生——提示菌群特征有望成为精神疾病早期生物标志物，并支持以菌群为靶点的精准干预。
    New research covered by China-Gut Daily shows that, before pathological symptoms emerge, genetically shaped gut microbiota can continuously tune synaptic connectivity in specific brain regions via the vagus nerve, predisposing hosts to emotional disorders and impulsive externalizing behaviors. In mice, microbiota differences were already present at 10 weeks of age, before neurotransmitter changes — suggesting microbial signatures as early biomarkers and precision intervention targets in psychiatry.
  • 单菌分辨率看糖尿病：单细胞测序揭示肠道菌群“功能工种”失衡
    Diabetes at Single-Cell Resolution: Sequencing Reveals Imbalanced Functional Jobs in Gut Microbiota
    研究团队将smRandom-seq单细胞转录组测序适配到肠道内容物，对糖尿病小鼠全肠道菌群进行“单菌拍照”，鉴定出八个功能集群：糖尿病状态下执行运动趋化与应激适应的菌群增多，负责有机酸代谢与多糖降解者减少，并与琥珀酸升高、支链氨基酸异常等宿主代谢紊乱精准对应。该框架把菌群研究从“谁在场”推进到“谁在干什么”，为功能导向的精准干预提供路线图。
    By adapting smRandom-seq single-cell transcriptomics to gut contents, researchers captured per-cell snapshots of the entire gut microbiota in diabetic mice, identifying eight functional clusters: chemotaxis- and stress-adaptation jobs expand while organic-acid metabolism and polysaccharide degradation shrink, precisely mapping onto host metabolic disturbances such as elevated succinate and abnormal branched-chain amino acids. The framework shifts microbiome research from who is present to who is doing what, charting a route for function-directed precision interventions.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 乔治·丘奇团队发现“返老还童”基因SRSF1：老年小鼠寿命延长14%、衰弱进展放缓44%
    George Church Team Identifies Rejuvenation Gene SRSF1: 14% Longer Lifespan and 44% Slower Frailty in Aged Mice
    哈佛医学院乔治·丘奇团队10月14日发表于Nature Aging：团队构建可解释的转录组衰老预测模型，筛选出RNA剪接因子SRSF1，可在不丢失细胞身份的前提下令衰老细胞重现年轻转录组特征。经AAV载体在老年小鼠肝脏表达后，全身衰弱进展降低44%、中位寿命延长14%，皮肤伤口愈合显著加快，且未激活致癌的多能性程序，为组织特异性基因治疗延寿提供新靶点。
    Writing in Nature Aging on Oct 14, George Church's team at Harvard Medical School used an interpretable transcriptomic aging model to identify the RNA splicing factor SRSF1, which restores youthful transcriptomic signatures in aged cells without loss of cell identity. Liver-directed AAV delivery in aged mice slowed frailty progression by 44%, extended median lifespan by 14% and accelerated skin wound healing — without activating oncogenic pluripotency programs — pointing to a new geroprotective gene-therapy target.
  • 中国医科院李隽团队：NAD+激活脂肪因子Serpina3n，跨器官守护骨骼肌
    NAD+ Activates Adipokine Serpina3n to Protect Skeletal Muscle Across Organs
    中国医学科学院基础医学研究所李隽团队10月14日在Cell Metabolism发文：补充NAD+前体NMN的抗肌萎缩效果并非直接作用于肌肉，而是经脂肪组织介导——NAD+升高激活STAT1依赖的脂因子Serpina3n转录并释放入血，后者稳定骨骼肌丙酮酸羧化酶，促进蛋白合成与氧化代谢。在衰老、失用及癌症恶病质模型中均见肌肉保护效应，补充Serpina3n蛋白有望成为肌萎缩新疗法。
    Writing in Cell Metabolism on Oct 14, Jun Li's team at CAMS/PUMC shows that the anti-atrophy benefit of NAD+ precursor NMN is not muscle-autonomous but adipose-mediated: elevated NAD+ drives STAT1-dependent transcription and release of the adipokine Serpina3n, which stabilizes pyruvate carboxylase in skeletal muscle to promote protein synthesis and oxidative metabolism. Muscle protection held across aging, disuse and cancer-cachexia models, and Serpina3n supplementation emerges as a potential therapy.
  • Cell重磅：热量限制减少全基因组体细胞突变，基因组稳定性成可干预的衰老维度
    Caloric Restriction Reduces Genome-Wide Somatic Mutations, Establishing Genomic Stability as a Modifiable Aging Dimension
    中国疾控中心文献追踪报道的Cell论文利用高保真双链测序技术NanoSeq，对热量限制小鼠的肝、肾组织及单个细胞类型测序：热量限制显著降低多个组织的替换与插入缺失突变负荷，并压制哺乳动物主要突变来源SBS5的活性，且效应在转录不活跃区域最为显著。研究确立了基因组稳定性作为衰老的可调控维度，并提示进食时间节律与减量本身同等重要。
    A Cell study highlighted by the China CDC literature tracker used high-fidelity duplex sequencing (NanoSeq) on liver, kidney and single-cell samples from calorically restricted mice: restriction lowered substitution and indel mutation burdens across tissues and suppressed SBS5, the dominant mammalian mutational process, with the largest effects in transcriptionally inactive regions. The work establishes genomic stability as a modifiable aging dimension and suggests meal timing may matter as much as quantity.
  • 衰老的“控制论”框架出炉：用数学定义干预安全边界与最小安全代价
    A Control-Theory Framework for Aging: Mathematically Defining Safe Intervention Boundaries
    Insilico Medicine与巴克研究所Alex Zhavoronkov团队在Aging发表控制论衰老框架：把衰老定义为“安全可控性的渐进丧失”，生物学年龄即恢复功能所需的“最小安全代价”。框架以向量场描述药物作用，用Lie括号证明干预顺序影响结局——模拟中先清除衰老细胞再行部分重编程效果最佳，并主张不确定性高时优先可逆干预，为老年治疗药物发现提供安全性优先的设计范式。
    Alex Zhavoronkov's team (Insilico Medicine / Buck Institute) published in Aging a control-theory framework defining aging as progressive loss of safe controllability, with biological age reinterpreted as the minimum safe cost of functional restoration. Drugs are modeled as vector fields and Lie-bracket analysis shows intervention ordering matters — in simulation, clearing senescent cells before partial reprogramming worked best — while highly uncertain contexts should favor reversible interventions, offering a safety-first paradigm for geroscience drug discovery.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 扬州大学团队：大豆膳食纤维肠源代谢物harmaline破解耐药沙门菌定殖
    Soy Dietary Fiber-Derived Harmaline Blocks Colonization of Drug-Resistant Salmonella
    扬州大学王志强团队发表于Cell Reports：沙门菌会主动触发肠道炎症并“借势”利用炎症产物完成呼吸与扩增，形成毒力—炎症—定殖的自我强化循环。研究揭示大豆膳食纤维经肠道菌群衍生出代谢物harmaline（HAL），能同时削弱病原菌黏附侵袭、调节炎症水平并打破该循环，小鼠补充后肠道及脏器沙门菌定殖显著下降，为“以食养肠、自主抗感染”提供新机制。
    A Cell Reports study from Wang Zhiqiang's team at Yangzhou University shows Salmonella deliberately triggers gut inflammation and exploits its by-products for respiration and expansion, creating a self-reinforcing virulence-inflammation-colonization loop. Soy dietary fiber is converted by gut microbes into the metabolite harmaline, which simultaneously curbs pathogen adhesion and invasion, modulates inflammation and breaks the loop — markedly reducing intestinal and systemic colonization in mice and opening a food-based route against drug-resistant enteric infection.
  • Frontiers in Nutrition综述：饮食干预经菌群代谢物改写结直肠癌风险
    Diet Interventions Reshape Colorectal Cancer Risk via Microbial Metabolites, RCT Review Finds
    发表于Frontiers in Nutrition的系统综述专门纳入随机对照试验，梳理饮食—菌群—结直肠癌证据链：米糠与菜豆干预富集产丁酸抗炎相关的粪杆菌、双歧杆菌和乳杆菌，短链脂肪酸与多酚代谢物增加，次级胆汁酸等促瘤代谢物减少。SCFA抑制HDAC、抗性淀粉影响DNA甲基化等机制支持饮食改变CRC风险的生物学合理性。
    A systematic review in Frontiers in Nutrition restricted to randomized controlled trials maps the diet-microbiome-CRC evidence chain: rice bran and navy bean interventions enrich butyrate-producing, anti-inflammatory taxa (Faecalibacterium, Bifidobacterium, Lactobacillus), raise SCFA and polyphenol-derived metabolites and lower pro-tumor metabolites such as secondary bile acids and p-cresol sulfate, while ginger extract reduces Akkermansia and Ruminococcus. Mechanisms including HDAC inhibition by SCFAs and methylation effects of resistant starch support biological plausibility.
  • 康普茶或可安抚情绪：小鼠实验显示焦虑抑郁样行为减少、肠脑轴重塑
    Kombucha May Soothe Mood: Reduced Anxiety- and Depression-like Behaviors with Gut-Brain Remodeling in Mice
    明尼苏达大学团队发表于Food Bioscience的研究：两种背景饮食（高脂高糖与低脂低糖）小鼠每周三次饮用康普茶共七周，均表现出焦虑与抑郁样行为减少，同时肠道菌群多样性改变，与肠脑通讯相关的菌群功能及代谢物增加；但肠脑轴连接机制因背景饮食不同而有显著差异。研究提示发酵食品应同时纳入心理健康与身体健康的营养视野，人体验证仍在下一步。
    University of Minnesota researchers report in Food Bioscience that mice on both high-fat/high-sugar and lower-fat/sugar diets drinking kombucha three times weekly for seven weeks showed reduced anxiety- and depression-like behaviors, alongside shifts in gut bacterial diversity and increases in microbes, functions and metabolites tied to gut-brain communication — though the underlying mechanisms differed by background diet. The work argues for valuing fermented foods in mental as well as physical health, pending human validation.
  • MIHC 2026绍兴落幕：70余位全球前2%科学家共议微生态，原研益生菌联合宣言发布
    MIHC 2026 Concludes in Shaoxing: Top Scientists Convene on Microbiome Science and Joint Probiotic Declaration
    10月12-14日，香港理工大学微生物研究院等主办的MIHC 2026微生物创新与健康大会在绍兴举行，1000余名参会者、超70位全球前2%科学家围绕耐药性、食品安全、益生菌研发与未来食品交流。本土临床研究专题展示中国人群菌株的糖脂代谢证据；产业论坛上多家企业共同发起原研益生菌联合宣言，倡导以持续研究与全链条质量保障支撑应用。
    Held Oct 12-14 in Shaoxing and hosted by the PolyU Microbiota I-M (and partners), MIHC 2026 drew over 1,000 attendees and 70+ scholars from the world's top 2% scientist list, covering antimicrobial resistance, food safety, probiotic R&D and future foods. The Chinese local clinical research forum showcased evidence for domestic strains such as Bifidobacterium longum dipro-O in glycolipid metabolism, and industry players including Novonesis, Morinaga and Lallemand issued a joint declaration on original-research probiotics backed by continuous science and full-chain quality management.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • GLP-1药物正在重塑补剂需求：营养补剂行业必须读懂的五个变化
    Five Ways GLP-1 Drugs Are Altering Consumer Demand for Supplements
    NutraIngredients刊文梳理GLP-1受体激动剂大流行对补剂消费的五重冲击：减重人群肌肉流失担忧推高蛋白与肌酸需求、胃肠道副作用带带动消化类补剂、微量营养素摄入下降催生复合维生素场景、皮肤毛发与关节支持产品获得新客群，同时“配合用药的营养方案”正成为品牌沟通新语言。对补剂企业而言，围绕GLP-1使用者重新设计产品线已是现实命题。
    NutraIngredients maps five ways the GLP-1 wave is reshaping supplement demand: fear of muscle loss boosts protein and creatine, GI side effects drive digestive formulas, reduced micronutrient intake expands multivitamin use-cases, skin-hair-joint support gains new customers, and "nutrition alongside medication" is becoming the new brand language. Redesigning product lines around GLP-1 users is now a practical imperative for supplement companies.
  • CRN Convergence 2026：女性健康补剂研究面临更严苛的科学审视
    Women's Health Research Faces Tougher Questions at CRN Convergence 2026
    在CRN Convergence 2026大会上，女性健康补剂的科学证据成为焦点：与会专家指出更年期、经期与围产期营养领域的研究普遍样本量小、终点设计粗糙，性别特异性剂量与安全数据不足，导致产品宣称难以经受监管与媒体的双重检验。行业被敦促以更长周期、更精细分层的人群研究支撑女性全生命周期营养产品，避免概念先行。
    At CRN Convergence 2026, the evidence base for women's health supplements took center stage: experts noted that menopause, menstrual and perinatal nutrition studies are often small and crudely designed, lacking sex-specific dosing and safety data, leaving claims vulnerable to regulatory and media scrutiny. Industry was urged to back life-stage nutrition products with longer, better-stratified population research rather than leading with marketing concepts.
  • 精密发酵对决植物细胞培养：补剂原料的绿色科技路线之争
    Precision Fermentation vs Plant Cell Culture: The Green-Tech Rivalry in Supplement Ingredients
    NutraIngredients深度对比两条可持续原料路线：精密发酵以工程菌株高效产出稀有活性成分（如稀有人参皂苷、虾青素），纯度与批次一致性强但依赖糖源与发酵规模；植物细胞培养则免于转基因争议、更贴近“天然”心智，但产量与成本仍待突破。作者认为二者并非零和——按成分特性组合布局，才是应对气候波动与供应链脆弱性的韧性策略。
    NutraIngredients compares two sustainable ingredient routes: precision fermentation uses engineered microbes to efficiently produce rare actives with strong purity and batch consistency but depends on sugar feedstocks and fermentation scale, while plant cell culture avoids GMO concerns and fits natural positioning yet still struggles with yield and cost. The piece argues the two are complementary — a combined, ingredient-by-ingredient strategy builds supply-chain resilience against climate volatility.
  • 爱昕集团发布五款日养新品：把营养补剂嵌入“每天都做得到”的场景
    Aixin Group Launches Five Daily-Routine Supplements to Embed Nutrition into Everyday Scenarios
    爱昕集团十月发布清畅昕品牌五款日常养生新品，覆盖复合多肽粉、藤茶黄酮片、益生菌固体饮料等形态，主打“跟着一天里原本要做的事走”的高频使用逻辑，以补齐门店低频服务之外的日常空白。这一“低频到店+高频日养”的组合反映国内健康消费正从单次服务转向全周期陪伴，也为养生门店的复购与连带运营提供了新品类抓手。
    Aixin Group unveiled five daily-wellness products under its Qingchangxin brand — peptide blends, vine-tea flavone tablets and probiotic sachets among them — designed around a high-frequency logic of attaching nutrition to routines people already have, filling the gap between occasional in-store services. The low-frequency visit plus high-frequency daily-care model mirrors a shift in Chinese health consumption toward full-cycle companionship and gives wellness retailers new levers for retention.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • Nature Medicine：司美格鲁肽联合疗法减重22%，减掉的体重92%是脂肪
    Semaglutide Combination Cuts 22% of Body Weight with 92% from Fat in BELIEVE Phase 2
    发表于Nature Medicine的BELIEVE 2期试验（507人、72周）显示：司美格鲁肽联合在研单抗bimagrumab平均减重22.1%，其中92.2%来自脂肪，内脏脂肪降幅达58.2%；而瘦体重仅下降约2.9%，远优于司美单药的7.4%，停药6个月获益仍在持续。该结果把减重评价标杆从“体重数字”推向“身体成分”，也为GLP-1时代的肌少症预防提供了联合方案思路。
    The BELIEVE phase 2 trial (507 participants, 72 weeks) published in Nature Medicine shows semaglutide plus investigational bimagrumab achieved 22.1% average weight loss with 92.2% from fat mass and 58.2% visceral fat reduction, while lean mass fell only about 2.9% versus 7.4% on semaglutide alone; benefits persisted six months off therapy. The results push the benchmark from scale weight to body composition and suggest a combination strategy against sarcopenia in the GLP-1 era.
  • 讯飞医疗携手瑞慈医疗：AI大模型进体检场景，探索商业化健康管理闭环
    iFlytek Medical Partners with Rici Healthcare to Bring Medical LLMs into Checkup-Based Health Management
    讯飞医疗科技10月14日与上海瑞慈医疗订立合作框架协议：授权其使用讯飞星火医疗大模型的症状自测、药物查询与报告解读功能，在用户授权下打通健康数据，并联合推广健康管理套餐。体检被视为健康管理的天然入口，双方将在检前需求理解、检中辅助决策到检后持续管理的完整链路上验证“AI+体检”模式，探索可复制的商业化范式。
    On Oct 14 iFlytek Medical signed a framework agreement with Shanghai Rici Healthcare to license iFlytek Spark Medical LLM functions (symptom self-check, drug queries, report interpretation), enable user-authorized health data interoperability and jointly promote health-management packages. Framing checkups as the natural entry point of health management, the partners will validate an "AI + checkup" model across pre-visit triage, in-visit decision support and post-visit follow-up as a replicable commercial template.
  • 辉瑞健康减重科普展走进成都春熙路：体测、互动与“减重搭子”齐上阵
    Pfizer Brings Weight-Management Science Exhibit to Chengdu's Chunxi Road
    10月17-18日，辉瑞中国“不难瘦才享受”健康减重科普展全国巡展第四站落地成都春熙路：市民可现场体测身体成分、参与体感游戏了解肥胖相关风险，并与其数字健康伴侣“偏偏”互动，识别“一周瘦十斤”“断碳暴汗”等极端误区。活动呼应《国民健康“十五五”规划》将健康体重管理列为重点任务，把诊室知识搬到商圈，推动“全民主动管体重”。
    On Oct 17-18, Pfizer China's "No Struggle, More Enjoyment" weight-management science exhibit holds its fourth stop at Chengdu's Chunxi Road: visitors get body-composition testing, interactive games about obesity-related risks, and chats with the digital companion "Pianpian" to debunk extremes like "lose 10 jin a week" or zero-carb crash routines. Echoing the 15th Five-Year National Health Plan's focus on healthy weight, the exhibit moves clinical knowledge into the mall to popularize proactive weight management.
  • 上海宝山“体重管理+肾脏病”专场收官：心血管-肾脏-代谢共管思维下沉社区
    Shanghai Baoshan Concludes Weight-Management and Kidney-Disease Training, Pushing CKM Co-Management into Communities
    10月14日，上海宝山区体重管理服务能力提升系列培训第六期收官：三位肾病专家围绕肥胖与慢性肾脏病的中西医诊治、代谢相关性肾病及《心血管-肾脏-代谢综合征专家共识（2026）》授课，覆盖全区18家社区卫生服务中心骨干。培训直指基层对肾病高危人群筛查识别与干预处置的能力短板，推动体重管理与慢病管理从“单一指标”走向多系统一体化共管。
    On Oct 14, Baoshan District in Shanghai concluded the sixth session of its weight-management capacity training series: three nephrology experts lectured on obesity-CKD management in Chinese and Western medicine, metabolic kidney disease and the 2026 Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome consensus, reaching key staff from all 18 community health centers. The program targets grassroots gaps in screening and intervention for kidney-risk populations, steering weight and chronic-disease management toward integrated multi-system co-management.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-16
item.description: 2026-10-16 简报，共 20 条：湖南师大杨焕胜团队：丁酸梭菌与精氨酸联手，熄灭促肥胖巨噬细胞炎症；江南大学孙嘉/潘礼龙团队：一类特殊的大肠杆菌推动慢性胰腺炎走向纤维化；Nature Communications：重新审视脱硫弧菌，特定鞭毛蛋白瓦解肠道免疫耐受；Science Immunology：肠道上皮双哨兵，簇细胞联手M细胞重塑黏膜免疫；ScienceDaily："僵尸细胞"如何躲避免疫系统追杀的机制被揭开；一项长达47年的研究揭示：身体从多大年龄开始流失力量；给干细胞装上"抗衰发动机"：ATG5过表达让老年韧带伤口奇迹般愈合；阻断化疗后的"衰老毒素"：微小RNA miR-3155b精准关闭衰老分泌因子；近20万人数据：深夜进食与肝病风险升高最多30%相关；梅斯医学：一个月不吃肉就能年轻1.7岁？随机试验显示纯素饮食改写DNA甲基化；英国营养学杂志：2.1万人队列显示高质量膳食使糖尿病风险降低14%–28%，炎症指标起中介作用；昆明理工团队：发酵罗望子果肉重塑色氨酸代谢，缓解顽固便秘；NutraIngredients周报：荷兰植物成分新规、英国补剂广告、Ω-3走出鱼油、HTBA收购Specnova；Lallemand加码亚洲代谢平衡市场：携手本地伙伴推进益生菌方案；代谢健康补剂新品潮：瞄准肠道健康、血糖控制与饱腹感三大方向；十亿美元级补剂并购成新基准？行业整合加速洗牌；ScienceDaily：Ozempic与Wegovy与罕见突发性视力丧失风险相关；北大首钢医院"减重控糖"数智化慢病共管项目获评年度健康促进创新案例；VTN未来健康峰会发布"1+N"抗炎营养与长寿健康方案，成立V健康研究院；为什么一些运动恢复方法会适得其反？科学家揭示背后的生理机制
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 湖南师大杨焕胜团队：丁酸梭菌与精氨酸联手，熄灭促肥胖巨噬细胞炎症
    Hunan Normal University: Clostridium butyricum and arginine jointly extinguish pro-obesity macrophage inflammation
    湖南师范大学杨焕胜团队与印遇龙团队合作在Microbiome发表跨物种研究：肥胖机体肠道革兰氏阴性菌扩张、血清内毒素升高，LPS经EGR1转录因子驱动巨噬细胞M1极化，形成全身代谢性炎症。补充丁酸梭菌、丁酸或精氨酸，或抑制EGR1，均可显著减轻小鼠体重增幅、肝脂沉积并改善糖耐量，为肥胖的菌群-免疫联合干预给出清晰靶点。
    A cross-species study by Yang Huansheng's team at Hunan Normal University, published in Microbiome, shows that in obesity, expansion of gram-negative gut bacteria raises serum LPS, which drives M1 macrophage polarization via the EGR1 transcription factor and fuels systemic metabolic inflammation. Supplementing Clostridium butyricum, butyrate or arginine—or inhibiting EGR1—markedly reduced weight gain, hepatic fat and impaired glucose tolerance in mice, pointing to a clear microbiome-immune target for obesity intervention.
  • 江南大学孙嘉/潘礼龙团队：一类特殊的大肠杆菌推动慢性胰腺炎走向纤维化
    Jiangnan University: A distinctive E. coli drives chronic pancreatitis toward fibrosis
    江南大学孙嘉、潘礼龙团队联合上海交通大学邹多武等在Gastroenterology发表研究，整合多中心慢性胰腺炎患者宏基因组、小鼠模型与巨噬细胞实验，鉴定出一类高表达HtpG的大肠杆菌可促进胰腺纤维化，揭示了肠道菌群在慢性胰腺炎进展中的因果作用，为以微生态为靶点的胰腺疾病干预提供了机制依据。
    A team led by Sun Jia and Pan Lilong of Jiangnan University with Zou Duowu of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, publishing in Gastroenterology, integrated multi-center metagenomics from chronic pancreatitis patients with mouse models and macrophage experiments. They identified HtpG-high-expressing E. coli that promotes pancreatic fibrosis, establishing a causal role for gut microbes in disease progression and supporting microbiome-targeted strategies for pancreatic disorders.
  • Nature Communications：重新审视脱硫弧菌，特定鞭毛蛋白瓦解肠道免疫耐受
    Nature Communications: Rethinking Desulfovibrio — specific flagellins dismantle gut immune tolerance
    Nature Communications发表的一项泛基因组研究系统解析了脱硫弧菌属的广泛基因组多样性，发现不同物种携带的功能性状差异显著，其中特定鞭毛蛋白能够破坏肠道免疫耐受，与炎症性肠病等疾病相关。该工作提示判断硫酸盐还原菌的致病潜力必须细化到物种与效应分子层面，而非停留在属水平。
    A pan-genomic study in Nature Communications systematically mapped the extensive genomic diversity of the genus Desulfovibrio, revealing pronounced species-specific functional traits. Certain flagellins were shown to undermine gut immune tolerance and have been linked to inflammatory bowel disease. The work suggests that assessing the pathogenic potential of sulfate-reducing bacteria requires species- and effector-level resolution rather than genus-level labels.
  • Science Immunology：肠道上皮双哨兵，簇细胞联手M细胞重塑黏膜免疫
    Science Immunology: Tuft cells team up with M cells as dual sentinels of mucosal immunity
    Science Immunology发表的研究发现，肠道淋巴滤泡相关上皮中的簇细胞与M细胞形成功能协同：簇细胞放大2型黏膜免疫应答并促进IgA产生，与M细胞共同构成肠道黏膜免疫的"双哨兵"结构。该发现深化了对肠道上皮如何平衡免疫防御与耐受的理解，也为益生菌与黏膜疫苗设计提供了新的上皮靶点。
    Research published in Science Immunology shows that tuft cells in follicle-associated epithelium of the gut cooperate with M cells: tuft cells amplify type 2 mucosal immunity and boost IgA production, forming a dual-sentinel architecture with M cells. The finding deepens understanding of how the gut epithelium balances defense and tolerance, and suggests new epithelial targets for probiotic and mucosal vaccine design.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • ScienceDaily："僵尸细胞"如何躲避免疫系统追杀的机制被揭开
    ScienceDaily: How harmful 'zombie cells' hide from the immune system
    ScienceDaily报道的最新研究揭示了衰老细胞（"僵尸细胞"）逃避免疫清除的关键机制：它们通过特定的分子伪装躲过免疫系统的监视，从而在组织中持续累积并释放促炎因子，驱动慢性炎症与组织老化。理解这一"隐身术"为开发增强免疫清除衰老细胞的抗衰疗法提供了直接靶点，是衰老细胞清除策略的重要补充。
    New research covered by ScienceDaily reveals how senescent 'zombie cells' evade immune surveillance through specific molecular camouflage, allowing them to accumulate in tissues and secrete pro-inflammatory factors that drive chronic inflammation and tissue aging. Understanding this hiding mechanism offers direct targets for anti-aging therapies designed to boost immune clearance of senescent cells, complementing existing senolytic strategies.
  • 一项长达47年的研究揭示：身体从多大年龄开始流失力量
    A 47-year study reveals the age when the body starts losing strength
    ScienceDaily报道一项跨越47年的纵向研究，绘制了人体肌肉力量随年龄变化的长期轨迹，确定了力量开始加速流失的关键年龄节点。该发现对长寿医学意义重大：力量下降是失能与死亡风险的强预测因子，锁定"窗口期"意味着抗阻训练与蛋白质营养干预可在力量明显滑坡前提前介入，为延长健康寿命给出可操作的时间表。
    A 47-year longitudinal study covered by ScienceDaily charted the long-term trajectory of muscle strength across aging and identified the critical age at which strength decline accelerates. Because declining strength strongly predicts disability and mortality, pinning down this window means resistance training and protein-focused nutrition can be deployed before the slide begins—an actionable timetable for extending healthspan.
  • 给干细胞装上"抗衰发动机"：ATG5过表达让老年韧带伤口奇迹般愈合
    Equipping stem cells with an anti-aging engine: ATG5 overexpression rejuvenates aged ligament healing
    发表于Open Medicine的研究发现，老年大鼠韧带愈合缓慢的根源在于间充质干细胞自噬能力下降。研究者通过基因技术让干细胞过表达自噬关键基因ATG5后移植，不仅促进胶原有序排列与血管新生，还将巨噬细胞从促炎M1型转为抗炎M2型，显著提升老年韧带修复力，为老年运动损伤的干细胞疗法提供了"先抗衰、再修复"的新思路。
    A study in Open Medicine traced slow ligament healing in aged rats to reduced autophagy in mesenchymal stem cells. By engineering the cells to overexpress the autophagy gene ATG5 before transplantation, researchers promoted organized collagen alignment and new vessel growth, and shifted macrophages from pro-inflammatory M1 to reparative M2 phenotypes, markedly improving healing—suggesting an 'anti-age the cell, then repair' strategy for geriatric musculoskeletal injuries.
  • 阻断化疗后的"衰老毒素"：微小RNA miR-3155b精准关闭衰老分泌因子
    Blocking post-chemotherapy 'senescence toxins': microRNA miR-3155b precisely shuts down SASP
    一项新研究鉴定出乳腺癌治疗后产生的微小RNA miR-3155b，它像精准"刹车片"一样直接关闭引发炎症与肿瘤复发的衰老分泌因子（SASP），且不伤害正常细胞。该发现把细胞衰老研究从"清除"扩展到"驯化"——在不杀死衰老细胞的前提下中和其有害分泌，为减轻放化疗副作用及更温和的抗衰干预提供了全新靶点。
    New research identifies microRNA miR-3155b, produced after breast cancer treatment, which acts as a precise brake that directly silences the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) driving inflammation and tumor recurrence—without harming healthy cells. The finding extends senescence research from 'clearance' to 'taming,' neutralizing harmful secretions while leaving senescent cells alive, and opens a fresh target for softer anti-aging interventions and fewer radio-chemotherapy side effects.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 近20万人数据：深夜进食与肝病风险升高最多30%相关
    Nearly 200,000 people: Late-night eating linked to up to 30% higher liver disease risk
    俄勒冈健康与科学大学团队分析近20万人数据发现，习惯深夜进食与代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病风险升高最多达30%相关，进食时序本身独立于总热量摄入构成风险因素。研究强调"什么时候吃"与"吃什么"同样重要，为 chrono-nutrition（时间营养学）在脂肪肝一级预防中的应用提供了大样本流行病学支持。
    Analyzing data from nearly 200,000 people, researchers at Oregon Health & Science University found that habitual late-night eating is associated with up to a 30% higher risk of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease, with meal timing acting as a risk factor independent of total caloric intake. The study underscores that 'when we eat' matters as much as 'what we eat,' providing large-scale epidemiological support for chrono-nutrition in primary prevention of fatty liver disease.
  • 梅斯医学：一个月不吃肉就能年轻1.7岁？随机试验显示纯素饮食改写DNA甲基化
    One meat-free month makes you 1.7 years younger? Randomized trial shows a vegan diet rewrites DNA methylation
    发表于MedComm的随机饮食干预研究纳入48名健康成年人，等热量条件下进行一个月纯素与高肉饮食对照：尽管体重无明显变化，纯素组DNA甲基化谱偏向抗炎、抑癌与衰老相关通路改善，免疫细胞构成趋向更抗炎的稳态，部分表观遗传指标提示生物学衰老放缓。研究者提醒观察期仅4周且样本有限，长期效应与临床意义仍需验证。
    A randomized dietary intervention published in MedComm assigned 48 healthy adults to isocaloric vegan versus high-meat diets for one month. With no significant weight change, the vegan group's DNA methylation profile shifted toward anti-inflammatory, cancer-suppressive and longevity-related pathways, with immune cell composition trending toward a calmer state and epigenetic markers suggesting slower biological aging. The authors caution that four weeks and a small sample warrant longer, larger studies.
  • 英国营养学杂志：2.1万人队列显示高质量膳食使糖尿病风险降低14%–28%，炎症指标起中介作用
    British Journal of Nutrition: In 21,476 adults, high-quality diets cut diabetes odds 14%–28%, partly via inflammation
    发表于British Journal of Nutrition的福清队列研究（21,476名成人）显示，膳食质量最高组的糖尿病风险较最低组低14%–28%，11项血液炎症标志物可解释约9%的关联。研究提示膳食质量部分通过降低系统性炎症改善代谢健康，为抗炎膳食干预提供人群证据。
    A Fuqing Cohort study of 21,476 adults published in the British Journal of Nutrition found that those with the highest diet quality had 14%–28% lower odds of diabetes than the lowest group, depending on the scoring system, with eleven circulating inflammatory markers mediating about 9% of the association. The results suggest diet quality partly protects metabolic health by dampening systemic inflammation, supporting anti-inflammatory dietary patterns as a precision-nutrition target.
  • 昆明理工团队：发酵罗望子果肉重塑色氨酸代谢，缓解顽固便秘
    Kunming University of Science and Technology: Fermented tamarind pulp reshapes tryptophan metabolism to relieve stubborn constipation
    昆明理工大学储传奇团队发表于Journal of Advanced Research的研究显示，灭活益生菌发酵的罗望子果肉可通过调节肠道色氨酸分解代谢与AhR-NLRP3信号轴，改善顽固性便秘模型。该研究把传统药食同源食材与菌群-代谢组学机制对接，为功能性食品干预功能性胃肠病提供了"发酵增效"的精准营养思路。
    A team led by Chu Chuanqi at Kunming University of Science and Technology, publishing in the Journal of Advanced Research, showed that heat-inactivated probiotic-fermented tamarind pulp alleviates refractory constipation by modulating gut tryptophan catabolism and the AhR-NLRP3 axis. By linking a traditional food-medicine ingredient to microbiome-metabolomics mechanisms, the work offers a 'fermentation-boosted' precision nutrition strategy for functional gastrointestinal disorders.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • NutraIngredients周报：荷兰植物成分新规、英国补剂广告、Ω-3走出鱼油、HTBA收购Specnova
    Across the Nutraverse: Dutch botanical rules, UK supplement ads, omega-3s beyond fish oil, HTBA buys Specnova
    NutraIngredients行业周报盘点：荷兰拟议的补剂新规（涉及南非醉茄、蛇足石杉碱等植物成分）可能迫使企业重新配方；英国补剂广告监管趋严；Ω-3产品创新正走出传统鱼油形态；HTBA收购脂质递送技术公司Specnova，显示吸收与递送技术成为补剂行业并购新热点。
    NutraIngredients' industry roundup: proposed Dutch supplement rules targeting botanicals such as ashwagandha and huperzine could force product reformulation; UK supplement advertising scrutiny is tightening; omega-3 innovation is moving beyond conventional fish oil formats; and HTBA's acquisition of lipid-delivery specialist Specnova signals that absorption and delivery tech is the new hotspot in supplement M&A.
  • Lallemand加码亚洲代谢平衡市场：携手本地伙伴推进益生菌方案
    Lallemand doubles down on metabolic balance in Asia, working with local partners
    NutraIngredients报道，加拿大益生菌巨头Lallemand正聚焦"代谢平衡"主题深耕亚洲市场，通过与本地合作伙伴联合推进针对血糖、血脂与体重管理的益生菌与益生菌组合方案。该公司强调以临床证据与本地化配方适配亚洲人群饮食习惯，反映出全球益生菌企业正从泛肠道健康转向代谢健康细分赛道。
    NutraIngredients reports that Canadian probiotics major Lallemand is focusing on 'metabolic balance' across Asia, partnering with local players to advance probiotic and synbiotic formulations aimed at blood glucose, blood lipids and weight management. The company stresses clinical evidence and localization to Asian dietary habits—reflecting a wider industry shift from generic gut health toward the metabolic health segment.
  • 代谢健康补剂新品潮：瞄准肠道健康、血糖控制与饱腹感三大方向
    Metabolic health supplement launches target gut health, glucose control and satiety
    NutraIngredients汇总最新一波代谢健康补剂上市动态：新品集中主打肠道健康、血糖平稳与饱腹管理三大方向，普遍采用益生菌、膳食纤维、植物提取物与微量营养素的复配策略，并强调临床数据背书。代谢综合征高发叠加GLP-1时代消费者"自然辅助"需求，使该品类成为补剂行业增长最快的细分市场之一。
    NutraIngredients rounds up the latest wave of metabolic health supplement launches centered on gut health, glucose control and satiety. New products typically combine probiotics, fibers, botanical extracts and micronutrients, with an emphasis on clinical substantiation. Rising metabolic syndrome prevalence plus consumers seeking 'natural adjuncts' in the GLP-1 era make this one of the fastest-growing supplement categories.
  • 十亿美元级补剂并购成新基准？行业整合加速洗牌
    Are billion-dollar supplement deals becoming the new benchmark?
    NutraIngredients分析指出，补剂行业正迎来十亿美元量级的并购交易潮，头部品牌与原料商的整合明显提速，资本向拥有临床证据、供应链掌控力与多市场渠道的标的集中。分析认为，科学背书与合规能力正在取代营销概念成为估值核心，行业将加速从"营销驱动"转向"证据驱动"的整合洗牌。
    NutraIngredients analysis shows the supplement sector is seeing a wave of billion-dollar-scale acquisitions, with consolidation accelerating among leading brands and ingredient suppliers. Capital is flowing toward targets with clinical evidence, supply-chain control and multi-market distribution. Scientific substantiation and compliance capability are replacing marketing hype as the core of valuation, driving the industry from marketing-led to evidence-led restructuring.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • ScienceDaily：Ozempic与Wegovy与罕见突发性视力丧失风险相关
    ScienceDaily: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to rare risk of sudden vision loss
    ScienceDaily报道的最新研究提示，GLP-1类药物司美格鲁肽（Ozempic/Wegovy）与罕见突发视力丧失——非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）风险相关。研究并未否定GLP-1的代谢获益，但提示用药者出现视力变化应及时就医，为慢病管理中的用药监测再添一环。
