    Barcode-tracking of Bacteroides shows gut commensals can rapidly adapt within weeks in mice. Complex polysaccharides best recapitulate in vivo selection, and closely related lineages evolve heritable spatial niches (cecal vs fecal bias) without losing cross-host transmissibility — a dynamic evolutionary map guiding the design of more stably colonizing probiotics.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • Science：894只犬表观遗传时钟解释“大型犬为何短寿”，转座子成关键线索
    Science: Epigenetic clocks in 894 dogs explain why big dogs die young, pointing to transposable elements
    亚利桑那州立大学团队基于犬类衰老项目894只犬的1640个甲基化组构建表观遗传时钟：时钟可预测死亡风险，且表观衰老在生命早期最快；体型更大、寿命更短的公犬分子衰老加速，性别相关变化集中于X染色体，体型相关变化聚焦转座子区域，为“衰老速度决定寿命”提供了跨物种自然实验证据。
    Using 1,640 methylomes from 894 dogs in the Dog Aging Project, ASU researchers built an epigenetic clock that predicts mortality, with epigenetic aging fastest early in life. Larger, shorter-lived male dogs showed accelerated molecular aging; sex effects concentrated on the X chromosome while size effects were pronounced at transposable elements — a natural cross-species experiment linking aging pace to lifespan.
  • Restore联合Niagen Bioscience宣布十月为“长寿月”：从寿命转向健康寿命
    Restore and Niagen Bioscience declare October 'Longevity Month', shifting focus from lifespan to healthspan
    美国最大科学背书个性化健康服务连锁Restore Hyper Wellness与NAD+科学领导者Niagen Bioscience联合宣布十月为“长寿月”，推动公众关注从延长寿命转向健康寿命；首席科学官提出下午精力崩溃、恢复变慢、睡眠失效、放弃爱好、全或无式锻炼五大衰老信号，并倡导以可坚持的小习惯叠加细胞健康干预。
    Restore Hyper Wellness, the largest science-backed personalized wellness franchise in the US, has partnered with Niagen Bioscience to declare October 'Longevity Month', reframing the conversation from lifespan to healthspan. Their chief science officer lists five everyday aging signals — afternoon crashes, slower recovery, unrefreshing sleep, abandoned hobbies and all-or-nothing routines — and champions small, sustainable habits plus cellular-health support.
  • 每天酸奶+饮食管理+运动：日本小型研究显示男性生物衰老速度放缓约2.2%
    Daily yogurt, diet counseling and exercise slowed biological aging by about 2.2% in Japanese men
    日本一项针对48名50-74岁超重男性的研究显示：每日100克无糖酸奶配合减少过食与含糖饮料的饮食指导、每周至少三次30分钟步行或踏步运动，持续干预后DunedinPACE测算的生物衰老速度放缓约2.2%，效果与25%热量限制研究相当，且独立于体重下降，提示简单生活方式组合即可影响衰老速率。
    In a Japanese study of 48 overweight men aged 50-74, daily intake of 100 g plain yogurt plus dietary counseling and at least three 30-minute walks per week slowed DunedinPACE-measured biological aging by about 2.2% — comparable to 25% caloric restriction in prior research — with benefits independent of weight loss, suggesting a simple lifestyle bundle can shift the pace of aging.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • AJCN随机试验：抗阻训练下素食者与杂食者增肌接近，杂食者肌肉量多增约70%
    AJCN RCT: Vegetarians and omnivores gain strength alike on resistance training, but omnivores gain ~70% more muscle mass
    阿姆斯特丹应用科学大学团队让108名55岁以上成人随机采用素食或杂食饮食并进行每周三次抗阻训练、蛋白质≥1.2克/公斤：12周后两组肌力与体功能改善相当，但杂食组四肢肌肉量增幅约0.66公斤，比素食组（0.38公斤）高约70%；素食组中蛋白摄入越高增肌越多，提示植物基饮食者更需关注蛋白量与质。
    In a randomized trial from Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, 108 adults aged 55+ followed vegetarian or omnivorous diets with resistance training three times weekly and at least 1.2 g protein/kg. After 12 weeks, strength and function improved similarly, but omnivores gained ~70% more limb muscle (0.66 vs 0.38 kg). Vegetarians gained more muscle with higher protein intake, underscoring protein quantity and quality for plant-based eaters.
  • 个性化营养助力夜班工人：随机研究显示胆固醇与炎症指标改善
    Personalized nutrition for night-shift workers linked to reduced cholesterol and inflammation
    NutraIngredients报道一项针对夜班工人的个性化营养研究：依据个体代谢与作息特征定制膳食方案后，参与者胆固醇水平下降、炎症标志物改善。夜班人群因昼夜节律紊乱面临更高心血管代谢风险，该研究提示把“进食时间”纳入精准营养处方，或成轮班职业健康管理的新抓手。
    NutraIngredients reports a personalized nutrition study in night-shift workers: dietary plans tailored to individual metabolic and circadian profiles were linked to lower cholesterol and improved inflammatory markers. With circadian disruption raising cardiometabolic risk in shift workers, factoring meal timing into precision-nutrition prescriptions may become a new lever for occupational health management.
  • 大型综述：并非所有反式脂肪都有害，天然与工业来源需区别看待
    Major review: Not all trans fats are bad — natural and industrial sources should be judged differently
    ScienceDaily报道一项大型综述，对“反式脂肪一律有害”的笼统结论提出修正：工业部分氢化油产生的人工反式脂肪与心血管风险证据确凿，而反刍动物来源的天然反式脂肪酸（如共轭亚油酸、反式异油酸）在常规膳食剂量下的健康影响与人工来源并不相同，营养政策与标签管理需按来源区别对待。
    A major review covered by ScienceDaily refines the blanket claim that all trans fats are harmful: industrial trans fats from partial hydrogenation carry well-established cardiovascular risks, whereas ruminant-derived natural trans fatty acids such as CLA and trans-vaccenic acid behave differently at usual dietary intakes — arguing for source-specific nutrition policy and labeling.
  • 国际专家综述：肌肉健康应成为临床营养核心目标，功能比肌肉量更重要
    Expert review: Muscle health should become the core goal of clinical nutrition — function matters more than mass
    最新国际专家综述呼吁把肌肉健康视为临床营养学核心且可测量的目标，而非疾病或衰老的次要结果：肌肉健康不等于肌肉量，还涵盖力量、耐力、代谢与自我功能评估；肿瘤、危重症、衰老与减重（含GLP-1药物人群）需求各异，单一“多吃蛋白”并不够，需个性化营养支持并建立标准化测量方法。
    A new international expert review argues muscle health should be a core, measurable target of clinical nutrition rather than a secondary outcome: muscle health goes beyond mass to include strength, endurance, metabolism and self-reported function. Needs differ across cancer, critical illness, aging and weight-loss populations (including GLP-1 users), so protein alone is not enough — personalized support and standardized measurement are required.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 甜菜根硝酸盐或缓解咖啡因引起的动脉僵硬：随机交叉试验新证据
    Beetroot nitrates may attenuate caffeine-induced arterial stiffness, randomized crossover trial suggests
    NutraIngredients报道一项随机交叉研究：单次咖啡因摄入可短暂升高动脉僵硬度和血压，而提前补充富含硝酸盐的甜菜根汁可显著减弱这一反应，机制可能与硝酸盐-亚硝酸盐-一氧化氮通路改善血管内皮功能有关。研究为咖啡爱好者提供了膳食硝酸盐这一低成本血管保护思路，仍需更大规模试验确认。
    A randomized crossover study reported by NutraIngredients found that a single dose of caffeine transiently raises arterial stiffness and blood pressure, but pre-loading with nitrate-rich beetroot juice significantly blunted this response, likely via the nitrate-nitrite-NO pathway improving endothelial function. Dietary nitrate offers a low-cost vascular strategy for coffee drinkers, pending larger trials.
  • 代谢健康补剂科学盘点：最新研究如何支持血糖、血脂与体重管理
    Catching up with metabolic health supplements: the latest science for glucose, lipids and weight
    NutraIngredients梳理近期代谢健康补剂领域研究进展，覆盖多种植物提取物、膳食纤维与功能性成分在血糖调控、血脂改善与体重管理方面的最新临床试验与机制证据，指出行业正从单一成分宣称转向“成分组合+人群分层+硬终点”的证据路径，为配方开发与合规宣称提供参考。
    NutraIngredients rounds up recent metabolic-health supplement science, spanning botanical extracts, fibers and functional ingredients with new clinical and mechanistic evidence for glucose control, lipid improvement and weight management. The field is shifting from single-ingredient claims toward ingredient combinations, population stratification and hard endpoints — a roadmap for formulation and compliant claims.
  • XXL Nutrition联手Those Vegan Cowboys启动120万欧元项目，进军无牛酪蛋白
    XXL Nutrition and Those Vegan Cowboys launch €1.2M project to deliver cow-free casein
    荷兰运动营养品牌XXL Nutrition与精密发酵公司Those Vegan Cowboys达成120万欧元合作，共同开发无牛酪蛋白：经精密发酵产出与乳源酪蛋白结构一致的蛋白质，兼顾功能性与可持续性。此举显示精密发酵蛋白正从概念走向运动营养与临床营养的商业化落地。
    Dutch sports nutrition brand XXL Nutrition has joined forces with precision-fermentation company Those Vegan Cowboys in a €1.2M project to produce cow-free casein — proteins identical to dairy casein, made via precision fermentation — combining functionality with sustainability, and signaling that fermented dairy-equivalent proteins are moving from concept to commercial sports and clinical nutrition.
  • 莱特维健将亮相HNC深圳健康营养展，携NMN40000主打细胞级抗衰
    Wright Life to showcase NMN40000 cellular anti-aging line at HNC Shenzhen health nutrition expo
    2026深圳国际健康与营养保健品展将于10月13-15日在深圳国际会展中心举办，香港品牌莱特维健将携全新升级金至NMN40000等产品参展。在我国老龄化加速、60岁以上人口年均净增近千万的背景下，科学抗衰需求持续攀升，NAD+类补剂与长寿营养成为展会展位竞争与产业协同的焦点赛道之一。
    The 2026 Shenzhen International Health & Nutrition Expo (Oct 13-15) will host Hong Kong brand Wright Life (莱特维健), presenting its upgraded NMN40000 cellular anti-aging products. As China's population aged 60+ grows by nearly ten million a year, demand for science-based healthy-aging nutrition keeps rising, making NAD+ supplements and longevity nutrition one of the expo's most competitive tracks.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 卡罗林斯卡综述厘清GLP-1七大安全疑虑：胆囊疾病证据最强，其余多为不确定
    Karolinska review sorts seven GLP-1 safety concerns: strongest evidence for gallbladder disease, much else uncertain
    卡罗林斯卡学院Peter Ueda在《内科学杂志》发表叙述性综述，逐项评估GLP-1受体激动剂七类严重不良事件证据：胆囊及胆道疾病因果证据最一致，视网膜病变恶化疑似快速降糖的早期效应；甲状腺癌、NAION、自杀行为、胰腺炎与肠梗阻的因果关系仍不确定，罕见事件需结合基线风险个体化沟通。
    Peter Ueda of Karolinska Institutet published a narrative review in the Journal of Internal Medicine appraising seven serious adverse-event concerns for GLP-1 receptor agonists: gallbladder and biliary disease has the most consistent causal evidence; retinopathy worsening may reflect rapid glucose improvement; for thyroid cancer, NAION, suicidality, pancreatitis and intestinal obstruction causality remains uncertain — rare events warrant individualized baseline-risk counseling.
  • GLP-1停药体重反弹怎么办？Tufts试点：医疗定制餐与数字App各减反弹约7%
    Stopping GLP-1? Tufts pilot: medically tailored meals or a digital app each cut weight regain by ~7%
    Tufts食物即药物研究所联合UT西南医学中心开展的39人随机试点显示：停用GLP-1药物时转入医疗定制餐或数字健康App组，前四个月体重反弹显著少于常规照护（分别-7.17%与-7.16%差异）。作为假设生成型小试验，提示“停药过渡方案”值得在更大规模研究中验证。
    A 39-partner pilot randomized trial from Tufts Food is Medicine Institute and UT Southwestern found that adults transitioned off GLP-1 therapy gained significantly less weight over four months with medically tailored meals (-7.17% difference) or a digital wellness app (-7.16%) versus usual care. Hypothesis-generating but promising: an off-ramp plan deserves larger trials.
  • 仅一次运动就能帮老年人减脂保肌？ScienceDaily报道新研究
    Just one workout helped older adults lose fat and keep muscle, ScienceDaily reports
    ScienceDaily报道一项针对老年人的运动研究：仅需一次特定类型的运动干预即可观察到脂肪减少与肌肉保留的代谢信号，挑战“必须长期高强度训练才有效”的固有认知。研究者强调单次效应虽短暂，但为高龄、体弱人群提供了低门槛起始方案——动起来本身即是健康管理的一线处方。
    A study covered by ScienceDaily found that even a single session of a specific exercise modality produced measurable metabolic signals of fat loss and muscle preservation in older adults, challenging the assumption that only long-term high-intensity training works. Though transient, the single-session effect offers a low-barrier entry point for frail elderly — movement itself as first-line health management.
  • 同一瓶营养品不再全家通用：消费者按年龄与生活方式分龄选配方
    One supplement bottle no longer fits the whole family: consumers pick formulas by age and lifestyle
    NHANES最新数据显示美国成年人补剂使用率随年龄递增：20-39岁46.3%、40-59岁60.3%、60岁以上75.9%，“一瓶复合维生素全家吃”正被分龄分场景选品取代。文章提示消费者应核对营养成分表、每份含量与建议食用量的实质差异，结合年龄、季节、饮食与生活方式四因素理性选品，而非追随网红成分。
    Latest NHANES data show US adult supplement use rises with age — 46.3% at 20-39, 60.3% at 40-59 and 75.9% at 60+ — replacing the one-multivitamin-for-all habit with age- and scenario-specific choices. Consumers are advised to compare Supplement Facts, serving sizes and doses, and choose by age, season, diet and lifestyle rather than viral ingredients.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-09
item.description: 2026-10-09 简报，共 20 条：中国农大任发政团队NC：益生菌BL-99重塑胆汁酸代谢，逆转老年肠道动力衰退；中科院微生物所hLife研究：靶向噬菌体阻断肠菌迁居肾脏，缓解糖尿病肾损伤；阳明交大蔡亭芬团队：益生菌高效转化柑橘黄酮，改善衰老小鼠代谢；全球首个细胞重编程疗法公布人体安全性数据：首批患者耐受良好，剂量获批上调三倍；撒丁岛村庄Bolotana或成新蓝区：女性70岁后活到百岁概率达13.8%，全国三倍；6.5万人配对队列：减重手术与痴呆风险降52%、帕金森风险降30%相关；耶鲁团队：老药拉科酰胺在临床前阻断软骨破坏、推动骨关节炎关节修复；浙大等Nature Health研究：坚持东方膳食模式，肥胖风险降16%、心血管事件降22%；喂养方式塑造婴儿菌群发育：新研究揭示母乳与配方奶的早期菌群分化；随机交叉试验：每天40克核桃8周，情绪困扰评分下降、血清素代谢物升高；Phynova推动桑叶提取物走出控糖定位，拓展更广代谢健康赛道；维D2或降低体内D3水平：研究提示维生素D补充剂型选择需谨慎；Kaneka加码还原型辅酶Q10泛醌：线粒体健康补剂赛道热度持续攀升；生育三烯酚或保护早期胚胎线粒体健康：生殖营养补剂获新方向；Ω-3的下个篇章：行业需要比心脏健康更大的故事；WHO发布首份儿童青少年肥胖治疗指南：10岁以下不推荐减肥药与减重手术；第35个世界精神卫生日临近：主题悦纳情绪心有阳光，心理门诊服务加速下沉县域；全国高血压日聚焦体重管理：科学减重10公斤，血压可下降5-20mmHg；13万婴儿队列研究：父亲产后五年死亡几乎无人追踪，约六成或可预防；儿科学会年会研究：21岁以下结直肠癌患者多数确诊时已至III-IV期，警讯易被忽视
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 中国农大任发政团队NC：益生菌BL-99重塑胆汁酸代谢，逆转老年肠道动力衰退
    CUAST team in Nature Communications: probiotic BL-99 reshapes bile acid metabolism to reverse age-related gut motility decline
    热心肠日报10月8日解读中国农业大学任发政团队发表于《自然·通讯》的研究：随机双盲试验中，益生菌BL-99使老年便秘受试者全肠道转运时间平均缩短28.6小时、自发排便频率显著提高；衰老小鼠模型显示其通过抑制携带胆盐水解酶基因的菌群、保留牛磺鹅去氧胆酸，经PI3K/AKT-SRF通路恢复结肠平滑肌收缩蛋白表达，从代谢机制层面逆转衰老相关肠道动力减退。
    Mr-Gut Daily covered a Nature Communications study by Ren Fazheng's team at China Agricultural University: in a randomized double-blind trial, probiotic BL-99 shortened whole-gut transit time by an average of 28.6 hours in older adults with constipation; in aged mice it preserved taurine-conjugated bile acids by suppressing bile salt hydrolase-carrying microbes and restored colonic smooth-muscle contractile protein expression via the PI3K/AKT-SRF pathway, reversing age-related motility decline at the metabolic level.
  • 中科院微生物所hLife研究：靶向噬菌体阻断肠菌迁居肾脏，缓解糖尿病肾损伤
    CAS team in hLife: targeted phages block gut-to-kidney bacterial translocation and ease diabetic kidney injury
    科学网10月8日刊文介绍中科院微生物所刘宏伟团队发表于hLife的研究：糖尿病肾病患者肠道中肠聚集性大肠杆菌显著扩增，可跨越受损肠屏障定植肾脏并加重纤维化与炎症；EAEC特异性噬菌体EAWsc9连续三周口服给药，可靶向清除EAEC、显著减轻db/db小鼠肾间质纤维化、巨噬细胞浸润与系统炎症，为肠-肾轴干预提供了精准噬菌体疗法新工具。
    Science Net China on Oct 8 featured an hLife study from Liu Hongwei's team at the Chinese Academy of Sciences: enteroaggregative E. coli expands in the guts of patients with diabetic kidney disease and can cross the damaged gut barrier to colonize the kidney, worsening fibrosis and inflammation. Three weeks of oral dosing with the EAEC-specific phage EAWsc9 selectively cleared the bacterium and markedly reduced renal interstitial fibrosis, macrophage infiltration and systemic inflammation in db/db mice, offering a precise phage-therapy tool for the gut-kidney axis.
  • 阳明交大蔡亭芬团队：益生菌高效转化柑橘黄酮，改善衰老小鼠代谢
    NYCU team: probiotics efficiently convert citrus flavonoids and improve metabolism in aging mice
    热心肠日报收录，阳明交通大学蔡亭芬团队发表于Gut Microbes的研究显示，特定益生菌可将柑橘类黄酮高效转化为活性代谢物，补充后显著改善衰老小鼠的代谢指标。该工作把益生菌干预与植物多酚代谢直接衔接，提示益生菌加多酚的组合策略有望成为延缓代谢衰老的功能医学新路径，后续仍需在人体验证剂量窗口与个体应答差异。
    Mr-Gut Daily features a Gut Microbes study from Tsai Ting-Fen's team at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University showing that specific probiotics efficiently convert citrus flavonoids into active metabolites and significantly improve metabolic markers in aged mice, directly linking probiotic intervention with plant polyphenol metabolism; combined probiotic-polyphenol strategies may become a new functional-medicine route against metabolic aging, pending human validation of dosing and responder variability.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 全球首个细胞重编程疗法公布人体安全性数据：首批患者耐受良好，剂量获批上调三倍
    First human cellular reprogramming therapy reports safety data: early patients tolerated well, dose approved to rise threefold
    Business Insider报道，Life Biosciences公布其青光眼细胞重编程疗法ER-100首份人体安全数据：3名患者接受眼内注射联合8周每日抗生素激活重编程因子，未报告重大副作用，其中2人视力显著改善；独立安全监查委员会已批准下一组患者剂量提高三倍。这是部分表观遗传重编程从动物实验走向人体的关键节点，疗效与长期安全性仍需更大样本验证。
    Business Insider reports that Life Biosciences released the first human safety data for ER-100, a cellular reprogramming therapy for glaucoma: three patients received an eye injection plus eight weeks of daily antibiotics activating reprogramming factors, with no major side effects and significant vision improvement in two. An independent safety board approved a threefold dose escalation for the next cohort — a key step moving partial reprogramming from animals into humans, pending larger efficacy and safety trials.
  • 撒丁岛村庄Bolotana或成新蓝区：女性70岁后活到百岁概率达13.8%，全国三倍
    Sardinian village Bolotana emerges as a new blue zone: women face a 13.8 percent chance of reaching 100, triple the national rate
    卫报10月8日报道，萨萨里大学与阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校发表于Frontiers in Aging的研究发现，撒丁岛中部村庄Bolotana的女性70岁后活到100岁的概率达13.8%，约为意大利全国均值3.5%的三倍，女性长寿水平全球仅次于中国香港；这是25年来首次在传统蓝区之外发现新长寿热点，村庄数百年的出生与死亡档案可精确核验每位百岁老人年龄。
    The Guardian reported on Oct 8 that a Frontiers in Aging study by the University of Sassari and the University of Alabama at Birmingham found that in the central Sardinian village of Bolotana, 13.8 percent of women who reach 70 live to 100 — three times the Italian average of 3.5 percent, ranking second worldwide for female longevity after Hong Kong; it is the first new longevity hotspot identified outside the island's original blue zone in over 25 years.
  • 6.5万人配对队列：减重手术与痴呆风险降52%、帕金森风险降30%相关
    65,000-person matched cohort links bariatric surgery to 52 percent lower dementia and 30 percent lower Parkinson's risk
    《国际肥胖杂志》一项基于TriNetX电子病历的倾向评分配对队列研究（各32552人）显示，BMI≥35人群接受减重手术后痴呆发生率降低52%、帕金森病降低30%，心血管病、肥胖相关癌症与全因死亡分别下降47%、34%与54%，20年生存率84.7%对81.8%；提示代谢重塑具有系统性神经保护潜力，但观察性设计与中位随访不足6年仍是主要局限。
    A propensity-matched TriNetX cohort study of 32,552 pairs in the International Journal of Obesity found that among adults with BMI of 35 or higher, bariatric surgery was associated with 52 percent lower dementia incidence, 30 percent lower Parkinson's disease, plus reductions of 47 percent in cardiovascular disease, 34 percent in obesity-associated cancers and 54 percent in all-cause mortality — suggesting systemic neuroprotective potential of metabolic reset, with observational design and short follow-up as caveats.
  • 耶鲁团队：老药拉科酰胺在临床前阻断软骨破坏、推动骨关节炎关节修复
    Yale team finds epilepsy drug lacosamide blocks cartilage destruction and promotes joint repair in preclinical models
    ScienceDaily报道，耶鲁大学研究发现已获批的抗癫痫药拉科酰胺可同时作用于疼痛信号通路与软骨破坏相关蛋白，在临床前研究中帮助受损关节重回修复轨道，为骨关节炎干预从止痛维持转向结构修复提供了老药新用线索；研究人员指出该发现尚处临床前阶段，能否在人体重现软骨保护与再生效果仍需进一步试验验证。
    ScienceDaily reports that Yale researchers found lacosamide, an already-approved epilepsy drug, acts on both pain signaling and a protein involved in cartilage destruction, shifting damaged joints back toward repair in preclinical studies — a drug-repurposing lead for moving osteoarthritis care beyond pain control toward structural repair; the finding remains preclinical and human benefits await further trials.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 浙大等Nature Health研究：坚持东方膳食模式，肥胖风险降16%、心血管事件降22%
    Zhejiang-led Nature Health study links an Eastern Diet pattern to 16 percent lower obesity and 22 percent lower cardiovascular events
    腾讯新闻10月8日报道，浙江大学与中国疾控中心等团队在Nature Health分析WELL-中国队列8931人饮食数据，识别出以蔬果、水产、全谷物、豆制品与菌菇为特征的东方膳食模式：坚持者中心性肥胖风险降17%、整体肥胖降16%、主要不良心血管事件降22%，男性护心效应更突出；代谢组与菌群分析显示产丁酸有益菌增多、关键代谢物吲哚-3-丙酸水平升高，阐释了中式健康膳食的作用通路。
    Tencent News reported on Oct 8 that teams from Zhejiang University and the China CDC, publishing in Nature Health, analyzed dietary data from 8,931 WELL-China cohort participants and identified an EastDiet pattern rich in vegetables, seafood, whole grains, soy foods and mushrooms: adherence was associated with 17 percent lower central obesity, 16 percent lower overall obesity and 22 percent fewer major cardiovascular events, stronger in men, with metabolomics showing more butyrate-producing bacteria and higher indole-3-propionic acid.
  • 喂养方式塑造婴儿菌群发育：新研究揭示母乳与配方奶的早期菌群分化
    Feeding choices shape infant microbiome development, new study reveals early divergence
    NutraIngredients 10月8日报道的一项新研究系统比较了不同喂养方式下婴儿肠道菌群的发育差异，显示母乳喂养与配方奶喂养婴儿的菌群组成与功能轨迹在生命早期即明显分化。该发现为婴幼儿配方设计与生命早期免疫代谢支持提供了循证依据，也提示个性化母婴营养需把菌群发育节奏纳入考量，家长的喂养选择影响远超营养素本身。
    A new study covered by NutraIngredients on Oct 8 systematically compares infant gut microbiome development across feeding choices, showing that breastfed and formula-fed infants diverge early in microbiome composition and function; the findings inform formula design and early-life immune and metabolic support, and suggest personalized infant nutrition should account for the pace of microbiome maturation beyond nutrients alone.
  • 随机交叉试验：每天40克核桃8周，情绪困扰评分下降、血清素代谢物升高
    Randomized crossover trial: 40g walnuts daily for 8 weeks lowered mood distress and raised serotonin metabolites
    发表于Food & Function的随机交叉试验纳入31名健康年轻人，每天晚餐吃40克核桃持续8周后，总体情绪困扰评分平均降低4.85分，尿液血清素代谢物5-HIAA显著升高；核桃多酚经肠道菌群代谢产生的尿石素A/B同步增加并与5-HIAA变化相关，提示核桃-菌群-血清素轴或参与情绪调节，样本量小且以女性为主，结论有待更大规模试验确认。
    A randomized crossover trial in Food & Function with 31 healthy young adults found that eating 40g of walnuts at dinner daily for eight weeks lowered overall mood distress scores by an average of 4.85 points and significantly raised urinary 5-HIAA, a serotonin metabolite; walnut-polyphenol-derived urolithin A/B rose in parallel and tracked with 5-HIAA changes, hinting at a walnut-gut bacteria-serotonin axis, though the small female-dominant sample calls for larger trials.
  • Phynova推动桑叶提取物走出控糖定位，拓展更广代谢健康赛道
    Phynova pushes mulberry leaf extract beyond blood-sugar control into broader metabolic health
    NutraIngredients 10月8日报道，英国植物成分企业Phynova携桑叶提取物接连斩获亚洲与欧洲奖项后，正将其定位从传统的餐后血糖管理拓展至更广的代谢健康场景。桑叶中的活性成分可抑制双糖酶、延缓糖吸收，企业同步推进临床证据与法规路径布局；这一动向折射植物提取物行业正从单一功能声称走向循证化、平台化的精准营养赛道。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 8 that UK botanical firm Phynova, after winning awards in Asia and Europe for its mulberry leaf extract, is repositioning it beyond post-meal blood-sugar management toward broader metabolic health; the extract slows sugar absorption by inhibiting disaccharidases, and the company is building clinical evidence and regulatory pathways — reflecting the botanicals segment's shift from single claims toward evidence-based precision-nutrition platforms.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 维D2或降低体内D3水平：研究提示维生素D补充剂型选择需谨慎
    Vitamin D2 may lower the body's D3 levels: study urges caution over supplement form choice
    ScienceDaily 10月8日报道新研究显示，并非所有维生素D补充剂效果等同：服用麦角钙化醇（维生素D2）反而可能降低体内胆钙化醇（维生素D3）水平，而D3是日晒下人体自然合成、对提升总体维生素D状态与免疫防护更有效的形式。研究者据此提示公众与临床选择补D剂型时应优先考虑D3，并定期复查血清25-羟维生素D水平评估实际效果。
    ScienceDaily reported on Oct 8 that new research suggests not all vitamin D supplements are equal: taking ergocalciferol (vitamin D2) can actually lower levels of cholecalciferol (vitamin D3), the form naturally produced by sunlight and more effective at boosting overall vitamin D status and immune protection; the researchers advise prioritizing D3 when choosing a supplement and periodically checking serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D.
  • Kaneka加码还原型辅酶Q10泛醌：线粒体健康补剂赛道热度持续攀升
    Kaneka doubles down on ubiquinol as interest in mitochondrial health supplements grows
    NutraIngredients 10月8日报道，日本Kaneka公司表示将继续投资泛醌（还原型辅酶Q10）的产能与科学传播，以承接全球对线粒体健康与细胞能量补剂的快速增长需求。辅酶Q10是线粒体氧化磷酸化的关键辅因子，泛醌作为其还原活性形式在吸收与生物利用度上更具卖点；企业以临床研究积累与法规合规双轮驱动扩张，反映补剂大厂正押注细胞能量科学叙事。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 8 that Japan's Kaneka will keep investing in ubiquinol (reduced coenzyme Q10) capacity and science communication to meet fast-growing global demand for mitochondrial health and cellular energy supplements; as the reduced active form of a key cofactor in oxidative phosphorylation, ubiquinol carries absorption and bioavailability advantages, with Kaneka pairing clinical research and regulatory compliance — a sign major supplement makers are betting on cellular-energy science.
  • 生育三烯酚或保护早期胚胎线粒体健康：生殖营养补剂获新方向
    Tocotrienols may protect mitochondrial health in early embryos, opening a new direction for reproductive nutrition
    NutraIngredients 10月8日报道的研究显示，维生素E家族的生育三烯酚或有助于改善早期胚胎的线粒体健康，为生殖营养补充剂开发提供新方向。线粒体功能是卵母细胞质量与胚胎发育能量的核心，生育三烯酚凭借抗氧化与膜稳定特性有望成为辅助生殖与孕前营养干预的候选成分；研究者强调现有证据仍在早期阶段，人体验证与安全剂量范围有待积累。
    Research covered by NutraIngredients on Oct 8 suggests tocotrienols, a form of vitamin E, may help protect mitochondrial health in early embryos, opening a new direction for reproductive nutrition supplements; since mitochondrial function underpins oocyte quality and embryonic development, tocotrienols' antioxidant and membrane-stabilizing traits make them candidate ingredients for fertility and preconception nutrition, though evidence remains early and human validation is pending.
  • Ω-3的下个篇章：行业需要比心脏健康更大的故事
    Omega-3's next chapter: the industry needs a bigger tent beyond heart health
    NutraIngredients 10月7日专访中，资深补剂行业人士Andrew Hebard提出Ω-3品类需要更大的帐篷：在心血管健康这一经典卖点之外，应把大脑发育、情绪、运动恢复、孕产与老年营养等场景纳入叙事，并以更高吸收率与依从性的产品形态触达新人群。该评论折射补剂行业从单成分单卖点向全生命周期循证定位转型的趋势，也为Ω-3品牌差异化提供思路。
    In a NutraIngredients interview published on Oct 7, supplements veteran Andrew Hebard argues the omega-3 category needs a bigger tent: beyond its classic heart-health story, it should embrace brain development, mood, exercise recovery, maternal and healthy-aging use cases, reaching new audiences with better-absorbed, more palatable formats — reflecting the industry's shift from single-ingredient claims toward evidence-based, life-course positioning.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • WHO发布首份儿童青少年肥胖治疗指南：10岁以下不推荐减肥药与减重手术
    WHO issues first guidelines on child and adolescent obesity: no weight-loss drugs or surgery for under-10s
    世界卫生组织10月7日发布首份针对儿童青少年肥胖的全球治疗指南：2024年5-19岁肥胖人数达1.7亿、患病率较1990年翻两番。WHO强烈推荐以结构化饮食、运动与行为干预为基础，明确不推荐0-9岁儿童使用减肥药物、减重手术或减重器械；10-19岁青少年仅在监督下的多模式生活方式干预无效时，才考虑使用已批准药物或严格条件下的手术。
    On October 7 the World Health Organization issued its first global guidelines for managing obesity in children and adolescents: 170 million 5-19-year-olds were living with obesity in 2024, a fourfold prevalence rise since 1990. WHO strongly recommends structured dietary, physical-activity and behavioral interventions, explicitly advises against weight-loss drugs, bariatric surgery or devices for children aged 0-9, and permits approved medicines for adolescents only after supervised lifestyle programs fail.
  • 第35个世界精神卫生日临近：主题悦纳情绪心有阳光，心理门诊服务加速下沉县域
    Ahead of the 35th World Mental Health Day, China pushes psychological outpatient services into more counties
    健康报评论指出，今年10月10日是第35个世界精神卫生日，主题为悦纳情绪，心有阳光。2026年3月国家卫生健康委等25部门印发健全社会心理服务体系和危机干预机制实施方案，明确到2030年覆盖全人群、全生命周期的服务体系基本健全；2026年卫生健康系统为民服务实事项目提出新增110个县提供心理门诊服务，强调早期识别风险并精准对接需求。
    A Health News commentary notes that October 10 marks the 35th World Mental Health Day under a theme of embracing emotions and staying positive; in March 2026, 25 Chinese departments issued an implementation plan for social psychological services targeting full-population, life-course coverage by 2030, and this year's health-system agenda adds psychological outpatient services in 110 more counties, pushing early identification and grassroots access.
  • 全国高血压日聚焦体重管理：科学减重10公斤，血压可下降5-20mmHg
    National Hypertension Day puts weight management first: losing 10kg can cut blood pressure by 5-20 mmHg
    第29个全国高血压日之际，青岛市疾控中心提示超重肥胖是高血压核心可控危险因素，BMI越高发病风险越高，男性腰围≥90cm、女性≥85cm的中心型肥胖风险更大；每减重10公斤血压可下降5-20mmHg。专家建议每日食盐少于5克、蔬菜不少于400克，每周5-7次中等强度有氧运动并搭配抗阻训练，确诊者应遵医嘱优先使用长效降压药平稳控压。
    Marking the 29th National Hypertension Day, the Qingdao CDC highlighted excess weight as a leading modifiable risk factor for high blood pressure: risk rises with BMI, and central obesity with a waist of 90cm or more in men or 85cm in women is especially dangerous; losing 10kg can lower blood pressure by 5-20 mmHg, while experts advise under 5g of salt daily, at least 400g of vegetables, weekly aerobic plus resistance exercise and long-acting medications as prescribed.
  • 13万婴儿队列研究：父亲产后五年死亡几乎无人追踪，约六成或可预防
    130,000-baby study finds new fathers' deaths largely untracked — and about 60 percent potentially preventable
    ScienceDaily报道，一项覆盖佐治亚州13万余名新生儿的研究发现，数百名父亲在孩子出生后五年内死亡，其中约60%属潜在可预防，凶杀、意外伤害、自杀与药物过量占可预防死亡的大头。研究者称这是公共卫生的重大盲区：孕产期照护聚焦母婴，父亲群体的心理健康、物质滥用与安全风险长期缺乏系统筛查与随访，呼吁将父亲纳入围产期支持体系。
    ScienceDaily reports a study of more than 130,000 births in Georgia finding that hundreds of fathers died within five years of their child's birth, with about 60 percent of deaths potentially preventable — homicide, accidental injury, suicide and drug overdoses leading the list; researchers call it a major public-health blind spot, noting perinatal care focuses on mothers and babies while fathers' mental health and safety risks go unscreened, and urge including fathers in perinatal support.
  • 儿科学会年会研究：21岁以下结直肠癌患者多数确诊时已至III-IV期，警讯易被忽视
    AAP conference study: most colorectal cancer patients aged 21 or under already at stage III-IV when diagnosed
    美国儿科学会2026全国会议报告的一项84例研究显示，21岁及以下结直肠癌患者中仅20%有一级或二级亲属家族史，但多数确诊时已进展至III或IV期，超过三分之一复发、近半数死亡。腰背痛、腹痛、排便习惯改变、体重下降与直肠出血等警讯在年轻人群中易被忽视，研究者呼吁年轻人出现不明原因便血或消瘦时及时就医评估，并加强儿科与成人团队协作。
    An 84-patient study presented at the AAP 2026 National Conference found that among colorectal cancer patients aged 21 or under, only 20 percent had a first- or second-degree family history, yet most were already at Stage III or IV when diagnosed; over a third relapsed and nearly half died. Warning signs like back or abdominal pain, bowel changes, weight loss and rectal bleeding are easily missed in young people, and researchers urge prompt evaluation for unexplained bleeding or weight loss.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-08
item.description: 2026-10-08 简报，共 20 条：深圳湾实验室×中山大学Nature发文：肠道共生菌产十五烷酸C15:0降胆固醇、缓解动脉粥样硬化；麦克马斯特大学Gastroenterology研究：肠道炎症破坏食物代谢菌群，或解释IBD缓解期食物不耐受；医科院放射所：牛磺酸防辐射护肠道，雌雄机制大不同；热心肠日报：潘氏细胞或并非GVHD元凶，EGF供应才是辐照下肠道干细胞的生命线；直接药物激活AMPK首次证实：酵母、线虫与果蝇寿命延长，部分超25%；新研究：血液NAD+水平越低，老年人衰弱程度越重；僵尸细胞驱动衰老，科学家转向焕新免疫清除细胞而非单纯杀伤；194岁巨龟乔纳森的基因组与表观基因组：关键调控区域仍保持年轻秩序；广州医科大学Cell研究：肿瘤与T细胞竞争维生素B2，形成铁死亡代谢检查点；Cell Metabolism框架文章：大脑FGF21调度蛋白限制的全身适应与延寿效益；小鼠研究：5:2间歇性禁食同步改善脂肪肝与骨骼肌损伤，重塑菌群-胆汁酸轴；台湾VITABOX观察：运动营养正在成为日常营养；FDA就软糖类膳食补充剂发声，剂型质量与合规边界受关注；印度Pure Nutrition进军长寿补剂赛道，推出漆黄素、AKG等产品线；Nutritional Outlook评论：补剂行业的长期产品责任，昨日配方要经得起今日科学；雪印Megmilk设立新部门，发力益生菌与功能性原料销售；寒露逢全国高血压日：早睡早起适度动，护好四部位，稳住血压；1.8万人9年随访：每天睡约7.1小时，身体衰弱风险最低；食物即药物：长期发放植物基食物包，两年半降压减重效果可观；女子美容院灌肠致肠穿孔进ICU，专家：灌肠是医疗行为，不可当养生
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 深圳湾实验室×中山大学Nature发文：肠道共生菌产十五烷酸C15:0降胆固醇、缓解动脉粥样硬化
    Shenzhen Bay Laboratory and Sun Yat-sen University report in Nature that gut bacterial C15:0 lowers cholesterol and eases atherosclerosis
    新华社深圳10月7日电，深圳湾实验室与中山大学中山医学院合作研究10月7日在线发表于《自然》：肠道共生菌（如脆弱拟杆菌）可自发产生十五烷酸（C15:0），经HMGCR-SREBP2/LDLR通路抑制肝脏胆固醇合成并促进坏胆固醇清除；补充C15:0使动脉粥样硬化小鼠血脂改善、斑块减少，人群样本中血脂异常者该分子水平偏低，为高血脂与心血管代谢防治提供了菌群来源干预的新路径。
    Xinhua reported from Shenzhen that a Shenzhen Bay Laboratory and Sun Yat-sen University team, publishing online in Nature on Oct 7, showed gut commensal bacteria such as Bacteroides uniformis spontaneously produce pentadecanoic acid (C15:0), which suppresses hepatic cholesterol synthesis and promotes LDL clearance via the HMGCR-SREBP2/LDLR axis; C15:0 supplementation improved blood lipids and reduced plaque burden in atherosclerotic mice, and dyslipidemic people showed lower levels, pointing to a microbiome-derived route for cardiometabolic prevention.
  • 麦克马斯特大学Gastroenterology研究：肠道炎症破坏食物代谢菌群，或解释IBD缓解期食物不耐受
    McMaster study in Gastroenterology links gut inflammation-altered microbiota to food intolerances in IBD remission
    麦克马斯特大学团队发表于《胃肠病学》的研究显示，肠道炎症会破坏负责降解麸质与乳蛋白的特定菌群，使炎症性肠病患者即便处于缓解期也对新触发食物产生免疫反应；104名缓解期患者中约85%自报食物不耐受，远高于健康对照的33%。结肠炎模型中回补缺失菌株可逆转食物特异性免疫反应，为基于菌群的诊断与治疗指路，也提示个体化营养需考虑菌群对食物成分的加工能力。
    A McMaster University team reports in Gastroenterology that intestinal inflammation disrupts gut bacteria that break down gluten and dairy proteins, explaining why people with inflammatory bowel disease in remission react to once-tolerated foods; about 85 percent of 104 patients reported food intolerances versus 33 percent of controls, and replenishing depleted bacteria reversed food-specific immune reactions in colitis models, informing microbiome-based diagnosis and personalized nutrition.
  • 医科院放射所：牛磺酸防辐射护肠道，雌雄机制大不同
    Taurine protects the irradiated gut with sex-specific mechanisms, CAMS team shows
    热心肠日报10月7日收录：中国医学科学院放射医学研究所樊赛军、路璐团队发表于International Journal of Biological Sciences的研究显示，口服牛磺酸将受照雄鼠生存率从50%提升至91.7%、雌鼠从66.7%升至100%；雄鼠经乳杆菌-精氨酸/脯氨酸代谢轴促黏膜修复，雌鼠依赖雌激素-AICDA-IgA免疫轴；牛磺酸不干扰放疗杀瘤，支持性别分层的放射防护策略。
    As covered by Mr-Gut Daily on Oct 7, a Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences team showed in the International Journal of Biological Sciences that oral taurine raised survival of irradiated male mice from 50 to 91.7 percent and females from 66.7 to 100 percent; males were protected through a Ligilactobacillus-arginine/proline metabolic axis while females depended on an estrogen-AICDA-IgA mucosal immune axis abolished by ovariectomy, and taurine did not compromise radiotherapy, supporting sex-stratified radioprotection.
  • 热心肠日报：潘氏细胞或并非GVHD元凶，EGF供应才是辐照下肠道干细胞的生命线
    Paneth cells may not drive GVHD after all — their EGF supply is what guards gut stem cells after irradiation
    热心肠日报10月7日解读新研究：借助潘氏细胞特异性剔除小鼠发现，稳态下清除潘氏细胞后隐窝结构、肠道干细胞数量与WNT3表达均完好，提示其功能可被代偿网络覆盖；但致死性辐照后，潘氏细胞作为EGF的首要来源不可替代，补充重组EGF即可完全挽救肠道损伤。而在异基因骨髓移植GVHD模型中，潘氏细胞缺失并未加重病情，颠覆了潘氏细胞丢失驱动GVHD肠道损伤的传统认知。
    Mr-Gut Daily on Oct 7 covered a study using Paneth-cell-deficient mice: under homeostasis, crypt architecture, stem cell pools and WNT3 expression remained intact without Paneth cells, but after lethal irradiation their role as the dominant EGF source became irreplaceable and recombinant EGF fully rescued gut injury; in allogeneic bone marrow transplant models of GVHD, Paneth cell loss did not worsen disease, overturning a long-held assumption.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 直接药物激活AMPK首次证实：酵母、线虫与果蝇寿命延长，部分超25%
    Direct pharmacological AMPK activation extends lifespan in yeast, worms and flies, by over 25 percent in some settings
    10月7日报道，MRC医学科学实验室、帝国理工学院与科隆大学团队在Aging Cell发表研究：用化合物991直接激活细胞能量传感器AMPK，使裂殖酵母、线虫与果蝇寿命延长、部分实验超25%，且在AMPK功能缺失时效应消失，首次证明直接靶向AMPK可带来长寿获益；处理三周的小鼠肝脏出现促长寿蛋白组模式并抑制mTOR通路。作者提醒过度激活反而缩短寿命，距离人类抗衰应用仍很遥远。
    Reported on Oct 7: a team from the MRC Laboratory of Medical Sciences, Imperial College London and the University of Cologne showed in Aging Cell that directly activating the cellular energy sensor AMPK with compound 991 extended lifespan in fission yeast, nematode worms and fruit flies, by more than 25 percent in some experiments, with the effect vanishing when AMPK was disabled; three-week treatment of mice induced a pro-longevity proteomic profile with mTOR suppression. The authors caution that excess activation shortened life and human translation remains distant.
  • 新研究：血液NAD+水平越低，老年人衰弱程度越重
    Lower NAD+ levels linked to greater frailty in older adults, study finds
    NutraIngredients 10月7日报道，一项新研究发现老年人血液中NAD+水平越低，衰弱程度越重，两者呈显著关联。NAD+是细胞能量代谢与DNA修复的关键辅酶，随年龄增长而下降；该结果把NAD+从抗衰营销话题拉回可测量的临床指标层面，提示全血NAD+水平未来或可用于老年衰弱风险分层，也可作为NAD+前体干预试验的响应标志物，但因果关系与临床获益仍需前瞻性研究验证。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 7 that a new study links lower blood NAD+ levels to greater frailty severity in older adults. NAD+, a key coenzyme in cellular energy metabolism and DNA repair that declines with age, may thus serve as a measurable clinical marker for frailty risk stratification and as a response biomarker in NAD+-precursor intervention trials, although causality and clinical benefit still require prospective validation.
  • 僵尸细胞驱动衰老，科学家转向焕新免疫清除细胞而非单纯杀伤
    Zombie cells drive aging — scientists now aim to rejuvenate the immune cleanup crew rather than just kill the cells
    Live Science 10月7日发表深度报道：衰老细胞（俗称僵尸细胞）随年龄在组织中累积并释放促炎因子，而负责清除它们的巨噬细胞功能同步衰退。7月发表于《科学》的小鼠研究发现，老年巨噬细胞EP2受体增多、吞噬衰老细胞能力下降，敲除EP2或阻断其信号可恢复清除功能，改善认知、肌力、心功能与全身炎症；研究者认为焕新免疫系统或比直接杀伤衰老细胞更安全，有望成为senolytics之外的新路径。
    A Live Science feature published on Oct 7 explains how senescent zombie cells accumulate with age while the macrophages that clear them slow down; a July Science study in mice found aged macrophages overexpress the EP2 receptor, impairing engulfment of senescent cells, and blocking EP2 restored clearance and improved cognition, muscle strength, cardiac function and systemic inflammation, suggesting immune rejuvenation may offer a safer complement to senolytics.
  • 194岁巨龟乔纳森的基因组与表观基因组：关键调控区域仍保持年轻秩序
    Genome and epigenome of 194-year-old tortoise Jonathan reveal youthful order in key regulatory regions
    腾讯新闻10月8日发布科普：科学家对约194岁的圣赫勒拿巨龟乔纳森（已知最长寿陆生动物）口腔刮取组织进行基因组与表观基因组分析，鉴定出287个涉及DNA修复、炎症调控、胰岛素信号、端粒维持与肿瘤抑制的独特基因变体；尽管年事极高，其线粒体能量代谢与基因修复相关调控区域的甲基化状态仍异常有序、与年轻巨龟相近，为跨物种衰老与长寿机制研究提供了罕见参照样本。
    Chinese media detailed on Oct 8 the genomic and epigenomic analysis of Jonathan, the roughly 194-year-old Seychelles giant tortoise and the oldest known land animal: researchers identified 287 unique gene variants tied to DNA repair, inflammation control, insulin signaling, telomere maintenance and tumor suppression, and found methylation in regulatory regions linked to mitochondrial energy production and gene repair remained strikingly orderly, resembling much younger tortoises — a rare reference for cross-species aging research.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 广州医科大学Cell研究：肿瘤与T细胞竞争维生素B2，形成铁死亡代谢检查点
    Guangzhou Medical University Cell paper: tumors compete with T cells for vitamin B2, creating a ferroptosis checkpoint
    科学网10月7日报道，广州医科大学边英杰课题组10月6日发表于《细胞》的研究揭示肿瘤与T细胞之间的维生素B2竞争：肿瘤优先经SLC52A2掠夺VB2，令依赖SLC52A3摄取VB2的T细胞陷入缺乏，线粒体呼吸与谷胱甘肽再生受损、触发铁死亡并削弱抗肿瘤免疫；敲除肿瘤SLC52A2或补充VB2可增强CAR-T疗效，肿瘤SLC52A2高表达与患者生存期差相关，而膳食VB2摄入与癌症风险降低相关。
    Sciencenet reported on Oct 7 that a Cell paper from Guangzhou Medical University describes competition for vitamin B2 between tumors and T cells: tumors hijack VB2 via SLC52A2, starving T cells that rely on SLC52A3, which impairs mitochondrial respiration and glutathione regeneration, triggering ferroptosis; deleting tumor SLC52A2 or supplementing VB2 boosted CAR-T efficacy, high tumor SLC52A2 expression correlated with worse survival, and higher dietary VB2 intake was associated with lower cancer risk.
  • Cell Metabolism框架文章：大脑FGF21调度蛋白限制的全身适应与延寿效益
    Cell Metabolism framework: brain FGF21 orchestrates the systemic adaptation to protein restriction
    腾讯新闻10月7日解读路易斯安那州立大学彭宁顿生物医学研究中心发表于《细胞·代谢》的框架文章：限制蛋白质摄入无需削减总热量即可改善多个衰老标志，关键调度中心是大脑——肝源性激素FGF21直接作用于脑，协调低蛋白环境的全身适应，缺失该信号则代谢改善与寿命延长等益处无法展现；文章提出以蛋白食欲、血糖调节与能量消耗等可测量变化作为适应程序激活的标志物，为个性化低蛋白膳食干预提供依据。
    Chinese media on Oct 7 covered a Cell Metabolism framework article from LSU Pennington Biomedical Research Center: protein restriction improves multiple hallmarks of aging without cutting total calories because the brain acts as the central coordinator, with liver-derived FGF21 signaling required for the metabolic and longevity benefits; the authors propose measurable readouts such as protein appetite, glycemic regulation and energy expenditure as biomarkers of program activation, informing personalized low-protein interventions.
  • 小鼠研究：5:2间歇性禁食同步改善脂肪肝与骨骼肌损伤，重塑菌群-胆汁酸轴
    Mouse study: 5:2 intermittent fasting eases fatty liver and protects muscle while remodeling the microbiota-bile acid axis
    生物通10月7日编译一项小鼠研究：12周5:2间歇性禁食显著改善高脂饮食诱导的代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病，并同步防止骨骼肌损伤——握力与肌纤维横截面积增加、炎症基因下调，肠道紧密连接增强、血清LPS降低；宏基因组显示罗伊氏乳杆菌等有益菌富集、次级胆汁酸合成通路上调，肠、肝、肌组织胆汁酸受体表达同步升高。研究为兼顾肝脏脂肪变性与肌肉质量的非药物饮食干预提供了新证据。
    Ebiotrade summarized on Oct 7 a mouse study in which 12 weeks of 5:2 intermittent fasting improved high-fat-diet-induced MASLD while protecting skeletal muscle: grip strength and fiber cross-sectional area rose, inflammatory genes fell, gut tight junctions strengthened with lower serum LPS, and metagenomics showed enrichment of Limosilactobacillus reuteri with upregulated secondary bile acid synthesis and bile acid receptor signaling across gut, liver and muscle — evidence for a dietary intervention that addresses liver fat and muscle quality together.
  • 台湾VITABOX观察：运动营养正在成为日常营养
    Sports nutrition is becoming everyday nutrition — Taiwan's VITABOX
    NutraIngredients 10月7日报道，台湾订阅制营养品牌VITABOX观察到，运动营养正被消费者当作日常营养使用：蛋白与肌酸等品类不再只属于健身人群，而是融入上班族与女性消费者的日常能量与恢复管理。品牌以小包装、多品类组合与订阅模式降低尝试门槛，并依据活动量与生活场景做个性化搭配，反映出运动营养与精准营养加速融合、从专业渠道走向大众日常的亚洲市场趋势。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 7 that Taiwanese subscription nutrition brand VITABOX is seeing sports nutrition become everyday nutrition: protein and creatine products are now used by office workers and women for daily energy and recovery rather than by gym-goers alone, with small-pack formats, bundles and subscriptions lowering the entry barrier and personalization by activity level, reflecting the convergence of sports and precision nutrition across Asian markets.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • FDA就软糖类膳食补充剂发声，剂型质量与合规边界受关注
    Sticky situation: FDA weighs in on gummy dietary supplements
    NutraIngredients 10月7日报道，美国FDA就软糖类膳食补充剂公开发声。软糖是增长最快、最受消费者欢迎的剂型之一，但其基质存在成分稳定性、含量均一与标签准确性等固有难题，业界普遍关注FDA将如何在现有膳食补充剂框架内界定软糖的合规要求；叠加软糖剂型消费疲劳与功能性食品、脂质体等精准递送技术的兴起，厂商的剂型策略正面临重新洗牌。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 7 that the US FDA is weighing in on gummy dietary supplements, one of the fastest-growing and most popular formats. Gummy matrices pose persistent challenges around ingredient stability, content uniformity and label accuracy, and the industry awaits clarity on how existing supplement rules apply; combined with gummy fatigue and the rise of functional foods and precision delivery systems, manufacturers may need to rethink format strategies.
  • 印度Pure Nutrition进军长寿补剂赛道，推出漆黄素、AKG等产品线
    India's Pure Nutrition launches longevity supplements including fisetin and AKG
    NutraIngredients 10月6日报道，印度营养品牌Pure Nutrition正式进军长寿补剂领域，推出以漆黄素、α-酮戊二酸（AKG）等衰老生物学热门分子为核心的产品线，瞄准国内快速增长的健康长寿消费群体。印度补剂市场正从基础维生素向长寿与细胞健康品类升级，本土品牌依托成本与渠道优势切入，与全球长寿补剂赛道老牌玩家同场竞技，循证数据与剂量透明度或成竞争分水岭。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 6 that Indian brand Pure Nutrition has entered the longevity supplement field with a line built around popular aging-biology actives such as fisetin and alpha-ketoglutarate, targeting the country's fast-growing healthy-longevity consumer base; as India's supplement market shifts from basic vitamins toward longevity and cellular health, evidence standards and dosing transparency may decide which players endure.
  • Nutritional Outlook评论：补剂行业的长期产品责任，昨日配方要经得起今日科学
    What long-term product stewardship looks like in the supplement industry
    Nutritional Outlook 10月6日刊发评论，探讨补剂行业长期产品责任的应有之义：负责任的创新不止于推出新原料，还要追问昨天的配方是否仍符合今天的最佳科学。文章提出企业应在出现新安全性证据时重审存量配方、及时更新剂量与警示标识、以透明沟通退役过时宣称，认为覆盖产品全生命周期的自我管理，是行业赢得消费者与监管信任、区别于营销驱动竞争的根基。
    Nutritional Outlook published a commentary on Oct 6 arguing that long-term product stewardship means asking whether yesterday's formulations still reflect today's best science: companies should re-examine legacy products when new safety evidence emerges, update doses and warning labels, and retire outdated claims transparently, framing whole-lifecycle management as the foundation for consumer and regulatory trust.
  • 雪印Megmilk设立新部门，发力益生菌与功能性原料销售
    Megmilk Snow Brand sets up new unit to drive probiotics and ingredient sales
    NutraIngredients 10月7日报道，日本雪印Megmilk Snow Brand设立新业务部门，整合益生菌与功能性原料的销售与开发，以B2B方式向食品与补剂厂商供应菌株和成分。在肠道健康需求全球升温、日本益生菌研发积累深厚的背景下，公司希望把消费品牌之外的菌株资产货币化，并借海外扩张对冲国内人口萎缩；菌株特异性循证数据与功能声称能力将成为原料业务竞争的关键。
    NutraIngredients reported on Oct 7 that Japan's Megmilk Snow Brand has set up a new business unit to drive probiotic and ingredient sales, supplying strains and functional ingredients to food and supplement makers on a B2B basis; leveraging Japan's deep probiotic research base and rising global gut-health demand, the company aims to monetize strain assets beyond its consumer brands and offset domestic population decline, with strain-specific evidence as a key differentiator.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 寒露逢全国高血压日：早睡早起适度动，护好四部位，稳住血压
    Cold Dew meets National Hypertension Day: sleep early, move gently, keep warm and keep blood pressure steady
    央视新闻10月8日发布寒露节气健康指南，恰逢全国高血压日：寒露是全年降温最快、昼夜温差最大的节气之一，建议早睡早起顺应阳气收敛，太极拳、八段锦、散步等温和运动循序渐进，常按足三里健脾胃；头颈、腰腹、关节与足部四部位重点保暖，阳虚体质、老人、孕产妇及高血压、冠心病等慢病患者不宜秋冻；气温下降易致血压波动，调整用药切勿自行判断。
    CCTV News published a Cold Dew solar-term health guide on Oct 8, coinciding with China's National Hypertension Day: experts advise earlier sleep, gradual gentle exercise such as tai chi and Baduanjin, pressing the Zusanli acupoint, and protecting the head, neck, abdomen, joints and feet from cold; frail groups and patients with hypertension or heart disease should not practice autumn chill, and blood pressure medication should never be adjusted without medical advice as falling temperatures cause fluctuations.
  • 1.8万人9年随访：每天睡约7.1小时，身体衰弱风险最低
    Sleep of about 7.1 hours carries the lowest frailty risk, 18,000-person study finds
    腾讯新闻10月8日汇总睡眠研究：2026年9月《自然》子刊npj Aging基于中国健康与养老追踪调查1.8万余名中老年人、中位近9年随访的研究显示，睡眠时长与衰弱风险呈U型曲线，约7.1小时风险最低，不足7小时与超过9小时均明显升高；另有多项研究提示7小时左右全身器官衰老最慢、胰岛素敏感性最佳。专家提醒睡眠规律性与质量同样重要，无需为凑满8小时焦虑。
    Chinese media highlighted on Oct 8 a study in npj Aging based on over 18,000 middle-aged and older Chinese adults from CHARLS followed for a median of nearly nine years: sleep duration showed a U-shaped association with frailty risk, with the lowest risk at about 7.1 hours, while short and long sleep raised risk; other studies point to around seven hours as optimal for organ aging and insulin sensitivity, and experts stress regularity and quality matter as much as duration.
  • 食物即药物：长期发放植物基食物包，两年半降压减重效果可观
    Healthy food bundles lowered weight and blood pressure long-term, study shows
    HealthDay 10月7日报道，麻省总医院布莱根团队发表于《预防慢性病》的观察研究：68名参与食物即药物项目的成年人平均两年半内领取97箱植物基食物包，内含一周三餐量的新鲜果蔬、豆类罐头、坚果酱与全谷物；每多领100箱，舒张压平均下降3.2毫米汞柱、体重减轻近2.7公斤、BMI下降1点，高血压患者收缩压亦改善。研究者主张足量足期的食物干预应成为慢病管理标配，前瞻对照试验将进一步验证。
    HealthDay reported on Oct 7 that a Mass General Brigham observational study in Preventing Chronic Disease followed 68 adults in a Food Is Medicine program who received an average of 97 plant-based grocery boxes — a week of meals in fresh produce, canned beans, nut butter and whole grains — over about 2.5 years; every 100 boxes was associated with a 3.2-point drop in diastolic blood pressure, nearly 6 pounds of weight loss and a one-point BMI decline, supporting long-duration produce interventions.
  • 女子美容院灌肠致肠穿孔进ICU，专家：灌肠是医疗行为，不可当养生
    Colonic detox at beauty salon ends in bowel perforation — doctors warn enemas are medical procedures
    今日头条10月8日报道，42岁女子在美容院购买号称排毒焕肤的高端灌肠套餐，灌肠时肠管被捅破、肠内容物漏入腹腔引发弥漫性腹膜炎，送入ICU抢救后脱险。浙江省立同德医院肛肠外科专家提醒：灌肠是对液体温度、用量与压力有严格要求并需医护评估的医疗操作，频繁灌肠会破坏肠道菌群与自身排便反射；健康人无需灌肠排毒，切勿在非医疗机构进行。
    Chinese media reported on Oct 8 that a 42-year-old woman suffered bowel perforation and diffuse peritonitis after a high-end colonic detox package at a beauty salon and spent time in intensive care. Colorectal surgeons stress that enemas are medical procedures with strict requirements for fluid temperature, volume and pressure, that frequent enemas damage the gut microbiota and the natural defecation reflex, and that healthy people do not need colon cleansing for detox.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-07
item.description: 2026-10-07 简报，共 20 条：中科院大学聂广军/徐嘉琪团队：工程菌修复肠脑轴，同步改善结肠炎与精神共病；海南大学张家超团队Cell子刊：益生菌LGG以代谢物丙酰左卡尼汀助攻肺癌靶向药，减毒增效；热心肠日报：新模型揭示阿尔茨海默病肠道菌群代谢异常，APOE ε4携带者已现端倪；Lancet Microbe：健康人上呼吸道真菌图谱绘制，鼻咽与口咽真菌结构大不同；诺和诺德与礼来公布GLP-1衰老时钟读数：蛋白质组时钟显示生物年龄最多减速4年；Aging Cell：表型药物发现新型漆黄素衍生黄酮类senolytics，小鼠健康寿命标志物改善；长寿需要误差棒：Deerfield掌门Jim Flynn筹办非营利长寿中心，直指行业信息噪声；ScienceDaily：斯坦福找到促老年关节软骨再生的小分子策略，或减少关节置换需求；MIT团队Nature发文：生酮饮食经脂质而非酮体加剧小鼠小肠肿瘤、抑制结肠肿瘤；GUT综述：重启肠道生物钟，限时进食如何逆转代谢危机；Nature Metabolism随机交叉试验：超加工食品的代谢与神经应答新证据；Lancet综述：女性GLP-1使用者瘦体重流失约三成，营养缺口与可及性障碍被低估；美国最高法院拒绝受理CRN诉纽约州补剂年龄限制法案，案件发回地区法院；Lemme在沃尔玛独家上新GLP-1 Production Support胶囊，天然GLP-1支持赛道再升温；Nutrition Insight：Greenvit野樱莓提取物体外模拟研究显示菌群密度与短链脂肪酸双升；台湾2026保健食品消费大调查：人均年补6.6项，台大教授潘敏雄破解五大迷思；剑桥Heartwear获英国NHS 1.84亿英镑采购：全球首款医疗级无线充电多导联心电可穿戴；Mito上线249美元冠脉钙化扫描：免转介快速出结果，长寿检测版图再扩张；同花顺产业透视：2026-2030中国健康科技全景，AI健康管理用户规模突破1.2亿；ScienceDaily：产后护理加配患者导航员，抑郁筛查与长期随访显著改善
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 中科院大学聂广军/徐嘉琪团队：工程菌修复肠脑轴，同步改善结肠炎与精神共病
    UCAS team engineers gut bacteria to repair the gut-brain axis, easing colitis and psychiatric comorbidity
    热心肠日报第3746期报道，中国科学院大学聂广军、徐嘉琪团队构建可响应炎症微环境的工程菌：抵达病变肠段后由基质金属蛋白酶释放靶向蛋白，既锁死上皮紧密连接修复屏障，又促进乳酸杆菌与阿克曼氏菌增殖、恢复肠道GABA经循环作用于海马与前额叶。结肠炎小鼠体重下降被阻断、行为绝望缓解，疗效超越静脉注射抗TNFα抗体，为肠脑轴双通路干预提供新范式。
    Mr-Gut Daily (issue 3746) reports that a team led by Nie Guangjun and Xu Jiaqi at the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences built inflammation-responsive engineered bacteria that release targeting proteins at lesion sites, sealing epithelial tight junctions to repair the gut barrier while boosting Lactobacillus and Akkermansia growth and restoring gut-derived GABA signaling to the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex. In colitis mice the therapy halted weight loss, eased despair-like behavior and outperformed intravenous anti-TNF antibodies, offering a dual-pathway paradigm for gut-brain intervention.
  • 海南大学张家超团队Cell子刊：益生菌LGG以代谢物丙酰左卡尼汀助攻肺癌靶向药，减毒增效
    Hainan University team reports in Cell Reports that probiotic LGG metabolite propionyl-L-carnitine boosts lung-cancer targeted therapy while cutting toxicity
    海南大学张家超团队10月1日在线发表于Cell Reports：在受试益生菌株中，鼠李糖乳杆菌GG最能提升吉非替尼抗肿瘤疗效并减轻肠道与肝脏损伤，且不改变全身药物暴露量。代谢组学锁定其特征代谢物丙酰左卡尼汀，单独给予即可重现抑瘤效应，伴随线粒体代谢重塑、NF-κB/IL-6通路抑制与凋亡增加，并经肠-肝-肿瘤器官芯片验证，为益生菌辅助肿瘤靶向治疗提供菌株级证据。
    A team led by Zhang Jiachao at Hainan University, published online October 1 in Cell Reports, found that among tested probiotic strains Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG best enhanced gefitinib efficacy while easing gut and liver injury without changing systemic drug exposure. Metabolomics pinpointed propionyl-L-carnitine as the signature metabolite; giving it alone reproduced the tumor-suppressive effect via mitochondrial metabolic remodeling, NF-κB/IL-6 suppression and increased apoptosis, validated in gut-liver-tumor organ chips — strain-level evidence for probiotic support in oncology.
  • 热心肠日报：新模型揭示阿尔茨海默病肠道菌群代谢异常，APOE ε4携带者已现端倪
    New model reveals gut-microbiome metabolic abnormalities in Alzheimer's disease, already visible in APOE e4 carriers
    热心肠日报解读新研究：结合机器学习的代谢通量模型显示，阿尔茨海默病患者肠道中Bacteroides uniformis与B. thetaiotaomicron丰度升高，是驱动代谢通量改变的主要菌种，大肠杆菌则贡献甲酸盐通量；健康人群中APOE ε4高风险等位基因携带者已呈现与患者相似的菌群代谢特征，提示菌群代谢扰动或早于认知症状，为肠-脑干预锁定可验证靶点。
    Mr-Gut Daily explains a new study using machine-learning metabolic flux modeling: in Alzheimer's patients, elevated Bacteroides uniformis and B. thetaiotaomicron are the main species driving altered fluxes, with E. coli contributing formate flux. Notably, healthy carriers of the high-risk APOE e4 allele already show patient-like microbial metabolic signatures, especially in SAM and L-arginine fluxes, suggesting microbiome metabolic disturbance precedes cognitive symptoms and offering verifiable gut-brain targets.
  • Lancet Microbe：健康人上呼吸道真菌图谱绘制，鼻咽与口咽真菌结构大不同
    Lancet Microbe maps the healthy upper-airway mycobiota: nasopharynx and oropharynx differ markedly
    热心肠日报第3747期收录：威廉敏娜儿童医院Debby Bogaert团队10月1日发表于Lancet Microbe的横断面观察研究，绘制了健康个体上呼吸道真菌组图谱，显示鼻咽与口咽的真菌组成差异显著，宿主与环境因素分别塑造不同生态位。该工作填补呼吸道真菌组人群基线数据空白，为呼吸道疾病中的真菌-细菌-宿主互作研究与采样部位标准化提供参照框架。
    Mr-Gut Daily (issue 3747) covers a cross-sectional study by Debby Bogaert's team at Wilhelmina Children's Hospital, published October 1 in The Lancet Microbe: the first comprehensive map of the upper-airway mycobiota in healthy individuals shows markedly different fungal composition between nasopharynx and oropharynx, shaped by distinct host and environmental factors, filling a population baseline gap and informing site-standardized sampling in future respiratory research.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 诺和诺德与礼来公布GLP-1衰老时钟读数：蛋白质组时钟显示生物年龄最多减速4年
    Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly unveil GLP-1 aging-clock readings: proteomic clocks show biological age slowing by up to 4 years
    同花顺财经10月7日报道，在ARDD 2026披露的新分析中，诺和诺德基于10052名受试者的蛋白组学时钟显示司美格鲁肽随时间带来广泛衰老减速，基于心脏蛋白的时钟变化最高达4年，整体约2-3年；礼来用表观遗传时钟评估替尔泊肽得到方向一致的结果。Horvath等时钟领域专家认为这是GLP-1作为衰老保护剂十年来最有力的证据，但也强调结论目前仅适用于超重或代谢病人群，健康人群获益未知。
    10jqka reported on October 7 that new analyses unveiled at ARDD 2026 show Novo Nordisk's proteomic clocks across 10,052 participants indicating broad deceleration of biological aging on semaglutide, with a heart-protein clock showing changes of up to four years and overall effects of about two to three years; Eli Lilly saw concordant results for tirzepatide using epigenetic clocks. Clock pioneers such as Steve Horvath call it the strongest evidence in a decade that GLP-1s act as geroprotectors, while cautioning the data apply only to overweight or metabolic-disease populations.
  • Aging Cell：表型药物发现新型漆黄素衍生黄酮类senolytics，小鼠健康寿命标志物改善
    Aging Cell: novel fisetin-derived flavonoid senolytics discovered by phenotypic drug discovery improve healthspan markers in mice
    生物通10月7日编译Aging Cell研究：针对漆黄素疗效欠佳与生物利用度低的瓶颈，研究人员以整合表型药物发现策略开发两种新型漆黄素衍生黄酮类衰老细胞清除剂SR29384与SR31133，清除活性增强且覆盖多种衰老细胞类型；机制研究提示其经PARP1、CDK2及可能的BCL-xL通路选择性诱导衰老细胞凋亡，在小鼠衰老模型中减少组织衰老并改善多项健康寿命相关参数。
    Ebiotrade compiles an Aging Cell study reporting two novel fisetin-derived flavonoid senolytics, SR29384 and SR31133, developed through integrated phenotypic drug discovery to overcome fisetin's modest efficacy and poor bioavailability. The compounds show enhanced senolytic activity across senescent cell types; transcriptomics, machine learning and network pharmacology point to selective apoptosis via PARP1, CDK2 and possibly BCL-xL, reducing tissue senescence and improving multiple healthspan markers in aged mice.
  • 长寿需要误差棒：Deerfield掌门Jim Flynn筹办非营利长寿中心，直指行业信息噪声
    Show me the error bars: Deerfield's Jim Flynn is building a not-for-profit longevity center to cut through the hype
    Longevity.Technology 10月6日在ARDD 2026场边专访Deerfield管理合伙人Jim Flynn：他直言长寿是个误称、更看好健康寿命的投资逻辑，并指出许多长寿生物科技公司先拿其他适应症获批的表态本身就说明衰老终点难以测量。他正在纽约筹建非营利长寿中心，以数字平台提供无利益偏向的干预证据评估，自建调配实验室实测肽类等热门干预，核心主张是卖长寿之前先缩小误差棒。
    Longevity.Technology interviewed Deerfield managing partner Jim Flynn on the sidelines of ARDD 2026: he calls longevity a misnomer, prefers healthspan-based investment logic, and notes that many longevity biotechs admitting they will seek approval for other indications first reveals how hard aging endpoints are to measure. He is building a not-for-profit longevity center in New York with an unbiased digital evidence platform and an in-house compounding lab to actually test trendy interventions — his message: shrink the error bars before selling longevity.
  • ScienceDaily：斯坦福找到促老年关节软骨再生的小分子策略，或减少关节置换需求
    ScienceDaily: Stanford strategy regrows aged joint cartilage, potentially reducing the need for joint replacement
    ScienceDaily 10月6日报道，斯坦福团队发现阻断一种随年龄在关节内增多的蛋白后，老年小鼠自然丢失的膝关节软骨得以再生，并在前交叉韧带样损伤后预防骨关节炎发生；来自膝关节置换患者的软骨组织经同款抑制剂处理，也重新产出有功能的新软骨。研究将靶点锁定于软骨细胞随龄退变机制，为骨关节炎这一健康寿命的主要负担提供潜在疾病修饰路径，向人体的转化仍有待验证。
    ScienceDaily reported October 6 that Stanford researchers found blocking a protein that accumulates in joints with age regrew naturally lost knee cartilage in old mice and prevented osteoarthritis after ACL-like injuries; cartilage tissue from knee-replacement patients also produced new functional cartilage when exposed to the same inhibitor. By targeting age-related chondrocyte decline, the approach offers a potential disease-modifying route for osteoarthritis, though human translation remains to be proven.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • MIT团队Nature发文：生酮饮食经脂质而非酮体加剧小鼠小肠肿瘤、抑制结肠肿瘤
    MIT team in Nature: ketogenic diet drives small-intestinal tumors via lipids, not ketones, while suppressing colonic tumors
    ScienceDaily 10月5日报道，MIT团队发表于Nature的研究显示：生酮饮食使易患肠癌小鼠的小肠肿瘤增多，却令结肠肿瘤减少，同一饮食在相邻肠段作用截然相反。机制上风险并非来自酮体，而是肠道干细胞燃烧高脂脂肪酸氧化、激活PPAR家族加速增殖；家族性腺瘤性息肉病等遗传易感人群尤需警惕，商用酮酯补剂不会重现两类效应，生酮饮食的肠段特异性风险亟待人群研究厘清。
    ScienceDaily reported October 5 on an MIT study in Nature: a ketogenic diet increased small-intestinal tumors in cancer-prone mice while reducing colonic tumors, with opposite effects in adjacent gut segments. The risk traced not to ketones but to intestinal stem cells oxidizing the diet's high fat load, activating PPAR proteins and accelerating proliferation. People with inherited predispositions such as familial adenomatous polyposis should take note, while commercial ketone supplements would not reproduce either effect.
  • GUT综述：重启肠道生物钟，限时进食如何逆转代谢危机
    GUT review: resetting the intestinal clock — how time-restricted eating reverses metabolic crisis
    热心肠日报解读GUT综述：进食-禁食循环是肠道时钟最强的授时因子，菌群经短链脂肪酸与胆汁酸反哺肠壁细胞昼夜节律，节律失调可致餐后血糖飙升、肠易激综合征与结肠炎恶化。限时进食在动物中可逆转时差样代谢紊乱，克罗恩病患者小型RCT仅靠限制进食窗口即降低内脏脂肪与全身炎症；褪黑素等节律调节剂与时机疗法为个体化调控提供新选项，什么时候吃与吃什么同样重要。
    Mr-Gut Daily distills a GUT review: the feeding-fasting cycle is the strongest zeitgeber of the intestinal clock, with microbial SCFAs and bile acids feeding back on epithelial circadian programs, while circadian disruption drives postprandial hyperglycemia, IBS and colitis flares. Time-restricted eating reversed jet-lag-like metabolic derangement in animals, and in a small Crohn's RCT merely narrowing the eating window lowered visceral fat and systemic inflammation — when you eat matters as much as what you eat.
  • Nature Metabolism随机交叉试验：超加工食品的代谢与神经应答新证据
    Nature Metabolism randomized crossover trial: new evidence on metabolic and neural responses to ultra-processed foods
    热心肠日报第3747期收录：弗吉尼亚理工大学Zach Hutelin与Alexandra DiFeliceantonio团队10月5日发表于Nature Metabolism的随机对照交叉试验，系统刻画摄入不同加工度食品后的代谢与神经应答差异，为超加工食品的健康影响提供受控人体证据，并把关注点从热量与体重推进到大脑奖赏与代谢信号如何被加工工艺改写。
    Mr-Gut Daily (issue 3747) covers a randomized controlled crossover trial by Zach Hutelin and Alexandra DiFeliceantonio of Virginia Tech, published October 5 in Nature Metabolism, systematically characterizing metabolic and neural responses to foods of differing processing levels. The controlled human evidence pushes the ultra-processed food debate beyond calories and body weight toward how processing reshapes brain reward and metabolic signaling, informing future food policy and clinical guidance.
  • Lancet综述：女性GLP-1使用者瘦体重流失约三成，营养缺口与可及性障碍被低估
    Lancet review: women on GLP-1s lose roughly 30% lean mass, with nutrient gaps and access barriers underestimated
    Nutritional Outlook 10月5日报道，Meek团队9月29日发表于Lancet妇产科与女性健康的综述指出，GLP-1使用者以女性为主但指南滞后：减重中约30%为瘦体重，或加剧老年女性衰弱；早期热量锐减使维D、钾、胆碱、镁、铁摄入不足高发，约22.5%长期使用者出现确诊营养缺乏。抗阻训练加足量蛋白是保肌关键，药价、假药与运动壁垒亦待解。
    Nutritional Outlook reported October 5 on a narrative review by Claire Meek's team published September 29 in The Lancet Obstetrics, Gynaecology & Women's Health: women are the predominant GLP-1 users yet guidance lags behind. About 30% of weight lost is lean mass, raising frailty risk in older women; sharp early caloric restriction leaves many short on vitamin D, potassium, choline, magnesium and iron, with roughly 22.5% of long-term users developing diagnosed deficiencies. Resistance training plus adequate protein is key, alongside addressing cost, counterfeit supply and gendered exercise barriers.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 美国最高法院拒绝受理CRN诉纽约州补剂年龄限制法案，案件发回地区法院
    US Supreme Court declines CRN's challenge to New York supplement age-restriction law, case returns to district court
    Nutritional Outlook 10月6日报道，美国最高法院拒绝受理负责任营养委员会（CRN）对纽约州补剂年龄限制法的调卷申请，该法限制向未成年人销售以减重或增肌为卖点的膳食补充剂。CRN强调不受理并非实体裁决，案件回到地区法院；行业认为该法以营销话术而非成分为标准、覆盖过宽，加州已签署类似AB 2030，州级立法与商业言论的拉锯将持续。
    Nutritional Outlook reported October 6 that the US Supreme Court declined to hear the Council for Responsible Nutrition's challenge to New York's law restricting sales of weight-loss and muscle-building supplements to minors. CRN stresses the denial is not a ruling on the merits and the case returns to district court; the industry argues the statute regulates marketing claims rather than ingredients and is overbroad. With California's similar AB 2030 already signed, the tug-of-war between state legislation and commercial speech continues.
  • Lemme在沃尔玛独家上新GLP-1 Production Support胶囊，天然GLP-1支持赛道再升温
    Lemme launches Walmart-exclusive GLP-1 Production Support capsule as the natural GLP-1 support category heats up
    Nutritional Outlook 10月6日报道，Kourtney Kardashian旗下品牌Lemme在沃尔玛独家推出GLP-1 Production Support胶囊，以专利柠檬黄酮复合物Eriomin为核心，配伍铬、小檗碱、肌醇、苦瓜与维生素B12，宣称支持人体自然GLP-1分泌。Eriomin的12周交叉RCT显示空腹血糖降5%、GLP-1升17%，但完整配方缺乏临床数据。
    Nutritional Outlook reported October 6 that Lemme, co-founded by Kourtney Kardashian Barker, launched Walmart-exclusive GLP-1 Production Support capsules built on the patented lemon flavonoid complex Eriomin with chromium, berberine, myo-inositol, bitter melon and vitamin B12, marketed as supporting the body's natural GLP-1 production. Eriomin's 12-week crossover trial showed 5% lower fasting glucose and 17% higher GLP-1, but the full six-ingredient formula lacks clinical data; the category has faced lawsuits and the FDA has issued only one GLP-1 supplement warning letter.
  • Nutrition Insight：Greenvit野樱莓提取物体外模拟研究显示菌群密度与短链脂肪酸双升
    Nutrition Insight: Greenvit's aronia extract raises bacterial density and SCFA production in ex vivo gut model
    Nutrition Insight 10月6日报道，波兰Greenvit公布Aronvit野樱莓提取物的SIFR体外全消化道模拟研究：单次200毫克24小时后细菌密度提升15%、总短链脂肪酸增加10%，产丁酸相关菌Dysosmobacter welbionis增129%。三种花青素相近但多酚与纤维不同的提取物应答各异，提示原料标准化不能只看花青素，提取工艺与基质同样决定菌群结局。
    Nutrition Insight reported October 6 that Poland's Greenvit released SIFR ex vivo results for its Aronvit aronia extract: 24 hours after a single 200 mg dose, bacterial density rose 15% and total SCFAs 10%, with the butyrate-associated Dysosmobacter welbionis up 129% and cross-feeding network bacteria such as Faecalibacterium and Roseburia also increasing. Three extracts matched for anthocyanins but differing in polyphenols and fiber responded differently, suggesting standardization must account for processing and matrix, not anthocyanin content alone.
  • 台湾2026保健食品消费大调查：人均年补6.6项，台大教授潘敏雄破解五大迷思
    Taiwan 2026 supplement consumer survey: 6.6 products per user yearly, NTU professor debunks five myths
    TVBS健康2.0 10月6日报道，台湾保健食品学会发布2026国人保健食品消费大调查：有补充者年均食用6.6项，前五名为B族（55.4%）、叶黄素（50.6%）、益生菌（47.6%）、维C（42.3%）与鱼油藻油（40%）。理事长潘敏雄提出辨识、选择、执行、检视四步科学补充法，澄清脂溶性成分宜随餐吸收、抗氧化不等于逆转老化、亲友有感不等于循证，多品项叠加须警惕成分重复与药物相互作用。
    TVBS Health 2.0 reported October 6 that Taiwan's Society of Dietary Supplements released its 2026 national consumer survey: supplement users average 6.6 products yearly, led by B vitamins (55.4%), lutein (50.6%), probiotics (47.6%), vitamin C (42.3%) and fish/algae oil (40%). Society chair Pan Min-hsiung proposes a four-step approach — identify, choose, execute, review — clarifying that fat-soluble nutrients absorb better with meals, antioxidants cannot reverse aging, anecdotal efficacy is not evidence, and stacking products risks duplication and drug interactions.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 剑桥Heartwear获英国NHS 1.84亿英镑采购：全球首款医疗级无线充电多导联心电可穿戴
    Cambridge Heartwear wins £184M NHS tender for the world's first medical-grade wirelessly charged multichannel ECG wearable
    据PR Newswire 10月7日消息，剑桥大学孵化的Cambridge Heartwear获英国NHS供应链1.84亿英镑采购，其HeartSense可穿戴集诊断级多导联心电、自适应AI与无线充电于一身，患者居家即可持续监测心律，更早识别心衰与卒中风险；产品已获UKCA与ISO 13485认证、FDA 510(k)申请进行中，兼顾女性心血管人体工学，将向初级与二级医疗体系规模部署。
    PR Newswire reported October 7 that Cambridge Heartwear, spun out of the University of Cambridge, won a £184 million UK NHS Supply Chain tender for HeartSense, the first medical-grade wearable combining diagnostic multichannel ECG, adaptive AI and wireless charging, letting patients monitor heart rhythm at home to catch heart failure and stroke risk earlier. UKCA and ISO 13485 certified with FDA 510(k) pending, the device features ergonomic design for women's cardiovascular care and will scale across primary and secondary care.
  • Mito上线249美元冠脉钙化扫描：免转介快速出结果，长寿检测版图再扩张
    Mito adds a $249 coronary calcium scan: no referral needed, results in a day, as longevity testing expands
    Longevity.Technology 10月6日报道，健康检测公司Mito新增冠脉钙化积分CT扫描：会员价249美元、覆盖全美50州、无需转介，结果24小时内进入个人看板。依据2026版ACC/AHA血脂指南，40岁以上男性与45岁以上女性的中低危人群可借钙化积分决定是否启用他汀；文章同时提醒积分为零不等于零风险、扫描看不到软斑块，可购买人群与指南圈定范围存在错位，检测前宜与医生充分沟通。
    Longevity.Technology reported October 6 that health-testing company Mito added a coronary artery calcium CT scan: $249 for members, available in all 50 states without a referral, with results in the dashboard within 24 hours. Under the 2026 ACC/AHA dyslipidemia guideline, men over 40 and women over 45 at borderline-to-intermediate risk can use the calcium score to decide on statins; the piece cautions that a score of zero is not zero risk, soft plaque stays invisible, and who may buy the scan is broader than whom the guideline targets.
  • 同花顺产业透视：2026-2030中国健康科技全景，AI健康管理用户规模突破1.2亿
    China health-tech outlook 2026-2030: AI health-management users surpass 120 million
    同花顺财经10月7日刊发健康科技产业研究：2026年政府工作报告首次将生物医药列为新兴支柱产业，国民健康十五五规划提出2027年建成国家级AI应用中试基地、2030年智能辅助诊疗覆盖所有基层与二级以上医院；AI健康管理用户已突破1.2亿，基层医疗机构AI覆盖率达80%，依托可穿戴与远程诊疗的医院-社区-家庭三级管理网络使慢病管理指标改善率达60%，电子健康档案覆盖率达97%。
    10jqka published an industry review on October 7: China's 2026 government work report listed biomedicine as an emerging pillar industry for the first time, and the national health five-year plan targets a national AI pilot-testing base by 2027 and intelligent diagnostic support across all primary and secondary-plus hospitals by 2030. AI health-management users have surpassed 120 million, 80% of grassroots medical institutions use AI, and a hospital-community-home network built on wearables and telemedicine has lifted chronic-disease management improvement rates to 60%.
  • ScienceDaily：产后护理加配患者导航员，抑郁筛查与长期随访显著改善
    ScienceDaily: adding patient navigators to postpartum care markedly improves depression screening and follow-up
    ScienceDaily 10月6日报道，为新手妈妈配备患者导航员可显著提升产后照护完成率：受试母亲更可能获得产后访视、抑郁筛查、预防性检测与持续初级保健连接，导航员通过协助解决交通、托育、预约与复杂医疗信息等现实障碍发挥作用。研究者认为这一低成本增量服务有望成为改善女性长期健康的有力杠杆，为产后抑郁高发背景下的健康管理服务设计提供可复制样板。
    ScienceDaily reported October 6 that pairing new mothers with patient navigators markedly improved postpartum care completion: participants were far more likely to receive postpartum visits, depression screening, preventive testing and ongoing primary care, as navigators helped clear practical barriers such as transportation, childcare, scheduling and confusing medical information. Researchers see this low-cost add-on as a powerful lever for women's long-term health and a replicable template for postpartum health-management services.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-06
item.description: 2026-10-06 简报，共 19 条：Science综述：性激素、神经免疫到菌群——女性为何更易慢性疼痛；南方医科大学综述：口腔微生物组疗法四大平台，从下一代益生菌到口腔菌移植；新华社科普：七至九成血清素由肠道菌群参与合成，快乐体质源自肠道；丹麦1170例真实世界研究：重复粪菌移植联合延长抗生素预处理，艰难梭菌治愈率达81%；Nature Aging：分子伴侣介导自噬衰退让僵尸细胞随龄堆积，重启CMA可恢复免疫清除；Genflow SIRT6c基因疗法中期数据：老年比格犬表观遗传年龄最多回落超1岁；亚太长寿医学学会启动S.C.I.健康长寿模型：新加坡-中国-印度28亿人口真实世界试点；Atrogi首个人体数据：口服GRK2偏向性β2调节剂8周减脂1.1公斤、增肌0.8公斤；Digbi Health 1.6万人真实世界研究：菌群+基因+血糖精准生物学干预，过半IBS患者获临床级缓解；ScienceDaily：7天完全禁食重塑人体代谢，最大变化出现在第3天之后；2026营养品观察年度报告发布：精准营养成为行业增长主引擎；Frontiers荟萃：益生菌与合生元改善代谢综合征体成分与血脂，降HbA1c但不降空腹血糖；TriNutra将在SupplySide Global公布黑种草籽油新数据：肠道菌群与应激反应双向关联；RFI Ingredients将首秀Cranova全果蔓越莓平台与pH触发NSR肠道靶向递送技术；Nutritional Outlook评论：GLP-1药物与社交媒体重塑营养信息生态，临床营养继续教育亟需补位；青岛疾控：健康生活方式是最好的慢病疫苗，好习惯叠加具累加性保护效应；阿联酋把健康变得像点外卖一样方便：酒店餐厅全面推行Sehhi健康餐饮标准；国庆假期稳代谢指南：放下体重秤，用微习惯守住肌肉与激素平衡；英国率先确立AI医疗器械全生命周期监测规则，MHRA从一次性审批转向持续监管
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Science综述：性激素、神经免疫到菌群——女性为何更易慢性疼痛
    Why Women Hurt More: A Science Review Links Sex Hormones, Neuroimmunity and the Microbiome
    《Science》刊发综述系统梳理慢性疼痛的性别二态性：雌激素经肠内分泌细胞-PYY-5-羟色胺通路放大女性内脏痛，低发酵碳水化合物饮食缓解IBS或与此相关；女性慢性痛更依赖适应性免疫，脊髓Tregs在卵巢激素指挥下释放脑啡肽构成独有镇痛回路，雄性则以小胶质细胞通路为主，IL-23-TRPV1等机制获阐明，为女性特异性镇痛指明方向。
    A Science review maps the sex dimorphism of chronic pain: estrogen amplifies visceral pain in women via enteroendocrine cells, PYY and serotonin; female chronic pain relies more on adaptive immunity, with spinal Tregs releasing enkephalins under ovarian hormone control, while males depend on microglia. The work explains sex bias in IBS, interstitial cystitis, menstrual migraine and fibromyalgia and points to female-specific analgesic strategies.
  • 南方医科大学综述：口腔微生物组疗法四大平台，从下一代益生菌到口腔菌移植
    Oral Microbiome Therapies: Review Maps Four Platforms from Next-gen Probiotics to Oral Microbiota Transplant
    南方医科大学团队在《Journal of Translational Medicine》发表综述，评估口腔微生物组疗法四大平台：下一代益生菌、工程菌、无细胞微生物产物与口腔菌群移植。口腔菌群失调经LPS与TMAO通路关联心血管病、脂肪肝、慢性肾病、IBD与糖代谢紊乱；活菌制剂面临定植持久性难题，无细胞方案更安全可标准化但损失生态活性，临床转化仍需机制验证与标准化建设。
    A review from Southern Medical University in the Journal of Translational Medicine evaluates four oral microbiome therapy platforms: next-generation probiotics, engineered bacteria, cell-free microbial products and oral microbiota transplantation. Oral dysbiosis links to cardiovascular disease, NAFLD, CKD, IBD and glucose disorders via LPS and TMAO pathways; live biotherapeutics struggle with colonization durability while cell-free approaches trade ecological activity for safety and standardization.
  • 新华社科普：七至九成血清素由肠道菌群参与合成，快乐体质源自肠道
    Most of Your Serotonin Is Gut-Made: The Microbiome Behind a Sunny Temperament
    新华社科普指出，约70%—90%的5-羟色胺由肠道菌群参与合成，肠-脑轴经迷走神经、血液循环与HPA轴双向调控情绪、胃肠蠕动与认知。浙大一院团队20余年研究发现长寿老人肠道菌群多样性显著更高；上海精卫中心汇总21项研究、1503名参与者数据显示菌群干预改善焦虑的有效率达86%，且调整饮食结构比单纯补充益生菌更有效，好好吃饭或是更好的情绪处方。
    Xinhua explains that 70-90% of serotonin is synthesized with gut microbes, and the gut-brain axis bidirectionally regulates mood, motility and cognition via the vagus nerve, circulation and the HPA axis. A 20-year Zhejiang cohort found centenarians have higher microbial diversity, while a pooled analysis of 21 studies (1,503 participants) reported an 86% response rate for microbiome-targeted anxiety care — with dietary restructuring outperforming probiotic supplements alone.
  • 丹麦1170例真实世界研究：重复粪菌移植联合延长抗生素预处理，艰难梭菌治愈率达81%
    Danish Real-world Cohort of 1,170 FMT Patients: Repeated Transplants with Prolonged Antibiotic Pretreatment Reach 81% Cure
    奥胡斯大学医院CEFTA中心2016—2023年为1170例艰难梭菌感染患者实施1643次粪菌移植：首次移植8周治愈率60%，29%出现 confirmed 复发；经最多5次重复FMT后累计治愈率达81%。分析显示多剂量胶囊或结肠镜给药、并先行延长抗生素预处理者效果最佳，预防性万古霉素不影响结局，为FMT临床路径优化提供迄今最大规模真实世界证据。
    Aarhus University Hospital's CEFTA center performed 1,643 fecal microbiota transplantations in 1,170 C. difficile patients from 2016-2023: first-transplant cure at 8 weeks was 60%, rising to 81% with up to five repeat FMTs. Multi-dose capsules or colonoscopy delivery after extended antibiotic pretreatment worked best, while prophylactic vancomycin did not affect outcomes — the largest real-world evidence base for optimizing FMT pathways.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • Nature Aging：分子伴侣介导自噬衰退让僵尸细胞随龄堆积，重启CMA可恢复免疫清除
    Nature Aging: Declining Chaperone-mediated Autophagy Lets Zombie Cells Pile Up with Age
    Ana Maria Cuervo团队发表于《Nature Aging》的研究揭示衰老细胞随龄积累的新机制：分子伴侣介导的自噬（CMA）活性下降，既让衰老细胞滞留未降解毒性蛋白、分泌促衰老信号招募更多细胞变僵，又抑制巨噬细胞的识别与胞吞，形成免疫清除失效的恶性循环。老年小鼠药物激活CMA后多组织衰老细胞负荷下降、肺纤维化减轻，为senolytics之外提供全新治疗靶点。
    A Nature Aging study led by Ana Maria Cuervo reveals why senescent cells accumulate with age: declining chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) lets senescent cells secrete undegraded toxic proteins while simultaneously impairing macrophage recognition and engulfment, creating a vicious cycle. Pharmacological CMA activation in aged mice lowered senescent-cell burden across tissues and eased lung fibrosis, pointing to a therapeutic target beyond senolytics.
  • Genflow SIRT6c基因疗法中期数据：老年比格犬表观遗传年龄最多回落超1岁
    Genflow SIRT6c Gene Therapy Interim Data: Epigenetic Age Falls Over a Year in Aged Beagles
    Genflow在多伦多动物长寿峰会（ALOS 2026）公布SLAB研究中期结果：24只10岁以上比格犬随机接受百岁老人来源SIRT6变异的pDNA或AAV8疗法，第182天低剂量pDNA组Horvath犬甲基化时钟平均回落1.08岁、高剂量组0.48岁，对照组仅0.07岁，12只pDNA治疗犬中10只生物年龄下降且耐受良好；但衰弱评分未与对照组分离，肌少症终点有待第320天确证性读出。
    At the Animal Longevity Summit (ALOS) 2026 in Toronto, Genflow reported interim SLAB study results: 24 beagles over ten years old received plasmid or AAV8 gene therapy carrying a centenarian-derived SIRT6 variant. By Day 182 the Horvath dog methylation clock fell 1.08 years in the low-dose pDNA arm versus 0.07 in controls, with 10 of 12 pDNA-treated dogs younger; frailty endpoints await the confirmatory Day 320 readout.
  • 亚太长寿医学学会启动S.C.I.健康长寿模型：新加坡-中国-印度28亿人口真实世界试点
    APLMS Launches S.C.I. Healthy Longevity Model Spanning Singapore, China and India
    亚太健康长寿国际峰会期间，亚太长寿医学学会（APLMS）创建并启动S.C.I.健康长寿模型，在新加坡、中国、印度三国（合计约28亿人口）开展真实世界试点。与会专家强调衰老相关指标的改善并不等于真正更健康，模型聚焦老年人能否走得更好、保持认知、独立生活与延迟失能等实际功能目标，把生物标志物定位为辅助工具，探索跨文化可推广的长寿医学落地路径。
    During the Asia-Pacific Healthy Longevity Summit, the Asia-Pacific Longevity Medicine Society launched the S.C.I. Healthy Longevity Model, a real-world pilot across Singapore, China and India covering some 2.8 billion people. Experts stressed that improving aging biomarkers does not equal better health: the model prioritizes walking ability, cognition, independent living and delayed disability, treating biomarkers as auxiliary tools rather than endpoints.
  • Atrogi首个人体数据：口服GRK2偏向性β2调节剂8周减脂1.1公斤、增肌0.8公斤
    Atrogi First-in-human Data: Oral GRK2-biased Beta2 Modulator Cuts Fat 1.1 kg, Adds 0.8 kg Lean Mass
    斯德哥尔摩临床阶段公司Atrogi公布ATR-258的8周开放标签试验：13名超重或肥胖受试者下肢肌肉力量平均提升约13%、脂肪量减少1.1公斤、瘦体重增加0.8公斤，三个递增剂量均耐受良好。该首类口服GRK2偏向性β2肾上腺素调节剂直指肌少性肥胖与减重时代的肌肉流失问题，公司计划2027年启动二期临床，结果将于12月华盛顿恶病质与肌少症大会披露。
    Stockholm-based Atrogi reported positive 8-week open-label data for ATR-258 in 13 overweight or obese subjects: lower-extremity muscle power improved about 13%, fat mass fell 1.1 kg and lean mass rose 0.8 kg with no meaningful toxicity. The first-in-class oral GRK2-biased beta2 modulator targets sarcopenic obesity and muscle-sparing weight loss, with a Phase 2 planned for 2027.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Digbi Health 1.6万人真实世界研究：菌群+基因+血糖精准生物学干预，过半IBS患者获临床级缓解
    Digbi Health Real-world Study in 16,000 Members: Precision Biology Care Delivers IBS Relief at Scale
    Digbi Health发布15933名会员12周真实世界研究（medRxiv预印本）：基于肠道菌群、基因与血糖应答定制营养与生活方式干预，症状会员IBS-SSS评分平均降47.7分，53.8%改善≥50分达临床显著水平，重度患者改善率达71%，且各年龄、性别、收入与族群亚组一致获益，结果不受用药或GLP-1起始影响。记录内分析显示营养密度匹配个体生物学比减重更能改善肠道症状。
    Digbi Health released a 12-week real-world study of 15,933 members (medRxiv preprint): nutrition and lifestyle care personalized to gut microbiome, genetics and glucose response cut IBS-SSS scores by 47.7 points on average, with 53.8% of symptomatic members improving by at least 50 points (71% among severe cases), consistent across subgroups and independent of medications. Within-person data suggest nutrient density matched to biology matters more than weight loss.
  • ScienceDaily：7天完全禁食重塑人体代谢，最大变化出现在第3天之后
    What Seven Days of Fasting Does to the Human Body: Big Shifts Emerge After Day Three
    医学监督下的7天完全禁食研究显示：受试者平均减重约5.7公斤（瘦体重约4.6公斤、脂肪约1.4公斤），肌糖原一周内降至基线一半；许多关键变化在第3天前后才出现——血糖稳定于正常低值、酮体大幅升高，提示深度代谢开关需数日开启。肌力基本保留但最大摄氧量下降约13%，研究者认为这些保守应激通路或可催生无需真饿七天的禁食模拟疗法。
    In a medically supervised seven-day complete fast, participants lost about 5.7 kg (4.6 kg lean, 1.4 kg fat) while muscle glycogen halved; many hallmark changes emerged only after day three, when blood glucose settled low-normal and ketones surged — a deep metabolic switch requiring days. Strength was largely preserved but VO2max fell about 13%. Researchers suggest the conserved stress pathways could inspire fasting-mimetic therapies.
  • 2026营养品观察年度报告发布：精准营养成为行业增长主引擎
    2026 Nutrition Industry Annual Report: Precision Nutrition Emerges as the Growth Engine
    营养品观察发布2026年度报告：消费人群突破中老年局限，青少年长高与年轻群体占比快速上升；液态剂型占比增速超23%，钙铁锌直饮包、液体氨糖等骨骼健康新品井喷；肠道健康从单一肠胃调理延伸至代谢调节与女性健康，雌马酚、PQQ、麦角硫因等新兴成分崛起；心血管营养消费中超六成讨论来自21—35岁人群，鱼油向90%高纯度、辅酶Q10向还原型升级，行业围绕人群、功效与场景三大适配展开创新。
    The 2026 annual report from Nutrition Observer shows supplement consumers expanding beyond older adults, with teen growth and younger buyers surging; liquid formats grew over 23% with direct-drink mineral packs booming. Gut health now spans metabolism and women's health with equol, PQQ and ergothioneine rising; over 60% of cardiovascular-nutrition discussion comes from ages 21-35, while fish oil moves to 90% purity and CoQ10 to reduced form.
  • Frontiers荟萃：益生菌与合生元改善代谢综合征体成分与血脂，降HbA1c但不降空腹血糖
    Meta-analysis: Probiotics and Synbiotics Improve Body Composition and Lipids in Metabolic Syndrome
    发表于《Frontiers in Microbiology》的整合荟萃显示：益生菌/合生元补充在代谢综合征患者中显著降低体重（-1.06公斤）、腰围（-2.12厘米）、甘油三酯（-20.51 mg/dL）、总胆固醇与LDL-C并升高HDL-C，HbA1c下降而空腹血糖无显著变化；动物模型中瘦素等脂肪因子同步改善，敏感性分析确认结果稳健，支持菌群靶向干预作为代谢综合征的辅助营养策略。
    A Frontiers in Microbiology meta-analysis integrating preclinical and clinical evidence shows probiotic/synbiotic supplementation in metabolic syndrome significantly reduces body weight (-1.06 kg), waist circumference (-2.12 cm), triglycerides (-20.51 mg/dL), total cholesterol and LDL-C while raising HDL-C; HbA1c fell without significant fasting glucose change. Adipokines and liver markers improved in animal models, supporting microbiome-targeted care as an adjunct metabolic strategy.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • TriNutra将在SupplySide Global公布黑种草籽油新数据：肠道菌群与应激反应双向关联
    TriNutra to Present New Black Seed Oil Data Linking Gut Bacteria and the Stress Response
    Nutritional Outlook 10月5日报道，TriNutra将在拉斯维加斯SupplySide Global 2026展示其标准化黑种草籽油的新研究，聚焦肠道菌群与机体应激反应的双向影响，延续该成分在助眠（与褪黑素头对头试验）与头皮健康之后的又一功能方向。黑籽油正沿肠-脑-应激轴补齐证据链，成为植物标准化提取物以临床数据驱动品类升级的行业样本。
    Nutritional Outlook reports that TriNutra will present new data on its standardized black seed oil ingredient at SupplySide Global 2026 in Las Vegas, exploring the two-way relationship between gut bacteria and the stress response. It extends the ingredient's research arc from sleep (a head-to-head trial versus melatonin) and scalp health toward the gut-brain-stress axis, exemplifying botanicals upgraded through clinical data.
  • RFI Ingredients将首秀Cranova全果蔓越莓平台与pH触发NSR肠道靶向递送技术
    RFI Ingredients to Debut Cranova Whole-food Cranberry Platform and pH-triggered NSR Delivery Tech
    Nutrition Insight报道，RFI Ingredients将在SupplySide Global 2026首秀两项创新：pH触发的NSR天然缓释技术，以蛋白-多糖凝聚层保护活性成分穿越消化全程并向肠道下段靶向释放；以及Cranova全果蔓越莓平台（原花青素1.5%—7.2%标准化），把蔓越莓从泌尿健康拓展至肠道健康、健康老龄化与功能饮料，并加速欧洲与亚太扩张。
    Nutrition Insight reports RFI Ingredients will debut two innovations at SupplySide Global 2026 (Oct 28-30, Las Vegas): the pH-triggered protein-polysaccharide NSR sustained-release technology that protects actives through digestion and releases them further down the GI tract, and Cranova, a whole-food cranberry platform standardized to 1.5-7.2% proanthocyanidins expanding beyond urinary health into gut health, healthy aging and functional beverages.
  • Nutritional Outlook评论：GLP-1药物与社交媒体重塑营养信息生态，临床营养继续教育亟需补位
    Providing Clarity in a Noisy Nutrition Landscape: GLP-1 Drugs and Social Media Demand Better Clinician Education
    IAFNS营养政策主任Bonnie Johnson在Nutritional Outlook撰文指出：GLP-1受体激动剂快速普及叠加社交媒体传播，使患者听到的营养建议空前混乱——临床分歧直接影响结局，如对用药者仅说少吃而非关注瘦体重保留与蛋白充足。瓶颈不在证据稀缺而在证据转化，高质量继续教育应区分共识与假说、披露评价方法，并通过学界-学会-产业的预竞争协作产出可直接落地的实践资源。
    Writing in Nutritional Outlook, IAFNS's Bonnie Johnson argues that rapid GLP-1 adoption plus social media have made nutrition advice more confusing than ever, with diverging clinician guidance materially affecting outcomes — such as telling GLP-1 users to simply eat less instead of preserving lean mass and protein adequacy. The bottleneck is evidence translation, not scarcity; high-quality continuing education and pre-competitive collaboration are the fix.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 青岛疾控：健康生活方式是最好的慢病疫苗，好习惯叠加具累加性保护效应
    Qingdao CDC: Healthy Habits Are a Chronic-disease Vaccine with Cumulative Protection
    青岛市疾控中心发布提醒：慢性病日积月累潜伏于熬夜、油腻外卖与久坐之中，健康生活方式即提前接种的疫苗，且好习惯守住越多、综合管理具有累加性保护效应。专家给出三件易落地的事——每日蔬菜300-500克且深色占半、全谷物杂豆50-150克掺入主食、盐控制在5克以内；每周150-300分钟中等强度有氧加2-3次抗阻训练，慢病人群运动前应先行医学评估。
    Qingdao CDC frames healthy living as a vaccine against chronic disease: risks accumulate through late nights, greasy takeout and sitting, while each sustained habit adds cumulative protection. Three easy wins — 300-500 g of vegetables daily (half dark-colored), 50-150 g whole grains mixed into staples, salt under 5 g — plus 150-300 minutes of weekly aerobic activity and 2-3 resistance sessions; those with chronic conditions should seek medical assessment first.
  • 阿联酋把健康变得像点外卖一样方便：酒店餐厅全面推行Sehhi健康餐饮标准
    Making Healthy Living Convenient: Abu Dhabi Rolls Out Sehhi Nutrition Standards for Hotels
    The National社论梳理阿联酋公共政策转向：阿布扎比要求酒店与持牌餐厅每类菜单至少提供一款符合Sehhi标准的低脂低糖低盐菜品，儿童菜单达标比例过半；学校禁高糖高脂食品、明年起超市高可见度位置禁摆不健康食品、含糖饮料分级消费税并举，辅以迪拜商场马拉松等16万人参与的运动项目。世胖联估计肥胖到2035年或吞噬阿联酋近5%GDP，减少健康选择的行动阻力成为政策核心。
    A UAE editorial details a public-health pivot toward convenience for healthy choices: Abu Dhabi now requires hotels and licensed restaurants to offer at least one Sehhi-standard low-fat, low-sugar, low-salt item per menu category, with half of children's menus compliant. School food bans, supermarket placement rules and tiered sugary-drink excise taxes complement mass-events like the Dubai Mallathon, as obesity could cost nearly 5% of GDP by 2035.
  • 国庆假期稳代谢指南：放下体重秤，用微习惯守住肌肉与激素平衡
    Holiday Metabolism Guide: Skip the Scale Obsession, Build Micro-habits to Protect Muscle and Hormones
    上海健康播报发布假期体重管理提示：肌脂均衡与激素稳定才是核心，不必紧盯体重秤。饮食上固定进餐顺序——先蔬菜、再优质蛋白、后主食，聚餐七分饱、饮料换茶水；运动上每天10-15分钟徒手深蹲、臀桥等居家力量即可保肌，旅行每天累计6000-8000步；不建议节后立刻长时间高强度有氧，易致肌肉流失；体重涨1-2公斤多为水分滞留，维持习惯即可回落。
