    Shanghai health authorities advise focusing on muscle-fat balance and hormonal stability rather than scale weight over the holiday: fix meal order (vegetables first, then protein, staples last), stop at 70% fullness, and swap sugary drinks for tea. Ten to fifteen minutes of daily bodyweight strength protects muscle; 6,000-8,000 steps while traveling suffices. A 1-2 kg post-holiday rise is mostly water, so avoid punishing post-holiday endurance sessions that cost muscle.
  • 英国率先确立AI医疗器械全生命周期监测规则，MHRA从一次性审批转向持续监管
    UK Pioneers Lifecycle Monitoring Rules for AI Medical Devices as MHRA Moves Beyond One-off Approval
    英国药品与健康产品管理局（MHRA）负责人10月6日表示：基于AI的医疗器械获批后仍需持续监测，而非一次性上市前安全审查；政府将接受国家AI医疗委员会全部44项建议，2026年底前出草案、2027年春发布完整实施计划，覆盖NHS落地目标。MHRA同期启动AI Airlock第三期，聚焦上市后监测与生命周期管理，多国正就这套全球最全面规则赴英取经。
    The UK's MHRA said on Oct 6 that AI-based medical devices will need constant post-market monitoring rather than a single pre-approval check. The government accepted all 44 recommendations of its AI-in-healthcare commission, with a draft plan by end-2026 and full implementation by spring 2027 across the NHS; the AI Airlock sandbox enters phase three focused on surveillance and lifecycle oversight, drawing interest from regulators worldwide.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-05
item.description: 2026-10-05 简报，共 20 条：UCLA研究：肠道菌群组成与代谢物可揭示大脑衰老速度，或成痴呆早期预警；ScienceDaily：UBE2N酶帮助肝细胞清除受损线粒体，或成脂肪肝恶化的天然防线；浙江三甲医院公布国产AKK菌AKK001人体临床：12周平均减重7.2公斤、甘油三酯降21%；东英吉利大学提出慢性疲劳“统一理论”：长新冠、ME/CFS、PTSD等五病共享免疫代谢网络；ARDD 2026哈佛开幕：FDA首次把衰老与长寿纳入监管科学重点，长寿医学走向主流；礼来与诺和诺德ARDD首晒GLP-1长寿数据：司美格鲁肽模型预期延寿1.9年，替尔泊肽延缓表观衰老；DoNotAge 2026大会速览：SIRT6与百岁老人、亚精胺促肌肉干细胞增殖、槲皮素降压再添证据；Healthspan Summit 2026洛杉矶闭幕：先测量后干预成为长寿临床共识范式；Nature子刊：肠杆菌与膳食纤维协同决定肠道优势菌群，游离单糖或为信号分子；温医大郑宏团队Gut Microbes：Akk菌降解亮氨酸，菌群-亮氨酸-TBK1轴或可改善糖尿病认知衰退；EASD 2026：从餐盒配送到肠道菌群，饮食干预糖尿病的多维新证据；The Journal of Nutrition综述：乳液、微胶囊与脂质体等递送系统助力功能食品健康衰老应用；Applied and Environmental Microbiology：含co-biotic配方离体调节菌群功能与组成，不增加产气；NutraIngredients科研速览：生姜短期补充改善胆固醇外流，后生元CP2305或助减压；ScienceDaily：高剂量维生素B3加入胶质母细胞瘤标准治疗，小试验六个月无进展生存率82%；ScienceDaily：维生素D类似物或可瓦解胰腺癌保护屏障，小试验见鼓舞信号；ADA/EASD 2026共识报告发布：糖尿病管理超越降糖，心肾体重与生活品质并重；EASD 2026：RESET试验显示低能量饮食加结构化运动，过半早发2型糖尿病24周缓解；ScienceDaily：两年期大型RCT显示无糖饮料减重效果与水相当，打破代糖疑虑还是另有隐情；四川疾控发布10
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • UCLA研究：肠道菌群组成与代谢物可揭示大脑衰老速度，或成痴呆早期预警
    UCLA study: gut microbes and their metabolites reveal how fast the brain ages, hinting at early dementia warning
    UCLA团队10月4日发表研究，将特定肠道细菌及其代谢副产物与大脑生物性衰老速度挂钩：肠道显得更老者伴随更差记忆、专注力与情绪。代谢物可经血脑屏障影响脑内炎症与神经递质环境，提示脑衰老迹象或可比临床症状早数十年出现，菌群构成可通过膳食纤维与发酵食品干预，为痴呆预防提供可调节靶点。
    A UCLA team reported on October 4 that specific gut bacteria and their metabolic byproducts track the biological aging speed of the brain: people with older-looking brains also reported poorer memory, focus and mood. Microbial metabolites crossing the blood-brain barrier shape inflammation and neurotransmitter signaling, suggesting brain-aging signs may appear decades before symptoms - and because the microbiome is diet-responsive, it offers modifiable prevention targets.
  • ScienceDaily：UBE2N酶帮助肝细胞清除受损线粒体，或成脂肪肝恶化的天然防线
    ScienceDaily: enzyme UBE2N helps liver cells clear damaged mitochondria, a natural brake on fatty liver disease
    科学家鉴定出UBE2N酶可能是对抗脂肪肝恶化的天然防线：该酶帮助肝细胞清除受损线粒体并分解脂肪，从而减轻炎症、纤维化与细胞损伤，延缓其向更危险的MASH（代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎）进展。该研究影响约1亿美国人的疾病领域，为线粒体质量控制在代谢性肝病中的作用再添证据。
    Scientists identified the enzyme UBE2N as a potential natural defense against worsening fatty liver disease, which affects an estimated 100 million Americans: UBE2N helps liver cells clear damaged mitochondria and break down fat, limiting the inflammation, scarring and cell injury that drive progression to the more dangerous condition MASH, adding fresh evidence for mitochondrial quality control in metabolic liver disease.
  • 浙江三甲医院公布国产AKK菌AKK001人体临床：12周平均减重7.2公斤、甘油三酯降21%
    Chinese hospital reports human trial of domestic Akkermansia strain AKK001: 7.2 kg weight loss and 21% lower triglycerides in 12 weeks
    浙江某三甲医院公布国产Akkermansia菌株AKK001落地产品的随机双盲对照人体临床：60名BMI≥28受试者每日补充1.5×10¹⁰ TFU连续12周，平均体重下降7.2公斤、甘油三酯下降21%，第4周即见基础代谢率升5.17%、皮下脂肪面积减7.8%。业内认为这标志益生菌产业从菌株科研叙事走向人体证据，呼应新国标征求意见稿对菌株鉴定与人体试食试验的要求。
    A tertiary hospital in Zhejiang released randomized double-blind human trial data for the domestic Akkermansia muciniphila product AKK001: 60 adults with BMI≥28 took 1.5×10¹⁰ TFU daily for 12 weeks, losing an average 7.2 kg with triglycerides down 21%; by week 4 resting metabolic rate rose 5.17% and subcutaneous fat area fell 7.8%. Observers call it a shift from strain-level science toward human evidence, aligned with draft Chinese probiotic standards requiring strain ID and human feeding trials.
  • 东英吉利大学提出慢性疲劳“统一理论”：长新冠、ME/CFS、PTSD等五病共享免疫代谢网络
    A unifying theory of chronic fatigue: long Covid, ME/CFS, PTSD, RA and MS converge on shared immune-metabolic networks
    东英吉利大学与Oxford BioDynamics发表于Journal of Translational Medicine的研究，用3D基因组平台分析长新冠、ME/CFS、PTSD、类风湿关节炎与多发性硬化五种疾病：单基因层面几乎不重叠，但基因网络共同指向免疫炎症信号、线粒体能量生产、代谢调控与神经内分泌应激通路，或解释截然不同的病因为何导致相似的致衰性疲劳，并为血液生物标志物与新疗法铺路。
    A University of East Anglia and Oxford BioDynamics study in the Journal of Translational Medicine analyzed long Covid, ME/CFS, PTSD, rheumatoid arthritis and multiple sclerosis with 3D-genomic profiling: individual genes barely overlap, yet their networks converge on immune-inflammatory signaling, mitochondrial energy production, metabolic regulation and neuroendocrine stress pathways - explaining why different triggers yield similarly devastating fatigue and opening routes to blood biomarkers and therapies.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • ARDD 2026哈佛开幕：FDA首次把衰老与长寿纳入监管科学重点，长寿医学走向主流
    ARDD 2026 opens at Harvard: FDA puts aging and longevity on its regulatory-science agenda as longevity goes mainstream
    第13届衰老研究与药物发现会议（ARDD）10月1日在哈佛开幕，规模创历届之最。哈佛医学院院长Daley以医疗事故警示长寿干预必须建立在科学与监管严谨之上；FDA高层首次明确将在监管科学重点文件中纳入衰老与长寿，并提出两类审批路径——逐病累积证据或直接以死亡/衰弱等硬终点开展老年人群试验，标志该领域获监管层制度性认可。
    The 13th Aging Research and Drug Discovery meeting opened at Harvard on October 1 as its largest ever. Dean George Daley warned that longevity interventions must earn trust through evidence after a wellness-center death, and senior FDA officials said for the first time that aging and longevity will be explicitly included in the agency's regulatory-science focus document, outlining two approval routes - disease-by-disease evidence or hard endpoints such as mortality and frailty in aging populations.
  • 礼来与诺和诺德ARDD首晒GLP-1长寿数据：司美格鲁肽模型预期延寿1.9年，替尔泊肽延缓表观衰老
    Lilly and Novo debut GLP-1 longevity data at ARDD: semaglutide modeled to add 1.9 life-years, tirzepatide slows epigenetic aging
    诺和诺德与礼来首次在ARDD 2026主舞台展示GLP-1药物衰老终点数据：诺和诺德基于SELECT试验效应的英国真实世界队列（1.9万人）模型预测司美格鲁肽带来平均1.9个生命年增益，蛋白组学生物年龄在13-20周内下降；礼来SURMOUNT-5表观遗传子研究显示替尔泊肽72周后15个时钟全部显示衰老慢于时间流逝，DunedinPACE中位数由1.13降至1.08。两家均强调数据仍属早期探索。
    Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly presented aging-endpoint data for GLP-1 drugs on the ARDD 2026 main stage for the first time: Novo modeled a mean 1.9 life-year gain for semaglutide from SELECT effect estimates in a 19,117-person UK cohort, with proteomic biological age falling within 13-20 weeks; Lilly's SURMOUNT-5 epigenetic sub-study found all 15 clocks showed less aging than elapsed time on tirzepatide, with median DunedinPACE dropping from 1.13 to 1.08. Both stressed the signals remain early.
  • DoNotAge 2026大会速览：SIRT6与百岁老人、亚精胺促肌肉干细胞增殖、槲皮素降压再添证据
    DoNotAge 2026 conference brief: SIRT6 in centenarians, spermidine boosts muscle stem cells, quercetin lowers blood pressure
    Live Forever Club报道10月2日DoNotAge科学大会要点：罗切斯特大学Gorbunova指出长寿动物SIRT6活性更高、百岁老人携带更高频SIRT6等位基因、褐藻来源岩藻多糖为其激活剂；奥胡斯团队发现亚精胺水平随龄下降且可促肌肉干细胞增殖；兰卡斯特20天槲皮素试验使健康人收缩压降约7 mmHg并将扩展至高血压前期人群，为长寿补剂管线提供临床线索。
    Covering DoNotAge's October 2 science conference, Live Forever Club highlights: Rochester's Vera Gorbunova on SIRT6 being more active in long-lived animals and more common SIRT6 alleles in centenarians, with fucoidan from brown seaweed as an activator; Aarhus data that spermidine declines with age and boosts muscle stem cell proliferation; and a 20-day quercetin trial cutting systolic blood pressure about 7 mmHg in healthy adults, now extending to prehypertension.
  • Healthspan Summit 2026洛杉矶闭幕：先测量后干预成为长寿临床共识范式
    Healthspan Summit 2026 in Los Angeles closes: measure first, intervene later becomes the clinical longevity playbook
    10月2-3日第四届Healthspan Summit在洛杉矶举行，逾千名临床医生与创业者参会。长寿医学临床轨道的主线是客观测量优先：Vexon Med等以综合生理测试提炼单一基线评分，再叠加运动处方、营养咨询、循证补剂与激素优化进行纵向管理；医用级光生物调节、声振疗法等康复手段加速进入临床场景，SNiP营养基因组学则推动DNA导向个性化营养，勾勒长寿医学的标准化诊疗雏形。
    The 4th Healthspan Summit drew 1,000-plus clinicians and founders to Los Angeles on October 2-3. The clinical track's throughline was objective measurement first: practices like Vexon Med distill comprehensive physiologic testing into a single baseline score before layering exercise prescription, nutrition counseling, evidence-based supplementation and hormone optimization for longitudinal care, while medical-grade photobiomodulation, vibroacoustic therapy and DNA-guided nutrigenomics push longevity medicine toward a structured standard of care.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nature子刊：肠杆菌与膳食纤维协同决定肠道优势菌群，游离单糖或为信号分子
    Nature-family journal: Enterobacteriaceae cooperate with dietary fiber to decide gut keystone species, free sugars acting as signals
    热心肠日报10月5日导读Nature子刊研究：在21种人肠菌合成群落中投放94种膳食成分，过半多糖显著推高普雷沃氏菌Segatella copri丰度并压缩拟杆菌；关键在于大肠杆菌这一“外援”——即便敲除其利用阿拉伯聚糖单糖的基因仍能恢复S. copri竞争优势，提示游离单糖充当信号分子触发与营养无关的级联反应，为膳食纤维精准搭配重塑菌群提供机制依据。
    A Nature-family journal study featured by ChinaGut Daily on October 5 screened 94 dietary components in a 21-species synthetic human gut community: over half the polysaccharides boosted Segatella copri at the expense of Bacteroidaceae. Crucially, commensal E. coli restored S. copri's competitive edge even when its arabinan-sugar utilization genes were knocked out, implying free sugars act as signal molecules triggering nutrition-independent cascades - mechanistic grounding for precision fiber pairing to reshape the microbiome.
  • 温医大郑宏团队Gut Microbes：Akk菌降解亮氨酸，菌群-亮氨酸-TBK1轴或可改善糖尿病认知衰退
    Wenzhou Medical University in Gut Microbes: Akkermansia catabolizes leucine, a microbiota-leucine-TBK1 axis against diabetic cognitive decline
    热心肠日报10月5日第3745期头条：温州医科大学郑宏团队发现糖尿病认知衰退患者与小鼠模型中Akkermansia（阿克曼氏菌）持续偏低而血亮氨酸升高——Akk菌具备降解亮氨酸的酶系，其耗竭致亮氨酸蓄积，过量亮氨酸经TBK1-OPTN磷酸化级联引发神经元过度线粒体自噬；补亮氨酸加重而限亮氨酸改善小鼠认知，为肠-脑代谢轴干预糖尿病脑病提供新靶点。
    Leading ChinaGut Daily's October 5 issue: Zheng Hong's team at Wenzhou Medical University found low Akkermansia and high circulating leucine in diabetic patients and mice with cognitive decline. Akkermansia carries the enzymatic machinery to catabolize leucine, so its depletion lets leucine accumulate and, via TBK1-OPTN phosphorylation, drives excessive neuronal mitophagy; leucine supplementation worsened while deprivation protected cognition in mice, framing a gut-brain metabolic axis against diabetic encephalopathy.
  • EASD 2026：从餐盒配送到肠道菌群，饮食干预糖尿病的多维新证据
    EASD 2026: from meal-kit delivery to gut metabolites, fresh evidence on dietary intervention in diabetes
    EASD 2026年会多项研究描绘饮食干预糖尿病新图景：餐盒配送的低碳水高蛋白饮食12个月改善2型糖尿病异位脂肪；DANCE试验显示低碳水饮食对1型糖尿病同样有益；荷兰抗生素干预试验证实肠菌色氨酸代谢物IPA为菌源、与血糖变异性负相关；蔗糖酶-异麦芽糖酶缺乏的格陵兰人群食物偏好不同、中链脂肪酸可诱导促红细胞生成，凸显个体化营养的生物学基础。
    EASD 2026 studies sketch a multidimensional picture of dietary intervention in diabetes: meal-kit-delivered carbohydrate-reduced high-protein diets improved ectopic fat over 12 months; the DANCE trial showed low-carb diets benefit type 1 diabetes; a Dutch antibiotic intervention confirmed the tryptophan metabolite IPA is gut-derived and inversely tied to glycemic variability; and sucrase-isomaltase deficiency plus MCT-induced erythropoietin responses underscore the biology behind personalized nutrition.
  • The Journal of Nutrition综述：乳液、微胶囊与脂质体等递送系统助力功能食品健康衰老应用
    Journal of Nutrition review: emulsions, microcapsules and liposomes advance functional-food delivery for healthy aging
    生物通10月4日推介The Journal of Nutrition综述：系统梳理面向老年人的功能性食品四大活性成分——多酚、生物活性肽、益生菌与维生素，及乳液、微胶囊、水凝胶、脂质体等递送系统在稳定性、生物利用度与靶向释放上的进展；同时指出载体长期安全性、感官接受性、工业化与法规标准仍是瓶颈，呼吁以多组学驱动个性化配方并加强多病共存老年人群临床验证。
    A Journal of Nutrition review highlighted by BioTrade on October 4 maps the four key bioactives in functional foods for older adults - polyphenols, bioactive peptides, probiotics and vitamins - and how emulsion, microcapsule, hydrogel and liposome delivery systems improve stability, bioavailability and targeted release. Long-term carrier safety, sensory acceptance, industrial scale-up and regulatory standards remain bottlenecks; the authors call for multi-omics-driven personalized formulations and trials in older adults with multimorbidity.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • Applied and Environmental Microbiology：含co-biotic配方离体调节菌群功能与组成，不增加产气
    Applied and Environmental Microbiology: co-biotic formulas tune microbiome function and composition ex vivo without extra gas
    生物通10月2日报道：三种含co-biotic（共益体）化合物的新配方——复合维生素DM-02、能量专注型AM-02与助眠型PM-02，在6名健康成人粪便接种的离体SIFR结肠发酵模型中，均显著降低pH并提升总短链脂肪酸9-11%，AM-02与PM-02还使丁酸增20%、丙酸增7-8%，且富集产SCFA与B族维生素菌群、不增加产气，为共益体配方的临床评价奠定机制基础。
    Covered by BioTrade on October 2: three novel co-biotic supplement formulas - multivitamin DM-02, energy/focus AM-02 and sleep PM-02 - tested in a validated ex vivo SIFR colonic fermentation model (n=6 healthy adults) all lowered pH and raised total short-chain fatty acids 9-11%; AM-02 and PM-02 lifted butyrate 20% and propionate 7-8%, enriched SCFA- and B-vitamin-producing taxa, and produced no extra gas, laying mechanistic ground for clinical evaluation of co-biotics.
  • NutraIngredients科研速览：生姜短期补充改善胆固醇外流，后生元CP2305或助减压
    NutraIngredients science shorts: short-term ginger improves cholesterol efflux, postbiotic CP2305 may ease stress
    NutraIngredients 10月2日科研合辑：发表于Complementary Therapies in Clinical Practice的研究显示，健康人短期补充生姜可提升胆固醇外流能力（CEC）并改善抗氧化应答——CEC是冠脉事件的反向预测指标；另有Asahi研究称单剂热灭活加氏乳杆菌CP2305后生元可提升放松相关脑α波与副交感活性，为心血管与情绪类补剂提供新证据。
    NutraIngredients' October 2 round-up: research in Complementary Therapies in Clinical Practice shows short-term ginger supplementation enhances cholesterol efflux capacity (CEC) - an inverse predictor of coronary events - and improves antioxidant response in healthy adults; separately, Asahi reports that a single dose of heat-treated Lactobacillus gasseri CP2305 postbiotic raised relaxation-linked alpha brain activity and parasympathetic tone and boosted serotonin secretion in intestinal cell models.
  • ScienceDaily：高剂量维生素B3加入胶质母细胞瘤标准治疗，小试验六个月无进展生存率82%
    ScienceDaily: high-dose vitamin B3 added to glioblastoma treatment keeps 82% progression-free at six months in small trial
    ScienceDaily 10月4日报道：高剂量维生素B3（烟酸）作为标准治疗补充展现早期潜力——小型试验中82%的胶质母细胞瘤患者六个月保持无进展生存。研究者认为烟酸或可唤醒被肿瘤压制的免疫细胞，但样本量小，获益与安全性仍需更大规模研究确认，此为常见维生素转攻最凶险脑癌的探索性一步。
    ScienceDaily reported on October 4 that high-dose vitamin B3 (niacin) is showing intriguing early promise as an addition to standard glioblastoma treatment: 82% of patients in a small trial remained progression-free after six months. Researchers believe niacin may help revive immune cells suppressed by the cancer, but the sample is small and larger studies are still needed to confirm benefit and safety for one of the deadliest brain cancers.
  • ScienceDaily：维生素D类似物或可瓦解胰腺癌保护屏障，小试验见鼓舞信号
    ScienceDaily: a vitamin D analog may crack pancreatic cancer's protective shield, with encouraging early trial signals
    ScienceDaily报道：维生素D类似物或有助于瓦解胰腺癌的致密保护性防御，使肿瘤更易受化疗与免疫攻击；小型临床试验显示鼓舞人心的应答，尤其是维生素D受体水平较高的肿瘤患者。胰腺癌被称为“癌王”，基质屏障是其治疗 resistance 的关键，该策略若经更大规模验证，或为改善预后提供新路径。
    ScienceDaily reports that a vitamin D analog may help break down pancreatic cancer's dense protective defenses, making tumors more vulnerable to chemotherapy and immune attack; a small clinical trial found encouraging responses, especially in patients whose tumors had high levels of the vitamin D receptor. With the stromal barrier central to pancreatic cancer's notorious drug resistance, the strategy could open a new route to better outcomes if validated at scale.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • ADA/EASD 2026共识报告发布：糖尿病管理超越降糖，心肾体重与生活品质并重
    ADA/EASD 2026 consensus report: diabetes care beyond blood sugar, putting heart, kidney, weight and wellbeing first
    美国糖尿病学会与欧洲糖尿病研究协会10月2日发布2026版共识报告，接替2022版：倡导确诊早期即考虑具心肾获益的SGLT2抑制剂与GLP-1类药物，以“站立、步走、出汗、力量与睡眠”五主题整合全天健康行为，强调治疗方案须与个体病情、偏好与可负担性匹配；HbA1c仍是基石，但心、肾、体重与情绪健康共同构成管理目标。
    The ADA and EASD published their 2026 consensus report on October 2, updating 2022: earlier consideration of SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 therapies with proven heart and kidney benefits, a whole-day behavior framework of standing, stepping, sweating, strengthening and sleep, and explicit matching to individual conditions, preferences and affordability. HbA1c remains foundational, but heart, kidney, weight and emotional wellbeing now share the management stage.
  • EASD 2026：RESET试验显示低能量饮食加结构化运动，过半早发2型糖尿病24周缓解
    EASD 2026: RESET for Remission trial - low-energy diet plus structured exercise put over half of early-onset T2D into remission
    发表于Lancet Regional Health Americas并在EASD 2026报告的RESET for Remission试验：96名45岁前确诊的早发2型糖尿病肥胖成人随机接受24周800-900千卡/日低能量饮食加监督下有氧与抗阻运动，54%达到缓解（HbA1c<6.5%且停药12周以上），对照组仅4%；干预组平均减重8.4公斤且保留肌肉量、改善体能与心血管指标，无严重不良事件。
    The RESET for Remission trial, published in the Lancet Regional Health Americas and presented at EASD 2026: 96 adults with early-onset type 2 diabetes and obesity were randomized to 24 weeks of an 800-900 kcal/day low-energy diet plus supervised aerobic and resistance exercise. Remission (HbA1c below 6.5% off glucose-lowering drugs for 12 weeks) was achieved by 54% versus 4% on usual care, with 8.4 kg mean weight loss, preserved muscle mass, better fitness and cardiovascular measures, and no serious adverse events.
  • ScienceDaily：两年期大型RCT显示无糖饮料减重效果与水相当，打破代糖疑虑还是另有隐情
    ScienceDaily: two-year RCT finds diet drinks match water for weight loss, probing sweetener doubts
    一项纳入493名超重或肥胖成人的两年随机对照试验显示：以阿斯巴甜、安赛蜜或三氯蔗糖甜化的无糖软饮料在长期减重与维持上与水效果基本相当，两组体重、腰围、体成分及多项代谢指标改善幅度接近。结果挑战“代糖干扰代谢”的部分担忧，但研究者提示仍需结合个体反应与整体膳食质量解读，不宜简单化推广。
    A two-year randomized trial in 493 adults with overweight or obesity found that diet soft drinks sweetened with aspartame, acesulfame-K or sucralose were essentially as effective as water for long-term weight loss and maintenance, with similar improvements in weight, waist size, body composition and several metabolic measures in both groups. The results temper some concerns that non-nutritive sweeteners derail metabolism, though researchers caution that individual responses and overall diet quality still matter.
  • 四川疾控发布10月健康提示：国庆假期重点防范流感、新冠、诺如与蚊媒传染病
    Sichuan CDC's October health advisory: guard against flu, Covid, norovirus and mosquito-borne disease over the holiday
    人民网四川频道10月4日报道，四川省疾控中心发布10月健康提示：秋冬交替叠加国庆假期人员流动，重点防范蚊媒传染病、流感、新冠、感染性腹泻与手足口病五类风险；儿童、老年人、学生与慢性病患者等重点人群及时接种流感疫苗，出现高热肌肉酸痛不带病上班上学；居家每日开窗通风2-3次、每次不少于30分钟。
    People's Daily Online Sichuan reported on October 4 that the Sichuan Provincial CDC issued its October advisory: with the autumn-winter transition and heavy National Day travel, five risks take priority - mosquito-borne disease, influenza, Covid-19, infectious diarrhea and hand-foot-mouth disease. Priority groups including children, seniors, students and chronically ill residents should get flu shots promptly, stay home when febrile, and ventilate rooms two to three times daily for at least 30 minutes.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-04
item.description: 2026-10-04 简报，共 20 条：港中大张翔/于君团队Cell Metabolism：真菌少根根霉产犬尿酸，促脂肪肝相关肝癌变；上海药物所甘勇/潘超等Cell子刊：纳米新药同步调控菌群与宿主色氨酸代谢，重塑抗癌免疫；ScienceDaily：肠菌代谢物ImP与阿尔茨海默病风险升高及认知衰退加速相关；意大利Telethon研究所：聚合型α-1抗胰蛋白酶扰乱潘氏细胞蛋白稳态，加重肠道炎症；2026亚太健康长寿国际峰会在香港开幕：30多国200余位专家共议长寿医学；八子补肾入选清华发布年度“长寿医学十大进展”，中医药抗衰老研究获认可；长寿医生拆解biohacking：哪些干预值得花钱，哪些只是营销话术；Aging Cell：uPAR靶向T细胞接合器清除老年小鼠与灵长类衰老细胞，转氨酶充当安全仪表；Nature Cell Biology：亮氨酸不止增肌，还能稳定线粒体蛋白、为细胞产能“升级”；Nature Reviews Microbiology综述：从母乳到衰老，双歧杆菌如何塑造人体健康；果壳复盘中国精准营养赛道：雀巢关店、FANCL止步，低门槛问卷模式能否破局；土豆替代主食半年瘦25斤：抗性淀粉经肠道菌群助力减脂的科学依据；EVITA二期试验：每日1000毫克维生素C未抑制癌前血细胞增殖，但炎症改善、死亡更少；Nutritional Outlook发布senolytic补剂配方指南：细胞健康的“诚实记分牌”；SuanNutra将柠檬马鞭草种植迁至西班牙瓦伦西亚，强化品牌原料溯源与标准化；Healthgevity推出hydraCELL+细胞水合与肌肉支持配方，面向长寿与体重管理场景；新华社秋季健康指南：关节保暖、牙龈出血别只“降火”、谨防诺如病毒；河南疾控发布10月健康风险提示：呼吸道传染病、诺如腹泻、虫媒与食物中毒；ScienceDaily：每周仅一次力量训练也可能显著获益，抗肌少症不必“全或无”；英格兰大型研究：近六成高血压患者不知晓患病，一半服药者血压仍不达标
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 港中大张翔/于君团队Cell Metabolism：真菌少根根霉产犬尿酸，促脂肪肝相关肝癌变
    CUHK team in Cell Metabolism: gut fungus Rhizopus arrhizus drives MASLD-associated liver cancer via kynurenic acid
    香港中文大学张翔、于君团队发表于Cell Metabolism的研究发现，少根根霉（Rhizopus arrhizus）等肠道真菌在MASLD相关肝细胞癌中富集，其代谢物犬尿酸可促进肝癌变，揭示了肠-肝真菌轴促癌新机制，为脂肪肝相关肝癌的菌群导向干预提供了潜在新靶点。
    A Cell Metabolism study by Zhang Xiang and Yu Jun's team at the Chinese University of Hong Kong shows that the gut fungus Rhizopus arrhizus is enriched in MASLD-associated hepatocellular carcinoma and that its metabolite kynurenic acid promotes cancerous transformation, revealing a new gut-liver fungal axis mechanism and a potential microbiome-targeted avenue against fatty-liver-related liver cancer.
  • 上海药物所甘勇/潘超等Cell子刊：纳米新药同步调控菌群与宿主色氨酸代谢，重塑抗癌免疫
    SIMM team in a Cell-family journal: nanomedicine reshapes antitumor immunity by tuning tryptophan metabolism in both microbiota and host
    中科院上海药物研究所甘勇、潘超团队发表于Cell子刊的研究设计出可同步调控肠道菌群与宿主色氨酸代谢的纳米新药：通过重塑色氨酸代谢通量改善肿瘤免疫微环境，实现菌群与宿主双轴协同的抗癌免疫激活，为微生物组导向的肿瘤免疫联合治疗提供了新策略。
    Researchers led by Gan Yong and Pan Chao at the Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica report in a Cell-family journal a nanomedicine that simultaneously tunes tryptophan metabolism in gut microbes and the host, reshaping the tumor immune microenvironment and enabling dual-axis activation of antitumor immunity - a new strategy for microbiome-directed cancer immunotherapy.
  • ScienceDaily：肠菌代谢物ImP与阿尔茨海默病风险升高及认知衰退加速相关
    ScienceDaily: gut microbial compound ImP linked to higher Alzheimer's risk and faster cognitive decline
    研究将肠道细菌产生的化合物ImP（咪唑丙酸）与更高的阿尔茨海默病风险、有害脑蛋白聚集及更快的认知衰退联系起来；研究者提出，降低血液ImP水平未来或成为延缓或预防痴呆的干预路径，再次凸显肠-脑轴在神经退行性疾病防治中的研究价值。
    New research links ImP, a compound produced by gut bacteria, to higher Alzheimer's risk, buildup of harmful brain proteins and faster cognitive decline. The authors suggest that lowering blood ImP levels could one day help slow or prevent dementia, underscoring the gut-brain axis in neurodegenerative disease research.
  • 意大利Telethon研究所：聚合型α-1抗胰蛋白酶扰乱潘氏细胞蛋白稳态，加重肠道炎症
    Telethon Institute: polymeric alpha-1 antitrypsin perturbs Paneth cell proteostasis and worsens intestinal inflammation
    意大利Telethon遗传与医学研究所团队发表于Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy的研究显示，聚合型α-1抗胰蛋白酶（AAT）变异体可在潘氏细胞内质网中异常蓄积、扰乱蛋白稳态并加剧肠道炎症，从内质网应激角度阐明AAT缺乏症的肠道损伤机制，为肠-肝轴病理研究提供新视角。
    A study from Italy's Telethon Institute published in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy shows that polymeric alpha-1 antitrypsin (AAT) variants accumulate abnormally in Paneth cell endoplasmic reticulum, disturbing proteostasis and worsening intestinal inflammation, clarifying how AAT deficiency injures the gut and offering a new lens on the gut-liver axis.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 2026亚太健康长寿国际峰会在香港开幕：30多国200余位专家共议长寿医学
    Asia-Pacific Health and Longevity Summit 2026 opens in Hong Kong with 200-plus experts from 30+ countries
    新华社报道，2026亚太健康长寿国际峰会10月3日在香港开幕，全球30多个国家和地区的200余名科学家与临床专家参会。北京协和医院院长张抒扬介绍以老年健康需求为中心的整合医疗模式，巴克衰老研究院首席创新官胡德分享数据与AI驱动的个体健康管理实践，聚焦长寿医学与临床转化。
    Xinhua reports that the Asia-Pacific Health and Longevity Summit 2026 opened in Hong Kong on October 3, drawing more than 200 scientists and clinicians from over 30 countries. PUMCH president Zhang Shuyang presented an integrated geriatric care model, while Buck Institute chief innovation officer Leroy Hood discussed data- and AI-driven personal health management.
  • 八子补肾入选清华发布年度“长寿医学十大进展”，中医药抗衰老研究获认可
    Traditional Chinese medicine formula Bazi Bushen named among Tsinghua's top ten longevity medicine advances of the year
    据养生杂志报道，清华大学发布的年度“长寿医学十大进展”榜单中，“气络学说精气神理论指导中医药抗衰老研究”入选，为榜单中唯一中医药成果，其承载药物为八子补肾胶囊。该研究提出补肾填精、燮理阴阳的系统干预策略，与主流单靶点抗衰路线互补，体现整体调节范式在衰老研究中的价值。
    According to Yangsheng Magazine, Tsinghua University's annual list of top ten longevity medicine advances includes research on anti-aging guided by qi-luo essence-qi-spirit theory - the only TCM entry, embodied by the formula Bazi Bushen. Its systemic tonification strategy complements mainstream single-target approaches, reflecting the value of whole-system regulation in aging research.
  • 长寿医生拆解biohacking：哪些干预值得花钱，哪些只是营销话术
    A longevity doctor separates biohacking worth paying for from pure marketing
    Men's Fitness对话长寿医学医生Talal Khan：改变血液指标不等于改善健康结局。证据最扎实的仍是运动、睡眠与风险因素管理，以及肌酸、洋车前子、桑拿等；NAD+/NMN、BPC-157等多肽、生物年龄检测与不必要的睾酮补充证据有限甚至存在风险；雷帕霉素因PEARL试验未达主要终点，暂不推荐健康人常规使用。
    In a Men's Fitness interview, longevity physician Talal Khan argues that moving a biomarker is not the same as improving outcomes. Exercise, sleep and risk-factor management - plus creatine, psyllium and sauna - carry the best evidence, while NAD+/NMN, peptides like BPC-157, biological-age tests and unwarranted testosterone have limited or negative evidence; rapamycin is not yet ready for healthy people.
  • Aging Cell：uPAR靶向T细胞接合器清除老年小鼠与灵长类衰老细胞，转氨酶充当安全仪表
    Aging Cell: uPAR-targeting T-cell engager clears senescent cells in aged mice and primates with liver enzymes as a safety gauge
    9月29日发表于Aging Cell的研究构建了以uPA生长因子样结构域靶向uPAR的GFD-CD3双特异性T细胞接合器：高剂量会引发肝毒性，而在低剂量并用血转氨酶监测下，可清除老年小鼠与非人灵长类体内的衰老细胞、减轻年龄相关损伤且未见不良反应，为单次给药、可监测的senolytic免疫疗法提供概念验证。
    A study published September 29 in Aging Cell built GFD-CD3, a bispecific T-cell engager targeting uPAR via the growth-factor-like domain of uPA. High doses caused hepatotoxicity, but low doses guided by serum transaminase monitoring cleared senescent cells in aged mice and non-human primates without adverse effects - a proof of concept for monitorable, single-dose senolytic immunotherapy.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nature Cell Biology：亮氨酸不止增肌，还能稳定线粒体蛋白、为细胞产能“升级”
    Nature Cell Biology: leucine does more than build muscle - it stabilizes mitochondrial proteins to power up cells
    科隆大学CECAD衰老研究所Thorsten Hoppe团队10月1日发表于Nature Cell Biology的研究发现，必需氨基酸亮氨酸可降低SEL1L介导的蛋白降解，稳定线粒体外膜蛋白，使线粒体更高效产能；该机制在线虫中与生育力相关，并影响肺癌细胞存活，提示亮氨酸-SEL1L轴或成代谢疾病与肿瘤干预新方向。
    A University of Cologne CECAD team led by Thorsten Hoppe reports in Nature Cell Biology (October 1) that the essential amino acid leucine dampens SEL1L-mediated protein degradation, stabilizing outer mitochondrial membrane proteins so mitochondria produce energy more efficiently. The mechanism affects fertility in worms and survival of lung cancer cells, pointing to the leucine-SEL1L axis as a new target.
  • Nature Reviews Microbiology综述：从母乳到衰老，双歧杆菌如何塑造人体健康
    Nature Reviews Microbiology review: how Bifidobacteria shape human health from breast milk to aging
    热心肠日报推荐、9月28日发表于Nature Reviews Microbiology的综述系统梳理双歧杆菌的生物地理分布、宿主适应与生态功能：从母乳喂养婴儿的肠道定植，到全生命周期中经母乳低聚糖代谢、短链脂肪酸生成与免疫调节影响宿主健康，为益生菌与精准营养干预提供全景式科学框架。
    A September 28 review in Nature Reviews Microbiology maps the biogeography, host adaptation and ecological functions of Bifidobacteria - from colonizing the breastfed infant gut to shaping host health across life via human milk oligosaccharide metabolism, short-chain fatty acid production and immune modulation - offering a panoramic framework for probiotic and precision-nutrition strategies.
  • 果壳复盘中国精准营养赛道：雀巢关店、FANCL止步，低门槛问卷模式能否破局
    Guokr on China's precision nutrition market: Nestle exits, FANCL stalls - can low-cost questionnaire models break through?
    果壳撰文复盘国内精准营养赛道的起落：雀巢旗下Persona入局两年即关店，FANCL止步于分龄营养包，核心症结在于干血斑检测成本高企与海外算法缺乏中国人群队列数据。近期“营养日记”以3-5分钟问卷加7D机能雷达图、约400元月费的低门槛模式跑出，但“仅凭问卷靠谱吗”仍待临床证据回应。
    A Guokr retrospective examines why precision nutrition stalled in China: Nestle's Persona closed its stores within two years and FANCL never moved beyond age-tier packs, squeezed by costly dried-blood-spot testing and foreign algorithms lacking Chinese cohort data. The low-cost app Nutrition Diary - a 3-5 minute questionnaire, a 7D radar profile and about 400 yuan monthly - is rising fast, though its validity still awaits clinical evidence.
  • 土豆替代主食半年瘦25斤：抗性淀粉经肠道菌群助力减脂的科学依据
    Potatoes instead of rice for 25 jin of weight loss: the resistant-starch and gut microbiome science
    新浪财经10月3日科普抗性淀粉：汕头一男子以土豆替代精制主食半年减重25斤，血压血糖与脂肪肝同步改善。抗性淀粉绕过小肠消化、在大肠被菌群发酵，既往研究显示其可经调节肠道菌群帮助减重、减轻脂肪肝并改善血脂与胰岛素抵抗；全谷物、豆类、薯类及放凉的米饭土豆均为优质来源。
    Sina Finance explains resistant starch: a Shantou man lost 25 jin in six months by swapping refined staples for potatoes, with blood pressure, glucose and fatty liver improving. Resistant starch bypasses small-intestinal digestion and is fermented by colonic microbes; studies link it to weight loss, reduced fatty liver and better lipids and insulin sensitivity, with whole grains, legumes, tubers and cooled rice or potatoes as top sources.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • EVITA二期试验：每日1000毫克维生素C未抑制癌前血细胞增殖，但炎症改善、死亡更少
    EVITA phase 2 trial: daily 1,000 mg vitamin C did not slow premalignant cell growth but showed less inflammation and fewer deaths
    Van Andel研究所牵头的EVITA二期随机对照试验（109人）测试每日1000毫克维生素C在克隆性血细胞减少与低危髓系肿瘤中的作用：主要终点未延缓异常细胞增殖，但炎症信号改善、贫血与肺炎等并发症减少；探索性分析随访33.6个月死亡11例对24例，生存获益需三期试验验证，胃肠道不良反应更多见。
    The EVITA phase 2 randomized trial (109 participants), led from the Van Andel Institute, tested daily 1,000 mg vitamin C in clonal cytopenia and lower-risk myelial malignancies. The primary endpoint - slowing abnormal cell growth - was not met, but inflammatory markers improved, anemia and pneumonia fell, and exploratory follow-up at 33.6 months showed 11 versus 24 deaths; confirmation requires a phase 3 trial, with more GI side effects noted.
  • Nutritional Outlook发布senolytic补剂配方指南：细胞健康的“诚实记分牌”
    Nutritional Outlook's senolytic supplement formulation guide: an honest scorecard for cellular health
    Nutritional Outlook 9月29日刊文梳理senolytic（衰老细胞清除）补剂配方现状：在The Outlook on Active Nutrition活动上，Savage Nutra创始人Joey Savage为品牌方给出“诚实记分牌”——衰老细胞生物学的机制证据持续累积，但哪些成分真正具备人体临床获益数据仍是缺口，行业需正视研究阶段与营销声量之间的距离。
    Nutritional Outlook's September 29 feature reviews the state of senolytic supplement formulation: at The Outlook on Active Nutrition, Savage Nutra founder Joey Savage gave brands an honest scorecard - mechanistic evidence on senescent cells keeps accumulating, but human clinical benefit data remain the gap, and the industry must mind the distance between research stage and marketing claims.
  • SuanNutra将柠檬马鞭草种植迁至西班牙瓦伦西亚，强化品牌原料溯源与标准化
    SuanNutra moves lemon verbena cultivation to Valencia, Spain, for traceable branded ingredients
    补剂原料商SuanNutra宣布将柠檬马鞭草种植迁往西班牙瓦伦西亚：在监管下的多农场种植体系支撑可溯源与标准化质量，为旗下多个品牌原料提供稳定植物药源。柠檬马鞭草常见于运动恢复、睡眠与肌肉保护类配方，此举反映植物原料供应链“地理标志化”的行业趋势。
    Ingredient supplier SuanNutra is relocating lemon verbena cultivation to Valencia, Spain, where a supervised multi-farm system supports traceability and standardized quality for its branded ingredients. Lemon verbena appears in sports-recovery, sleep and muscle-protection formulas, and the move mirrors an industry trend toward origin-anchored botanical supply chains.
  • Healthgevity推出hydraCELL+细胞水合与肌肉支持配方，面向长寿与体重管理场景
    Healthgevity launches hydraCELL+ cellular hydration and muscle-support formula for longevity care
    面向执业医师的精准长寿营养公司Healthgevity 10月2日推出hydraCELL+：每份含8克一水肌酸、10克海藻糖及丙氨酸、甘氨酸、谷氨酰胺与亮氨酸，围绕细胞水合、营养信号与能量供给三条路径支持肌肉生理，定位于健康老龄化、体重管理与运动表现人群，经医师渠道销售。
    Practitioner-focused precision longevity nutrition company Healthgevity launched hydraCELL+ on October 2: each serving combines 8 g creatine monohydrate, 10 g trehalose plus alanine, glycine, glutamine and leucine, supporting muscle physiology through cellular hydration, nutrient signaling and energy availability, aimed at healthy aging, weight management and performance, sold via practitioner channels.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 新华社秋季健康指南：关节保暖、牙龈出血别只“降火”、谨防诺如病毒
    Xinhua's autumn health guide: keep joints warm, don't blame bleeding gums on 'internal heat', guard against norovirus
    新华社10月3日刊发秋季养生防病指南：广安门医院专家提示关节炎患者注意膝、手、腰背保暖，膏药与止痛药切勿自行加量；北大口腔专家指出牙龈出血多为牙菌斑性牙龈炎，“降火”无效，需洁治与牙线护理；中疾控专家提醒国庆假期做好手卫生，诺如病毒与手足口病均可再次感染。
    Xinhua's October 3 autumn health guide: Guang'anmen Hospital experts advise keeping knees, hands and back warm and never self-escalating painkillers or medicated patches; Peking University dental experts note bleeding gums usually signal plaque-driven gingivitis where 'heat-clearing' fails and scaling plus interdental cleaning is needed; China CDC staff urge holiday hand hygiene as norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease can reinfect.
  • 河南疾控发布10月健康风险提示：呼吸道传染病、诺如腹泻、虫媒与食物中毒
    Henan CDC's October health risk advisory: respiratory infections, norovirus, vector-borne disease and food poisoning
    河南省疾控中心10月3日发布10月健康风险评估：正值国庆假期与深秋降温，重点防范呼吸道传染病（建议6月龄以上无禁忌人群在流行季前尽早接种流感疫苗）、诺如病毒感染性腹泻与食物中毒、登革热等虫媒传染病；提醒假期出行科学佩戴口罩、注意手卫生与饮食饮水卫生，学校托幼机构加强晨午检。
    Henan Provincial CDC issued its October risk assessment on October 3: with the National Day holiday and falling temperatures, priorities are respiratory infections (flu vaccination before the season for everyone aged 6 months and older without contraindications), norovirus diarrhea and food poisoning, and vector-borne diseases like dengue, plus mask-wearing, hand hygiene and school morning checks.
  • ScienceDaily：每周仅一次力量训练也可能显著获益，抗肌少症不必“全或无”
    ScienceDaily: even one strength-training session a week may help - fighting sarcopenia need not be all-or-nothing
    ScienceDaily 10月2日发文聚焦年龄相关肌肉减少（肌少症）：深蹲、负重、弹力带乃至自重训练等抗阻运动可保留或重建力量，研究显示每周哪怕仅一次训练也能带来有意义的获益。肌少症增加跌倒、骨折与失能风险，专家呼吁将“最小可行力量训练”纳入老年健康管理基本盘，而非追求高强度打卡。
    A ScienceDaily feature on October 2 spotlights age-related muscle loss (sarcopenia): resistance work - squats, weights, bands or bodyweight - preserves and rebuilds strength, and research shows even a single weekly session delivers meaningful benefits. Because sarcopenia raises the risk of falls, fractures and disability, experts urge making minimal viable strength training a baseline of geriatric care rather than chasing high-frequency routines.
  • 英格兰大型研究：近六成高血压患者不知晓患病，一半服药者血压仍不达标
    Large England study: nearly 6 in 10 people with hypertension are undiagnosed, half of those treated still uncontrolled
    一项覆盖英格兰的大规模研究显示：近六成高血压患者从未被诊断或治疗，而已服药者中仍有半数血压未达标；研究者呼吁更主动的“查找与控制”策略——扩大筛查、强化随访与用药优化，可预防数千例心梗与卒中，为慢病管理中的“知晓-行动差距”提供量化警示。
    A large England-wide study finds nearly six in ten people with high blood pressure have never been diagnosed or treated, and half of those on medication still have elevated readings. Researchers call for a more proactive find-and-treat approach - broader screening, tighter follow-up and optimized therapy - that could prevent thousands of heart attacks and strokes, quantifying the know-do gap in chronic disease management.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-03
item.description: 2026-10-03 简报，共 20 条：仁济医院洪洁团队Nature子刊：两种“坏”菌互作驱动持久肠道动力障碍，益生菌或可破局；Lancet子刊综述：肠道菌群如何打开癌症治疗新局面——从关联走向干预；协和医院陈宏达团队：锁定结直肠肿瘤的菌群拓扑特征；阿尔茨海默风险基因APOE4的“可逆弱点”：损伤脑血管与蛋白清除系统可被逆转；2026全球十大长寿突破大奖在香港揭晓；自噬与衰老的真相：并非整体下降，而是随细胞类型与性别各异，运动可调节；线虫“钙触发的肌动蛋白笼”揭示线粒体损伤延寿之谜；藤茶多酚二氢杨梅素（DHM）关联线虫健康寿命与神经保护；湖南师大首登Nature正刊：翟宗昭团队揭示蛋白质营养感知经4E-BP–TOP mRNA翻译调控寿命；中科院亚热带生态所：丁酸梭菌以胞外囊泡投递小RNA，抑制肠道脂肪吸收；百岁老人到底吃什么？最新综述总结长寿饮食五大共性；专家共识：精准营养的价值不在检测数据本身，而在“检测-干预-结局”的循证链条；生合TWK10益生菌抢攻GLP-1配套营养，人体研究登国际期刊；美国补剂立法2026年度盘点：强制列名、药品排除与联邦优先；膳食CoQ10经COPS3-自噬轴恢复衰老巨核细胞功能，抑制老化血小板高反应性；Nova Mentis推出精密发酵羟基酪醇HT1，瞄准健康老龄化市场；REACT研究：约1/13的30岁以下成人已有隐匿动脉斑块；中疾控发布流感疫苗指南2026-2027：全面转向三价，9-10月为最佳接种期；英国心脏病专家：几点入睡也影响心血管风险，10-11点入睡风险最低；总在凌晨三四点醒？研究提示晚餐钾摄入与失眠相关，钾还“松开”血管助夜间降压
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 仁济医院洪洁团队Nature子刊：两种“坏”菌互作驱动持久肠道动力障碍，益生菌或可破局
    Renji Team in Nature Microbiology: Two Pathobionts Interact to Drive Persistent Gut Dysmotility, Probiotics May Help
    上海仁济医院洪洁、房静远团队发表于Nature Microbiology的研究显示，具核梭杆菌可增强产肠毒素脆弱拟杆菌介导的肠神经元丢失，两者协同驱动持续性肠道动力障碍；动物模型中针对性益生菌干预展现出破局潜力，为功能性肠病与菌群互作机制研究提供了新靶点。
    A Nature Microbiology study led by Hong Jie and Fang Jingyuan of Renji Hospital shows that Fusobacterium nucleatum amplifies enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis-driven enteric neuron loss, jointly driving persistent gut dysmotility; targeted probiotic intervention shows therapeutic potential in models, offering a new target for functional bowel disease.
  • Lancet子刊综述：肠道菌群如何打开癌症治疗新局面——从关联走向干预
    Lancet Oncology Review: Cancer and the Microbiome — From Association to Intervention
    希望之城综合癌症中心Sumanta K. Pal团队在《柳叶刀·肿瘤学》发表综述，系统梳理肠道菌群在肿瘤免疫治疗疗效、免疫相关不良反应及抗癌药物代谢中的作用，并评估菌群导向干预（饮食调整、益生菌、粪菌移植）从关联性证据走向临床干预的转化路径与现存挑战。
    A Lancet Oncology review by Sumanta K. Pal and colleagues synthesizes how the gut microbiome shapes cancer immunotherapy response, immune-related toxicity and drug metabolism, and maps the translational path from associative evidence to microbiome-directed interventions such as diet, probiotics and fecal microbiota transplantation.
  • 协和医院陈宏达团队：锁定结直肠肿瘤的菌群拓扑特征
    PUMCH Chen Hongda Team Maps Gut Microbial Topology of Colorectal Neoplasia
    北京协和医院陈宏达团队联合代敏、朱师达等在Advanced Science发表研究，通过对结直肠肿瘤样本的菌群数据分析，锁定与结直肠肿瘤发生相关的菌群“拓扑特征”与代谢标志物，提示菌群空间组织模式而非单纯物种丰度，可能是精准识别结直肠肿瘤性病变的新维度。
    A team led by Chen Hongda of Peking Union Medical College Hospital reports in Advanced Science that gut microbial “topology” and metabolic signatures — spatial organization patterns rather than species abundance alone — are associated with colorectal neoplasia, suggesting a new dimension for precise detection of colorectal precancerous and cancerous lesions.
  • 阿尔茨海默风险基因APOE4的“可逆弱点”：损伤脑血管与蛋白清除系统可被逆转
    Alzheimer's Risk Gene APOE4 May Have a Reversible Weakness
    西奈山团队发表于Cell与Cell Stem Cell的两项研究显示，APOE4可使血管周细胞转化为瘢痕样成纤维细胞，驱动脑血管纤维化与淀粉样沉积；阻断TGF-β信号可逆转这些病变。人源miBrain类器官还揭示APOE4经星形胶质细胞胆固醇堆积削弱α-突触核蛋白清除，提示血脂与溶酶体通路为可干预靶点。
    Two Mount Sinai studies in Cell and Cell Stem Cell show APOE4 converts vascular pericytes into scar-like cells, driving brain vessel fibrosis and amyloid buildup; blocking TGF-β signaling reversed these changes. Human miBrain organoids further link APOE4 to astrocyte cholesterol accumulation and impaired alpha-synuclein clearance, pointing to lipid and lysosomal pathways as druggable targets.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 2026全球十大长寿突破大奖在香港揭晓
    2026 Global Top 10 Longevity Breakthrough Awards Announced in Hong Kong
    2026亚太健康长寿国际峰会期间，全球十大长寿突破大奖颁奖典礼于10月1日在香港举行。来自美、瑞、德、韩、新、日的十家机构获奖，涵盖α-突触核蛋白种子扩增检测、被动传感生理监测、可穿戴平衡与前庭电刺激、纯化尿石素A、口服多靶点复方、肌少症AI筛查等长寿医学与精准检测前沿成果。
    During the 2026 Asia-Pacific Healthy Longevity Summit, the Global Top 10 Longevity Breakthrough Awards ceremony was held in Hong Kong on October 1, honoring ten institutions from the US, Switzerland, Germany, Korea, Singapore and Japan for advances spanning alpha-synuclein seed amplification assays, passive sensing wearables, vestibular stimulation, purified urolithin A, oral multi-target formulations and AI sarcopenia screening.
  • 自噬与衰老的真相：并非整体下降，而是随细胞类型与性别各异，运动可调节
    Autophagy Doesn't Uniformly Decline With Age — It Varies by Cell Type and Sex, and Exercise Modulates It
    Sanford Burnham Prebys研究所9月27日发表于Aging Cell的研究，对23-72岁健康人皮肤细胞、血细胞及诱导神经元直接测量自噬速率，发现“自噬随年龄整体下降”的说法证据薄弱：不同细胞类型与性别变化方向各异，70岁以上人群自噬偏高反而与体能较差相关；12周轻度运动使老年人血细胞自噬向年轻水平回落并改善体能。
    A Sanford Burnham Prebys study published September 27 in Aging Cell directly measured autophagy in skin, blood and induced-neuron cells from healthy adults aged 23-72. Autophagy did not uniformly decline with age: patterns varied by cell type and sex, higher autophagy in older adults correlated with poorer physical function, and a 12-week light exercise program shifted blood-cell autophagy toward youthful levels.
  • 线虫“钙触发的肌动蛋白笼”揭示线粒体损伤延寿之谜
    Calcium-Triggered Actin Cages Explain How Damaged Mitochondria Extend Lifespan in Worms
    范德堡大学Burkewitz实验室9月30日经Phys.org报道发表于Nature Communications的研究解开衰老生物学经典悖论：线粒体呼吸链突变延寿需要内质网IP3受体介导的钙信号——钙释放激活肌动蛋白重塑，形成“分子笼”约束功能受损线粒体网络的过度扩张，促进其更新；破坏该笼状结构则延寿效应消失。
    A Vanderbilt study from the Burkewitz lab, published in Nature Communications and reported September 30 by Phys.org, resolves a classic aging paradox: lifespan extension from mitochondrial respiratory-chain mutation in C. elegans requires ER IP3-receptor calcium signaling, which remodels actin into cages that restrain expansion of dysfunctional mitochondrial networks and promote their turnover; disrupting the cages abolishes the longevity benefit.
  • 藤茶多酚二氢杨梅素（DHM）关联线虫健康寿命与神经保护
    Dihydromyricetin (DHM) From Vine Tea Linked to Healthspan and Neuroprotection in C. elegans
    生物通10月1日报道的研究系统表征藤茶来源二氢杨梅素对秀丽隐杆线虫寿命相关表型的影响：DHM伴随氧化还原状态改善、线粒体膜电位维持与线粒体自噬相关运输变化，保护年龄相关机械感觉神经元退行，并依赖DAF-16/SKN-1及线粒体质量控制通路，为这一天然黄酮醇作为衰老形态调节剂提供了机制线索。
    Reported October 1 by EBioTrade, a study characterizes dihydromyricetin from Ampelopsis grossedentata in C. elegans: DHM was associated with improved redox state, preserved mitochondrial membrane potential, altered mitophagy-related trafficking and protection of mechanosensory neurons from age-related degeneration, engaging DAF-16/SKN-1 and mitochondrial quality-control pathways.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 湖南师大首登Nature正刊：翟宗昭团队揭示蛋白质营养感知经4E-BP–TOP mRNA翻译调控寿命
    Hunan Normal University's First Nature Paper: Protein Nutrient Sensing Regulates Lifespan via 4E-BP-TOP mRNA Translation
    湖南师范大学翟宗昭团队联合湖南大学、中科院上海营养与健康研究所10月2日发表于Nature正刊的研究，以果蝇为模型揭示蛋白质营养感知通过4E-BP对TOP motif mRNA翻译的调控影响寿命；选择性调控该通路的药物有望提供独立于雷帕霉素的衰老干预新路径，为蛋白摄入与长寿关系提供分子机制。
    Published October 2 in Nature by Zhai Zongzhao's team at Hunan Normal University with Hunan University and SIBS-CAS, a Drosophila study shows protein nutrient sensing regulates lifespan through 4E-BP-mediated translation of TOP-motif mRNAs; selective modulation of this pathway may offer aging interventions independent of rapamycin, grounding protein intake-longevity links in mechanism.
  • 中科院亚热带生态所：丁酸梭菌以胞外囊泡投递小RNA，抑制肠道脂肪吸收
    CAS Institute Develops Evidence That Clostridium butyricum Delivers Small RNAs via Extracellular Vesicles to Curb Intestinal Fat Absorption
    中科院亚热带生态所周锡红、胡竑及印遇龙团队发表于Journal of Extracellular Vesicles的研究显示，丁酸梭菌可经胞外囊泡包裹小RNA调控宿主肠道脂质代谢，抑制肠道脂肪吸收。该发现把益生菌作用机制从“菌株定植”拓展到“囊泡-核酸递送”，为靶向肠道脂质吸收的精准营养干预提供了新思路。
    A Journal of Extracellular Vesicles study by Zhou Xihong, Hu Hong and Yin Yinlong at the CAS Institute of Subtropical Agriculture shows Clostridium butyricum delivers small RNAs via extracellular vesicles to modulate host intestinal lipid metabolism and curb fat absorption, extending probiotic mechanisms beyond strain colonization toward vesicle-mediated nucleic-acid delivery for precision nutrition.
  • 百岁老人到底吃什么？最新综述总结长寿饮食五大共性
    What Do Centenarians Eat? New Review Distills the Common Threads of Longevity Diets
    一篇发表于Journal of Translational Medicine的综述对比地中海、冲绳、北欧、尼科亚等长寿地区的饮食模式发现：植物性天然食物为主、以全谷物豆类等高质量碳水替代精制主食、少盐、选对脂肪来源并保护肌肉，是各长寿人群的共同特征；富含膳食纤维与多酚的饮食还通过肠道菌群多样性与肠屏障维持发挥抗衰作用。
    A Journal of Translational Medicine review comparing dietary patterns of centenarians across the Mediterranean, Okinawa, Nordic and Nicoya regions finds shared features: predominantly natural plant-based foods, high-quality carbohydrates from whole grains and legumes, less salt, well-chosen fats and muscle protection — with fiber- and polyphenol-rich diets supporting gut microbiome diversity and barrier function.
  • 专家共识：精准营养的价值不在检测数据本身，而在“检测-干预-结局”的循证链条
    Precision Nutrition Needs Proven Outcomes, Not Just Test Data, Experts Say
    Nutrition Insight对话Clasado、ADM与Plug and Play专家指出：个性化检测结果不等于个性化营养方案，NIST研究显示同一粪样送检七家菌群公司结果差异堪比不同个体；专家强调精准营养必须把测量指标、目标健康结局与营养干预三者用临床证据连接起来，并提醒消费者警惕“既卖检测又卖补剂”的利益捆绑。
    Speaking to Nutrition Insight, experts from Clasado Biosciences, ADM and Plug and Play stress that a test result is not a personalized solution: a NIST study found seven consumer microbiome tests returned differences as large as between different people on identical samples. Precision nutrition requires clinical evidence linking measurement, outcome and intervention — and consumers should beware conflicts of interest where firms sell both tests and supplements.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 生合TWK10益生菌抢攻GLP-1配套营养，人体研究登国际期刊
    TWK10 Probiotic Targets GLP-1 Companion Nutrition as Human Studies Reach International Journals
    台湾益生菌原料厂生合10月1日宣布，专利菌株L. plantarum TWK10聚焦GLP-1药物时代的“配套营养”：发表于Current Research in Food Science的人体研究显示其可提升植物蛋白餐后氨基酸吸收，Microorganisms刊载的18周随机双盲试验显示下肢肌力、步行速度与平衡能力改善，瞄准减重期间肌肉与功能维持这一新市场。
    Taiwanese ingredient maker Synbio announced October 1 that its proprietary Lactiplantibacillus plantarum TWK10 is targeting companion nutrition for the GLP-1 era: a human study in Current Research in Food Science showed improved post-meal amino acid uptake from plant protein, while an 18-week randomized double-blind trial in Microorganisms reported gains in lower-limb strength, gait speed and balance during weight management.
  • 美国补剂立法2026年度盘点：强制列名、药品排除与联邦优先
    Dietary Supplement Legislation in 2026: Product Listing, Drug Preclusion and Federal Preemption
    Nutritional Outlook 10月1日发布美国补剂监管年度盘点：众议院《膳食补充剂列名法案》拟强制厂商向FDA提交标签与成分信息，行业团体立场分化；《膳食补充剂创新法案》试图改革“药品排除”条款，防止早期小规模临床试验永久封锁补剂原料；各州与联邦层面的监管动作持续重塑品类准入与合规边界。
    Nutritional Outlook's October 1 regulatory review of 2026 US supplement legislation covers the House Dietary Supplement Listing Act mandating FDA product registration, the Dietary Supplement Innovation Act seeking to reform the drug-preclusion rule that can permanently bar supplement ingredients after early clinical trials, and divergent industry positions as state and federal measures reshape oversight and compliance.
  • 膳食CoQ10经COPS3-自噬轴恢复衰老巨核细胞功能，抑制老化血小板高反应性
    Dietary CoQ10 Rejuvenates Aging Megakaryocytes via a COPS3-Autophagy Axis and Tames Platelet Hyperreactivity
    中山大学团队发表于Aging Cell的研究显示，相当于成人每日约300毫克的膳食CoQ10干预12周，可恢复自然衰老小鼠巨核细胞的增殖与成熟，上调COPS3、激活自噬通量，并抑制年龄相关的血小板高聚集性，且不影响血小板计数与止血。研究为这一常见补剂在衰老血液系统中的作用提供了首个跨生命周期动物证据。
    A Sun Yat-sen University study in Aging Cell shows 12 weeks of dietary CoQ10 (roughly 300 mg/day human-equivalent) restored proliferation and maturation of megakaryocytes in naturally aged mice, upregulated COPS3, activated autophagic flux and suppressed age-related platelet hyperaggregability without affecting platelet counts or bleeding time — the first lifespan-scale animal evidence for this popular supplement in aging hematology.
  • Nova Mentis推出精密发酵羟基酪醇HT1，瞄准健康老龄化市场
    Nova Mentis Launches Precision-Fermentation Hydroxytyrosol HT1 for Healthy Aging Formulations
    都柏林大学学院衍生生物科技公司Nova Mentis 10月2日宣布推出精密发酵羟基酪醇原料Polyphenol-HT1：相比橄榄提取物，其纯度更高、批次一致；羟基酪醇作为地中海饮食关键多酚，既往研究显示可降低氧化LDL与8-OHdG等氧化应激标志物，并可能经“橄榄油-肠-脑轴”支持认知健康，定位心血管与细胞健康品类。
    Nova Mentis, a University College Dublin spin-out, launched Polyphenol-HT1 on October 2 — a hydroxytyrosol produced by precision fermentation with higher purity and batch consistency than olive extracts. As a key Mediterranean-diet polyphenol, hydroxytyrosol has been linked to lower oxLDL and 8-OHdG and possible cognitive support via the olive oil-gut-brain axis, targeting healthy aging and cardiovascular categories.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • REACT研究：约1/13的30岁以下成人已有隐匿动脉斑块
    One in 13 Adults Under 30 Already Has Hidden Artery Plaque, REACT Study Finds
    丹麦与西班牙团队对16808名18-70岁表面健康成人进行冠脉、颈动脉与股动脉三区影像筛查（REACT-DETECT，NEJM发表）：57.1%存在动脉粥样硬化，18-29岁组检出率约1/13。研究者主张心血管预防从“风险概率估算”转向影像直接识别疾病本身，为早发动脉粥样硬化的精准防控提供新范式。
    Screening 16,808 apparently healthy adults aged 18-70 in Denmark and Spain with imaging of coronary, carotid and femoral arteries (REACT-DETECT, published in NEJM), researchers found atherosclerosis in 57.1%, including about 1 in 13 aged 18-29. They propose shifting cardiovascular prevention from risk-score estimation to direct imaging-based disease detection for earlier, precision-guided intervention.
  • 中疾控发布流感疫苗指南2026-2027：全面转向三价，9-10月为最佳接种期
    China CDC Issues 2026-2027 Flu Vaccine Guideline: Trivalent-Only Lineup, September-October Prime Window
    中国疾控中心《中国流感疫苗预防接种技术指南（2026-2027）》明确：本流行季仅供应三价疫苗（灭活+鼻喷减毒），H1N1、H3N2与B/Victoria三组分全面更新；因Yamagata系自2020年起未再检出，四价退出。9-10月为最佳接种窗口，医务人员、老人、慢病者、孕妇等优先，农村“一老一小”多省份免费接种。
    China CDC's 2026-2027 seasonal influenza vaccination guideline confirms a trivalent-only supply this season (inactivated and nasal-spray live vaccines) with all three components updated to H1N1, H3N2 and B/Victoria, as B/Yamagata has not been detected since 2020. September-October is the prime window, with healthcare workers, older adults, chronic-disease patients and pregnant women prioritized and free vaccination for rural seniors and students.
  • 英国心脏病专家：几点入睡也影响心血管风险，10-11点入睡风险最低
    Bedtime May Shape Heart Risk: 10-11 PM Sleep Onset Linked to Lowest Cardiovascular Disease Incidence
    英国新维多利亚医院心脏病专家Vasudeva分享自身护心routine：地中海饮食、每日适度运动加力量训练、定期自测血压血脂血糖；并援引UK Biobank 8.8万人研究——22-23点入睡者心血管发病率最低，午夜后入睡风险高25%。专家强调预防应从日常习惯入手，女性还需关注孕产期与围绝经期的风险窗口。
    UK cardiologist Arvind Vasudeva shares his own heart-protection routine — Mediterranean eating, daily moderate exercise plus strength training, and regular self-measured blood pressure, lipids and glucose — citing a UK Biobank study of 88,000 adults showing the lowest cardiovascular incidence among those falling asleep between 10-11 PM, with a 25% higher risk after midnight; women should also reassess risk around pregnancy and menopause.
  • 总在凌晨三四点醒？研究提示晚餐钾摄入与失眠相关，钾还“松开”血管助夜间降压
    Waking at 3-4 AM? Dinner Potassium Intake Is Linked to Insomnia, and Potassium Helps Blood Pressure Dips at Night
    国内健康科普援引《营养学前沿》逾四千人研究：晚餐钾摄入越多失眠发生率越低，可能与其稳定神经肌肉兴奋性、拮抗钠的作用有关；《欧洲心脏杂志》数据显示钾摄入提升与心血管事件风险下降相关，钠摄入高者每天多1克钾收缩压可显著降低。富含钾的菠菜、豆类、薯类晚餐是低成本干预起点。
    Citing a Frontiers in Nutrition study of over 4,000 participants, Chinese health communicators note that higher dinner potassium intake is associated with lower insomnia rates, likely via stabilizing neuromuscular excitability and offsetting sodium; European Heart Journal data link higher potassium intake to lower cardiovascular event risk, with each extra gram of potassium notably lowering systolic pressure in high-sodium consumers — potassium-rich greens, beans and tubers at dinner are a low-cost starting point.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-02
item.description: 2026-10-02 简报，共 18 条：Nature重磅：抗生素治疗期间吃甜食，肠道菌群“伤上加伤”；麦吉尔大学Nature：膳食-菌群协同破解癌症免疫治疗“肥胖悖论”；中山一院Cell Reports：间歇性禁食经菌群-IPA轴安全抑制血栓；Gut Microbes：抗生素干预人体试验证实IPA几乎完全源于肠道菌群；哈佛Gladyshev团队Nature综述：衰老是细胞身份“语法”的缓慢侵蚀；Nature：跨1.1万转录组构建“分子时钟”，预测死亡风险与衰老干预效果；Nature Aging：运动囊泡携带miR-29去抑制Klotho，让老年软骨重返年轻；ARDD 2026哈佛开幕：720人低剂量雷帕霉素III期试验同步推进；国家卫健委发布《成人肌少症食养指南（2026年版）》，科学增肌有了国家方案；NutraIngredients：超越鱼油——谁能填补全球Ω-3摄入缺口；南昌大学团队：锌-植物化学物配位纳米药物重塑肠道菌群高效缓解结肠炎；NutraIngredients：益生菌或可减轻格斗运动员快速减重的胃肠道负担；北欧后生元品牌Nordic Rebalance出海，发布直面消费者新品牌；法国新精密发酵工厂启用，加速营养原料创新；ASA最新裁决敲响警钟：食品品牌健康声称合规风险上升；中国疾控中心发布国庆假期健康提示：警惕食源、呼吸道与蚊媒传染病；华为WATCH D3发布：腕上动态血压监测进入第三代；人民日报健康客户端：国庆假期过敏、运动损伤与五官急症高发，及时就医有讲究
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Nature重磅：抗生素治疗期间吃甜食，肠道菌群“伤上加伤”
    Nature: eating sweets during antibiotics worsens gut microbiome disruption
    纽约大学朗格尼、纪念斯隆-凯特琳与希望之城团队追踪173名造血干细胞移植患者的9419顿配餐与1000余份粪便样本，发现广谱抗生素治疗期间每多摄入100克甜食，肠道菌群多样性额外下降约21%，粪肠球菌显著扩增；小鼠实验中蔗糖使抗生素诱导的肠球菌扩张放大16-33倍，提示抗生素治疗期间限糖或可保护菌群。
    Tracking 9,419 meals and 1,000-plus stool samples from 173 stem-cell transplant patients, NYU Langone, Memorial Sloan Kettering and City of Hope found that every extra 100 g of sweets during broad-spectrum antibiotic treatment was linked to a further ~21% drop in gut microbial diversity and expansion of Enterococcus; in mice, sucrose amplified antibiotic-induced Enterococcus blooms 16-33-fold, suggesting limiting sugar during antibiotic courses may protect the microbiome.
  • 麦吉尔大学Nature：膳食-菌群协同破解癌症免疫治疗“肥胖悖论”
    McGill Nature study: diet-microbiome synergy underlies the obesity paradox in immunotherapy
    麦吉尔大学团队用12种模拟人类膳食的小鼠饮食模型发现，抗PD-1疗效取决于“膳食-肠道菌群轴”而非体重或代谢紊乱：致胖饮食中富集的约翰逊乳杆菌与特定膳食协同，经芳香族氨基酸代谢物（如脱氨基酪氨酸）增强T细胞效应；短期饮食切换或补充特定菌株即可逆转免疫治疗耐药，为肿瘤精准营养干预开辟新路径。
    Using 12 mouse diet models mimicking human eating patterns, McGill researchers show that anti-PD-1 response depends on the diet-gut axis rather than body weight or metabolic dysfunction: Lactobacillus johnsonii enriched by obesogenic diets acts synergistically with diet via aromatic amino acid metabolites such as desaminotyrosine to boost T-cell effector function; short-term diet switches or specific bacteria reversed immunotherapy resistance, opening new routes for precision nutrition in oncology.
  • 中山一院Cell Reports：间歇性禁食经菌群-IPA轴安全抑制血栓
    Sun Yat-sen First Hospital in Cell Reports: intermittent fasting curbs thrombosis via gut-microbial IPA
    中山一院常光其、李梓伦团队在Cell Reports报道，隔日禁食通过重塑肠道菌群提升吲哚-3-丙酸（IPA），后者靶向维持血小板Rho GTPase循环稳态，在不增加出血风险的前提下抑制血小板活化；粪菌移植可复制抗血栓效应，动脉血栓患者血浆IPA显著偏低且为独立保护因子，为代谢相关血栓提供新干预靶点。
    A Cell Reports study from Sun Yat-sen University First Hospital shows alternate-day fasting reshapes the gut microbiota to raise indole-3-propionate (IPA), which keeps platelet Rho GTPase cycling in check and suppresses platelet activation without bleeding risk; fecal microbiota transfer reproduced the effect, and plasma IPA was independently protective in patients with arterial thrombosis, pointing to a new target for metabolic thrombosis.
  • Gut Microbes：抗生素干预人体试验证实IPA几乎完全源于肠道菌群
    Gut Microbes: antibiotic intervention confirms IPA is almost entirely gut-microbiota derived
    阿姆斯特丹大学医学中心团队让20名2型糖尿病患者与19名健康人接受7天广谱抗生素干预，结合血浆代谢组与宏基因组证实：血浆吲哚-3-丙酸（IPA）在干预后降至近检出限，几乎完全由菌群产生；IPA水平越低者2型糖尿病风险越高，且与血糖变异性呈负相关，关联菌属集中于毛螺菌科与颤螺菌科，提示菌群整体结构决定代谢保护。
    Amsterdam UMC gave 20 people with type 2 diabetes and 19 healthy controls a 7-day broad-spectrum antibiotic course: plasma indole-3-propionate (IPA) fell to near detection limits, confirming it is almost entirely microbiota-derived; lower IPA tracked higher T2D risk and greater glycemic variability, with community structure dominated by Lachnospiraceae and Ruminococcaceae — not single producers — determining the metabolic protection.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 哈佛Gladyshev团队Nature综述：衰老是细胞身份“语法”的缓慢侵蚀
    Nature review from Gladyshev lab: ageing as slow erosion of the grammar of cell identity
    哈佛医学院Gladyshev团队在Nature发表理论综述，提出发育期以高保真方式“写入”细胞身份约束（染色质架构、PRC2介导的抑制），成年后仅靠低保真局部维护，二者不对称导致可预测的表观遗传漂移；约90%年龄相关DNA甲基化增加位于PRC2结合低甲基化区域，可解释跨哺乳动物表观遗传时钟的稳健性，并给出可检验的干预预测。
    A Nature review from Vadim Gladyshev's Harvard lab argues that cell-identity constraints are written with high fidelity during development but maintained only imperfectly afterwards, and this asymmetry drives predictable epigenetic drift; about 90% of age-related DNA methylation gain sits at PRC2-bound low-methylated regions, explaining the robustness of pan-mammalian epigenetic clocks and yielding testable intervention predictions.
  • Nature：跨1.1万转录组构建“分子时钟”，预测死亡风险与衰老干预效果
    Nature: transcriptomic clocks across 11,000 samples predict mortality and rejuvenation
    Tyshkovskiy与Gladyshev团队整合小鼠、大鼠、猕猴与人的1.1万余份转录组，构建可解释的多组织多物种衰老与死亡风险时钟，精度比肩二代表观遗传时钟；衰老特征跨物种保守，炎症、干扰素与线粒体模块构成模块化架构，热量限制与Klotho主要作用于代谢模块，慢性病主要加速炎症模块，为干预效果评估提供实时分子标尺。
    Integrating more than 11,000 transcriptomes from mice, rats, macaques and humans, Tyshkovskiy and Gladyshev built interpretable multi-tissue, multi-species clocks for age and mortality whose accuracy rivals second-generation epigenetic clocks; conserved hallmarks form a modular architecture in which chronic disease mainly accelerates inflammatory modules while caloric restriction and Klotho target metabolic ones, giving a real-time molecular ruler for interventions.
  • Nature Aging：运动囊泡携带miR-29去抑制Klotho，让老年软骨重返年轻
    Nature Aging: exercise-derived vesicles carry miR-29 to de-repress Klotho in aged cartilage
    哈佛团队在Nature Aging报道，3个月有氧运动使老年人细胞外囊泡中运动响应性miR-29升高，这些囊泡经表观遗传去抑制长寿基因KL（α-Klotho），恢复软骨细胞年轻表型；过表达miR-29的工程囊泡以KL依赖方式复现效应，关节内注射改善老龄小鼠软骨健康，为运动获益的远端器官递送提供可转化载体。
    A Harvard team reports in Nature Aging that three months of aerobic exercise raised miR-29 in circulating extracellular vesicles of older adults; these vesicles epigenetically de-repress the longevity gene KL (alpha-Klotho) to restore youthful chondrocyte phenotypes, and engineered miR-29 vesicles recapitulated the effect in a KL-dependent manner, improving cartilage health in aged mice — a translatable vehicle for exercise's distal benefits.
  • ARDD 2026哈佛开幕：720人低剂量雷帕霉素III期试验同步推进
    ARDD 2026 opens at Harvard as a 720-person low-dose rapamycin Phase 3 trial gets underway
    第13届衰老研究与药物发现大会（ARDD 2026）10月1-3日在哈佛举行，聚焦衰老药物监管路径、AI试验设计与产业转化；同期亚利桑那大学宣布启动迄今规模最大的人体雷帕霉素试验：720名65岁以上成人随机接受每周低剂量雷帕霉素或安慰剂两年，以衰弱转化与IL-6为共同主要终点，标志长寿科学正式走向注册临床阶段。
    The 13th Aging Research and Drug Discovery meeting (ARDD 2026) runs October 1-3 at Harvard, focused on regulatory pathways, AI in trials and translation; the University of Arizona simultaneously launched the largest human rapamycin trial to date, randomizing 720 adults aged 65+ to two years of weekly low-dose rapamycin or placebo with frailty transition and IL-6 as co-primary endpoints — a landmark step for geroscience into registered clinical stages.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 国家卫健委发布《成人肌少症食养指南（2026年版）》，科学增肌有了国家方案
    China's NHC releases the 2026 dietary guideline for adult sarcopenia
    国家卫健委发布《成人肌少症食养指南（2026年版）》，倡导以科学饮食联合运动防治肌肉流失：65岁以上老年人蛋白质推荐量提高至每天每公斤体重1.17克，肌少症人群建议1.2-1.5克且优质蛋白占比60%以上；指南同时警示蛋白粉滥用与网红增肌产品非法添加风险，并强调维生素D与抗阻训练在增肌中的协同作用。
    China's National Health Commission released the 2026 dietary guideline for adult sarcopenia, pairing diet with resistance exercise: protein recommendations rise to 1.17 g/kg/day for adults 65+ and 1.2-1.5 g/kg/day for those with sarcopenia, with 60%+ from high-quality sources; the guideline also cautions against protein-powder misuse and illicit additives, and highlights vitamin D and resistance training as synergies.
  • NutraIngredients：超越鱼油——谁能填补全球Ω-3摄入缺口
    NutraIngredients: beyond fish oil — what could close the global omega-3 gap
    NutraIngredients专题梳理Ω-3供应与创新路径：全球多数人口EPA+DHA摄入远低于推荐量，鱼油原料承压背景下，藻油DHA、转基因油料作物的长链Ω-3、磷虾与鱿鱼源磷脂型Ω-3以及精密发酵等替代方案加速产业化，行业在可持续性与生物利用度之间寻找下一个主流Ω-3来源。
    A NutraIngredients feature maps the omega-3 innovation landscape: with most of the world's population falling short on EPA+DHA intake and fish-oil raw materials under pressure, algal DHA, long-chain omega-3 from engineered oilseed crops, phospholipid forms from krill and squid, and precision fermentation are scaling up as the industry searches for the next mainstream, sustainable and bioavailable source.
  • 南昌大学团队：锌-植物化学物配位纳米药物重塑肠道菌群高效缓解结肠炎
    Nanchang University: zinc-phytochemical coordination nanodrug reshapes microbiota to ease colitis
    南昌大学黄晓畅团队以锌离子为桥构筑超分子纳米网络，将脆弱的植物化学成分重塑为口服纳米药物：进入炎症微环境后兼具抗氧化、阻断炎症信号与富集产短链脂肪酸有益菌的三重作用；粪菌移植实验证实被“驯化”的菌群可独立保留结肠屏障与抗炎能力，为炎症性肠病及菌群失调相关病症的非药物干预提供新思路。
    A Nanchang University team built a zinc-bridged supramolecular nanonetwork that turns fragile phytochemicals into an oral nanodrug; in the inflamed gut it simultaneously scavenges oxidants, blocks inflammatory signaling and expands short-chain-fatty-acid-producing bacteria, and fecal microbiota transfer showed the conditioned microbiota alone preserves colonic barrier and anti-inflammatory capacity — a non-drug route for IBD and dysbiosis.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • NutraIngredients：益生菌或可减轻格斗运动员快速减重的胃肠道负担
    NutraIngredients: probiotics may ease gut burden of weight-cutting in combat athletes
    新研究关注格斗运动员赛前快速减重引发的胃肠道症状：能量与纤维骤减常导致便秘、腹胀与菌群紊乱，影响训练与比赛状态；研究提示针对性补充益生菌可改善减重期的胃肠道耐受性，为按体重分级项目的运动员营养策略提供了实用方向，也拓展了益生菌在运动营养场景的应用边界。
    New research addresses the gastrointestinal toll of rapid weight-cutting in combat sports: steep cuts in energy and fiber commonly trigger constipation, bloating and microbiota disruption that impair training and performance; targeted probiotic supplementation appears to improve gut tolerance during the cut, offering a practical nutrition strategy for weight-class athletes and extending probiotics into sports nutrition.
  • 北欧后生元品牌Nordic Rebalance出海，发布直面消费者新品牌
    Nordic Rebalance takes fermented oat postbiotic overseas with new D2C brand
    挪威Nordic Rebalance凭借消费者验证数据将燕麦发酵后生元推向国际市场，并发布全新直面消费者品牌；后生元无需活菌、稳定性强、与肠道屏障和免疫调节证据绑定，正在成为益生菌之外肠道健康品类的高增长赛道，此次出海也印证欧洲后生元创新向全球外溢的产业趋势。
    Norway's Nordic Rebalance is taking its fermented oat postbiotic international on the back of consumer validation data and launched a new direct-to-consumer brand; stable, non-living postbiotics tied to gut-barrier and immune evidence are emerging as a fast-growing segment beyond probiotics, confirming the global spillover of European postbiotic innovation.
  • 法国新精密发酵工厂启用，加速营养原料创新
    New precision fermentation facility opens in France to accelerate ingredient innovation
    一座新的精密发酵设施在法国启用，定位于加速功能营养成分从菌株构建、小试到放大生产的迭代；精密发酵正被用于稀有多少功能原料（如稀有脂质、特殊蛋白与活性代谢物）的可持续生产，为补剂与功能食品行业缩短供应周期、降低成本并提升原料溯源透明度。
    A new precision fermentation facility in France aims to speed the iteration of functional nutritional ingredients from strain engineering through piloting to scale-up; precision fermentation is increasingly used for sustainable production of rare lipids, specialty proteins and bioactive metabolites, shortening supply cycles, cutting costs and improving traceability for supplement and functional food makers.
  • ASA最新裁决敲响警钟：食品品牌健康声称合规风险上升
    ASA ruling highlights rising health-claim compliance risks for food brands
    英国广告标准局对Whitworths的裁决显示，随着食品品牌竞相强调功能价值，健康与营养声称的合规风险正在上升：缺乏充分科学依据或未与获授权声称严格对齐的宣传语面临下架与声誉代价，行业呼吁营销、法规与科学团队在产品上市前协同完成声称审核。
    The UK Advertising Standards Authority's ruling against Whitworths underscores growing compliance risk as food brands lean into functional messaging: claims lacking robust substantiation or strict alignment with authorized health claims face takedowns and reputational cost, and the industry is urging earlier cross-functional review between marketing, regulatory and science teams.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 中国疾控中心发布国庆假期健康提示：警惕食源、呼吸道与蚊媒传染病
    China CDC issues National Day holiday health alert on foodborne, respiratory and mosquito-borne risks
    中国疾控中心国庆前夕提示：假期聚餐与外出增多，需防范诺如病毒胃肠炎与食物中毒，不采食野生蘑菇；车站景区等人群密集场所注意佩戴口罩与手卫生，老年人等高危人群建议接种流感疫苗；秦岭淮河以南蚊虫仍活跃，防蚊灭蚊预防登革热；慢病人群出行应带足药物、避免擅自停药并监测血压血糖。
    Ahead of the National Day holiday, China CDC warned travelers about norovirus gastroenteritis and food poisoning (avoid wild mushrooms), urged masks and hand hygiene in crowded hubs with flu vaccination for high-risk groups, dengue prevention where mosquitoes remain active south of the Qinling-Huaihe line, and medication adherence plus BP/glucose monitoring for people with chronic conditions.
  • 华为WATCH D3发布：腕上动态血压监测进入第三代
    Huawei launches WATCH D3, third-generation wrist ambulatory blood pressure monitor
    10月1日华为在Mate90系列发布会推出第三代腕部动态血压记录仪WATCH D3：整机厚度减至11.3毫米，微泵气囊与PPG融合技术使全天加压测量从27次降至7次；获二类医疗器械注册与CE-MDR认证，支持运动前后血压测量、海拔与气温骤变提醒，新增高尿酸与冠心病风险评估研究，华为腕上血压测量累计已超4亿次。
    On October 1 Huawei unveiled WATCH D3, its third-generation wrist ambulatory blood pressure monitor: 11.3 mm thin, with hybrid micro-pump plus PPG sensing that cuts inflatable measurements from 27 to 7 per day; certified as a Class II medical device and CE-MDR, it adds peri-exercise BP measurement, altitude and cold-snap alerts, plus uric-acid and coronary-risk studies, building on 400 million-plus lifetime BP measurements.
  • 人民日报健康客户端：国庆假期过敏、运动损伤与五官急症高发，及时就医有讲究
    Holiday health watch: allergies, sports injuries and ENT/eye emergencies spike over National Day
    多地疾控与医院提示假期高发健康问题：华山医院指出紫外线、花粉与冷空气叠加易诱发过敏，户外运动前充分热身可防扭伤拉伤；复旦眼耳鼻喉科医院数据显示假期前三天结膜炎、角膜损伤与咽部异物居急诊前列；专家提醒鱼刺卡喉切勿吞饭团喝醋，突发视力下降、听力下降或持续鼻出血应立即就医。
    Hospitals and CDCs flag holiday spikes: Huashan Hospital notes UV, pollen and cold snaps driving allergies and sports injuries without warm-ups; Eye and ENT Hospital of Fudan data put conjunctivitis, corneal injury and pharyngeal foreign bodies atop early-holiday ER visits; experts warn against swallowing rice balls or vinegar for fish bones and urge immediate care for sudden vision or hearing loss.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-01
item.description: 2026-10-01 简报，共 20 条：南京大学Cell Metabolism：二甲双胍降糖效果不佳？一种肠菌酶或是元凶；Cell：4种关键肠菌代谢物双向调控CAR-T疗效；Cell：肠道菌群-吲哚-AHR轴锁定脑卒中免疫损伤新机制；ScienceDaily：咖啡通过改变肠道菌群活性影响情绪与大脑功能；哥本哈根大学Nature Aging：心磷脂-ERRγ轴破解肌肉衰老纤维转变之谜；Nature：130万个细胞核绘制人类前额叶全生命周期衰老图谱；Nature Communications：EDISEA饮食指数关联表观遗传衰老减速约4年、死亡风险降20%；石榴代谢物尿石素A改善心衰模型心脏功能高达80%；华农团队同日两篇国际论文：从“吃多少脂肪”转向“吃什么脂肪”；弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学综述：桑葚制剂或重塑肠道菌群并影响代谢；NutraIngredients：专家提醒“纤维快加”需给肠道菌群适应时间；富矿物质水缓解便秘RCT：短期见效但效应趋平；德州农工12周RCT：肌酸无需运动也能增肌减脂；加州签署补剂限制法案，行业表达担忧；肠-脑轴新证据：后生元显示缓解压力与调节脑活动潜力；新研究：靶向营养补充可为社会节省数十亿美元；中秋智能穿戴销售额增1.2倍，厂商争夺健康服务入口；陕西启动2026-2027流行季流感疫苗接种，国庆假期可约；烟台疾控释疑“贴秋膘”：补营养不补热量，慢病患者尤需控量；武汉卫健委答复提案：三减三健闭环管理，控糖专项调查覆盖4000余人
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 南京大学Cell Metabolism：二甲双胍降糖效果不佳？一种肠菌酶或是元凶
    Nanjing University in Cell Metabolism: A Gut Microbial Enzyme May Undermine Metformin Response
    热心肠日报第3740期报道，南京大学王婷婷/赵越团队在Cell Metabolism发表研究，揭示肠道菌群编码的酶可降解二甲双胍，导致部分患者降糖效果不佳，为药物-菌群互作与个体化用药提供新证据。
    Featured in China Gut Daily issue 3740, a Cell Metabolism study by Wang Tingting and Zhao Yue at Nanjing University reveals that a gut microbial enzyme can degrade metformin, explaining poor glucose-lowering response in some patients and informing drug-microbiome interactions.
  • Cell：4种关键肠菌代谢物双向调控CAR-T疗效
    Cell: Four Key Gut Microbial Metabolites Bidirectionally Modulate CAR-T Therapy Efficacy
    热心肠日报第3739期报道，Cell刊发研究锁定4种关键肠菌代谢物，可双向调控CAR-T细胞治疗效果，提示肠道菌群有望成为提升细胞免疫疗法疗效的可干预靶点。
    China Gut Daily issue 3739 covers a Cell study identifying four key gut microbial metabolites that bidirectionally modulate CAR-T therapy outcomes, suggesting the gut microbiome as a targetable lever to improve cellular immunotherapy.
  • Cell：肠道菌群-吲哚-AHR轴锁定脑卒中免疫损伤新机制
    Cell: Gut Microbiota-Indole-AHR Axis Reveals New Mechanism of Stroke Immune Injury
    研究揭示肠道菌群经吲哚-AHR通路抑制树突状细胞加重脑卒中损伤；重症患者粪菌移植无菌小鼠后脑梗死更严重，色氨酸酶基因丰度与90天不良结局强关联，为卒中预防提供新靶点。
    A Cell study shows gut bacteria worsen stroke injury via an indole-AHR pathway that suppresses dendritic cells; fecal microbiota from severe stroke patients enlarged infarcts in germ-free mice, and microbial tryptophanase abundance strongly predicted 90-day outcomes.
  • ScienceDaily：咖啡通过改变肠道菌群活性影响情绪与大脑功能
    ScienceDaily: Coffee May Influence Mood and Brain Function via Gut Microbes
    新研究显示，含咖啡因与低因咖啡均与压力、抑郁和冲动性降低相关，并伴随可测量的肠道菌群活性改变，提示咖啡对情绪和脑功能的部分益处可能经由肠-脑轴介导。
    A new study finds both caffeinated and decaf coffee are linked to lower stress, depression and impulsivity alongside measurable shifts in gut microbial activity, suggesting part of coffee's mood and brain benefits may be mediated by the gut-brain axis.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 哥本哈根大学Nature Aging：心磷脂-ERRγ轴破解肌肉衰老纤维转变之谜
    University of Copenhagen in Nature Aging: Cardiolipin-ERRγ Axis Explains Muscle Aging Fiber Shift
    哥本哈根大学团队发现，衰老肌肉线粒体心磷脂减少经ROS-ERRγ通路驱动快肌向慢肌转变；部分恢复心磷脂即可逆转小鼠肌肉萎缩并防止早亡，ERRγ为可成药核受体，具备干预转化潜力。
    University of Copenhagen researchers show that age-related loss of mitochondrial cardiolipin drives a fast-to-slow fiber switch in muscle via ROS and the nuclear receptor ERRγ; partially restoring cardiolipin reversed wasting in mice, highlighting a druggable target.
  • Nature：130万个细胞核绘制人类前额叶全生命周期衰老图谱
    Nature: 1.3 Million Nuclei Chart a Lifespan Aging Atlas of the Human Prefrontal Cortex
    西奈山团队整合284名0-97岁供者130余万细胞核数据，绘制背外侧前额叶单核转录组图谱：约24岁后细胞组成趋稳，60岁后胶质细胞免疫、应激与代谢程序转录变化重启，为脑衰老干预锁定时间窗。
    Mount Sinai researchers integrated over 1.3 million nuclei from 284 donors aged 0-97 to build a single-nucleus atlas of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, showing composition stabilizes around age 24 while glial immune, stress and metabolic programs reignite after 60.
  • Nature Communications：EDISEA饮食指数关联表观遗传衰老减速约4年、死亡风险降20%
    Nature Communications: EDISEA Diet Index Linked to About 4 Years Slower Epigenetic Aging and 20% Lower Mortality
    基于四大队列开发的EDISEA饮食指数显示：多摄入茶、全谷物和水果，少摄入油炸食品、酒、加工肉和含糖饮料，与GrimAge2加速差距缩小约4年、死亡风险降低约20%及糖尿病、心血管病等多种慢病风险下降相关。
    The EDISEA index, built from four major cohorts, links higher intake of tea, whole grains and fruit with lower intake of fried foods, alcohol, processed meat and sugary drinks to roughly 4 years less GrimAge2 acceleration, 20% lower mortality and reduced risks of diabetes and cardiovascular disease.
  • 石榴代谢物尿石素A改善心衰模型心脏功能高达80%
    Pomegranate-Derived Urolithin A Improves Heart Function by Up to 80% in HFpEF Models
    尿石素A（石榴、核桃与浆果经肠道菌代谢产生）在难以治疗的射血分数保留型心衰动物模型中，使心脏功能指标改善最高达80%，帮助僵硬心组织舒张，为线粒体自噬用于心衰干预提供新证据。
    Urolithin A, a gut-microbial metabolite of pomegranates, walnuts and berries, improved heart function measures by up to 80% in animal models of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, helping stiff cardiac tissue relax and supporting mitophagy-based interventions.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 华农团队同日两篇国际论文：从“吃多少脂肪”转向“吃什么脂肪”
    Huazhong Agricultural Team Publishes Two Papers: Which Fat Matters More Than How Much
    华中农业大学张涛团队同日发表两项成果，系统梳理中链甘油三酯在阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病中的代谢与应用进展，实验显示补充MCT可改善α-突触核蛋白线虫运动障碍，提示“换对脂肪”或成老龄营养干预新策略。
    Two same-day papers from Zhang Tao's team at Huazhong Agricultural University review the metabolism and applications of medium-chain triglycerides in neurodegenerative disease, showing MCT supplementation improved motor deficits in alpha-synuclein worms and reframing aging nutrition around fat quality.
  • 弗罗茨瓦夫医科大学综述：桑葚制剂或重塑肠道菌群并影响代谢
    Wroclaw Medical University Review: Mulberry Preparations May Reshape Gut Microbiota and Metabolism
    发表于Biomolecules的综述显示，桑叶与桑果制剂可改变肠道菌群组成并提升短链脂肪酸产量，与糖脂代谢改善相关；效果高度依赖品种、部位与加工方式，目前仍缺乏直接的人体研究证据。
    A Biomolecules review finds mulberry leaf and fruit preparations can shift gut microbiota composition and boost short-chain fatty acid production, with associations to improved glucose and lipid metabolism, though effects depend strongly on species, plant part and processing, and human evidence is lacking.
  • NutraIngredients：专家提醒“纤维快加”需给肠道菌群适应时间
    NutraIngredients: Experts Warn the Gut Microbiome Needs Time to Adapt to Fibermaxxing
    社交媒体流行的“fibermaxxing”快速增加膳食纤维摄入法引发专家警示：短期内大量加纤维可能带来腹胀胀气，肠道菌群需要逐步适应，循序渐进并保证水分才是可持续做法。
    Experts caution that the social-media trend of rapidly boosting fiber intake can trigger bloating and gas because the gut microbiome needs time to adapt, recommending gradual increases with adequate fluid as the sustainable approach.
  • 富矿物质水缓解便秘RCT：短期见效但效应趋平
    Mineral-Rich Water Eases Constipation in RCT, but Effects Level Off
    新发表的随机对照试验显示，饮用富含矿物质的天然水可在短期内改善便秘等消化症状，但效果随时间趋于平缓，提示其在肠道健康管理中的定位仍需更大规模研究验证。
    A new randomized controlled trial shows mineral-rich natural water improved constipation and digestive symptoms in the short term, though benefits leveled off over time, calling for larger studies to define its role in gut health management.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 德州农工12周RCT：肌酸无需运动也能增肌减脂
    Texas A&M 12-Week RCT: Creatine Builds Muscle Even Without Exercise
    64名45-65岁成人每日补充10克肌酸单水合物12周，未运动组仍增加约1.1公斤瘦体重并提升力量；联合运动与控卡饮食者减脂更明显，为中年肌健康与健康衰老支持提供实用证据。
    In a 12-week trial, 64 adults aged 45-65 taking 10 g creatine monohydrate daily gained about 1.1 kg of lean tissue and strength even without structured exercise, while combining creatine with training and calorie control cut body fat further, supporting midlife muscle health.
  • 加州签署补剂限制法案，行业表达担忧
    California Signs Restrictive Supplement Bill into Law, Industry Concerned
    美国加州正式签署一项限制性膳食补充剂法案，行业组织对法案的可执行性与合规成本表示失望与担忧，认为其或对补剂创新与市场准入产生深远影响，凸显州级监管趋严的新信号。
    California has signed a restrictive dietary supplement bill into law; industry groups voiced disappointment over enforceability and compliance costs, warning of far-reaching effects on innovation and market access as state-level oversight tightens.
  • 肠-脑轴新证据：后生元显示缓解压力与调节脑活动潜力
    Gut-Brain Axis: Postbiotic Shows Potential to Ease Stress and Modulate Brain Activity
    新研究报道后生元在肠-脑轴方向的干预证据，显示其在缓解压力与调节脑活动方面具有潜力，无需活菌即可起效的特性也为情绪健康类补剂提供了更稳定的成分选择。
    New findings add to evidence that postbiotics may ease stress and modulate brain activity via the gut-brain axis, and their non-live format offers a stable ingredient option for mood-health supplement formulations.
  • 新研究：靶向营养补充可为社会节省数十亿美元
    Targeted Supplementation Could Deliver Billions in Societal Savings, New Research Finds
    新研究测算显示，基于人群需求的靶向营养补充策略有望带来数十亿美元级的社会成本节省，为公共卫生政策将微量营养素干预纳入慢病预防体系提供了经济学论证。
    New economic modelling suggests targeted, needs-based supplementation strategies could deliver billions in societal savings, offering a health-economic case for embedding micronutrient interventions into chronic disease prevention policy.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 中秋智能穿戴销售额增1.2倍，厂商争夺健康服务入口
    Smart Wearable Sales Up 120% Over Mid-Autumn Holiday as Vendors Vie for Health Service Entry
    商务部数据显示中秋假期智能穿戴设备销售额同比增长1.2倍，手表、手环与智能戒指的健康功能持续加密，厂商正把硬件、App、算法与健康服务打包，争夺“数据-建议-服务”闭环入口。
    Ministry of Commerce data show smart wearable sales rose 120% year on year during the Mid-Autumn holiday; vendors are bundling hardware, apps, algorithms and health services to own the data-to-guidance-to-service loop in consumer health management.
  • 陕西启动2026-2027流行季流感疫苗接种，国庆假期可约
    Shaanxi Launches 2026-2027 Flu Season Vaccination, Bookable Through the National Day Holiday
    陕西省启动新流行季流感疫苗接种，农村65岁以上老人与中小学生可免费接种三价流感疫苗；今年“四价转三价”系基于流行趋势的科学调整，专家建议60岁以上及慢病人群等在9-10月完成接种。
    Shaanxi has begun 2026-2027 flu season vaccination, offering free trivalent vaccine to rural seniors and students; the quadrivalent-to-trivalent switch reflects circulating strains, and experts urge adults over 60 and chronic disease patients to vaccinate by October.
  • 烟台疾控释疑“贴秋膘”：补营养不补热量，慢病患者尤需控量
    Yantai CDC on Autumn Nourishment: Replenish Nutrients, Not Calories
    烟台市卫健委发布会上，疾控专家指出我国超半数成人超重或肥胖，现代版“贴秋膘”应适度补优质蛋白与蔬果全谷物而非囤热量，高血压、糖尿病患者进补应量力而行并监测体重腰围。
    At a Yantai health commission briefing, CDC experts noted over half of Chinese adults are overweight or obese and urged a modern take on autumn nourishment - adding quality protein, vegetables and whole grains rather than calories, with chronic disease patients monitoring weight and waistline.
  • 武汉卫健委答复提案：三减三健闭环管理，控糖专项调查覆盖4000余人
    Wuhan Health Commission: Closed-Loop Salt, Sugar and Oil Reduction Backed by Citywide Sugar-Intake Survey
    武汉市卫健委在政协提案答复中介绍，依托基本公卫、体重管理年等建立高血压糖尿病健康档案并季度监测，完成覆盖16区4000余人次的含糖食品消费专项调查，下一步推动“三减”纳入地方标准。
    In a proposal response, Wuhan's health commission described quarterly monitoring of hypertension and diabetes health records under basic public health programs, a sugary-food consumption survey covering over 4,000 residents across 16 districts, and plans to embed salt, sugar and oil reduction into local standards.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-09-30
item.description: 2026-09-30 简报，共 20 条：Nature 背靠背两篇：幼年蛋白质限制通过储存蛋白 Lsp2「写入」成年寿命；Nature Communications：AI 构建膳食指数 EDISEA，高分者表观遗传年龄年轻约 4 岁；Nature Health：高纤维、多植化素饮食与更深睡眠及更低夜间心率相关；综述：饮食—肠道菌群—心理健康机制的整合视角；耶鲁 Nature Medicine：51 项干预研究横评，生活方式与三类处方药可降低表观遗传年龄，非处方补充剂普遍无效；首个进入临床的表观遗传重编程疗法：Life Biosciences 的 ER-100 完成首位人类给药；全球活跃长寿临床试验达 44 项，近 30 天发生 8 项状态变动；Mount Sinai 扩展版 XPRIZE Healthspan 试验计划 2026 年底启动，同测药物＋营养补充＋监督运动；大阪大学随机对照试验：70% 植物蛋白饮食显著降低晚期 CKD 患者 TMAO；AI 多维表型分型识别出 7 种肠道代谢状态，为后生元精准选配提供依据；儿童特应性皮炎肠—肤轴综述：益生菌降至「可选辅助」，精准营养仍属研究阶段；定制营养改写保健品竞争逻辑：全球个性化营养补剂市场预计 124 亿美元，复合增速 14.7%；东京大学 npj Aging：24 周高剂量 NMN 显著升高 NAD+，却未改善听力、步速与握力；热灭活 AKK 复合后生元：小鼠 10 周改善脂肪肝与糖代谢，且不侵蚀肠道黏液层；尿石素 A 证据盘点：Mitopure 500 mg 的人体数据仍是同类中最扎实，但 2026 年 9 月仍无 NSF／USP 认证产品；美国国家衰老研究所启动尿石素 A 糖代谢三盲随机试验，计划入组 180 人；中国疾控中心：慢性病死亡占比超 88%，重在「主动健康、自我管理」；我国已启动新版《中国居民膳食指南》修订，将更强调个性化与中国特色；武汉：家庭医生按季监测血压血糖 BMI 腰围，完善「防筛治管康」闭环；48 位专家共识发布：慢性病早期预防「十保、九减、八防」行动框架
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Nature 背靠背两篇：幼年蛋白质限制通过储存蛋白 Lsp2「写入」成年寿命
    Two back-to-back Nature papers: early-life protein restriction writes adult lifespan through storage protein Lsp2
    东京大学与湖南师范大学两团队 9 月 23 日在《Nature》背靠背发表果蝇研究，锁定储存蛋白 Lsp2 为「营养记忆」分子。幼虫期限制蛋白质可持续压低 Lsp2，进而减少成年早期核糖体蛋白供给、抑制翻译活性，最终延长寿命；直接沉默 Lsp2 可复现延寿效果，且不损害生殖与体型。研究还发现仅限制苯丙氨酸、酪氨酸等 Lsp2 富集氨基酸即足以延寿，为生命早期营养编程提供了分子层面的解释。
    Two teams — the University of Tokyo and Hunan Normal University — published back-to-back Drosophila studies in Nature on Sept 23 identifying the storage protein Lsp2 as a molecular carrier of nutritional memory. Larval protein restriction persistently lowers Lsp2, reducing early-adult ribosomal protein supply and translational activity, ultimately extending lifespan; silencing Lsp2 reproduces the effect without harming reproduction or body size. Restricting only Lsp2-enriched amino acids such as phenylalanine and tyrosine was sufficient to extend lifespan, offering a molecular account of early-life nutritional programming.
  • Nature Communications：AI 构建膳食指数 EDISEA，高分者表观遗传年龄年轻约 4 岁
    Nature Communications: AI-derived EDISEA dietary index linked to ~4 years younger epigenetic age

    Researchers from Zhejiang University's First Affiliated Hospital and School of Public Health used elastic net regression to link 38 food groups to GrimAge2 acceleration, constructing an Empirical Dietary Index for Slowing Epigenetic Aging (EDISEA). Across development and validation cohorts, the highest versus lowest quintile differed by 4.17 and 3.77 years of GrimAge2 acceleration respectively; higher scores were associated with lower all-cause mortality (pooled HR 0.80) and lower incidence of cancer, dementia, cardiovascular disease and functional limitation. The design is observational and cannot establish causation.
  • Nature Health：高纤维、多植化素饮食与更深睡眠及更低夜间心率相关
    Nature Health: fiber- and phytochemical-rich diets linked to deeper sleep and lower nighttime heart rate

    Published Sept 27 in Nature Health, an analysis of 32 dietary factors in the Human Phenotype Project (28,000 enrolled) identified seven associated with better sleep architecture, including plant food variety, fiber density and phytochemical intake. Higher fiber intake tracked with more deep and REM sleep; greater minimally processed plant food variety tracked with lower nighttime heart rate. Heavier evening meals were linked to slightly longer total sleep but elevated nighttime heart rate, suggesting the extra sleep may come at a cost to quality.
  • 综述：饮食—肠道菌群—心理健康机制的整合视角
    Review: an integrated view of diet, the gut microbiome and mental health
    《Molecular Nutrition & Food Research》第 70 卷第 18 期（9 月 28 日）刊出综述，系统梳理特定膳食模式如何经微生物代谢物、免疫调节、迷走神经信号、肠屏障完整性与 HPA 轴等多条通路影响「微生物—肠—脑轴」，进而作用于情绪、认知与应激韧性。作者明确指出，尽管机制框架合理，但基于菌群的个性化饮食策略仍需更多设计严谨的人体研究验证，目前尚不足以支撑临床推荐。
    The Sept 28 issue of Molecular Nutrition & Food Research carries a review mapping how specific dietary patterns act on the microbiota–gut–brain axis through microbial metabolites, immune regulation, vagal signaling, gut barrier integrity and the HPA axis, shaping mood, cognition and stress resilience. The authors stress that although the mechanistic framework is plausible, personalized microbiome-informed dietary strategies still require validation in well-designed human studies and are not yet ready for clinical recommendation.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 耶鲁 Nature Medicine：51 项干预研究横评，生活方式与三类处方药可降低表观遗传年龄，非处方补充剂普遍无效
    Yale study in Nature Medicine: across 51 interventions, lifestyle and three prescription drugs lower epigenetic age — OTC supplements generally do not
    耶鲁大学 Higgins-Chen 实验室汇总 51 项人体干预研究、110 余项 DNA 甲基化标志物（含 16 种主流表观遗传时钟）进行系统评估。结果显示：运动联合健康饮食（地中海、低碳或低脂均可）稳定降低表观遗传年龄；处方药降幅最大，以二甲双胍、司美格鲁肽与抗 TNF 疗法最为显著；而鱼油、NMN 等非处方补充剂及高压氧等医疗操作普遍未见显著效果。研究还提示新一代时钟（DunedinPACE、PCGrimAge）对干预更敏感，且患病受试者的标志物改变幅度大于健康人。
    The Higgins-Chen lab at Yale pooled 51 human intervention studies and more than 110 DNA methylation markers (including 16 major epigenetic clocks). Exercise combined with a healthy diet — Mediterranean, low-carb or low-fat — consistently lowered epigenetic age; prescription drugs produced the largest reductions, led by metformin, semaglutide and anti-TNF therapy; over-the-counter supplements such as fish oil and NMN, along with procedures like hyperbaric oxygen, generally showed no significant effect. Newer clocks (DunedinPACE, PCGrimAge) were more responsive, and marker changes were larger in diseased than healthy participants.
  • 首个进入临床的表观遗传重编程疗法：Life Biosciences 的 ER-100 完成首位人类给药
    First clinical-stage epigenetic reprogramming therapy: Life Biosciences doses first human with ER-100
