    Boston-based Life Biosciences announced that the first human has received its gene therapy ER-100 (AAV2-OSK), which uses Oct4, Sox2 and Klf4 for partial epigenetic reprogramming aimed at repairing aged or damaged cells. Trials target open-angle glaucoma and non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy. The company describes it as the first epigenetic repair candidate cleared for clinical trials. The approach had previously been validated only in rodents and primates; human safety and efficacy data are still pending.
  • 全球活跃长寿临床试验达 44 项，近 30 天发生 8 项状态变动
    Global active longevity trials hold at 44, with eight status changes in the past month
    据 DataLookout 仪表盘（每日抓取 ClinicalTrials.gov）截至 9 月 27 日的统计，全球活跃长寿临床试验共 44 项，其中 21 项正在招募，涉及 38 家申办方。过去 30 天记录到 8 项状态变动，包括 9 月 17 日 Cedars-Sinai 的 NCT06682767 重大更新，以及 NCT06573463 由「尚未招募」转为「状态未知」。44 项试验中仅 7 项标注了明确分期，35 项未标注分期，反映该领域试验设计与分期登记仍待规范。
    According to the DataLookout dashboard, which pulls from ClinicalTrials.gov daily, 44 active longevity trials were running as of Sept 27, with 21 recruiting across 38 sponsors. Eight status changes were recorded in the past 30 days, including a major Sept 17 update to Cedars-Sinai's NCT06682767 and NCT06573463 moving from Not Yet Recruiting to Unknown. Only seven of the 44 trials list an explicit phase, while 35 list none — a sign that trial design and phase registration in the field still need standardization.
  • Mount Sinai 扩展版 XPRIZE Healthspan 试验计划 2026 年底启动，同测药物＋营养补充＋监督运动
    Mount Sinai's expanded XPRIZE Healthspan trial aims to launch by end of 2026, testing drug plus supplement plus supervised exercise
    Mount Sinai 于 9 月 26 日更新 NYC-Vita XPRIZE Healthspan 试验页面，称该试验将于 2026 年底前启动，是其已完成研究 NCT07058974 的扩展版本。试验将同时测试一种药物、一种营养补充剂与监督下运动，目标是预防或逆转与年龄相关的免疫功能改变。XPRIZE Healthspan 竞赛要求让 50–90 岁成年人的肌肉、认知与免疫功能至少恢复 10 年（目标 20 年）。具体方案将在研究设计定稿并获 IRB 与 FDA 批准后公布。
    Mount Sinai updated its NYC-Vita XPRIZE Healthspan trial page on Sept 26, stating the trial will open by the end of 2026 as an expanded version of the completed study NCT07058974. It will test a drug, a nutritional supplement and supervised exercise to prevent or reverse age-related immune shifts. The XPRIZE Healthspan competition aims to restore muscle, cognition and immune function in adults aged 50–90 by at least 10 years, with a 20-year goal. Final details await study design completion and IRB and FDA approvals.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 大阪大学随机对照试验：70% 植物蛋白饮食显著降低晚期 CKD 患者 TMAO
    Osaka University RCT: a 70% plant-protein diet significantly lowers TMAO in advanced CKD
    大阪大学团队在《American Journal of Kidney Diseases》发表随机对照试验，对 36 例晚期慢性肾病患者比较含 70% 与 50% 植物蛋白的等量常蛋白饮食（0.8 g/kg/天）干预 4 周的代谢效应。70% 植物蛋白组血清 TMAO 显著下降（组间差 −4.6 μg/mL），碳酸氢盐与血钙升高、全段甲状旁腺激素下降，产短链脂肪酸菌属如 Butyricicoccus 增加、促炎菌属 Bilophila 减少。两组血钾与瘦体重无差异，提示未增加高钾血症风险。样本量较小，需更大规模验证。
    Published in the American Journal of Kidney Diseases, an Osaka University randomized trial compared 70% versus 50% plant-protein isonitrogenous diets (0.8 g/kg/day) over four weeks in 36 patients with advanced CKD. The 70% group showed a significant fall in serum TMAO (between-group difference −4.6 μg/mL), higher bicarbonate and serum calcium, lower intact parathyroid hormone, and shifts toward short-chain fatty acid producers such as Butyricicoccus with fewer pro-inflammatory Bilophila. Potassium and lean mass did not differ, suggesting no added hyperkalemia risk. The sample was small and needs larger validation.
  • AI 多维表型分型识别出 7 种肠道代谢状态，为后生元精准选配提供依据

    《Molecular Nutrition & Food Research》刊出研究，通过时间分辨的多模态测量表征粪便分散体系，由人工智能整合理化描述符，识别出 7 种肠道代谢表型。机器学习、菌群图谱与常规实验室指标的联合分析支持这些表型的生物学一致性，作者认为这为未来非侵入性功能评估以及「按表型选配」益生元、益生菌与后生元策略提供了基础框架，但目前仍属方法学与概念验证阶段。
    A study in Molecular Nutrition & Food Research used time-resolved multimodal measurements of stool dispersions and had artificial intelligence integrate physicochemical descriptors to identify seven gut metabolic phenotypes. Machine learning, microbiome profiling and standard laboratory markers together supported their biological coherence. The authors position this as a basis for future non-invasive functional assessment and phenotype-guided prebiotic, probiotic or postbiotic strategies, though the work remains methodological and proof-of-concept.
  • 儿童特应性皮炎肠—肤轴综述：益生菌降至「可选辅助」，精准营养仍属研究阶段
    Gut–skin axis in pediatric atopic dermatitis: probiotics downgraded to optional adjuncts, precision nutrition still research-stage
    《Nutrients》刊登叙述性综述，检索至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的文献，评估儿童特应性皮炎的营养管理证据。当前指南支持条件允许时母乳喂养、辅食期保持饮食多样性、避免不必要饮食排除、纠正已证实的营养缺乏并管理已确认的食物过敏。荟萃分析显示益生菌与合生元可降低 SCORAD 评分，但合并效应量小、异质性高，未达最小临床重要差异，因此应表述为可选辅助而非推荐治疗。微生物组与多组学表型分型目前尚无经验证的饮食反应预测价值。
    A narrative review in Nutrients, covering literature through July 31, 2026, assessed nutritional management in pediatric atopic dermatitis. Guidelines support breastfeeding when feasible, dietary diversity during complementary feeding, avoiding unnecessary elimination, correcting confirmed deficiencies and managing confirmed food allergy. Meta-analyses show probiotics and synbiotics reduce SCORAD scores, but pooled effects were small and heterogeneous and did not reach minimal clinically important difference — supporting an optional adjunct rather than a recommended therapy. Microbiome and multi-omic phenotyping have no validated dietary-response predictive value yet.
  • 定制营养改写保健品竞争逻辑：全球个性化营养补剂市场预计 124 亿美元，复合增速 14.7%
    Customized nutrition rewrites the supplement playbook: global personalized supplement market projected at $12.4B, 14.7% CAGR
    据报道，传统保健品龙头汤臣倍健两年营收缩水超 30 亿元，而个性化营养公司 Nourished 已售出超 6000 万粒定制维生素软糖、营收增速 61%；国内定制营养品牌「营养日记」以月费约 400 元的方案切入，依据基于《Cell》14 项衰老标志物框架开发的 7D 评估模型，从 7 个维度摸排营养缺口。Stratistics MRC 数据显示，2026 年全球个性化营养补剂市场规模预计 124 亿美元，复合年增长率 14.7%。资本层面，Bioniq 于 2026 年 3 月被康宝莱以最高 1.5 亿美元收购。
    Reporting indicates that Chinese supplement leader By-Health has shed more than 3 billion yuan in revenue over two years, while personalized nutrition company Nourished has sold over 60 million custom vitamin gummies with 61% revenue growth. Domestic brand Nutrition Diary entered at roughly 400 yuan per month, using a 7D assessment model built on the 14 hallmarks of aging published in Cell. Stratistics MRC puts the global personalized supplement market at $12.4 billion in 2026 with a 14.7% CAGR. On the capital side, Herbalife acquired UK-based Bioniq in March 2026 for up to $150 million.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 东京大学 npj Aging：24 周高剂量 NMN 显著升高 NAD+，却未改善听力、步速与握力
    University of Tokyo in npj Aging: 24 weeks of high-dose NMN raises NAD+ but does not improve hearing, gait speed or grip strength
    东京大学团队在《npj Aging》发表随机双盲安慰剂对照试验，62 名健康老年人按 1:1 分组，每日补充 1250 mg NMN 或安慰剂，持续 24 周。结果显示 NMN 组血液 NAD+ 及 NMN、NAM、NAR、NAMN、NAAD 等代谢物显著升高，证明长期口服可有效增强全身 NAD 代谢；但听力（主要终点）、步速、握力、30 秒坐立、6 分钟步行与肌肉功能等指标均未改善，总体安全性良好。研究提示需理性看待 NMN 的「抗衰老」宣称，肝脏异常人群补充时宜监测肝功能。研究由 NMN 供应商 Mirailab Bioscience 资助。
    In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in npj Aging, 62 healthy older adults received 1,250 mg NMN daily or placebo for 24 weeks. Blood NAD+ and related metabolites (NMN, NAM, NAR, NAMN, NAAD) rose significantly in the treatment arm, confirming that long-term oral NMN effectively augments systemic NAD metabolism. Yet hearing (the primary endpoint), gait speed, grip strength, the 30-second chair stand, six-minute walk and muscle function did not improve; overall safety was good. The authors urge a measured view of anti-aging claims and monitoring of liver function in people with abnormal liver enzymes. The study was funded by NMN supplier Mirailab Bioscience.
  • 热灭活 AKK 复合后生元：小鼠 10 周改善脂肪肝与糖代谢，且不侵蚀肠道黏液层
    Heat-killed AKK postbiotic: 10 weeks improved fatty liver and glucose metabolism in mice without eroding the mucus layer
    韩国团队在《Scientific Reports》发表动物实验，对高脂饮食诱导的肥胖小鼠每日口服 1×10¹⁰ 细胞剂量的热灭活嗜黏蛋白阿克曼菌（AKK）与普通拟杆菌复合菌体，持续 10 周。结果显示可抑制体重增长与内脏脂肪堆积、缓解肝脂肪变性、优化葡萄糖稳态，并重塑肠道微生态；热灭活后菌体失去增殖与降解黏蛋白的活性，肠道黏液屏障完整性反而改善。值得注意的是小鼠进食量未变，体重与体脂变化并非来自节食。研究仅为小鼠实验，作者明确提示结论不能直接外推到人体。
    A Korean team published animal work in Scientific Reports in which high-fat-diet obese mice received 1×10¹⁰ cells daily of heat-killed Akkermansia muciniphila plus Bacteroides vulgatus for 10 weeks. The intervention suppressed weight gain and visceral fat accumulation, eased hepatic steatosis, improved glucose homeostasis and reshaped the gut microbiota. Because heat-killed bacteria cannot proliferate or degrade mucin, gut mucus barrier integrity actually improved. Notably food intake was unchanged, so body composition changes were not from caloric restriction. The authors caution the findings are mouse-only and cannot be extrapolated directly to humans.
  • 尿石素 A 证据盘点：Mitopure 500 mg 的人体数据仍是同类中最扎实，但 2026 年 9 月仍无 NSF／USP 认证产品
    Urolithin A evidence check: Mitopure's 500 mg human data remains the strongest in class, yet no NSF/USP-certified product existed as of September 2026
    行业盘点指出，尿石素 A 的人体证据在同类成分中相对扎实：2022 年《Nature Metabolism》随机双盲试验显示老年人每日 500 mg Mitopure 四个月可改善肌肉耐力与握力，该剂量也成为零售产品标准；2024 年《JAMA Network Open》在 40–64 岁中年人观察到 VO₂max 与抗疲劳改善。同时文章明确指出三点局限：尿石素 A 与 NMN／NR 的联合方案尚无任何人体试验；多数产品缺乏第三方认证（截至 2026 年 9 月，NSF 与 USP 公开数据库均无尿石素 A 产品）；生物利用度数据主要来自 Mitopure 晶型，其他原料的纯度与吸收资料有限。
    An industry review notes urolithin A's human evidence is comparatively robust for its class: a 2022 Nature Metabolism randomized double-blind trial showed 500 mg Mitopure daily for four months improved muscle endurance and grip strength in older adults — the dose now standardized in retail products — while a 2024 JAMA Network Open trial in adults aged 40–64 found gains in VO2 max and fatigue resistance. Three limitations are flagged: no human trial has tested urolithin A combined with NMN or NR; most products lack third-party certification (as of September 2026 neither NSF nor USP databases listed any urolithin A product); and bioavailability data come mainly from Mitopure's crystalline form, with limited purity and absorption data for other raw materials.
  • 美国国家衰老研究所启动尿石素 A 糖代谢三盲随机试验，计划入组 180 人
    US National Institute on Aging launches triple-masked randomized trial of urolithin A for glucose metabolism, targeting 180 participants
    美国国家衰老研究所（NIA）登记的 NCT06274749 试验于 2026 年 9 月 30 日启动，计划入组 180 名 55 岁以上、BMI ≥ 27 的健康成人，随机接受每日 1 g 尿石素 A 或安慰剂共 8 周，采用四盲设计（受试者、照护者、研究者、结局评估者）。主要终点为补充后 β 细胞对葡萄糖的响应速率；次要终点包括肠促胰素分泌、基于大腿 MRI/MRS 的线粒体呼吸、脑氧化代谢、肠道菌群组成与免疫细胞比例。所用原料已获 FDA GRAS 认定（GRN No. 000791），预计 2027 年 3 月完成。
    Registered by the US National Institute on Aging, trial NCT06274749 starts Sept 30, 2026, aiming to enroll 180 healthy adults aged 55+ with BMI ≥ 27, randomized to 1 g urolithin A daily or placebo for eight weeks in a quadruple-masked design covering participants, care providers, investigators and outcome assessors. The primary endpoint is the rate at which beta cells respond to glucose; secondary endpoints include incretin secretion, mitochondrial respiration via thigh MRI/MRS, brain oxidative metabolism, gut microbiome composition and immune cell proportions. The material holds FDA GRAS status (GRN No. 000791), with completion expected in March 2027.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 中国疾控中心：慢性病死亡占比超 88%，重在「主动健康、自我管理」
    China CDC: chronic diseases account for over 88% of deaths, making proactive self-management essential
    今年全民健康文明生活方式宣传月主题为「主动健康 自我管理」。中国疾控中心慢病处处长赖建强、慢病中心主任吴静等专家指出，我国慢性病导致的死亡占总死亡的 88% 以上，仅靠患病后就医的被动模式难以遏制高发态势，必须推动健康关口前移。今年 7 月国务院印发《国民健康「十五五」规划》，提出到 2030 年人均预期寿命达 80 岁、居民健康素养水平提升至 40%。专家建议普通人优先做好几件关键事：定期体检并关注血压、血糖、血脂、腰围与体重；均衡膳食、避免久坐；不吸烟、限制饮酒、保证充足睡眠；指标异常及时就医。
    This year's national healthy-lifestyle campaign is themed 'proactive health, self-management.' Officials from China CDC's chronic disease division note that chronic diseases account for more than 88% of all deaths in China, and that a passive model of seeking care only after illness cannot curb the trend — health must be moved upstream. The State Council's 15th Five-Year National Health Plan, issued in July, targets average life expectancy of 80 years and health literacy of 40% by 2030. Experts advise prioritizing regular checkups tracking blood pressure, glucose, lipids, waist circumference and weight; balanced diet and less sitting; no smoking, limited alcohol and adequate sleep; and prompt care when markers go abnormal.
  • 我国已启动新版《中国居民膳食指南》修订，将更强调个性化与中国特色
    China has begun revising its national dietary guidelines, with stronger emphasis on personalization and Chinese dietary patterns
    国家卫生健康委表示将进一步组织做好《中国居民膳食指南》修订工作。现行指南除面向健康成人提出八条准则外，还制定 9 种特定人群膳食指南，并针对糖尿病、高血压等慢性病制定食养指南，提供不同地区、季节与饮食习惯的个性化食谱示例；同时依托数字化平台上线小程序端口提供膳食调理参考。修订方向包括：针对营养失衡制定符合国情的干预建议；用更通俗语言提升可操作性；结合科学前沿、国民营养监测数据与中医药传统智慧打造中国特色膳食模式；按地域与个人营养状况提出个性化建议。
    China's National Health Commission says it will further organize revision of the Chinese Dietary Guidelines. The current edition sets eight principles for healthy adults plus dietary guidelines for nine specific populations, alongside therapeutic diet guides for diabetes, hypertension and other chronic diseases with personalized menu examples by region, season and dietary habit; a digital platform and mini-program provide dietary reference tools. Revision directions include intervention advice tailored to national nutritional imbalances, more accessible and actionable language, a distinctly Chinese dietary pattern drawing on scientific frontiers, national nutrition surveillance data and traditional Chinese medicine wisdom, and personalized recommendations by region and individual status.
  • 武汉：家庭医生按季监测血压血糖 BMI 腰围，完善「防筛治管康」闭环
    Wuhan: family doctors to monitor blood pressure, glucose, BMI and waist quarterly, closing the prevention-to-rehabilitation loop
    武汉市卫健委在 9 月 29 日发布的政协提案答复中介绍，该市依托基本公共卫生服务、「323」攻坚行动、体重管理年活动与老年人体检等工作，为高血压、糖尿病等慢性病患者及高危人群建立健康档案，签约家庭医生每季度监测血压、血糖、BMI 与腰围，并根据监测结果开展营养配餐与科学运动宣教，落实个性化健康干预。2024–2025 年该市还组织覆盖 16 个区、4000 余人次的含糖加工食品消费量专项调查，为制定控糖干预策略提供数据支撑。
    In a Sept 29 reply to a political consultative conference proposal, the Wuhan Municipal Health Commission described building health records for patients with hypertension, diabetes and other chronic diseases as well as high-risk groups, drawing on basic public health services, the '323' campaign, the weight-management year and elderly checkups. Contracted family doctors monitor blood pressure, glucose, BMI and waist circumference quarterly and deliver nutrition and exercise guidance based on results. In 2024–2025 the city also ran a survey of sugar-sweetened processed food intake covering more than 4,000 person-visits across 16 districts to inform sugar-control strategy.
  • 48 位专家共识发布：慢性病早期预防「十保、九减、八防」行动框架
    Consensus from 48 experts: a 10-keep, 9-reduce, 8-prevent framework for early chronic disease prevention
    由「癌症、心脑血管、呼吸和代谢性疾病防治研究国家科技重大专项」项目组牵头、全国 48 位多学科专家共同制定的《面向个体健康行为促进的慢性病早期预防专家共识》在《中国慢性病预防与控制》杂志发表。共识提出「十保、九减、八防」框架：保持合理饮食、充足饮水（成人每日 1500–1700 毫升）、每周至少 150 分钟中等强度运动、良好睡眠（7–8 小时）与适宜 BMI（18.5–23.9 kg/m²）等十项；减少盐（＜5 克/天）、添加糖（＜25 克/天）、烹调油（25–30 克/天）、酒精、久坐等九类风险因素；防跌倒、防吸烟、防合餐、防极端天气等八项侵害，为成年居民提供系统化、普适化的早期预防行为框架。
    Led by the national science and technology major project on cancer, cardiovascular, respiratory and metabolic disease prevention and developed by 48 multidisciplinary experts, a consensus on early chronic disease prevention through individual health behavior was published in the Chinese Journal of Prevention and Control of Chronic Diseases. It proposes a 10-keep, 9-reduce, 8-prevent framework: keep a balanced diet, adequate hydration (1,500–1,700 ml daily for adults), at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity activity weekly, good sleep (7–8 hours) and a BMI of 18.5–23.9 kg/m², among ten items; reduce nine risk factors including salt (under 5 g/day), added sugar (under 25 g/day), cooking oil (25–30 g/day), alcohol and prolonged sitting; and prevent eight harms including falls, smoking, shared utensil use and extreme weather.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-09-29
item.description: 2026-09-29 简报，共 20 条：Gut：机器学习融合肠道菌群数据，升级肝硬化住院风险预后模型；肠道菌群与囊泡特征可预测重度哮喘靶向药度普利尤单抗疗效；中日友好医院曹彬/邹晓辉团队构建口腔与气道菌群基因组目录，含超9.9万个高质量基因组；奥斯陆大学团队解读肠道菌群CRISPR免疫库：老年人肠道中的菌际交锋档案；东京大学24周高剂量NMN随机对照试验：NAD+持续升高但未见抗衰老获益；L-Nutra庆祝始创模拟禁食饮食Prolon问世十周年：136项专利、40余项临床与D轮融资；BioAro 将 AI 辅助长寿生物活性物组合 LONgevity+ 引入美国与英国市场；中南大学湘雅医学院举办长寿科技产学研报告会，发布「预见时光」衰老时钟与五维营养支持体系；《精准营养产品研发指南》团体标准启动编制，填补行业研发规范空白；中国食品科学技术学会科普：B族维生素联结肠道菌群与心理健康的双重角色；个性化营养赛道爆发：Nourished卖出6000万粒定制软糖，营养日记以7D评估模型切入国内市场；综述：地中海饮食或经肠道菌群途径保护大脑健康；NutraIngredients：PDRN 或成口服美容补剂赛道下一个热点成分；川北医学院团队：槲皮素缓解糖尿病神经痛，肠—脊髓代谢轴是关键；希吉亚生物 Ca-AKG、NMN、脱氮黄素三款原料同获适老化营养创新认证；2026年9月补剂搜索趋势：虾青素、纳豆激酶、谷胱甘肽领涨长寿赛道；国内首个AI健康生活方式沉浸式体验馆亮相北京昌平；国家健康体重管理中心建设项目启动，营养管理软件首次列入必备设备清单；唯蜜瘦智能腹部按摩仪多中心临床研究于《中医临床研究》刊发；武汉市卫健委回应政协提案：将分层推进餐后2小时血糖纳入体检筛查
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Gut：机器学习融合肠道菌群数据，升级肝硬化住院风险预后模型
    Machine learning integrating gut microbiome data upgrades cirrhosis prognosis model (Gut)
    《Gut》发表一项跨国宏基因组研究，发现肝硬化住院患者的肠道菌群在结构与功能上呈现独特特征。研究将菌群数据与机器学习相结合，显著提升了肝硬化病情与住院风险的预测效能，提示菌群标志物有望并入临床预后评估体系，为功能医学视角下的肝病管理提供新的分层工具。
    A multinational metagenomic study in Gut found that hospitalized patients with cirrhosis carry distinct gut microbiome structural and functional profiles. Combining microbiome features with machine learning markedly improved prediction of disease course and hospitalization risk, suggesting microbiome markers could join clinical prognostic models for liver disease management.
  • 肠道菌群与囊泡特征可预测重度哮喘靶向药度普利尤单抗疗效
    Gut microbiome and vesicle signatures predict response to dupilumab in severe asthma
    《Allergy》发表 PRISM 研究成果：研究者在多腔室前瞻框架下分析重度哮喘患者的粪便与气道菌群及囊泡特征，发现其与抗 IL-4R 靶向药度普利尤单抗的治疗应答显著相关。这提示未来启动昂贵生物制剂治疗前，或可先通过无创粪便样本为患者绘制菌群地图，精准筛选最可能获益的个体，迈向重度哮喘的个体化精准干预。
    The PRISM study in Allergy analyzed stool and airway microbiome plus vesicle signatures in severe asthma, finding them significantly associated with treatment response to the anti-IL-4R biologic dupilumab. Non-invasive stool-based microbiome mapping could help clinicians pre-select patients most likely to benefit before starting costly biologics.
  • 中日友好医院曹彬/邹晓辉团队构建口腔与气道菌群基因组目录，含超9.9万个高质量基因组
    C-J Friendship Hospital team builds oral-airway genome catalog with 99,000+ high-quality genomes
    团队在《NPJ Biofilms and Microbiomes》发布 OAPGC 口腔与气道原核生物基因组目录，整合超9.9万个高质量基因组。分析全球1.6万余份粪便样本发现约12.3%的口腔/气道物种可迁移入肠，在肝硬化、结直肠癌等疾病状态下多样性与累积丰度显著攀升，将其纳入模型可提升结直肠癌交叉诊断性能，为呼吸与消化系统疾病的精准诊疗提供共享参考资源。
    Published in NPJ Biofilms and Microbiomes, the OAPGC catalog integrates over 99,000 high-quality oral and airway prokaryotic genomes. Analysis of 16,000+ global fecal samples showed about 12.3% of oral/airway species can migrate into the gut, rising markedly in cirrhosis and colorectal cancer and improving cross-cohort CRC diagnostic performance when included in models.
  • 奥斯陆大学团队解读肠道菌群CRISPR免疫库：老年人肠道中的菌际交锋档案
    Oslo team decodes gut bacterial CRISPR-Cas immune archives in 1,034 older adults
    《Gut Microbes》刊登奥斯陆大学研究，基于1034名老年人粪便宏基因组构建了含约1700种原核生物、1.95万个病毒与7.4万个CRISPR-Cas免疫库的大规模图谱。细菌的CRISPR间隔序列高度个性化，显著倾向靶向同一样本中共存的移动遗传元件，免疫记忆由局部微环境暴露驱动，并与宿主生活方式相关，甚至可追溯出与高频乳制品摄入相关的双歧杆菌保守免疫记忆。
    An Oslo University study in Gut Microbes built a large-scale catalog from 1,034 older adults comprising ~1,700 prokaryotes, 19,500 viruses and 74,200 CRISPR-Cas immune records. CRISPR spacers were highly individualized and preferentially targeted co-resident mobile elements, driven by local microenvironment exposure and linked to host lifestyle, including conserved immune memory in Bifidobacterium tied to frequent dairy intake.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 东京大学24周高剂量NMN随机对照试验：NAD+持续升高但未见抗衰老获益
    24-week high-dose NMN trial (University of Tokyo): sustained NAD+ rise, no anti-aging benefit
    东京大学团队在《npj Aging》发表62名健康老年人参与的随机双盲安慰剂对照试验：每日1250mg NMN持续24周显著提升血液NAD+及多种相关代谢物，但听力、握力、步速、30秒坐立、6分钟步行等衰老相关终点均无显著改善。高剂量下安全性总体良好，但一例基线肝酶异常者转氨酶进一步升高，提示NMN抗衰证据仍不足、肝功能异常人群需谨慎。
    A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in npj Aging enrolled 62 healthy older adults: 1,250 mg/day NMN for 24 weeks significantly raised blood NAD+ and related metabolites, but showed no significant improvement in hearing, grip strength, gait speed, 30-second chair stand or six-minute walk. Safety was generally good, though one participant with baseline liver-enzyme abnormalities worsened, underscoring that anti-aging evidence remains insufficient.
  • L-Nutra庆祝始创模拟禁食饮食Prolon问世十周年：136项专利、40余项临床与D轮融资
    L-Nutra marks 10th anniversary of Prolon fasting-mimicking diet: 136 patents, 40+ trials, Series D
    长寿营养公司 L-Nutra 宣布其5日模拟禁食饮食（FMD）产品 Prolon 问世十周年：累计持有136项长寿与疾病缓解相关专利、完成40余项临床试验，获1.2万余名执业医师处方推荐。据披露，近期两项人体试验显示连续三个周期可诱导细胞自噬并使生物学年龄平均逆转2.5岁，公司已完成由 Mubadala 领投的8350万美元D轮融资，目标未来十年惠及一亿人。
    Longevity nutrition company L-Nutra marked ten years of Prolon, its 5-day fasting-mimicking diet: 136 patents in longevity and disease remission, 40+ completed clinical trials and recommendations from 12,000+ practitioners. Recent human trials reportedly showed autophagy induction and an average 2.5-year reversal of biological age after three cycles; the company closed an $83.5M Series D led by Mubadala.
  • BioAro 将 AI 辅助长寿生物活性物组合 LONgevity+ 引入美国与英国市场
    BioAro launches AI-assisted LONgevity+ bioactives in the U.S. and U.K.
    精准健康公司 BioAro 继迪拜首发后，将 LONgevity+ 长寿生物活性物组合推向美英市场。其配方结合科学文献分析、生物通路研究与AI辅助研发，围绕细胞能量、代谢调节、氧化应激与炎症等衰老机制进行组合式设计，并通过 BioAro Intelligence 平台以「健康目标—方案」结构连接产品、成分与科学依据，体现AI驱动个性化长寿补剂的新路径。
    Following its Dubai debut, BioAro brought its LONgevity+ longevity bioactives to the U.S. and U.K. Formulations combine biotech literature analysis, biological pathway research and AI-assisted development around cellular energy, metabolic regulation, oxidative stress and inflammation, while the BioAro Intelligence platform organizes products and evidence into goal-based protocols — an AI-driven approach to personalized longevity supplements.
  • 中南大学湘雅医学院举办长寿科技产学研报告会，发布「预见时光」衰老时钟与五维营养支持体系
    Changsha symposium unveils aging-clock assessment and five-dimension nutrition support system
    长寿科技产学研生态共建专题报告会9月22日在中南大学湘雅医学院举行，高校、医疗与康养产业近130名代表参会。长寿科技品牌生命记发布「预见时光」衰老时钟评估与「溯光系列五维营养支持体系」，确立指标具备循证依据、依托中南大学科研底座、适配体检与健康管理机构场景三大标准，形成「评估—干预」服务闭环，推动生物学年龄评估从实验室走向普惠健康服务。
    A longevity-tech industry-academia symposium was held at Central South University Xiangya School of Medicine with nearly 130 participants. The brand Shengmingji launched the foreseeTime aging-clock assessment and a five-dimension nutrition support system, setting standards for evidence-based indicators, university-backed research and fitness for physical-exam and health-management settings, forming an assessment-intervention loop that brings biological-age evaluation into mainstream services.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 《精准营养产品研发指南》团体标准启动编制，填补行业研发规范空白
    China launches group standard drafting for precision nutrition product development guidelines
    由农业农村部食物与营养发展研究所、中国中医科学院、北京中医药大学、中国农业科学院等权威机构联合圣泽松生物集团共同参与的《精准营养产品研发指南》团体标准近日启动编制，将明确从原料筛选、配方设计、功效研究、安全性评估到产品上市评价的全链条研发规范，建立科学、可落地的评价体系，补齐国内精准营养产品标准短板，助推大健康产业提质升级。
    A group standard, the Precision Nutrition Product Development Guidelines, has begun drafting with participation from the Institute of Food and Nutrition Development (MARA), China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, Beijing University of Chinese Medicine and others. It will define end-to-end R&D norms covering ingredient screening, formulation, efficacy research, safety assessment and market evaluation, filling a standards gap in China's precision nutrition industry.
  • 中国食品科学技术学会科普：B族维生素联结肠道菌群与心理健康的双重角色
    B vitamins bridge gut microbiota and mental health, CIFST science feature explains
    浙江大学阎芙洁副研究员等撰文指出，B族维生素既是中枢神经系统合成5-羟色胺、多巴胺、GABA等神经递质的必需辅因子，也是肠道菌群代谢的枢纽分子；地中海饮食等富含全谷物、膳食纤维与益生元的模式可促进产B族维生素益生菌增殖。文章提出未来可结合MTHFR基因多态性检测与微生物组测序，为患者定制活性形式B族维生素与针对性益生菌组合的个体化营养干预。
    A science feature by Zhejiang University researchers on the CIFST platform explains that B vitamins serve as essential cofactors for neurotransmitter synthesis while also acting as hub molecules in gut microbial metabolism; fiber- and prebiotic-rich diets boost B-vitamin-producing probiotics. Future individualized interventions may combine MTHFR polymorphism testing with microbiome sequencing to tailor active B-vitamin and probiotic combinations.
  • 个性化营养赛道爆发：Nourished卖出6000万粒定制软糖，营养日记以7D评估模型切入国内市场
    Personalized nutrition booms: Nourished sells 60 million gummies; 7D-assessment brands enter China
    据山西经济日报报道，2026年全球个性化营养补剂市场规模预计达124亿美元、年复合增长14.7%。康宝莱以最高1.5亿美元收购Bioniq，Rem3dy Health完成1400万英镑融资；国内定制营养品牌「营养日记」基于《Cell》衰老标志物框架研发7D评估模型，以月费约400元的「测—补—验—调」方案切入一、二线城市，而传统龙头汤臣倍健两年营收缩水超30亿元，行业竞争逻辑正被定制化改写。
    Per Shanxi Economic Daily, the global personalized nutrition supplement market is projected at $12.4 billion in 2026, growing 14.7% annually. Herbalife acquired Bioniq for up to $150M and Rem3dy Health raised £14M; in China, the custom-nutrition brand Yingyang Riji applies a 7D assessment model built on Cell's hallmarks of aging with a roughly 400-yuan monthly test-supplement-verify-adjust plan, while incumbent By-Health has lost over 3 billion yuan in revenue across two years.
  • 综述：地中海饮食或经肠道菌群途径保护大脑健康
    Narrative review: Mediterranean diet may protect the brain via the gut microbiome
    《Nutrients》发表的叙事综述梳理了地中海饮食与菌群功能、免疫调节、肠屏障完整性及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病相关脑改变的关联证据，认为其经菌群重塑发挥神经保护作用具有生物学合理性，但尚不能确立因果方向。作者建议结合AI可穿戴饮食监测与菌群标志物开展长期干预研究，推动认知衰老与神经退行性疾病预防的精准营养策略。
    A narrative review in Nutrients synthesized evidence linking Mediterranean-diet adherence to microbiome function, immune regulation, intestinal barrier integrity and neurodegeneration-related brain changes in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. The gut-mediated neuroprotection is biologically plausible but causality is unproven; the authors propose AI-enabled wearable dietary monitoring plus microbiome markers for long-term trials to advance precision nutrition for cognitive aging.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • NutraIngredients：PDRN 或成口服美容补剂赛道下一个热点成分
    PDRN heralds a new era in beauty-from-within supplements?
    NutraIngredients 分析指出，源自鲑鱼生殖组织的多聚脱氧核糖核苷酸（PDRN）在韩国医美注射领域应用多年，正快速向口服美容补剂扩展，主打皮肤再生、屏障修复与抗光老化方向。行业观察认为 PDRN 有望接棒胶原蛋白与烟酰胺成为「beauty from within」新晋热点，但其口服后的剂量换算、吸收路径与临床证据仍待更多研究完善。
    NutraIngredients reports that polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN), long used in Korean aesthetic medicine injections, is rapidly expanding into oral beauty-from-within supplements targeting skin regeneration, barrier repair and anti-photoaging. Analysts see PDRN as a potential next trending ingredient after collagen and niacinamide, though oral dosing, absorption pathways and clinical evidence still need strengthening.
  • 川北医学院团队：槲皮素缓解糖尿病神经痛，肠—脊髓代谢轴是关键
    Quercetin relieves painful diabetic neuropathy via gut microbial remodeling, Chinese team reports
    《Phytomedicine》刊载川北医学院附属医院林菁艳团队研究：槲皮素干预可重塑糖尿病神经痛模型的肠道菌群结构，并伴随脊髓甜菜碱相关代谢改变，经「肠—脊髓」代谢轴减轻神经病理性疼痛。研究为植物来源活性成分经菌群途径干预糖尿病并发症提供了新机制证据，也为槲皮素类补剂的功能定位与后续临床转化提供了参考。
    A Phytomedicine study by Lin Jingyan's team at North Sichuan Medical College shows quercetin reshapes gut microbiota in painful diabetic neuropathy models alongside spinal betaine-related metabolic changes, easing neuropathic pain through a gut-spinal metabolic axis. The work offers mechanistic support for plant-derived actives targeting diabetic complications via the microbiome and informs positioning of quercetin supplements.
  • 希吉亚生物 Ca-AKG、NMN、脱氮黄素三款原料同获适老化营养创新认证
    Hygieia's Ca-AKG, NMN and deazaflavin ingredients win senior-nutrition innovation certification
    希吉亚生物宣布旗下 Enerlive Ca-AKG、SirtuAct NMN 与 DeazaKing 脱氮黄素三款原料同获 FDL 数食主张「2026年度适老化营养产品力创新认证」。三款原料分别对应健康衰老与代谢、成熟NAD+前体的工艺竞争与前沿抗衰分子布局；公司依托 Zymevolver 合成生物平台、1500平米研发中试平台与8000平米GMP车间，强调从分子发现到稳定供应的全链路原料能力。
    Hygieia Biotech announced that three ingredients — Enerlive Ca-AKG, SirtuAct NMN and DeazaKing deazaflavin — won FDL's 2026 senior-nutrition product innovation certification. Spanning healthy-aging metabolism, mature NAD+-precursor manufacturing and next-generation anti-aging molecules, the portfolio leverages the Zymevolver synthetic-biology platform with GMP production, highlighting full-chain ingredient capabilities from discovery to stable supply.
  • 2026年9月补剂搜索趋势：虾青素、纳豆激酶、谷胱甘肽领涨长寿赛道
    September 2026 supplement search trends: astaxanthin, nattokinase and glutathione lead longevity interest
    Rising Trends 发布9月补剂搜索趋势报告：虾青素以月搜索30.1万次、同比+307%成为增长最快的长寿成分，谷胱甘肽+50%（脂质体形式+123%）、纳豆激酶+173%、NMN+172%、尿石素A+123%持续升温；小檗碱热度持平且近三月下降18%。报告同时警示 BPC-157、MOTS-c 等实验性研究肽搜索激增但证据不足，应在专业医学监督下谨慎对待。
    Rising Trends' September report shows astaxanthin as the fastest-rising longevity term (301,000 monthly searches, +307% YoY), with glutathione +50% (liposomal +123%), nattokinase +173%, NMN +172% and urolithin A +123%; berberine is flat and down 18% over three months. The report cautions that experimental research peptides like BPC-157 and MOTS-c are surging in searches despite limited evidence and warrant medical supervision.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 国内首个AI健康生活方式沉浸式体验馆亮相北京昌平
    China's first immersive AI healthy-lifestyle experience center opens in Beijing's Changping
    超超AI健康生活方式体验馆9月28日在北京昌平未来科学城启幕，设置运动疗法、中医养生、营养免疫、居家康养、健康管理等功能区，公众可体验VR运动、律动健康椅及由清华长庚医院AI健康联合研发中心等联合研发的SupRing智能戒指。体验馆倡导从「被动治疗」到「主动健康」、从「千人一面」到「一人一策」的转变，构建「评估—干预—监测—反馈」闭环，呼应「人工智能+医疗卫生」政策方向。
    The Chaochao AI healthy-lifestyle experience center opened in Changping Future Science City on Sept 28, with zones for exercise therapy, TCM wellness, nutritional immunity, home care and health management. Visitors can try VR exercise, vibration chairs and the SupRing smart ring co-developed with Tsinghua Changgung Hospital's AI health center, embodying the shift from passive treatment to proactive, personalized health with an assess-intervene-monitor-feedback loop.
  • 国家健康体重管理中心建设项目启动，营养管理软件首次列入必备设备清单
    National weight-management center program adds nutrition software to required equipment list
    2026年国家健康体重管理中心建设项目启动，依托中央财政专项资金，优先支持国家慢性病综合防控示范区的县级综合医院建设。项目首次将营养管理软件与生活方式评估设备列入必备清单，要求搭建涵盖人体成分、营养代谢评估及营养、运动、心理、睡眠四维个体化干预的一体化服务体系，推动体重管理从门诊向县域中心、从硬件配置向长期运营闭环升级。
    China's 2026 national healthy-weight management center program, backed by central funds, prioritizes county-level general hospitals in chronic-disease demonstration zones. Nutrition management software and lifestyle-assessment devices appear on the required equipment list for the first time, mandating an integrated service system covering body-composition and metabolic assessment plus individualized nutrition, exercise, psychological and sleep interventions — shifting weight management from outpatient clinics to county centers with sustainable operations.
  • 唯蜜瘦智能腹部按摩仪多中心临床研究于《中医临床研究》刊发
    Multicenter study of Weimisou smart abdominal massager published in TCM Clinical Research
    由浙江中医药大学、北京中医药大学王琦书院、国家中医体质与治未病研究院等共同完成的多中心开放标签单臂试验发表于《中医临床研究》：61名超重及肥胖受试者使用神阙穴温灸联合EMS脉冲的智能腹部按摩仪并配合饮食干预2个月，平均减重10.8kg、腰围缩减13.6cm、BMI下降4.1，全部受试者减重≥5%。研究为消费级中医体重管理设备提供循证支撑，但缺乏安慰剂对照，解读需谨慎。
    A multicenter, open-label, single-arm trial published in TCM Clinical Research, conducted with Zhejiang Chinese Medical University and Beijing University of Chinese Medicine, enrolled 61 adults with overweight or obesity. Two months of a smart abdominal massager combining Shenque-point moxibustion heating with EMS pulses plus dietary intervention yielded mean weight loss of 10.8 kg, waist reduction of 13.6 cm and BMI drop of 4.1; all participants lost ≥5%. Lacking placebo control, results warrant cautious interpretation.
  • 武汉市卫健委回应政协提案：将分层推进餐后2小时血糖纳入体检筛查
    Wuhan health commission to stage in 2-hour postprandial glucose screening in checkups
    武汉市卫健委9月28日答复市政协提案称，我国糖尿病患病率超12%，30%-50%人群仅靠空腹血糖筛查会发生漏诊，餐后2小时血糖是识别糖耐量减低与隐匿糖尿病的核心指标。受检测流程、场地人力与成本约束，暂不宜将全员强制列为体检基础项目，将按「高危人群优先纳入、分层设置套餐、标准化流程、全域科普宣教」分步推进，落实糖尿病防治行动实施方案要求。
    Replying to a CPPCC proposal on Sept 28, the Wuhan Health Commission noted diabetes prevalence exceeds 12% and 30-50% of people are missed by fasting-glucose-only screening; 2-hour postprandial glucose is key to identifying impaired glucose tolerance and occult diabetes. Citing workflow and cost constraints, it will proceed in stages — high-risk groups first, tiered checkup packages, standardized procedures and public education — per the national diabetes prevention and control action plan.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-09-28
item.description: 2026-09-28 简报，共 20 条：Nature子刊多组学研究：心衰患者肠道菌群失衡，护心代谢物吲哚-3-丙酸大幅降低；JAMA子刊：补充多菌株益生菌与极早产儿死亡及肠炎风险降低相关；类器官技术迈入衰老研究核心赛道：人脑类器官培养超5年，微流控芯片数天模拟数十年老化；《环境科学与技术》：高脂饮食加速微塑料肠道沉积，膳食纤维促进排出并修复屏障；《自然·衰老》25位科学家联合综述：NAD+有望延缓衰老并对抗阿尔茨海默病与帕金森病；JEM：华中科大团队开发尿石素A衍生物UA-30，抑制RalA延缓小鼠全身衰老并延长寿命；Aging Cell：肌肉Timeless基因连接运动与老年睡眠及心脏功能，过表达可延寿；川大华西等《自然·衰老》研究：男女衰老各有“时间表”，男性35-45岁、女性55-65岁迎转折期；《自然》子刊研究：植物蛋白与膳食纤维丰富的饮食改善深度睡眠与快速眼动睡眠；从“千人一方”到“一人一菌”：智能微流控技术撬动益生菌个体化精准干预；《Food Research International》：全杏鲍菇通过菌群-屏障-免疫轴缓解高脂饮食诱导的结肠低度炎症；MDPI《IJMS》综述：以菌群为导向的母婴精准营养——本土食物、发酵食品与后生元证据整合；ScienceDaily：常用关节补剂氨基葡萄糖与轻度认知障碍更快进展为痴呆相关；AKK菌全网爆火：单瓶近千元的“瘦子菌”“长寿菌”，行业溢价与平价供应链之争；补剂行业先驱Terry Lemerond逝世：业界致谢其数十年推动消费者教育与独立零售；《Scientific Reports》人体试验：黑种草籽油补充20天，4种共生菌增加；2026年慢性病防控大会召开：李斌提出“五同四共”，推动多病共防全链条管理；四部门部署2026年基本公共卫生服务：人均补助99元，慢性病患者将分类分级管理；央视《健康中国》解码睡眠：睡眠健康不能只看时长，睡眠紊乱与慢性病密切相关；大庆研究长期随访：糖尿病前期早期减重≥5%，心血管死亡推迟6.5年
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Nature子刊多组学研究：心衰患者肠道菌群失衡，护心代谢物吲哚-3-丙酸大幅降低
    Nature portfolio multi-omics study: gut dysbiosis in heart failure with sharply reduced cardioprotective indole-3-propionic acid
    研究对59名慢性收缩性心衰患者与50名健康人做深度多组学分析，发现心衰患者菌群多样性显著降低，产短链脂肪酸的双歧杆菌等有益菌耗竭，碳水化合物发酵通路全面下调，转向促炎的氧化型代谢；色氨酸代谢物吲哚-3-丙酸在患者血中大幅下降且与病情严重度相关。体外实验证实多株双歧杆菌可合成该护心物质，仅凭菌群代谢通路特征区分心衰与健康的曲线下面积达0.94。
    Deep multi-omics analysis of 59 chronic heart-failure patients and 50 healthy controls found markedly reduced microbial diversity, depletion of SCFA-producing bifidobacteria, a shift toward pro-inflammatory oxidative metabolism, and sharply lower blood levels of the cardioprotective tryptophan metabolite indole-3-propionic acid, correlating with disease severity. In vitro work confirmed several Bifidobacterium strains can synthesize it, and microbial functional features alone distinguished patients from controls with an AUC of 0.94.
  • JAMA子刊：补充多菌株益生菌与极早产儿死亡及肠炎风险降低相关
    JAMA subsidiary journal: multi-strain probiotic supplementation linked to lower death and enterocolitis risk in very preterm infants
    发表于JAMA子刊的真实世界证据显示，对极早产儿规范补充经严谨筛选的多菌株益生菌配方，与死亡及坏死性小肠结肠炎等严重肠道疾病风险降低相关，为生命极早期阶段的精准微生态干预提供了重要衡量标尺。研究者强调并非所有益生菌都等同有效，菌株选择、剂量与质控是关键前提，这一结果或推动 NICU 常规化微生态管理流程的建立与更新。
    Real-world evidence published in a JAMA subsidiary journal indicates that rigorously selected multi-strain probiotic supplementation in very preterm infants is associated with lower risks of death and necrotizing enterocolitis, offering a benchmark for precision microbiome interventions at the earliest stage of life. The authors caution that not all probiotics are equivalent — strain selection, dosing and quality control are prerequisites — findings that may update routine microbiome-management protocols in NICUs.
  • 类器官技术迈入衰老研究核心赛道：人脑类器官培养超5年，微流控芯片数天模拟数十年老化
    Organoids enter the core of aging research: human brain organoids cultured beyond 5 years, microfluidic chips simulating decades of aging in days
    科技日报梳理称，针对“小鼠有效、人体失效”的转化难题，全球科研界正双线并行推进类器官衰老模型：哈佛大学与博德研究所今年8月在《自然》报道首次将人脑皮层类器官稳定培养超过5年，复刻从胎儿晚期到衰老脑的特征，并发现神经祖细胞的“细胞时间记忆”机制；另一条路线用微流控芯片在数天内加速模拟人体数十年的老化进程，为抗衰与神经退行性疾病药物提供更可靠的药效预判载体。
    To address the persistent mouse-to-human translation gap, researchers are advancing organoid aging models along two tracks: a Harvard–Broad team reported in Nature in August the first human cortical organoids stably cultured for over five years, recapitulating fetal-to-aged brain features and revealing a cellular temporal memory in neural progenitors; a parallel microfluidic approach compresses decades of human aging into days, giving drug developers a more reliable platform for predicting efficacy against aging and neurodegenerative disease.
  • 《环境科学与技术》：高脂饮食加速微塑料肠道沉积，膳食纤维促进排出并修复屏障
    Environmental Science & Technology: high-fat diets accelerate intestinal nanoplastic accumulation while dietary fiber promotes clearance and barrier repair
    新研究显示，塑料颗粒经口进入后，在高脂饮食背景下因肠道屏障脆弱与蠕动抑制而大量蓄积，诱发菌群失调、短链脂肪酸代谢崩溃、紧密连接破坏与免疫抑制的恶性循环；而高纤维饮食通过物理吸附减少微塑料与肠黏膜接触、促进肠道蠕动加速排出，并维持产短链脂肪酸菌群修复屏障。研究提示在减少塑料暴露的同时，应主动增加全谷物、豆类、蔬果等膳食纤维摄入。
    New research shows that orally ingested plastic particles accumulate heavily under a high-fat diet due to a weakened barrier and slowed motility, triggering dysbiosis, collapsed SCFA metabolism, tight-junction damage and immunosuppression. High-fiber diets counter this by adsorbing particles away from the mucosa, speeding transit and clearance, and sustaining SCFA-producing bacteria that repair the barrier — supporting higher intake of whole grains, legumes, vegetables and fruits alongside reducing plastic exposure.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 《自然·衰老》25位科学家联合综述：NAD+有望延缓衰老并对抗阿尔茨海默病与帕金森病
    Nature Aging consensus review by 25+ scientists: NAD+ may slow aging and help fight Alzheimer's and Parkinson's
    奥斯陆大学、阿克什胡斯大学医院联合多国团队在《自然·衰老》发表专家综述，汇集超过25位衰老生物学与代谢领域科学家共识：NAD+作为细胞能量与DNA修复核心分子随年龄下降，与记忆减退、肌力下降及年龄相关疾病风险升高有关；NR、NMN等前体在早期临床试验中显示记忆、身体活动与代谢健康的改善信号，但作者强调仍需更大样本、更长周期研究验证有效性与安全性，为全球NAD+临床试验提供科学路线图。
    A Nature Aging expert review from the University of Oslo, Akershus University Hospital and international collaborators distills the consensus of more than 25 scientists: NAD+, central to cellular energy and DNA repair, declines with age and is linked to memory loss, muscle weakness and age-related disease risk. Early trials of precursors such as NR and NMN show encouraging signals for memory, physical activity and metabolic health, but the authors stress that larger, longer studies are needed, offering a roadmap for ongoing and future NAD+ clinical trials.
  • JEM：华中科大团队开发尿石素A衍生物UA-30，抑制RalA延缓小鼠全身衰老并延长寿命
    JEM: Huazhong-based team develops urolithin A derivative UA-30 that inhibits RalA to mitigate systemic aging and extend lifespan in mice
    华中科技大学同济医学院团队在《实验医学杂志》报道新型尿石素A衍生物UA-30：从约80个结构类似物中筛选获得，具良好药代动力学与骨骼肌分布，不依赖体内转化为UA。18.5月龄自然衰老小鼠连续10周干预后，爬杆、握力、耐力等运动指标改善，肌肉纤维化减轻，整体衰弱程度下降，表观遗传年龄增速放缓，长期给药显著延长寿命。机制上UA-30直接抑制RalA，阻断促纤维化JNK-Smad通路并增强线粒体功能。
    A team from Huazhong University of Science and Technology reports in the Journal of Experimental Medicine a novel urolithin A derivative, UA-30, selected from roughly 80 analogs with favorable pharmacokinetics and skeletal-muscle distribution that acts without conversion to UA. In naturally aged mice, 10 weeks of treatment improved climbing, grip and endurance, reduced muscle fibrosis and frailty, slowed epigenetic aging and extended lifespan with long-term dosing. Mechanistically, UA-30 directly inhibits RalA, blocking the pro-fibrotic JNK–Smad pathway while boosting mitochondrial function.
  • Aging Cell：肌肉Timeless基因连接运动与老年睡眠及心脏功能，过表达可延寿
    Aging Cell: muscle Timeless gene links exercise to sleep and cardiac function in aging flies; overexpression extends lifespan
    2026年9月《Aging Cell》发表研究：老年果蝇肌肉中特异性敲低Timeless（Tim）基因会加重睡眠片段化、降低攀爬速度与心脏泵血功能；而在老年雄性果蝇肌肉中过表达Tim可改善睡眠、运动能力、心率与抗心衰能力，并延长寿命。四周运动训练可提升肌肉Tim水平，带来类似的睡眠与心脏获益。研究提示肌肉生物钟基因是把“运动有益老年健康”翻译为可干预靶点的潜在枢纽。
    A September 2026 study in Aging Cell shows that muscle-specific knockdown of the Timeless (Tim) gene in aged fruit flies worsens sleep fragmentation, climbing speed and cardiac output, while muscle Tim overexpression in older males improves sleep, climbing, heart rate, stroke volume and resistance to heart failure — and extends lifespan. Four weeks of exercise raised muscle Tim levels and produced similar sleep and cardiac benefits, positioning the muscle clock gene as a potential lever for translating exercise benefits into targets for healthy aging.
  • 川大华西等《自然·衰老》研究：男女衰老各有“时间表”，男性35-45岁、女性55-65岁迎转折期
    Nature Aging study from West China Hospital: men and women age on different timetables, with transition windows at 35-45 and 55-65
    中国科学院、四川大学华西医院与南昌大学团队在《自然·衰老》构建性别特异性生物学衰老时钟，发现男性约在35-45岁迎来衰老转折，BMI、胆固醇与甘油三酯升高、代谢紊乱明显；女性的转折出现在55-65岁更年期前后，伴随激素与代谢重塑。按“生物学年龄-实际年龄”差值划分，加速衰老人群表现为血脂升高、慢性炎症更明显与肾功能下降，而减速衰老人群抗氧化能力、肌肉骨骼储备与免疫功能更佳，提示性别分层健康管理窗口。
    Researchers from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, West China Hospital and Nanchang University built sex-specific biological aging clocks in Nature Aging, identifying a male transition window around ages 35-45 marked by rising BMI, cholesterol and triglycerides, and a female window at 55-65 around menopause with hormonal and metabolic remodeling. Ranking by the gap between biological and chronological age, accelerated agers showed worse lipids, inflammation and kidney function, while decelerated agers had stronger antioxidant defenses, musculoskeletal reserves and immunity — supporting sex-stratified prevention windows.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 《自然》子刊研究：植物蛋白与膳食纤维丰富的饮食改善深度睡眠与快速眼动睡眠
    Nature Health study: plant- and fiber-rich diets improve deep sleep and REM sleep
    9月27日发表于《自然》系列期刊的研究利用人类表型项目2.8万人队列，结合可穿戴睡眠监测、连续血糖、菌群与遗传数据，分析32项饮食因素后发现：植物食物多样性、膳食纤维密度与植物化学物摄入等7项因素与更深睡眠、更多快速眼动睡眠及更低夜间心率相关；晚餐更饱虽略延长总睡眠时间，却伴随夜间心率升高。专家建议改善睡眠应优先增加最小加工植物食物与纤维摄入。
    A study published September 27 in a Nature portfolio journal leveraged the 28,000-participant Human Phenotype Project with wearable sleep tracking, continuous glucose, microbiome and genetic data to analyze 32 dietary factors. Seven — including plant-food variety, fiber density and phytochemical intake — were associated with more deep sleep, more REM sleep and lower nighttime heart rates; heavier evening meals slightly extended sleep duration but raised nocturnal heart rate. Experts advise prioritizing minimally processed plant foods and fiber for better sleep architecture.
  • 从“千人一方”到“一人一菌”：智能微流控技术撬动益生菌个体化精准干预
    From one-size-fits-all to one-person-one-strain: smart microfluidics powers individualized probiotic interventions
    博士后创业团队吕赵劼等报道“一人一菌”个体化益生菌路径：先通过肠道检测建立个体基线，AI分析健康信息后从菌株库筛选候选菌株，再用微流控芯片与斑马鱼活体平台验证适配性与安全性，最终交付专属复配菌粉并通过复检持续优化。团队指出通用益生菌产品有效率可能仅约30%，其方案已与伊利、诺维信等企业合作，应用从乳制品、功能食品延伸至农业等领域，为精准营养落地提供产业样本。
    A postdoctoral venture is advancing a one-person-one-strain probiotic pipeline: individual baselines are established via gut testing, AI screens candidate strains from a library, microfluidic chips and zebrafish platforms validate fit and safety, and bespoke blended formulations are delivered with follow-up retesting. Noting that generic probiotics may work in only about 30% of users, the team has partnered with firms including Yili and Novozymes, extending from dairy and functional foods to agriculture — a concrete industry template for precision nutrition.
  • 《Food Research International》：全杏鲍菇通过菌群-屏障-免疫轴缓解高脂饮食诱导的结肠低度炎症
    Food Research International: whole king oyster mushroom eases high-fat-diet colonic inflammation via the microbiota-barrier-immunity axis
    马萨诸塞大学团队以完整杏鲍菇（保留多糖、膳食纤维、蛋白与多酚全组分）干预高脂饮食小鼠，发现其可同步改善黏液屏障与紧密连接蛋白、调节免疫细胞浸润与炎症因子平衡；16S测序显示Akkermansia、双歧杆菌、丁酸产生菌等有益菌增加，丁酸/丙酸代谢通路增强，SCFAs呈剂量依赖恢复，其中Akkermansia与屏障蛋白正相关、与促炎指标负相关，或为全食物精准营养干预提供新思路。
    University of Massachusetts researchers used whole king oyster mushroom — retaining its polysaccharides, fiber, protein and polyphenols — to intervene in high-fat-diet mice, simultaneously improving mucus barrier and tight-junction proteins and rebalancing immune infiltration and cytokines. 16S sequencing showed enrichment of Akkermansia, Bifidobacterium and butyrate producers with dose-dependent restoration of SCFAs; Akkermansia correlated positively with barrier proteins and negatively with inflammatory markers, suggesting whole-food strategies for precision nutrition.
  • MDPI《IJMS》综述：以菌群为导向的母婴精准营养——本土食物、发酵食品与后生元证据整合
    IJMS review: microbiome-guided maternal and child precision nutrition — indigenous foods, fermented foods and postbiotics
    9月23日发表于《国际分子科学杂志》的结构化叙述综述系统梳理菌群导向母婴营养干预证据：本土食物体系、发酵食品、益生菌与后生元可经短链脂肪酸等代谢物影响免疫成熟、屏障完整与代谢编程，涉及AMPK、mTOR、NF-κB等通路；并整合AI、多组学与精准营养提出“菌群知情的营养框架”。作者指出人群特异性菌群谱、标准化制剂与低资源地区证据仍存在明显缺口。
    A structured narrative review published September 23 in the International Journal of Molecular Sciences synthesizes evidence on microbiome-directed maternal and child nutrition: indigenous food systems, fermented foods, probiotics and postbiotics may shape immune maturation, barrier integrity and metabolic programming via SCFAs and pathways including AMPK, mTOR and NF-κB. Proposing a Microbiome-Informed Nutrition Framework that integrates AI, multi-omics and precision nutrition, the authors flag gaps in population-specific profiles, standardized formulations and evidence from low-resource settings.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • ScienceDaily：常用关节补剂氨基葡萄糖与轻度认知障碍更快进展为痴呆相关
    ScienceDaily: popular joint supplement glucosamine linked to faster progression from MCI to dementia
    9月27日报道的大型健康记录分析发现，使用氨基葡萄糖的人群中，轻度认知障碍发展为痴呆的可能性升高约25%；后续实验室实验提示这种广受欢迎的关节补充剂可能以出乎意料的方式影响脑内病理过程。研究者提醒该结果为观察性关联、尚未确立因果，服用者无须自行停药，但认知功能下降人群补充前应与医生沟通并随访监测。
    A large health-records analysis reported September 27 found that glucosamine users with mild cognitive impairment were about 25% more likely to progress to dementia, with follow-up laboratory experiments suggesting the popular joint supplement may influence brain pathology in unexpected ways. The authors stress this is an observational association — causality is not established — and users should not stop medication on their own, though those with cognitive decline should discuss supplementation with their physician and monitor accordingly.
  • AKK菌全网爆火：单瓶近千元的“瘦子菌”“长寿菌”，行业溢价与平价供应链之争
    Akkermansia mania: near-thousand-yuan bottles of the “lean and longevity” bug fuel a premium-versus-affordable-supply-chain debate
    AKK菌（嗜黏蛋白阿克曼菌）近期在保健品市场迅速走热并蔓延至资本市场。比利时鲁汶大学研究显示连续补充12周，40名肥胖者平均减重2.27公斤、胰岛素敏感性提升28%且无明显不良反应，国内三甲医院临床亦得出类似结论。但头部品牌“双减瓶”开价近800元，有品牌以供应链直采把单粒压至6.8元并公示文献与GMP等认证，引发行业对成分溢价与透明定价的讨论。
    Akkermansia muciniphila has rapidly heated up the supplement market and spilled into capital markets. A Leuven study showed 12 weeks of supplementation cut an average 2.27 kg in 40 adults with obesity and raised insulin sensitivity 28% without notable adverse events, with similar findings in Chinese tertiary-hospital trials. Yet leading brands charge nearly 800 yuan per bottle, while newer players using direct supply chains price single capsules at 6.8 yuan with published literature and GMP credentials, sparking debate over ingredient premiums and transparent pricing.
  • 补剂行业先驱Terry Lemerond逝世：业界致谢其数十年推动消费者教育与独立零售
    Supplement industry pioneer Terry Lemerond dies: tributes pour in for decades of consumer advocacy
    美国膳食补充剂行业标志性人物、Terry Naturally与EuroPharma创始人Terry Lemerond逝世，业界纷纷致哀。NutraIngredients刊文回顾其五十余年职业生涯：从早年创立天然食品零售连锁，到持续推动标准化植物提取物、循证配方与消费者教育，并长期为独立健康零售商争取生存空间，被视为连接科研证据与一线门店的关键桥梁，其倡导的“教育先行”营销理念影响深远。
    Terry Lemerond, an iconic figure in the US dietary supplement industry and founder of Terry Naturally and EuroPharma, has died, prompting tributes across the trade. NutraIngredients chronicled his five-decade career — from founding natural-food retail chains to championing standardized botanical extracts, evidence-based formulations and consumer education, while long advocating for independent health retailers — casting him as a bridge between research evidence and the shop floor whose education-first philosophy shaped the industry.
  • 《Scientific Reports》人体试验：黑种草籽油补充20天，4种共生菌增加
    Scientific Reports human trial: 20 days of black seed oil supplementation increases four commensal gut bacteria
    《自然》旗下《Scientific Reports》9月发表小规模人体研究：8名健康成人中4人连续20天补充黑种草籽油胶囊（每天3次、每次2粒），采集40份粪便样本分析显示，整体菌群多样性与组成保持稳定，但产丁酸菌、参与膳食纤维分解与碳水化合物发酵的4种共生菌显著增加，部分具潜在抗炎特征；长双歧杆菌与青春双歧杆菌略有减少。研究同时为胃肠手术前后的菌群管理提供新线索。
    A small human trial in Nature portfolio journal Scientific Reports had 4 of 8 healthy adults take black seed (Nigella sativa) oil capsules three times daily for 20 days, with 40 stool samples analyzed. Overall diversity and composition stayed stable, but four commensal species increased — including butyrate producers and fiber-fermenters, some with potential anti-inflammatory traits — while B. longum and B. adolescentis slightly declined. The work also hints at microbiome-management strategies around gastrointestinal surgery.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 2026年慢性病防控大会召开：李斌提出“五同四共”，推动多病共防全链条管理
    2026 Chronic Disease Prevention and Control Conference: the Five-Same Four-Shared framework for integrated multi-disease management
    中华预防医学会与中国疾控中心在南京主办2026年慢性病防控大会。数据显示我国18岁及以上居民高血压患病率27.5%、糖尿病11.9%，超半数成年人超重或肥胖，近九成死亡与慢性病相关。中华预防医学会会长李斌提出“五同四共”框架——以同防、同筛、同诊、同治、同康贯通服务链，以共管、共通、共担、共育夯实支撑体系，推动从单病种管理转向以人为中心的多病协同管理，并设AI慢病管理等六大平行分会场。
    Hosted in Nanjing by the Chinese Preventive Medicine Association and China CDC, the conference reported that 27.5% of Chinese adults have hypertension, 11.9% have diabetes, over half are overweight or obese, and nearly nine in ten deaths are linked to chronic disease. Association president Li Bin proposed the Five-Same Four-Shared framework — same prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation to integrate the service chain, with shared management, data, responsibility and training as the support system — shifting from single-disease programs to person-centered multi-disease coordination, alongside six parallel tracks including AI-driven chronic disease management.
  • 四部门部署2026年基本公共卫生服务：人均补助99元，慢性病患者将分类分级管理
    Four ministries set out 2026 basic public health services: 99 yuan per capita with tiered chronic-disease management
    国家卫健委、财政部、国家中医药局、国家疾控局联合印发《关于做好2026年基本公共卫生服务工作的通知》，明确2026年人均财政补助标准99元，要求基层主动进村庄、社区、楼宇、家庭；将高血压、2型糖尿病、高脂血症、肥胖症膳食运动指导要点嵌入医生工作站，2026年覆盖三分之二以上乡镇卫生院与社区卫生服务中心，并按红黄绿三类对慢性病患者分级管理；2026年基本实现县级电子健康档案向居民开放全覆盖，评价结果与资金分配挂钩。
    China's health, finance, TCM and disease-control authorities jointly issued the 2026 basic public health services notice: per-capita funding stays at 99 yuan, primary-care teams are to deliver proactive services in villages, communities, buildings and homes, embedding diet-exercise guidance for hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia and obesity into clinician workstations across two-thirds of primary institutions. Chronic-disease patients will be managed in red/yellow/green tiers, electronic health records open county-wide to residents, and performance evaluation will be tied to fund allocation.
  • 央视《健康中国》解码睡眠：睡眠健康不能只看时长，睡眠紊乱与慢性病密切相关
    CCTV Healthy China decodes sleep: sleep health is more than duration, and disturbed sleep is closely tied to chronic disease
    9月27日央视《健康中国》栏目邀请北京大学第六医院睡眠医学科主任孙伟解读睡眠健康：判断睡眠好坏不能只看时长，鼾声背后可能隐藏睡眠呼吸暂停；睡眠紊乱与高血压、糖尿病等慢性病互为因果，盲目补觉难以抵消熬夜损伤，饮食与入睡时间同样影响睡眠质量。节目同时给出快速入睡的可操作建议，为公众提供基于睡眠医学的权威科普。
    On September 27, CCTV's Healthy China program invited Sun Wei, director of sleep medicine at Peking University Sixth Hospital, to decode sleep health: quality cannot be judged by duration alone, snoring may signal sleep apnea, and disturbed sleep interacts with hypertension and diabetes. Catch-up sleep cannot offset late nights, while diet and bedtime habits shape sleep quality. The episode also shared practical advice on falling asleep faster, offering authoritative sleep-medicine guidance for the public.
  • 大庆研究长期随访：糖尿病前期早期减重≥5%，心血管死亡推迟6.5年
    Da Qing study long-term follow-up: early ≥5% weight loss in prediabetes delays cardiovascular death by 6.5 years
    阜外医院李光伟/巩秋红团队8月在线发表于《糖尿病护理》的大庆糖尿病预防研究长期随访分析显示：糖耐量受损患者诊断后最初几年经生活方式干预实现减重≥5%，与随后长达34年随访中心血管死亡风险降低44%、心血管事件降低29%、全因死亡降低33%独立相关，全因死亡与心血管死亡中位发生时间分别推迟2.1年和6.5年，提示早期体重管理应成为糖尿病前期管理的核心干预靶点。
    A long-term follow-up analysis of the Da Qing Diabetes Prevention Study, published online in Diabetes Care in August by Fuwai Hospital's Li Guangwei and Gong Qiuhong teams, shows that prediabetic patients who achieved ≥5% weight loss through lifestyle intervention in the first years had 44% lower cardiovascular death, 29% fewer cardiovascular events and 33% lower all-cause mortality over 34 years of follow-up, delaying median all-cause and cardiovascular death by 2.1 and 6.5 years — making early weight management a core intervention target in prediabetes.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-09-27
item.description: 2026-09-27 简报，共 20 条：《柳叶刀》REFIT2 三期试验：粪菌移植治疗肠易激综合征未见显著获益；晋城市人民医院开展精准肠道菌群移植：慢性腹泻显著缓解，自闭症女孩血糖下降、性格转开朗；Science：高脂饮食促肠癌转移新机制——神经酰胺合成激活 YAP 再生程序；Gastroenterology：膳食调控肠道菌群延长先天性巨结肠相关肠炎小鼠生存；Nature 双研究：幼年低蛋白饮食经 Lsp2「记住营养史」，深远影响果蝇寿命；老年肌力流失另有隐因：神经-肌肉通讯衰退，靶向关键蛋白在动物模型中恢复肌力；Tirzepatide 或有减重之外的代谢获益：激活肥胖小鼠棕色脂肪产热；mBio：无菌果蝇+工程大肠杆菌证实肠道菌源多胺可直接延长宿主寿命；Nature Communications 五国分析：健康饮食与肠道菌群的关联因地而异；Genome Medicine：机器学习识别菌群与临床预测因子，禁食减重效果因人而异；中国大型研究：维生素 A 与 Ω-3 缺乏增加早产风险，孕期需精准补足；中国农大 Advanced Materials：纳米纤维素几何结构解锁不同肠段益生菌精准递送；GLP-1 减重降糖药物的儿童隐忧：近 1/6 一年内出现确诊营养缺乏；人群研究：Ω-3 摄入更高与癌症患者长期生存改善相关；Lubrizol 白皮书：中国女性四个生命阶段补剂需求被系统性低估；Concordix 押注「后生元+美容+免疫」：咀嚼片新概念亮相 SupplySide Global 2026；国家卫健委：警惕减肥训练营「急速暴瘦」，超 95% 三级公立综合医院已设体重管理门诊；《柳叶刀·胃肠病学和肝脏病学》：13 省 2.6 万人研究首次摸清我国社区人群肝纤维化家底；2026 年全国食品安全宣传周启动：27 部门联合、40 余场「部委主题日」；全国儿童青少年「五健」促进行动工作交流会暨培训班召开
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《柳叶刀》REFIT2 三期试验：粪菌移植治疗肠易激综合征未见显著获益
    Lancet REFIT2 Phase 3 Trial: FMT Shows No Significant Benefit in IBS
    挪威五家医院开展的随机双盲安慰剂对照三期试验纳入 450 例中重度肠易激综合征患者，按 2:1 随机接受一次供体或自身粪菌灌肠。90 天时症状严重度评分改善达 75 分及以上者供体组 40%、安慰剂组 38%，绝对差异仅 1.9 个百分点，未达统计学显著。作为迄今规模最大的 FMT 治疗 IBS 严格对照试验，结果提示其疗效并不确凿，供体筛选与制剂优化仍是未来关键。
    A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial across five Norwegian hospitals enrolled 450 patients with moderate-to-severe IBS, randomized 2:1 to a single donor or self faecal enema. At 90 days, 40% of the donor-FMT group versus 38% of the placebo group achieved a 75-point or greater drop in symptom severity — an absolute difference of only 1.9 percentage points. As the largest rigorously controlled FMT trial in IBS, the results suggest its efficacy remains unproven, keeping donor selection and formulation optimization as key challenges.
  • 晋城市人民医院开展精准肠道菌群移植：慢性腹泻显著缓解，自闭症女孩血糖下降、性格转开朗
    Precision FMT Debuts at Jincheng People's Hospital: Chronic Diarrhea Eased, Autistic Girl's Glucose Down and Mood Brightened
    晋城市人民医院消化内科首次开展两例精准肠道菌群移植均获显著疗效：一例长期慢性腹泻患者移植后大便成形、症状明显缓解；一例合并血糖异常的 12 岁自闭症女孩移植三个月后血糖显著下降，且性格转为活泼开朗。团队指出菌群重建可能经肠-脑轴同时影响代谢与情绪行为，填补了晋城地区微生态治疗空白，后续将推进规范化应用。
    The gastroenterology team at Jincheng People's Hospital reported two successful precision fecal microbiota transplantations: a chronic diarrhea patient achieved formed stools and marked symptom relief, while a 12-year-old autistic girl with abnormal glucose saw her blood sugar fall significantly and her personality become markedly more outgoing three months after the procedure. The team notes microbial reconstruction may simultaneously influence metabolism and emotional behavior via the gut-brain axis.
  • Science：高脂饮食促肠癌转移新机制——神经酰胺合成激活 YAP 再生程序
    Science: High-Fat Diet Drives Colorectal Cancer Metastasis via Ceramide Synthesis Activating a YAP Regenerative Program
    发表于 Science 的研究揭示高脂饮食促进结直肠癌转移的关键通路：膳食脂质负荷上调神经酰胺合成，后者激活 YAP 驱动的再生程序，使肿瘤细胞获得更强的侵袭与定植能力。该发现把饮食脂肪、鞘脂代谢与肿瘤干性联系起来，为功能医学视角下以膳食结构和代谢干预降低肠癌转移风险提供了新靶点。
    A study in Science uncovers a key pathway by which a high-fat diet promotes colorectal cancer metastasis: dietary lipid load upregulates ceramide synthesis, which activates a YAP-driven regenerative program endowing tumor cells with enhanced invasive and colonizing capacity. Linking dietary fat, sphingolipid metabolism and tumor plasticity, the finding offers fresh targets for reducing metastatic risk through dietary patterning and metabolic intervention.
  • Gastroenterology：膳食调控肠道菌群延长先天性巨结肠相关肠炎小鼠生存
    Gastroenterology: Dietary Modulation of Gut Microbes Prolongs Survival in Hirschsprung Disease Enterocolitis Model
    先天性巨结肠相关肠炎（HAEC）是患儿致命并发症。发表于 Gastroenterology 的小鼠研究显示，特定膳食干预可同时保护肠道上皮线粒体功能并抑制致炎肠杆菌扩张，从而显著延长模型小鼠生存期。研究证明在不改变基因背景的前提下，精准的营养处方能够重塑微生态、降低肠炎风险，为高危患儿的膳食管理提供循证方向。
    Hirschsprung-associated enterocolitis (HAEC) is a life-threatening complication for affected children. A mouse study in Gastroenterology shows that targeted dietary modulation simultaneously protects epithelial mitochondrial function and curbs inflammatory Enterobacteriaceae overgrowth, significantly prolonging survival — evidence that precision nutrition prescriptions can reshape the microbiota and reduce enterocolitis risk without altering genotype.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • Nature 双研究：幼年低蛋白饮食经 Lsp2「记住营养史」，深远影响果蝇寿命
    Twin Nature Studies: Early-Life Protein Restriction Is Remembered by Lsp2, Shaping Lifespan in Fruit Flies
    9 月 23 日 Nature 背靠背发表两项研究：果蝇幼年期限制蛋白，即使成年后恢复正常饮食，寿命仍延长。研究者鉴定脂质转运蛋白 Lsp2 为「营养史的分子载体」，它把早期饮食信息带入成虫期，并通过放大 mTORC1 输出调控衰老。结合英国生物样本库 6.4 万人早期糖配给队列证据，提示生命早期营养可能是长寿医学被低估的干预窗口，但能否外推到人类仍待验证。
    Two Nature papers published on Sep 23 show that restricting protein in young fruit flies extends lifespan even after returning to a normal adult diet. The lipid-transport protein Lsp2 acts as a molecular carrier of nutritional history, carrying early-life dietary information into adulthood and modulating longevity by amplifying mTORC1 output. Together with UK Biobank evidence from sugar-rationing cohorts, the work hints that early-life nutrition may be an underestimated longevity window in humans.
  • 老年肌力流失另有隐因：神经-肌肉通讯衰退，靶向关键蛋白在动物模型中恢复肌力
    Aging Muscles May Be Losing Strength for a Reason Scientists Missed: Nerve-Muscle Communication Breakdown
    ScienceDaily 报道的新研究发现，增龄相关的肌力下降并非仅源于肌肉萎缩，还存在此前被忽视的神经与肌肉之间通讯失灵：连接信号随衰老衰减，导致运动单位募集不足。研究团队在动物模型中靶向关键蛋白干预后肌力显著改善，提示恢复神经-肌肉突触功能可能成为肌少症与老年虚弱的新治疗路径。
    A newly identified breakdown in communication between nerves and muscles — beyond muscle wasting itself — may explain age-related strength loss, as connection signals decay and impair motor-unit recruitment. Targeting a key protein restored muscle strength in an animal model, suggesting re-establishing neuromuscular synaptic function as a promising therapeutic route for sarcopenia and frailty.
  • Tirzepatide 或有减重之外的代谢获益：激活肥胖小鼠棕色脂肪产热
    Tirzepatide May Burn Beyond Appetite: Activating Brown Fat in Obese Mice
    新研究显示，替尔泊肽（Mounjaro/Zepbound）在肥胖小鼠中激活了耗能的棕色脂肪组织，提示其强大减重与降糖效果可能部分来自食欲抑制之外的产热代谢通路。若在人体得到证实，这一机制将解释 GLP-1/GIP 双靶点药物的部分代谢获益来源，并为联合能量消耗通路的下一代肥胖与糖尿病疗法提供思路。
    Tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound) activated calorie-burning brown fat in obese mice, hinting that its powerful weight-loss and glucose benefits may partly stem from thermogenic pathways beyond appetite suppression. If confirmed in humans, the finding could explain part of the metabolic benefit of dual GLP-1/GIP agonism and inspire next-generation obesity and diabetes therapies that couple energy expenditure.
  • mBio：无菌果蝇+工程大肠杆菌证实肠道菌源多胺可直接延长宿主寿命
    mBio: Gut-Derived Polyamines Directly Extend Host Lifespan in Gnotobiotic Flies
    日本近畿大学与金泽大学团队利用无菌果蝇定植基因工程大肠杆菌的体系，首次把「菌群代谢物」与「膳食多胺」的贡献分开：无论经膳食补充还是由菌株合成，腐胺与亚精胺均使果蝇平均寿命从约 18 天延长至 21 天左右。该因果性证据强化了亚精胺等菌群代谢物作为延寿营养靶点的地位，也提示调控产多胺菌株或成精准营养新策略。
    Using gnotobiotic flies colonized with engineered E. coli, Japanese researchers separated the contribution of microbiota-derived metabolites from dietary polyamines: putrescine and spermidine, whether supplied in food or produced by the bacteria, extended mean fly lifespan from about 18 to 21 days. This causal evidence strengthens spermidine-type microbial metabolites as longevity nutrient targets and points to tuning polyamine-producing strains as a precision nutrition strategy.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nature Communications 五国分析：健康饮食与肠道菌群的关联因地而异
    Nature Communications: Diet-Microbiome Links Vary Across Five Countries
    发表于 Nature Communications 的跨国研究分析了五个国家人群的肠道菌群组成与基因组变异，发现健康膳食与菌群特征之间的关联存在显著地理与膳食结构差异：同一「健康饮食」在不同人群中被不同的物种与功能基因承载。结果提示菌群导向的膳食建议必须结合本地膳食文化与人群基线，为分层化、本地化的精准营养干预提供证据。
    A five-country analysis in Nature Communications maps gut microbiome composition and genomic variation against dietary patterns, showing that associations between healthy eating and microbial features differ markedly by geography and diet: the same healthy diet is carried by different species and functional genes across populations. Microbiome-directed dietary guidance must therefore be localized, supporting stratified precision nutrition interventions.
  • Genome Medicine：机器学习识别菌群与临床预测因子，禁食减重效果因人而异
    Genome Medicine: Machine Learning Identifies Microbiome Predictors of Weight Loss After Prolonged Fasting
    发表于 Genome Medicine 的研究用机器学习整合肠道菌群与临床指标，预测延长禁食后能否持续减重：基线菌群特征与临床变量共同决定个体应答差异，部分人群减重效果显著而另一些人迅速反弹。研究为「先测菌群再定禁食处方」的精准体重管理提供框架，也解释了同一禁食方案在不同个体间疗效悬殊的原因。
    Machine learning models integrating gut microbiome and clinical features can predict who sustains weight loss after prolonged fasting. Baseline microbial signatures and clinical variables jointly explain individual response variability, with some individuals responding strongly while others rapidly regain weight. The study frames a test-first approach to fasting prescriptions for precision weight management.
  • 中国大型研究：维生素 A 与 Ω-3 缺乏增加早产风险，孕期需精准补足
    Large Chinese Study: Vitamin A and Omega-3 Deficiency Raise Preterm Birth Risk
    一项中国大型研究显示，孕母维生素 A 及 EPA、DHA 等 Ω-3 脂肪酸水平不足与 37 周前早产风险升高相关，并阐明这些营养素在胎盘发育、炎症调控与胎儿生长中的作用。研究者建议孕妇关注维 A 与 Ω-3 的适宜摄入，同时警惕维 A 与 Ω-6 过量带来的反向风险，体现孕期营养「补足与限量并重」的精准思路。
    A large Chinese study links insufficient maternal vitamin A and omega-3 (EPA/DHA) status to elevated risk of preterm birth before 37 weeks, clarifying these nutrients' roles in placental development, inflammation control and fetal growth. Adequate intake matters — alongside caution against excess vitamin A and omega-6 — exemplifying the dual imperative of repletion and limits in pregnancy nutrition.
  • 中国农大 Advanced Materials：纳米纤维素几何结构解锁不同肠段益生菌精准递送
    Advanced Materials: Geometry-Mediated Microgels Enable Region-Specific Probiotic Delivery Along the Gut
    中国农业大学李媛、陈莎男团队在 Advanced Materials 发表研究，通过调控纳米纤维素微凝胶的几何形状与力学特性，使益生菌在不同肠道区域实现定点释放：形状决定其在胃肠道的滞留、耐受与解体位置。该材料学策略绕开了传统包埋「一刀切」的困境，为菌-靶点匹配的下一代精准益生菌制剂提供工程化路径。
    Researchers at China Agricultural University report in Advanced Materials that tuning the geometry and mechanics of nanocellulose microgels directs probiotic release to specific intestinal regions, with shape governing retention, tolerance and disintegration sites along the gut. The materials strategy enables next-generation probiotics matched to target segments, moving beyond one-size-fits-all encapsulation.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • GLP-1 减重降糖药物的儿童隐忧：近 1/6 一年内出现确诊营养缺乏
    GLP-1 Drugs in Children Linked to Nutritional Deficiencies in Nearly 1 in 6 Within a Year
    发表于 Childhood Obesity 的研究追踪使用 GLP-1 类药物（Victoza、Saxenda、Trulicity、Ozempic 等）减重或治疗糖尿病的儿童，发现近 1/6（16.8%）在开始用药一年内出现确诊的营养缺乏，其中维生素 D 缺乏约占 12%。食欲受抑叠加饮食结构改变是重要机制，提示儿科 GLP-1 治疗须同步开展微量营养素监测与补充方案，不可只盯体重曲线。
    A study in Childhood Obesity found that nearly one in six children (16.8%) prescribed GLP-1 medications such as Victoza, Saxenda, Trulicity or Ozempic developed a diagnosed nutritional deficiency within a year of starting treatment, with vitamin D deficiency affecting about 12%. Suppressed appetite and dietary shifts are key mechanisms, underscoring the need for micronutrient monitoring alongside pediatric GLP-1 therapy.
  • 人群研究：Ω-3 摄入更高与癌症患者长期生存改善相关
    Higher Omega-3 Intake Associated With Improved Long-Term Survival in Cancer Patients
    发表于 Nutrition Research 的人群研究显示，来自富脂鱼类与鱼油的 EPA、DHA 摄入更高与癌症患者长期生存改善相关，并可能通过抗炎、影响细胞信号与代谢等机制参与肿瘤预防。作者强调观察性证据不支持「鱼油抗癌」的简单结论，但提示肿瘤康复人群维持充足 Ω-3 状态是值得纳入营养管理策略的环节。
    A population-based study in Nutrition Research reports that higher intake of EPA and DHA from fatty fish and fish oil is associated with longer survival among cancer patients, with anti-inflammatory and metabolic mechanisms possibly contributing to prevention as well. The observational evidence does not support simplistic anti-cancer claims, but maintaining adequate omega-3 status is worth including in oncology nutrition strategies.
  • Lubrizol 白皮书：中国女性四个生命阶段补剂需求被系统性低估
    Lubrizol White Paper: Chinese Women's Supplement Needs Across Four Life Stages Are Underserved
    路博润联合 IQVIA 完成的亚太消费者研究显示，中国女性对生命周期定制补剂需求强烈：87% 按生命阶段选购产品，93% 认为需要面向孕妇的铁与营养方案，亚太多数受访者认为现有产品不完全起效。中国「主动健康指数」34.3% 居三国之首，孕产人群愿为降低不确定性支付最高 50% 溢价，为母婴与更年期细分补剂市场划出增量方向。
    A Lubrizol-IQVIA consumer study across China, South Korea and Indonesia finds Chinese women strongly prefer life-stage-specific supplements: 87% choose products by life stage, 93% see a need for pregnancy-focused iron and nutrition solutions, and many report current products only partly work. With China's proactive wellness index highest at 34.3% and mothers willing to pay up to 50% premiums, the data highlight clear growth lanes in maternal and menopause supplement segments.
  • Concordix 押注「后生元+美容+免疫」：咀嚼片新概念亮相 SupplySide Global 2026
    Concordix Bets on Postbiotics, Beauty and Immunity With New Chewable Concepts at SupplySide Global 2026
    挪威制剂企业 Concordix 在 SupplySide Global 2026 展出新一代咀嚼片概念：将后生元与生物素、维生素 D3 组合，定位于皮肤、头发与免疫健康的交集场景。咀嚼与无水服用形式持续从传统片剂胶囊分流份额，后生元则因规避活菌稳定性难题成为配方热点，折射出补剂行业向「便捷剂型×温和成分×多靶点声称」的融合趋势。
    Norwegian dose-form specialist Concordix unveiled chewable concepts pairing postbiotics with biotin and vitamin D3 for skin, hair and immune health at SupplySide Global 2026. Chewable, water-free formats keep taking share from tablets and capsules, while postbiotics sidestep live-probiotic stability issues — reflecting the industry drift toward convenient formats, gentle actives and multi-target claims.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 国家卫健委：警惕减肥训练营「急速暴瘦」，超 95% 三级公立综合医院已设体重管理门诊
    NHC Warns Against Crash-Diet Boot Camps; Over 95% of Top Tertiary Hospitals Now Run Weight-Management Clinics
    国家卫健委新闻发言人胡强强在 9 月 23 日发布会上回应近期减肥训练营伤亡事件：以「急速暴瘦」「不瘦退款」招揽学员的过度节食、超负荷训练可致脱水、脱发、电解质紊乱与肌肉流失，甚至增加心血管风险。目前超过 95% 的三级公立综合医院设置健康体重管理门诊，体重困扰严重者应先到医疗机构接受评估与指导，减重须以合理膳食、适量运动与生活方式为基础。
    Responding to recent boot-camp casualties, China's National Health Commission warned that crash diets and overtraining marketed with promises of rapid weight loss can cause dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, muscle loss and cardiovascular risks. Over 95% of tertiary public hospitals now operate weight-management clinics, and people with serious weight problems should seek medical assessment before any program.
  • 《柳叶刀·胃肠病学和肝脏病学》：13 省 2.6 万人研究首次摸清我国社区人群肝纤维化家底
    Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology: First Nationwide Portrait of Liver Fibrosis in Chinese Communities
    覆盖 13 个省份 25736 名社区成年居民的普通人群肝脏健康项目 9 月 23 日发表于《柳叶刀·胃肠病学和肝脏病学》，首次系统回答我国社区人群肝纤维化与脂肪性肝病患病情况：肝纤维化风险随体重、血糖、血压、饮酒等代谢危险因素累积而显著升高。研究为把肝脏健康管理纳入慢病全程管理与生活方式干预提供流行病学依据。
    A liver health project covering 25,736 community adults across 13 Chinese provinces, published in The Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, provides the first systematic picture of liver fibrosis and fatty liver disease in the general population: fibrosis risk rises steeply with accumulating metabolic risk factors such as weight, glucose, blood pressure and alcohol. The findings ground liver health in chronic-disease and lifestyle management programs.
  • 2026 年全国食品安全宣传周启动：27 部门联合、40 余场「部委主题日」
    2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week Launches With 27 Departments and 40+ Ministerial Theme Days
    国务院食安办联合中央文明办、农业农村部、市场监管总局等 27 个部门和单位于 9 月 22 日在京启动 2026 年全国食品安全宣传周，主题为「尚德守法 共享食安——深化全链条监管」。宣传周期间将举办 40 余场部委主题日活动，涵盖法规标准宣贯、典型案例发布与食品安全营养科普，并通过「你点我检」等公众参与形式推进社会共治。
    China's State Council food safety office launched the 2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week in Beijing on Sep 22 with 27 departments under the theme of deepening whole-chain regulation. More than 40 ministerial theme-day events will cover standards training, case releases and nutrition education, with public participation mechanisms such as the 'you order, we test' program.
  • 全国儿童青少年「五健」促进行动工作交流会暨培训班召开
    National Training Session Held for the Children and Adolescents 'Five Healths' Promotion Initiative
    全国儿童青少年「五健」促进行动工作交流会暨培训班近日召开，围绕视力、体重、心理、骨骼、口腔五大健康促进行动部署落地路径，推动各地整合学校、医疗机构与家庭场景开展筛查、干预与健康教育。该行动与「十五五」健康规划中儿童青少年健康促进行动相衔接，是肥胖防控与近视、脊柱问题协同治理的重要抓手。
    A national exchange and training session for the 'Five Healths' initiative for children and adolescents laid out implementation pathways across vision, weight, mental health, bone and oral health, mobilizing schools, medical institutions and families for screening, intervention and education. The program aligns with the 15th Five-Year health plan's child and adolescent health promotion actions.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-09-26
item.description: 2026-09-26 简报，共 20 条：仁济医院团队 Science 揭示成纤维细胞调控肠道免疫抗肠炎新机制；工程益生菌化身“肿瘤药厂”：结肠癌小鼠模型肿瘤缩小 43%；VA 盲法 RCT 亚分析：FMT 治复发性艰难梭菌未改善生活质量；国家卫健委答复强化糖尿病综合防治：营养标签新国标强制标示糖与饱和脂肪；北大韩敬东/陈嘉伟 Nature Aging：AI 锁定口腔“长寿菌”奈瑟氏菌；第五届中国基础医学发展大会首届衰老与健康研讨会：专家称“长寿药并不存在，逆龄是商业炒作”；《基因组精神病学》系统综述：警惕衰老测量指标混淆“治病”与“抗衰”；Nature Metabolism：肌肉干细胞靠 PFKM 代谢“开关”先修复后生长；Nutrition Reviews 荟萃：基因导向膳食建议仅多减重 0.52 公斤；AJKD RCT：植物蛋白主导饮食可降低晚期 CKD 患者尿毒症毒素；JAMA Psychiatry：抑郁症患者限制超加工食品的非药物干预初见成效；Frontiers 综述：饮食、生活方式与宿主因素如何塑造菌群-宿主互作的个体差异；Balchem 维生素 K2 研究显示与冠脉钙化进展放缓 21% 相关；研究：社交媒体补剂营销误导信息泛滥；Alice Mushrooms 案件检验成分实证边界：功能性蘑菇品牌面临声称审查；NutraIngredients 趋势追踪：AI 双刃剑与健康span新品集中发布；48 位专家共议慢病早期预防：《“十保九减八防”专家共识》发布；贵州 68 家三级公立综合医院健康体重管理门诊全覆盖，累计接诊超 6 万人次；PATHFINDER 2 前瞻研究：多癌早检血液测试覆盖 17 种癌，阳性预测值 60.3%；三部门部署中秋国庆及秋冬季重点传染病防治：强化智能监测预警
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 仁济医院团队 Science 揭示成纤维细胞调控肠道免疫抗肠炎新机制
    Renji Team in Science Reveals How Fibroblasts Orchestrate Gut Immunity Against Colitis
    上海仁济医院周磊、林清霞团队在 Science 发表研究，阐明肠道成纤维细胞通过特定信号通路调控局部免疫反应、抑制肠道炎症的新机制。该发现为炎症性肠病等功能医学视角下的黏膜免疫失衡干预提供了新靶点，也为菌群-免疫-屏障轴的精准调节研究补充了关键环节。
    A team led by Zhou Lei and Lin Qingxia at Shanghai Renji Hospital published in Science a new mechanism whereby intestinal fibroblasts regulate local immune responses and restrain gut inflammation via specific signaling pathways. The finding offers fresh targets for mucosal immune imbalance in inflammatory bowel disease and enriches the microbiome-immunity-barrier axis in functional medicine research.
  • 工程益生菌化身“肿瘤药厂”：结肠癌小鼠模型肿瘤缩小 43%
    Engineered Probiotic Acts as a Tumor Drug Factory, Cutting Colorectal Tumors by 43% in Mice
    发表于 Science Translational Medicine 的研究将益生菌大肠杆菌 Nissle 1917 改造成肿瘤内定向“制药工厂”：细菌富集于肿瘤后原位生成 5-氟尿嘧啶，并叠加免疫激活与 PD-L1 阻断功能。小鼠实验中结肠肿瘤体积减少 43%，3/7 肿瘤完全消退，为活体微生物疗法联合化免治疗提供概念验证。
    A Science Translational Medicine study reprogrammed probiotic E. coli Nissle 1917 into an in-tumor drug factory: bacteria enriched in tumors locally convert 5-fluorocytosine into 5-fluorouracil while additionally stimulating immunity and blocking PD-L1. Colorectal tumors in mice shrank by 43%, with three of seven eliminated — a proof of concept for live biotherapeutics combined with chemoimmunotherapy.
  • VA 盲法 RCT 亚分析：FMT 治复发性艰难梭菌未改善生活质量
    VA Blinded RCT Subanalysis: FMT Fails to Improve Quality of Life in Recurrent C. difficile
    9 月上传于 Research Square 的预印本对 VA 安慰剂对照 FMT 随机试验进行生活质量亚分析：胶囊 FMT 组与安慰剂组的胃肠生活质量指数无显著差异，且该试验主结果同样未显示复发率获益。作者强调应将患者报告结局纳入 FMT 试验常规终点，提示不同制剂与递送方式的疗效差异需审慎解读。
    A September preprint on Research Square reports a quality-of-life subanalysis of the VA placebo-controlled FMT randomized trial: encapsulated FMT showed no significant difference from placebo on the GI Quality of Life Index, and the main trial likewise found no recurrence benefit. The authors urge patient-reported outcomes as standard FMT endpoints, cautioning that formulation and delivery may explain divergent results.
  • 国家卫健委答复强化糖尿病综合防治：营养标签新国标强制标示糖与饱和脂肪
    NHC Outlines Strengthened Diabetes Prevention: New Nutrition Label Rules Mandate Sugar and Saturated Fat Labeling
    国家卫健委在答复全国人大代表建议时系统介绍糖尿病防治进展：联合 14 部门印发防治行动实施方案提出 24 条措施；修订《预包装食品营养标签通则》将糖与饱和脂肪新增为强制标示项并增加儿童青少年提示语；在校园限制销售含糖饮料，强化三减三健与医防融合监测体系。
    Replying to a deputy's proposal, China's National Health Commission outlined diabetes prevention measures: a 24-point action plan with 14 ministries, revised nutrition labeling rules making sugar and saturated fat mandatory label items with youth-specific warnings, restrictions on sugary drinks in schools, and strengthened screening and integrated prevention-treatment monitoring.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 北大韩敬东/陈嘉伟 Nature Aging：AI 锁定口腔“长寿菌”奈瑟氏菌
    Peking University Team in Nature Aging: AI Pinpoints Oral “Longevity Bacterium” Neisseria flavescens
    北京大学韩敬东、陈嘉伟团队在 Nature Aging 发表研究，用生成式多模态框架 AURORA 构建衰老时钟并对干预进行算术筛选，鉴定出口腔共生菌 Neisseria flavescens 为核心延寿菌：在线虫中延长寿命与健康span，老年小鼠补充热灭活菌可逆转血清代谢组、肝脏转录组与肠道菌群至更年轻状态，提示口腔微生物组是系统性衰老的被低估轴。
    Peking University's Han Jingdong and Chen Jiawei reported in Nature Aging that AURORA, a generative multi-modality framework for aging clocks and in silico intervention screening, identified oral commensal Neisseria flavescens as a geroprotective microbe: it extended lifespan and healthspan in C. elegans, and heat-killed N. flavescens in aged mice shifted serum metabolome, liver transcriptome and gut microbiome toward younger states — framing the oral microbiome as an underestimated axis of systemic aging.
  • 第五届中国基础医学发展大会首届衰老与健康研讨会：专家称“长寿药并不存在，逆龄是商业炒作”
    China's 5th Basic Medical Development Congress Debuts Aging & Health Symposium: “No Longevity Pills — Reversal Claims Are Hype”
    中国医学科学院北京协和医学院主办的第五届中国基础医学发展大会暨首届衰老与健康研讨会上，西湖大学付向东提出衰老“耗竭理论”，北京大学韩敬东展示整合 58 万样本的生成式 AI 衰老时钟。与会专家普遍认为基于现有研究“长寿药”并不存在，逆龄概念属商业炒作，呼吁把基础研究与临床需求结合，服务健康老龄化。
    At the 5th China Basic Medical Development Congress and first Aging & Health Symposium hosted by the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, Fu Xiangdong of Westlake University proposed a “resource exhaustion” theory of aging, while Peking University's Han Jingdong presented generative AI aging clocks trained on 580,000 samples. Experts agreed that no true “longevity pill” exists yet, called anti-aging reversal claims commercial hype, and urged tighter basic research-clinical integration.
  • 《基因组精神病学》系统综述：警惕衰老测量指标混淆“治病”与“抗衰”
    Genomic Psychiatry Review Warns Aging Metrics May Confuse Disease Treatment With Slower Aging
    发表于《基因组精神病学》的系统性综述指出，广泛使用的衰老测量方法——表观遗传时钟、虚弱指数与衰老标志物框架——可能混淆真正的衰老减缓与疾病特异性改善；不同物种主要死因差异巨大，通过延缓癌症延长小鼠寿命不等于减缓多系统衰退。作者呼吁区分基线效应与速率效应，建立跨组织、跨物种的标准化表型评估体系。
    A systematic review in Genomic Psychiatry argues that widely used aging metrics — epigenetic clocks, frailty indices and hallmark frameworks — may confound genuine slowing of aging with disease-specific improvement. Because leading causes of death differ vastly across species, extending mouse lifespan by delaying cancer is not equivalent to slowing multisystem decline. The authors call for separating baseline from rate effects and standardized cross-tissue, cross-species phenotyping.
  • Nature Metabolism：肌肉干细胞靠 PFKM 代谢“开关”先修复后生长
    Nature Metabolism: Muscle Stem Cells Use a PFKM Metabolic Switch to Repair Before They Grow
    加州大学尔湾分校团队在 Nature Metabolism 揭示肌肉干细胞应对压力的代谢时序：通过 PFKM 酶暂时减缓能量生产，将葡萄糖转向抗氧化修复，完成后再重启能量生产构建肌纤维。该机制为年龄增长、损伤及 GLP-1 减重药物导致的肌肉流失干预提供了代谢“构建块”补充的新思路。
    UC Irvine researchers reported in Nature Metabolism that muscle stem cells respond to stress with a metabolic timing mechanism: the enzyme PFKM temporarily dials down energy production to divert glucose toward antioxidant repair, then restarts energy production to build new fibers. The finding suggests metabolic “building block” supplementation strategies against muscle loss from aging, injury and GLP-1 weight-loss drugs.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nutrition Reviews 荟萃：基因导向膳食建议仅多减重 0.52 公斤
    Nutrition Reviews Meta-Analysis: Genetics-Based Diet Advice Adds Just 0.52 kg Weight Loss
    9 月 24 日发表于 Nutrition Reviews 的荟萃分析汇总 8 项随机对照试验：与常规膳食建议相比，基于基因型的个性化营养与生活方式建议仅额外减重 0.52 公斤、BMI 多降 0.30，体脂率无显著差异。结果显示基因导向营养的群体平均获益微小，提示基因检测应作为个性化营养的参考数据点而非“捷径”。
    A meta-analysis published September 24 in Nutrition Reviews pooled 8 randomized trials: genetics-based personalized nutrition and lifestyle advice produced only 0.52 kg extra weight loss and 0.30 BMI reduction versus standard advice, with no change in body fat percentage. The average population benefit is tiny, suggesting genetic testing should serve as one data point in precision nutrition rather than a shortcut.
  • AJKD RCT：植物蛋白主导饮食可降低晚期 CKD 患者尿毒症毒素
    AJKD RCT: Normoproteic Plant-Dominant Diets Lower Uremic Toxins in Advanced CKD
    发表于 American Journal of Kidney Diseases 的随机对照试验显示，在保持正常蛋白摄入的前提下采用植物蛋白为主的饮食，可通过靶向肠道菌群显著降低晚期慢性肾病患者的尿毒症毒素水平。研究为“营养干预调节肠菌、减轻肾脏负担”的精准营养路径提供了高级别临床证据。
    A randomized controlled trial in the American Journal of Kidney Diseases showed that a normoproteic, plant-dominant diet significantly reduced uremic toxin levels in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease by targeting the gut microbiota. The results provide high-level clinical evidence for precision nutrition strategies that modulate gut microbes to ease renal burden.
  • JAMA Psychiatry：抑郁症患者限制超加工食品的非药物干预初见成效
    JAMA Psychiatry: Cutting Ultra-Processed Foods Shows Early Promise for Depression
    JAMA Psychiatry 发表的短篇研究探讨从抑郁症患者饮食中移除超加工食品的非药物干预路径，初步结果显示可行性并在情绪结局上初见成效。研究将饮食质量作为精神健康的可调节靶点，为“营养精神病学”与菌群-肠-脑轴导向的个体化膳食干预积累了早期证据。
    A short article in JAMA Psychiatry explored removing ultra-processed foods from the diets of patients with depression as a non-pharmacological intervention. Early results suggest feasibility and promising mood outcomes, positioning diet quality as a modifiable target in psychiatric care and adding early evidence for nutritional psychiatry and microbiome-gut-brain-directed personalized dietary intervention.
  • Frontiers 综述：饮食、生活方式与宿主因素如何塑造菌群-宿主互作的个体差异
    Frontiers Review: Dietary, Lifestyle and Host Determinants of Microbiota-Host Interactions
    墨西哥锡那罗亚自治大学团队 9 月 25 日接收于 Frontiers in Microbiomes 的叙述性综述系统梳理膳食模式、食物成分、运动、睡眠与昼夜节律、衰老及药物暴露对肠道菌群组成与功能的调节作用，强调个体间差异是核心特征，提出整合菌群数据与宿主及环境特征的个性化营养框架，并呼吁纵向研究与多组学验证。
    A narrative review from Universidad Autónoma de Sinaloa, accepted September 25 in Frontiers in Microbiomes, maps how dietary patterns, food components, exercise, sleep and circadian rhythms, aging and medication exposure shape gut microbial composition and function. Highlighting interindividual variability as the central feature, it proposes a personalized nutrition framework integrating microbiome, host and environmental data, and calls for longitudinal multi-omics validation.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • Balchem 维生素 K2 研究显示与冠脉钙化进展放缓 21% 相关
    Balchem's Vitamin K2 Linked to 21% Slower Coronary Calcium Progression
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日报道，Balchem 公司 K2VITAL DELTA 型维生素 K2（MK-7）的长期研究数据显示，补充与冠状动脉钙化（CAC）进展速度放缓 21% 相关，提示维生素 K2 可能通过激活基质 Gla 蛋白引导钙沉积、减少血管钙化，为心血管长期健康管理提供具成本效益的营养干预线索，仍需更大型硬终点试验确认。
    NutraIngredients reported on September 25 that long-term data on Balchem's K2VITAL DELTA vitamin K2 (MK-7) link supplementation with 21% slower coronary artery calcium (CAC) progression. The findings suggest K2 may direct calcium deposition via matrix Gla protein activation and reduce vascular calcification, hinting at a cost-effective nutritional lever for long-term cardiovascular health — pending confirmation in larger hard-endpoint trials.
  • 研究：社交媒体补剂营销误导信息泛滥
    Social Media Rife With Misleading Supplement Marketing, Researchers Find
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日报道的新研究系统审查社交媒体上的膳食补剂营销内容，发现夸大功效、未经证实健康声称与隐晦广告普遍存在，缺乏充分科学依据的“种草”内容大量触达消费者。研究者呼吁平台加强审核、行业提升声称实证标准，也为功能医学与营养从业者做科学传播提供警示样本。
    New research covered by NutraIngredients on September 25 systematically reviewed dietary supplement marketing on social media and found pervasive exaggerated efficacy claims, unsubstantiated health statements and covert advertising reaching consumers at scale without adequate scientific backing. The authors call for stronger platform moderation and higher substantiation standards — a caution for practitioners doing science communication in nutrition and functional medicine.
  • Alice Mushrooms 案件检验成分实证边界：功能性蘑菇品牌面临声称审查
    Alice Mushrooms Case Tests the Limits of Ingredient Substantiation
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日分析 Alice Mushrooms 功能性蘑菇产品相关案件，聚焦“成品证据”与“原料推断证据”的边界：品牌引用成分研究支持终端产品声称是否充分，正成为功能性蘑菇、适应原等热门品类的监管与诉讼焦点，为补剂行业标注实证与合规策略敲响警钟。
    A September 25 NutraIngredients analysis of the Alice Mushrooms functional mushroom case examines the boundary between finished-product evidence and ingredient-level inference: whether citing ingredient studies sufficiently supports end-product claims is becoming a regulatory and litigation flashpoint for mushrooms and adaptogens — a warning shot for supplement substantiation and compliance strategy.
  • NutraIngredients 趋势追踪：AI 双刃剑与健康span新品集中发布
    NutraIngredients Trend Tracker: AI's Pros and Cons and a Wave of Healthspan Launches
    NutraIngredients 9 月 25 日趋势追踪栏目盘点：AI 正同时赋能补剂行业的个性化推荐与新品研发，也带来虚假营销与过度承诺风险；健康span（健康寿命）导向的多成分组合新品集中上市，品牌更多把细胞健康科学嵌入整体健康老龄化产品组合，反映“从延寿叙事转向循证日常产品”的行业转变。
    NutraIngredients' September 25 trend tracker rounds up how AI is simultaneously powering personalization and product development in supplements while amplifying misinformation and overclaiming risks; healthspan-oriented multi-ingredient launches are clustering as brands fold cellular-health science into broader healthy-aging portfolios — a shift from longevity narratives toward evidence-based everyday products.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 48 位专家共议慢病早期预防：《“十保九减八防”专家共识》发布
    48-Expert Consensus Issued: “Ten Keeps, Nine Reductions, Eight Preventions” for Early Chronic Disease Prevention
    国家科技重大专项项目组牵头、48 位多学科专家共同制定的《面向个体健康行为促进的慢性病早期预防专家共识》近日在《中国慢性病预防与控制》发表，提出保持十种健康生活方式、减少九类风险因素、防止八项相关侵害的系统化框架，覆盖饮食、运动、睡眠、体重、疫苗接种与新技术合理使用等，为成年居民提供普适化健康行为处方。
    A consensus on early chronic disease prevention, drafted by a national major science program team with 48 multidisciplinary experts and published in the Chinese Journal of Prevention and Control of Chronic Diseases, sets out a systematic framework of ten healthy lifestyle behaviors, nine risk-factor reductions and eight harm preventions — spanning diet, exercise, sleep, weight, vaccination and proper use of health devices — as a universal behavioral prescription for adults.
  • 贵州 68 家三级公立综合医院健康体重管理门诊全覆盖，累计接诊超 6 万人次
    Guizhou Achieves Full Coverage of Weight-Management Clinics Across 68 Tertiary Public Hospitals
    据贵州省卫健委消息，全省 68 家三级公立综合医院已全部设置健康体重管理门诊，截至 8 月底累计接诊 6 万余人次。当地依托临床营养科、内分泌科、儿科等多学科资源并注重中西医协同，集中推进体重管理门诊建设，为“体重管理年”从政策到基层落地提供了省级样板。
    Guizhou's health commission says all 68 tertiary public hospitals in the province now run health weight-management clinics, with over 60,000 visits logged by the end of August. Built on multidisciplinary resources — clinical nutrition, endocrinology and pediatrics — with emphasis on integrated Chinese-Western medicine, the program offers a provincial model for taking national weight-management policy to the grassroots.
  • PATHFINDER 2 前瞻研究：多癌早检血液测试覆盖 17 种癌，阳性预测值 60.3%
    PATHFINDER 2: Multi-Cancer Blood Test Detects 17 Cancer Types With 60.3% Positive Predictive Value
    发表于 Nature Medicine 的前瞻性 PATHFINDER 2 研究纳入 35,878 名 50 岁以上成人：多癌早检（MCED）血液测试在 32,007 人主分析中识别 287 例阳性，阳性预测值 60.3%、特异性 99.64%，检出癌种中 72.8% 目前无常规筛查推荐，53% 为 I-II 期。研究者强调该测试应作为现有筛查的补充而非替代。
    The prospective PATHFINDER 2 study published in Nature Medicine enrolled 35,878 adults aged 50 and older: the multi-cancer early detection (MCED) blood test flagged 287 positive results among 32,007 in the primary analysis, with a 60.3% positive predictive value and 99.64% specificity; 72.8% of detected cancers currently have no routine screening, and 53% were stage I-II. Researchers stress it should complement, not replace, existing screening.
  • 三部门部署中秋国庆及秋冬季重点传染病防治：强化智能监测预警
    Three Agencies Deploy Pre-Holiday and Autumn-Winter Infectious Disease Prevention With Smart Surveillance
    9 月 24 日国家疾控局联合国家卫健委、国家中医药局召开全国视频会议，部署中秋国庆假期前后及秋冬季重点传染病防治：要求加强多渠道监测、用好国家传染病智能监测预警前置软件，健全入境疑似病例闭环处置机制，及时处置蚊媒与人畜共患病聚集性疫情，并广泛开展爱国卫生运动与健康科普。
    On September 24 the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, with the National Health Commission and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, held a national video meeting on infectious disease control around the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays and autumn-winter season — strengthening multi-channel surveillance with the national intelligent early-warning software, closed-loop handling of imported suspected cases, prompt response to vector-borne and zoonotic clusters, and broad health education.
